Dr. Sophia Yin, a renowned California veterinarian and pioneering figure in humane pet-training, died by suicide at age 48. According to the Yolo County coroner, Dr. Yin was found at her home in Davis, with the cause of death listed as asphyxiation by hanging. Friends, family, and thousands of followers have expressed shock at her passing, turning her professional Facebook page—which has over 62,000 followers—into a memorial filled with tributes.

During her career, Dr. Yin taught humane animal-training techniques to trainers and owners in the U.S., Germany, and Canada. She authored three influential books: 'Perfect Puppy in 7 Days,' 'How to Behave So Your Dog Behaves,' and 'Low Stress Handling, Restraint and Behavior Modification of Cats & Dogs.' Her research and methods appeared in seminars, magazines, academic journals, and other educational materials.

Dr. Yin was also a respected leader in organizations such as the American Humane Association and the American Veterinary Society of Animal Behavior. Since her death, her Facebook page has been flooded with condolences, as many recall her pioneering work, compassion, and lasting impact on both people and animals.

The family and staff have requested privacy as they navigate this sudden and profound loss. Information about survivors or memorial services has not been made public.

During a federal court hearing, Dr. Raymond Patterson, a psychiatrist familiar with John Hinckley Jr.'s case, recommended that Hinckley should not be allowed unsupervised time when visiting his mother’s home in Virginia. Patterson, who evaluated Hinckley both in the 1980s and more recently, said he became concerned after learning that Hinckley had misrepresented how he spent his unsupervised hours—for example, claiming to have seen movies when he had not. When questioned, Hinckley minimized these actions, referring to the concerns as ‘nitpicking.’

Hinckley, who was found not guilty by reason of insanity after shooting President Ronald Reagan and three others in 1981, now spends ten days per month at his elderly mother’s residence in Williamsburg, Virginia, a gated community. During these visits, he is granted three hours of unsupervised time on two occasions, with Secret Service agents sometimes monitoring him without his knowledge. St. Elizabeths Hospital, where Hinckley is under care, is seeking approval to lengthen his visits—first to two 17-day visits, then several 24-day stays—which could eventually allow him permanent outpatient status.

Patterson, the former director of forensic psychiatry at St. Elizabeths, argued against these changes, citing Hinckley’s history of deception and unhealthy relationships as risk factors. He pointed to Hinckley’s past fixation on actress Jodie Foster—a motive behind his attempt to assassinate Reagan—and noted that even years afterwards, images of Foster were found in Hinckley’s room. Patterson asserted these traits signal potential danger to himself or others.

Barry Levine, Hinckley’s lawyer, contends there is no evidence demonstrating his client’s current danger, also arguing that Secret Service observations about Hinckley’s bookstore visits do not prove he viewed material on assassinations. The court hearing to decide whether Hinckley will get increased freedoms is ongoing and is set to continue on Monday.

Patterson, som utvärderat Hinckley både på 1980-talet och nyligen, uttryckte oro efter att ha fått veta att Hinckley lämnat felaktiga uppgifter om hur han tillbringade sin obevakade tid – bland annat påstod han att han gick på bio när han i själva verket inte gjorde det. När han konfronterades avfärdade Hinckley det hela som 'petitesser.'

article_content: Juan Martin del Potro is now a back-to-back champion at the Estoril Open, joining an exclusive group of three who have defended the title. In Sunday’s final, the Argentine controlled play against France’s Richard Gasquet, sealing victory 6-4, 6-2 in just 88 minutes. Del Potro got off to a fast start, breaking Gasquet early and capitalizing on mistakes made by his opponent. After the win, Del Potro said it was his strongest game of the week and highlighted his hard work to reach peak form, looking ahead to upcoming tournaments.  Gasquet congratulated Del Potro, complimenting his power and all-around game. Although disappointed by another final loss, he recognized that he has often faced the world’s best players in these situations.  Elsewhere, German player Philipp Kohlschreiber delighted local fans by winning the Munich ATP title, beating Croatia’s Marin Cilic in straight sets: 7-6 (10/8), 6-3. This win marks his second Munich victory in five years and will likely move him into the ATP’s top 25. Kohlschreiber said winning at home is an incredible experience.  Despite a close first set, Cilic finished as runner-up in Munich for the second time but remains positive, choosing to focus on the upcoming Madrid Open.  Looking forward, the clay court season shifts to the Madrid Open, which is debuting blue clay—a change that has sparked debate. Top players Djokovic, Nadal, and Federer are expected to compete.

This Christmas is expected to be Addie Fausett’s last. To make the holiday especially meaningful, her family is gathering festive cards for her. Addie, a six-year-old from Fountain Green, Utah, weighs just 23 pounds and suffers from an undiagnosed illness that has caused cerebral atrophy, affecting her brain function. She struggles daily to speak, move, and play with her siblings, Shayley and Audree. Last month, the family received the devastating prognosis that Addie has about a year left to live.

In an effort to brighten her final Christmas, Addie’s parents, Tami Fausett and her father, along with her grandparents, launched a campaign to collect a 'lifetime of cards' from friends and strangers alike. Cards have begun arriving from well-wishers across the country. Addie enjoys counting them and displaying them throughout their home.

'Because she doesn’t get to play with kids, we thought if everyone sent her a card, it would help make her Christmas a little better,' said Tami Fausett to KSL.com. The family hopes to cover all the walls with cards for Addie.

Addie’s grandmother expressed her gratitude on the Facebook page ‘Little Addie,’ which was set up to support the card-collecting initiative. She wrote, 'I feel like we are sharing Addie with the world for Christmas. Your kind and comforting words have warmed our hearts. Addie and her sisters are smiling, and their mom is happy to see them smile. Thank you, everyone.'

Addie began undergoing hospital tests at age three after she stopped growing. Over the past three years, her condition has worsened, and she has gained little weight. 'She likes to laugh, have fun, and listen to stories, but lately, there are days she just cries,' said her mother. 'Cerebral atrophy is just a symptom; the underlying cause is still unknown. They told us she probably has about a year.'

Those wishing to send Addie and her siblings a card can mail them to Box 162, Fountain Green, Utah, 84632.

Den här julen förväntas bli Addie Fausetts sista. För att göra högtiden extra speciell samlar hennes familj in julkort till henne. Hon har dagliga svårigheter att prata, röra sig och leka med sina syskon, Shayley och Audree. Förra månaden fick familjen det förkrossande beskedet att Addie har ungefär ett år kvar att leva.

För att göra Addies sista jul så fin som möjligt startade hennes föräldrar, Tami Fausett och hennes pappa, tillsammans med mor- och farföräldrar, en kampanj för att samla in ett 'livstids förråd av kort' från både vänner och främlingar. Nu strömmar korten in från personer över hela landet. Addie tycker om att räkna dem och hänga upp dem runt om i hemmet.

"Eftersom hon inte kan leka med andra barn tänkte vi att om alla skickade henne ett kort så skulle det göra hennes jul lite bättre," sa Tami Fausett till KSL.com. Familjen hoppas kunna täcka alla väggar med kort för Addie.

Addies mormor uttryckte sin tacksamhet på Facebook-sidan 'Little Addie', som skapades för att stödja kortinsamlingen. Hon skrev: "Jag känner att vi delar Addie med världen inför jul. Addie började genomgå sjukhusundersökningar när hon var tre år efter att hon hade slutat växa. De senaste tre åren har hennes tillstånd förvärrats, och hon har gått upp väldigt lite i vikt. "Hon tycker om att skratta, ha roligt och höra berättelser, men på sistone har det varit många dagar då hon bara gråter," säger hennes mamma. A Mexico City metro driver was captured on video playing FarmVille on his tablet while operating a train. Passenger Carlo Segura Linares recorded the video on his mobile phone after boarding the train, and it shows the driver playing the game between the Cuatro Caminos and Tasqueña stations. Mr. Linares expressed disbelief and concern for passenger safety, stating that he wanted to document the incident so others would believe it and understand the risks involved. The video, which was posted online and widely shared on social media, triggered significant public outrage. As a result, the driver has been suspended from duty.

The Mexico City Metro company issued a statement confirming that disciplinary action was underway and that the driver had failed to meet acceptable standards or follow internal protocols. The Mexico City Metro is one of the largest underground systems worldwide, transporting more than 1.6 billion passengers in 2012 and ranking eighth globally in passenger volume.

FarmVille, the game seen in the video, is an interactive online farming simulation developed by Zynga. Players manage virtual farms, harvest crops, and raise animals to earn in-game currency and points. While the game can be played for free, some players choose to make purchases with real money. At its peak in 2011, Zynga, the maker of FarmVille, was valued at up to £5.6 billion.

article_content: Since 2010, entertainment companies have increasingly relied on reimagining classic franchises—often in the form of remakes and reboots—to drive profits. Disney's live-action 'Alice in Wonderland' remake that year spurred a wave of 14 such films, earning $3.2 billion at the domestic box office over the following decade. Warner Bros., anticipating the end of its profitable 'Harry Potter' film series, partnered with Universal Orlando in 2010 to launch The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, capitalizing on millennials’ affection for franchise-themed merchandise. Other studios followed: Sony rebooted 'Spider-Man,' Fox reimagined 'X-Men,' and DC relaunched 'Superman.' This surge in reboots and revivals is not coincidental. These companies successfully tap into nostalgia, an emotion that can be both comforting and commercially lucrative. While nostalgia’s origins are complex, research suggests it is closely linked to feelings of loneliness—particularly among younger people. A 2006 series of experiments from the University of Southampton, published in the Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, used manipulations of loneliness scores to investigate how such feelings impact nostalgia. Participants, believing their loneliness levels were higher or lower than average, then completed an established nostalgia inventory. Those primed to feel more lonely consistently scored higher in nostalgia, especially for memories about family, dependable relationships, and simpler times. Broader data indicates that loneliness is on the rise, especially among young adults. Cigna’s health surveys found that by 2020, 61% of Americans reported feeling lonely—a 7-percentage-point increase since 2018. Additional surveys from Pew Research and Gallup confirm that large proportions of Americans regularly experience loneliness, with rates highest among those aged 18–29. Meta-analyses of loneliness studies dating back to the 1970s show a steady rise in reported loneliness among young adults through 2012. This environment has supported the growth of nostalgia-driven entertainment. Legacy sequels, such as 'Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull,' 'TRON: Legacy,' 'Jurassic World,' and others, have become box office hits. Top films and video games today are often continuations of decades-old franchises, while audiences increasingly favor older books and TV shows over new content. In 2021, backlist titles made up 68% of book sales, and evergreen pop culture properties account for the majority of Funko’s merchandise sales. With loneliness rates high and nostalgia selling better than ever, studios show little sign of slowing the trend. Numerous high-profile reboots and adaptations are already in production to meet ongoing demand. This article is excerpted and adapted from Walt Hickey's book, 'You Are What You Watch: How Movies and TV Affect Everything.'

En serie experiment 2006 från University of Southampton, publicerad i Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, manipulerade känslor av ensamhet för att undersöka hur det påverkade nostalgi. Deltagarna, som trodde att de var mer eller mindre ensamma än genomsnittet, genomförde därefter ett etablerat nostalgi-test. De som förbereddes på att känna sig mer ensamma fick genomgående högre nostalgi-poäng, särskilt när det gällde minnen om familj, pålitliga relationer och enklare tider. Bredare data visar att ensamhet ökar, särskilt bland unga vuxna. Cignas hälsoundersökningar visar att 2020 rapporterade 61% av amerikanerna att de kände sig ensamma – en ökning med 7 procentenheter sedan 2018. Meta-analyser av ensamhetsstudier som går tillbaka till 1970-talet pekar på en stadig ökning av rapporterad ensamhet bland unga vuxna fram till 2012. Denna miljö har gynnat tillväxten av nostalgi-drivna underhållning. Legacy-sequels som 'Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull', 'TRON: Legacy', 'Jurassic World' och andra har blivit publiksuccéer. Toppfilmer och tv-spel idag är ofta fortsättningar på decennier gamla franchise, samtidigt som publiken i allt större utsträckning väljer äldre böcker och tv-serier framför nytt. 2021 stod backlist-titlar för 68% av bokförsäljningen, och tidlösa popkulturfenomen utgör majoriteten av Funkos produktförsäljning. Med höga nivåer av ensamhet och stora försäljningsframgångar för nostalgi, finns få tecken på att trenden avtar. Flera stora omstarter och anpassningar är redan i produktion för att möta den fortsatta efterfrågan. article_content: President Bola Tinubu assured potential investors on Friday that their investments are safe in Nigeria. He based this assurance on recent economic reforms by his administration, including the removal of fuel subsidies and the unification of the foreign exchange market, which aim to improve the ease of doing business. Speaking at the Saudi-Africa Summit in Riyadh, Tinubu told Saudi investors their investments would be protected by the rule of law and would generate good returns in Africa’s largest economy. This statement was confirmed by Ajuri Ngelale, Special Adviser to the President on Media and Publicity. Tinubu’s remarks came shortly after meeting with Saudi Arabia’s Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Adel Al-Jubeir, who officially invited him to the summit. The President voiced his intention to enhance cooperation with Saudi Arabia in combating terrorist organizations such as Boko Haram and ISWAP operating in the Lake Chad and Sahel regions. He also noted that Nigeria, like Saudi Arabia, is working to diversify its economy beyond oil to encourage sustainable development. Tinubu emphasized that his administration has implemented reforms to facilitate easier business operations and highlighted the significance of the Nigeria-Saudi Business Council. Reflecting on more than sixty years of diplomatic relations, Tinubu stated that cooperation between Nigeria and Saudi Arabia has expanded to cover many shared interests. He expressed pride in the large number of Nigerian professionals, including doctors and footballers, contributing in Saudi Arabia. He added that both nations, being members of major international organizations, effectively use these platforms to strengthen bilateral cooperation. Tinubu expressed appreciation to Saudi Arabia for its humanitarian assistance through the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre. On climate change, he highlighted its impact in accelerating desertification and flooding in Nigeria and elsewhere in Africa, commending both countries for their efforts to address these challenges. He referenced Nigeria’s recently launched Energy Transition Plan, which aims for net-zero carbon emissions by 2060, while promoting industrial development and universal access to clean energy. President Tinubu called for an immediate ceasefire in the Middle East, notably in Palestine, urging a swift and peaceful resolution to the conflict. He reaffirmed Nigeria’s strong support for Riyadh’s bid to host Expo 2030 and the 2034 FIFA Men’s World Cup, noting that such global events are expected to bring wide-ranging economic and political benefits. The candidate cities for Expo 2030 are Busan, Rome, and Riyadh. On October 20, Tinubu also received a delegation from South Korea, led by Special Envoy Won Hee-Ryong, seeking Nigeria’s support for Busan’s bid to host the Expo.

article_content: A water main burst in Kennington, south London, overnight, flooding Clapham Road with muddy water up to four inches deep. The water entered at least one basement flat and left a brown residue across the busy street, while firefighters rushed in to lay sandbags and stop further damage to homes. Clapham Road, a major thoroughfare where homes can cost over £800,000, was promptly closed for emergency cleanup work, forcing commuters to find alternative routes and causing heavy travel disruption. Initially, some residents and police believed sewage was leaking due to the foul smell and murky water, but Thames Water later confirmed a pressurized water main had burst, mixing clean water with mud and silt—no sewage was involved. One basement flat was reported flooded, but sandbags protected most other properties. Thames Water and local officials said the repairs would be complex because other utility pipes are located near the broken main. Engineers stopped the leak and restored water service to most customers by midnight. Cleanup and repairs on the road are ongoing, with no clear timeline for reopening. Residents such as Arthur Fitzpatrick and Angela Reynolds described how rapidly the water surged, with Reynolds saying the road became 'like a river' in just a few minutes. Many people shared pictures and updates on social media showing the difficult situation for local residents and workers. At the height of the emergency, four fire engines and around 20 firefighters responded. Crews pumped water from the flooded basement flat, laid sandbags to defend other homes, and worked to stabilize the area while daily life continued around them.

Till en början trodde vissa boende och poliser att det var avloppsvatten som läckte, på grund av den starka lukten och det grumliga vattnet, men Thames Water bekräftade senare att det handlade om en trasig vattenledning där rent vatten blandats med lera och silt—inget avloppsvatten var inblandat. Många delade bilder och uppdateringar på sociala medier som visade den svåra situationen för lokalbefolkningen och arbetande i området. Som mest var fyra brandbilar och runt 20 brandmän på plats. Räddningspersonal pumpade ut vatten från den översvämmade källarlägenheten, la ut sandsäckar för att skydda andra fastigheter och arbetade för att stabilisera området samtidigt som vardagslivet pågick runt dem.

article_content: Steven Carter, the father of murdered schoolgirl Tia Sharp, has revealed he is expecting a new child with his partner, Melissa Potter, later this year. Melissa Potter is approximately 14 weeks pregnant and is due to give birth in mid-December. Carter, 31, said he found out about the pregnancy a week before Stuart Hazell, Tia’s killer, went on trial. The couple, who already have a nine-year-old son named Thomas, kept the pregnancy private in order to focus on getting justice for Tia. Carter described the new baby as 'a blessing from Tia,' adding that although it might sound unusual, it gives the family something positive to look forward to. He emphasized that while they will never forget Tia, he does not believe she would want her family to be constantly grieving, and sees this as a chance to move forward. With Tia’s birthday and the first anniversary of her death approaching, Carter acknowledged the period is especially hard for the family. After the trial, the family took a short holiday to Majorca to help recover from their recent ordeal. Later this year, Carter will face the emotional task of redecorating Tia’s bedroom for the new baby, as the family does not yet know the baby’s sex. On Father’s Day, Carter’s son Thomas gave him a card signed 'from Thomas and Tia,' explaining he wrote it on Tia’s behalf. Carter said Thomas often asks about Tia, and that he has many photos of the siblings together. Steven Carter attended the first week of Stuart Hazell’s trial at the Old Bailey, where Hazell eventually pleaded guilty to Tia’s murder. Hazell, the 37-year-old former boyfriend of Tia’s grandmother Christine Bicknell, initially claimed Tia’s death was accidental before confessing, after months of denying responsibility. Hazell stated he panicked after Tia died, concealed her body in the loft, and was eventually arrested after police found her during a fourth search. Carter expressed anger and called for Hazell to face the death penalty, stating he does not consider the legal outcome to be true justice for Tia. Carter is upset about Hazell’s decision to appeal his 38-year prison sentence, criticizing the legal process and expressing frustration about the situation.

article_content: Second seed Elise Mertens capped a dominant week at the Jasmin Open Monastir in Tunisia by defeating top-seeded Jasmine Paolini of Italy 6-3, 6-0 in the final on Sunday. The Belgian player did not drop a set throughout the tournament, securing her eighth career singles title. She lost more than three games in a set only once during her run. In the final, Mertens won 63% of total points (57 out of 91), converted six of 11 break points, and won 74% of points on her first serve, compared to 40% for Paolini, during the 70-minute match. At the Jiangxi Open in Nanchang, China, Katerina Siniakova outlasted fellow Czech Marie Bouzkova 1-6, 7-6 (5), 7-6 (4) to win an all-Czech final. Siniakova overcame three match points, seven double faults, and a tough opening set, rallying for victory in a match that lasted three hours and 33 minutes—the longest WTA final of 2023. The second set alone lasted one hour and 40 minutes. After saving a championship point in the second set, Siniakova fell behind 5-3 in the third but saved two more match points, won three consecutive games, and eventually prevailed in the tiebreak. At the Transylvania Open in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, Germany's Tamara Korpatsch claimed her first career WTA title, defeating home favorite Ruse 6-3, 6-4. It was the 28-year-old Korpatsch's first tour final and took her one hour and 52 minutes to win. After falling behind 0-3 in the first set, she powered back to win six straight games and close out the set. Korpatsch converted six out of 10 break point chances against Ruse, a wild-card entrant.

Den belgiska spelaren tappade inte ett enda set under hela turneringen och säkrade sin åttonde singeltitel i karriären. Hon förlorade mer än tre game i ett set endast en gång under turneringen. article_content: I’ll never forget the day Roy Hodgson made me jump ten feet off my couch. It was a midweek afternoon, and I was at home winding down after training when Roy called to tell me he had important news: I was going to be his England captain. It was an unbelievable feeling, a real 'punch the air' moment, and I’m sure Wayne Rooney will experience the same emotions this week when my successor is announced. As far as I am concerned, there’s no more deserving candidate. Roy Hodgson has tremendous faith in Wayne. When the Manchester United striker was under pressure last summer and speculation about his place in the England team was growing, the manager stuck by him and played him in key games. It was a significant show of respect. On target: Wayne Rooney celebrates after scoring against Uruguay at the 2014 World Cup. Chilling out: Rooney and I relaxed during an England training session in the Algarve in May. Captain: Rooney led Manchester United for the pre-season friendly against Valencia on August 12. Red Devil: Rooney celebrates scoring against Swansea in Manchester United's Premier League opener. Perhaps other managers would have taken him out of the firing line when scrutiny increased, but Roy knows what Wayne brings to the team and, just as importantly, what he will contribute in the coming years. So why is Wayne the number one choice? First, he is a natural leader. Aside from being a top player who commands respect, Wayne is passionate about representing his country and won’t be fazed by the responsibility. Before games, he is one of the most vocal players in the dressing room. He wouldn’t be afraid to speak up, even one-to-one, telling teammates what’s expected. As my deputy, he gave me great support, and during our eleven years with England, I saw him mature. As a young player, he didn’t always say the right things, but he now chooses his words carefully. Teammates: I was congratulated by Rooney after scoring against Poland at Wembley last year. Called it a day: I retired from international football in July after earning 114 caps for England. Wayne is brave, too. He won’t hide in a game nor shy away from difficult questions from the media, whether he’s in world-class form or facing challenges. Don’t think, though, that he will criticize players publicly if things aren’t going well. That wasn’t my style, nor will it be his. He knows the best place for tough words is behind closed doors, and those he needs to speak to will appreciate his approach. It’s also important for an England captain to lead his club. The qualities that prompted Louis van Gaal to make Wayne United’s captain are the same that Roy has seen at every England gathering for the past two years. My England journey with Wayne began in March 2003. I’d known about him since he played for Everton’s Under-13 side with my cousin, Anthony. He was already attracting attention when he broke into Everton’s first team. The pressure increases when you’re selected for England. I remember when we joined up for the European Championship qualifier away to Liechtenstein, thinking ‘let’s see what you’ve got’ before training with him for the first time. I missed his debut against Australia the previous month due to injury. It quickly became clear this was his stage. In training, he chipped the ball over David James from nowhere—a bold move for a 17-year-old—but he acted as if it was the most natural thing. Everyone stopped to applaud. Not a bad way to settle into the group. Taking the armband isn’t new for Wayne—he’s led England against Brazil in 2009 in Qatar and San Marino in 2012—but it’s different when you’re not just a stand-in. Wearing the armband: Rooney is put under pressure by San Marino's Christian Brolli in October 2012. United: Rooney captained England for the friendly against Brazil in Doha in 2009. I couldn’t wait to walk into the dressing room after Roy gave me the news, and it will be the same for Wayne. He will be eager to get to Wembley for the Norway friendly, and the responsibility could inspire him to break Sir Bobby Charlton’s record of 49 goals. Everything is set for him now. He’s about to become captain, and the next two tournaments, in France and Russia, could define his legacy. We played together 71 times for England and at his best, he’s a world-class talent. After Brazil’s disappointment, this is a fresh start, and Wayne can lead the team positively into the new campaign. Tearful goodbye: I was emotional after my last match for England at the World Cup in Brazil. If and when he leads the team out on September 3, I’ll be delighted for him. We are two lads from Liverpool council estates who’ve loved playing for England, and I know what emotions Wayne will feel when he stands at the front in the tunnel. As for me, I know I’ve made the right decision and will enjoy a break, but I’ll miss playing for England. That’s for sure.

Det var en otrolig känsla, ett riktigt 'jubla i luften'-ögonblick, och jag är säker på att Wayne Rooney kommer att känna samma sak den här veckan när min efterträdare avslöjas. Enligt mig finns det ingen mer förtjänt kandidat. Roy Hodgson har enormt förtroende för Wayne. När Manchester United-anfallaren var under press förra sommaren och spekulationerna om hans plats i Englands landslag ökade, stod tränaren bakom honom och gav honom chansen i de viktiga matcherna. Det var ett betydande bevis på respekt. Målskytt: Wayne Rooney firar efter att ha gjort mål mot Uruguay i VM 2014. Slappnar av: Rooney och jag kopplade av under ett engelskt träningspass i Algarve i maj. Kapten: Rooney ledde Manchester United i träningsmatchen mot Valencia den 12 augusti. Red Devil: Rooney firar ett mål mot Swansea i Manchester Uniteds Premier League-premiär. Kanske hade andra tränare satt honom på bänken när pressen ökade, men Roy vet vad Wayne tillför laget och, minst lika viktigt, vad han kommer bidra med de kommande åren. Så varför är Wayne förstavalet? För det första är han en naturlig ledare. Utöver att vara en toppspelare som får respekt är Wayne passionerad om att representera sitt land och han kommer inte att bli skrämd av ansvaret. Inför matcher är han en av de mest högljudda spelarna i omklädningsrummet. Han tvekar inte att tala ut, även enskilt, och tala om för lagkamraterna vad som förväntas. Som min vicekapten stöttade han mig alltid, och under våra elva år i England såg jag honom växa. Som ung sa han inte alltid rätt saker, men nu väljer han sina ord noga. Lagkamrater: Rooney gratulerade mig efter mitt mål mot Polen på Wembley förra året. Lade av: Jag slutade med landslagsfotboll i juli efter att ha spelat 114 matcher för England. Wayne är också modig. Han gömmer sig aldrig under en match och drar sig inte för svåra frågor från media, oavsett om han är i toppform eller har det tufft. Han kommer inte heller kritisera spelare offentligt om det inte går bra. Det var inte min stil, och det kommer inte vara hans heller. Han vet att sådana samtal är bäst bakom stängda dörrar, och de han talar med kommer uppskatta hans sätt. Det är också viktigt att Englands kapten leder sitt klubblag. De egenskaper som fick Louis van Gaal att göra Wayne till Uniteds kapten är desamma som Roy har sett vid varje samling de senaste två åren. Min landslagsresa med Wayne började i mars 2003. Jag hade hört talas om honom sen han spelade i Evertons U13-lag med min kusin Anthony. Han fick redan då mycket uppmärksamhet när han slog sig in i Evertons A-lag. Pressen ökar när man blir uttagen till England. Jag minns när vi reste till EM-kvalet borta mot Liechtenstein och tänkte 'nu ska vi se vad du går för' innan jag tränade med honom första gången. Jag missade hans debut mot Australien månaden innan på grund av skada. Det blev snabbt tydligt att det här var hans scen. På träning chippade han bollen över David James från ingenstans – djärvt av en 17-åring – men han uppträdde som om det var helt normalt. Alla stannade upp och applåderade. Inte ett dumt sätt att komma in i gruppen. Att bära kaptensbindeln är inte nytt för Wayne – han har lett England mot Brasilien 2009 i Qatar och mot San Marino 2012 – men det är annorlunda när man är ordinarie kapten. Med bindeln: Rooney pressas av San Marinos Christian Brolli i oktober 2012. United: Rooney var Englands lagkapten i vänskapsmatchen mot Brasilien i Doha 2009. Jag kunde inte vänta med att gå in i omklädningsrummet efter att Roy berättat nyheten, och det kommer vara samma sak för Wayne. Han kommer vara ivrig att komma till Wembley för vänskapsmatchen mot Norge, och ansvaret kan inspirera honom att slå Sir Bobby Charltons målrekord på 49 mål. Allt är upplagt för honom nu. Han kommer snart bli kapten, och de två kommande turneringarna i Frankrike och Ryssland kan definiera hans arv. Vi spelade ihop 71 gånger för England och när han är som bäst är han en världsspelare. Efter besvikelsen i Brasilien är detta en nystart, och Wayne kan leda laget positivt in i den nya kampanjen. Tårfyllt farväl: Jag var känslosam efter min sista landskamp för England vid VM i Brasilien. Om och när han leder laget ut den 3 september kommer jag bli jätteglad för hans skull. Vi är två killar från Liverpool-förorter som älskat att spela för England, och jag vet vilka känslor Wayne kommer känna när han står längst fram i tunneln. För min egen del vet jag att jag tagit rätt beslut och jag ska njuta av en paus, men jag kommer sakna att spela för England. Det är säkert.

Major battery manufacturers are increasingly investing in sodium-based battery technology, which could mark a significant shift in the energy storage industry vital to the global energy transition. Sodium, found abundantly in rock salts and brines worldwide, offers a cheaper and more plentiful alternative to lithium, currently the mainstay of battery technology. Despite sodium’s chemical similarities to lithium, it has not yet achieved mainstream use, primarily because lithium batteries still outperform sodium in range and capacity.

Recent developments, however, could change this landscape. In the past week, Sweden’s Northvolt AB announced a technological breakthrough, while Chinese electric vehicle maker BYD Co. revealed plans for a $1.4 billion sodium-ion battery plant. Earlier this year, China’s CATL said it would begin deploying sodium-based batteries in selected vehicles this year.

Analysts suggest this indicates a growing confidence in sodium technology. Rory McNulty, senior research analyst at Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, stated, “It’s serious investment. It’s creating a confidence boost with them saying we are here to continue scaling capacity to commercialize this technology.”

Should sodium-based products prove successful, they could significantly reduce lithium consumption, highlighting the challenges of forecasting demand for battery metals in a rapidly evolving market. While sodium-ion batteries have a lower energy density, making them unsuitable for larger electric vehicles, they are increasingly seen as an alternative for lower-end, short-range vehicles and large-scale power grid storage, where size is less critical.

Research by BloombergNEF indicates that sodium could offset around 272,000 tons of lithium demand by 2035, or more than one million tons if lithium supply constraints intensify. Shifts in the battery metals landscape have already radically altered supply and demand projections, as with cobalt and nickel, whose demand forecasts were downgraded after new battery chemistries emerged that do not require them.

Lithium prices have also been highly volatile, with a surge last year driving battery companies to consider sodium as a cost-effective substitute, followed by a steep drop as EV demand softened and supply prospects improved. Sam Adham, head of battery materials at consultancy CRU Group, commented, “Sodium-ion will have a part to play in improving the lithium supply-demand balance. It will dampen those really severe swings in lithium prices.”

Despite recent price declines in lithium, sodium remains a less expensive choice. If adoption increases, its trajectory could mirror that of lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cells, which gained popularity due to their lower cost despite modest performance. Sodium’s standout advantage may be in grid-scale energy storage, where affordability outweighs high performance.

Sodium’s commercial success, however, will depend on improving battery cycle life – the number of charge-discharge cycles before replacement. Sodium cells now average 5,000 cycles, compared to about 7,500 cycles for some lithium products, according to industry data. Duo Fu, an analyst at Rystad Energy, said, “The crucial factor is achieving longer cycle life; if successful, demand from the energy storage sector could increase.”

Currently, Chinese manufacturers dominate the nascent sodium battery sector, leveraging their large-scale lithium battery production capabilities to keep costs low. This offers them a significant advantage over European and American competitors, who lack comparable mass production experience. As Sam Adham of CRU noted, “You’re able to be cost competitive in reality through economies of scale.”

Other recent business news includes a drop in imports by leading electronics firms such as Apple and Samsung, and potential executive changes at PepsiCo India, with George Kovoor likely to succeed Ahmed ElSheikh as president.

Stora batteritillverkare investerar nu allt mer i natriumbaserad batteriteknik, vilket kan innebära en betydande förändring inom energilagringsindustrin som är avgörande för den globala energiomställningen. Natrium, som finns rikligt i bergsalt och saltvatten världen över, erbjuder ett billigare och mer tillgängligt alternativ jämfört med litium, vilket idag dominerar batteriteknologin. Trots natriums kemiska likheter med litium har det ännu inte slagit igenom på bred front, framför allt eftersom litiumbatterier fortfarande överträffar natrium vad gäller räckvidd och kapacitet.

De senaste framstegen kan dock förändra detta. Den senaste veckan meddelade svenska Northvolt AB att de gjort ett tekniskt genombrott, medan den kinesiska elbilstillverkaren BYD Co. presenterade planer på en natriumjonbatterifabrik för 1,4 miljarder dollar. Tidigare i år berättade den kinesiska batteritillverkaren CATL att deras natriumbatterier kommer att användas i vissa fordon redan i år.

Analytiker menar att satsningarna visar på ett ökat förtroende för natriumtekniken. Rory McNulty, senior research analyst vid Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, sa: "Det är seriösa investeringar. Det skapar självförtroende att de säger att vi finns här för att fortsätta expandera kapaciteten och kommersialisera teknologin."

Om natriumbaserade produkter visar sig framgångsrika kan de kraftigt minska behovet av litium, vilket understryker svårigheterna i att förutsäga efterfrågan på batterimetaller i en snabbt föränderlig marknad. Eftersom natriumjonbatterier har lägre energitäthet är de inte lämpliga för större elbilar, men de ses allt mer som ett alternativ för enklare fordon och storskalig energilagring där storlek inte är avgörande.

Forskning från BloombergNEF visar att natrium kan ersätta cirka 272 000 ton litiumbehov till 2035 och över en miljon ton om litiumtillgången stramas åt. Snabba förändringar inom batterimetallbranschen har redan påverkat efterfrågan på kobolt och nickel, vars prognoser sänkts när nya batterityper som inte kräver dessa metaller introducerats.

Litiumpriserna har varit mycket volatila – rusningen ifjol fick batteritillverkare att börja överväga natrium som ett billigare alternativ, och därefter föll priserna när efterfrågan på elbilar svalnade och tillgången förbättrades. Sam Adham, chef för batterimaterial på konsultbolaget CRU Group, säger: "Natriumjon kommer att spela en roll för att balansera tillgång och efterfrågan på litium. Det kommer att dämpa de riktigt allvarliga svängningarna i litiumpriser."

Trots att litiumpriserna nyligen sjunkit är natrium fortfarande billigare. Om användningen ökar kan utvecklingen likna den för litiumjärnfosfat (LFP)-batterier, som blivit populära tack vare lägre kostnad trots något lägre prestanda. Natriums största fördel kan bli storskalig lagring av el – där kostnad är viktigare än batteriprestanda.

Natriums kommersiella framgång avgörs dock av att förbättra cykellivslängden – alltså hur många gånger batteriet kan laddas och urladdas innan det måste bytas. Natriumceller klarar nu cirka 5 000 cykler, jämfört med cirka 7 500 för vissa litiumprodukter. Duo Fu, analytiker på Rystad Energy, säger: "Det avgörande är att öka livslängden; om det lyckas kan efterfrågan inom energilagring öka."

Idag dominerar kinesiska tillverkare denna unga natriumbatterimarknad och drar fördel av sin storskaliga produktion som håller nere kostnaderna. Det ger dem ett övertag gentemot europeiska och amerikanska företag som saknar erfarenhet av massproduktion. Som Sam Adham från CRU påpekar: "Man kan bli konkurrenskraftig i praktiken genom stordriftsfördelar."

Andra affärsnyheter är bland annat minskad import av ledande elektronikföretag som Apple och Samsung, samt möjliga förändringar i ledningen för PepsiCo India, där George Kovoor sannolikt efterträder Ahmed ElSheikh som president.

article_content: Anita Ekberg, the Swedish-born actress best known for her role in Federico Fellini's 'La Dolce Vita,' has died at the age of 83 in Rome. Ekberg's performance as Sylvia, especially the scene where she wades through Rome's Trevi Fountain in a strapless black dress, remains one of cinema's most iconic moments and established her international fame. Her lawyer, Patrizia Ubaldi, confirmed Ekberg passed away in Rome on Sunday morning after a series of illnesses. Ekberg had been hospitalized shortly after Christmas. According to Ubaldi, Ekberg was saddened in her final days by her illness and advancing age. 'She had hoped to recover, but unfortunately that did not happen,' said Ubaldi. A ceremony will be held at a Lutheran church in Rome in the coming days, and Ekberg requested to be cremated. Born on September 29, 1931, in Malmö, Sweden, Ekberg grew up with seven siblings. In 1951, she won the Miss Sweden competition after being encouraged by organizers who noticed her on the street. She went to the United States to participate in the Miss Universe pageant. Although she did not win, she became a successful model in Hollywood and gradually accepted small acting roles. Ekberg's breakthrough came with her role in 'La Dolce Vita,' portraying a movie star, which propelled her to global stardom. The film was a huge success and became emblematic of the early 1960s. In a 2005 Swedish radio program, Ekberg recalled filming the famous Trevi Fountain scene in cold February water while co-star Marcello Mastroianni struggled with the freezing conditions. 'I was freezing,' she recounted. 'They had to lift me out of the water because I couldn’t feel my legs anymore.' Ekberg lived in Italy for many years, the country that brought her worldwide fame. Her captivating looks and glamorous lifestyle made her a favorite of the tabloid press in the 1950s and 1960s. She married twice, to Anthony Steel in 1956 (divorced four years later) and to Rik van Nutter in 1963 (that marriage also ended in divorce). She never had children—a fact she later regretted. Ekberg never starred in a Swedish film and often had a strained relationship with Swedish journalists, who criticized her for leaving Sweden and for acquiring an American accent. She continued acting in Italy, including returning for two later Fellini films: 'Clowns' and 'Intervista.' She also appeared in movies such as 'Four for Texas' alongside Frank Sinatra. In an interview with the Swedish newspaper Aftonbladet in 2006, Ekberg expressed her regret over not having children and stated she was not afraid of death. 'I would have liked to have a child, preferably a son. It didn't turn out that way. That's life, you just have to accept it,' she said. She added, 'I’m just upset I won’t get the chance to tell others about death, where the soul goes, and if there is a life afterward. I don’t know if paradise or hell exist, but I’m sure hell is more interesting.'

Hennes advokat, Patrizia Ubaldi, bekräftade att Ekberg gick bort i Rom på söndagsmorgonen efter en rad sjukdomar. Ekberg hade blivit inlagd strax efter jul. Enligt Ubaldi var Ekberg nedstämd under sina sista dagar på grund av sjukdomen och sin höga ålder. "Hon hoppades att bli bättre, men det blev tyvärr inte så", sade Ubaldi. En ceremoni kommer att hållas i en luthersk kyrka i Rom inom de närmaste dagarna, och Ekberg hade uttryckt en önskan om att bli kremerad. Född den 29 september 1931 i Malmö, Sverige, växte Ekberg upp med sju syskon. År 1951 vann hon tävlingen Fröken Sverige, efter att ha uppmärksammats av arrangörer på gatan. Hon reste sedan till USA för att delta i skönhetstävlingen Miss Universe. Fastän hon inte vann blev hon modell i Hollywood och började så småningom ta mindre filmroller. Ekbergs genombrott kom med rollen i "La Dolce Vita", där hon spelade en filmstjärna, vilket gav henne världsomspännande berömmelse. Filmen blev en stor framgång och blev symbolisk för de tidiga 1960-talet. I ett svenskt radioprogram 2005 mindes Ekberg hur det var att spela in den berömda Trevi-fontänscenen i kallt februarivatten, medan motspelaren Marcello Mastroianni kämpade med de iskalla förhållandena. "Jag frös", berättade hon. "De fick lyfta upp mig ur vattnet eftersom jag inte längre kände mina ben." Ekberg bodde i Italien i många år, landet som gett henne världsberömmelse. Hennes slående utseende och glamorösa livsstil gjorde henne till en favorit i tabloidpressen på 1950- och 1960-talen. Hon var gift två gånger, först med Anthony Steel 1956 (skild fyra år senare) och sedan med Rik van Nutter 1963 (även det äktenskapet slutade i skilsmässa). Hon fick aldrig några barn, vilket hon senare ångrade. Ekberg medverkade aldrig i någon svensk film och hade ofta en ansträngd relation med svenska journalister, som kritiserade henne för att ha lämnat Sverige och för att ha lagt sig till med amerikansk accent. Hon fortsatte att filma i Italien, bland annat i två senare Fellini-filmer: "Clowns" och "Intervista". Hon spelade också i filmer som "Four for Texas" tillsammans med Frank Sinatra. I en intervju med den svenska tidningen Aftonbladet 2006 berättade Ekberg att hon ångrade att hon inte fått barn och att hon inte var rädd för döden. "Jag hade gärna velat ha ett barn, helst en son. Det blev inte så. Det är livet, man får acceptera det", sade hon. Hon tillade: "Jag är bara ledsen att jag inte får berätta för andra om döden, var själen hamnar och om det finns ett liv efteråt. Jag vet inte om paradis eller helvete finns, men jag är säker på att helvetet är mer intressant."

Seven US soldiers, including two Navy SEALs and a special operations demolition expert, died when a Black Hawk helicopter crashed in Taliban-controlled territory in Kandahar, southern Afghanistan, on Thursday. Three Afghan soldiers and an interpreter were also killed. Military officials stated the cause of the crash is under investigation, but early indications suggest the aircraft was not shot down. The incident happened in Shah Wali Kot district, and the helicopter was reportedly destroyed on impact.

US military casualties for August 2012 have reached 25, potentially making it the deadliest month in a year. More than 1,960 American service members have been killed since the Afghan war began over a decade ago.

Violence in Afghanistan is intensifying as the Taliban mounts its annual summer offensive. Last week alone, 13 US soldiers and Marines were killed. August has also seen a number of 'green-on-blue' incidents, in which Afghan security forces attack coalition troops. In one attack last week, three elite Special Forces soldiers were killed by an Afghan police officer who had invited them to dinner. Two British soldiers were also killed this month in a similar attack.

According to the International Security Assistance Force, the cause of the helicopter crash remains under investigation. US forces are beginning to withdraw from Afghanistan as plans to end combat operations move forward. The crash occurred in an area known for insurgent activity and as a major supply route. The Taliban claimed responsibility, but officials remain skeptical, noting that such claims are often exaggerated.

This incident follows a previous deadly crash in August 2011, when the Taliban shot down a CH-47 Chinook helicopter, killing all 38 people on board, including 25 US special operations personnel. July 2012 had already been the deadliest month for US troops, with 40 deaths. Despite the ongoing drawdown, American casualties continue at the rate of about one per day. US troop numbers have been reduced from nearly 103,000 last year to an expected 68,000 by October.

On Tuesday, the political spotlight shifted from the controversy surrounding U.S. Rep. Todd Akin’s comments on rape and pregnancy back to core election topics: Medicare and the economy. Campaign events throughout the day mostly overlooked the Akin issue as both presidential and vice presidential candidates addressed issues central to voters.

In Reno, Nevada, President Barack Obama spoke at a community college, emphasizing the nation's historic commitment to accessible education and criticizing the Republican party for lacking a clear education strategy. “America has always ensured that those willing to work hard can access a good education. That’s a cornerstone of our economic strength,” he said. Obama promised renewed efforts to lead globally in education and workforce training, urging, “We’ve come too far to turn back now.”

Republican vice presidential candidate Paul Ryan, speaking at a steel plant in Pennsylvania before a sign reading “We Did Build It,” echoed the Republican theme of encouraging individual success. He referenced Obama’s earlier remarks suggesting that government services contribute to business achievement. “Mitt and I believe if you encourage success, you’ll get more of it,” Ryan said, warning that demonizing success could hinder prosperity and job growth.

Meanwhile, Republican leaders intensified calls for Missouri Congressman Todd Akin to exit his Senate race after his statement that 'legitimate rape' rarely causes pregnancy. Mitt Romney, campaigning in Texas, labeled the remarks “deeply offensive” and urged Akin to step aside. Despite passing the withdrawal deadline, Akin remained in the race against Democratic Senator Claire McCaskill. Ryan, who opposes abortion except when the mother’s life is at risk, also called for Akin’s withdrawal but did not mention the controversy during his appearance.

Ryan shifted focus to Medicare, advocating a plan that would create competition between private insurers and traditional Medicare. Democrats argue this plan would undermine the program for seniors, but Ryan and Romney insist their proposals would not affect current Medicare beneficiaries, and accused President Obama of diverting Medicare funds to finance his health care law. Ryan reiterated criticism, saying Obama treated Medicare as a “piggybank” for the Affordable Care Act.

Vice President Joe Biden, campaigning in Minnesota, pushed back, stating that the health care law extended Medicare’s solvency by eight years without cutting benefits, and provided seniors with savings and improved coverage. Biden portrayed the election as pivotal for the middle class and criticized Romney for inconsistent positions, while raising doubts about Republican economic plans: “There’s overwhelming evidence their policies will not grow the economy. We’ve seen this before and know how it ends.”

At a fundraiser in Houston, Romney rebuked Obama’s campaign for outspending its fundraising in July, vowing to use resources more efficiently. Earlier in Ohio, Obama criticized Republican proposals on college funding, particularly Romney’s advice that students borrow money from their parents, arguing this approach favors the wealthy and neglects those hardest hit by the recession. The Romney campaign responded by blaming Obama for higher tuition costs and limited job prospects for graduates.

The day’s events reflected the candidates’ ongoing disputes over the economy, education, and health care, as both campaigns aimed to define the stakes of November’s election.

Social media has significantly shaped how we connect, offering us the ability to interact with old friends, colleagues, and to meet people with shared interests whom we might never have otherwise encountered. These connections are invaluable, and if this were social media's only function, its impact would be undeniably positive.

However, numerous studies in recent years have shown that social media can also have negative effects—leaving many users feeling angrier, increasingly unhappy, and more isolated. Beyond personal impacts, these platforms have become conduits for misinformation and disinformation, deepening social divisions.

Reflecting on the rapid expansion of digital technology, Professor Ubaldo Reyes, Coordinator of the Business Administration Graduate Program at CETYS University, notes that we've embraced immediacy in communication, global connectivity, and community-building online since the advent of the Internet. Platforms like Hi5, MySpace, and Facebook initially centered on social interaction through media such as photos, music, and games.

Social media platforms have since evolved, becoming hubs for personal expression, brand promotion, and news dissemination. The introduction of features like the 'Like' button and 'Followers' fundamentally changed online interactions, shifting the focus from genuine relationships to content-driven validation and engagement.

Susan Schreiner, technology analyst at C4 Trends, recalls the early 2000s 'golden age' of social media, marked by vibrant, playful interactions and the rise of user-friendly platforms like MySpace, LinkedIn, Facebook, and others. In these early days, the emphasis remained on building and maintaining connections.

Over time, however, social media transformed into a space where personal and commercial identities are shaped, often prioritizing promotional content. The widespread adoption of mobile devices enabled more immediate, real-time sharing, but also encouraged more curated and sometimes less authentic self-presentation.

According to Schreiner, the COVID-19 pandemic amplified existing issues by increasing isolation and reducing in-person interaction, accelerating the spread of polarization, conspiracy theories, and online hostility. People increasingly sought group belonging online—sometimes fostering echo chambers and hostile divisions.

These trends have made social media a primary news source for many, often prioritizing engagement over accuracy. Platforms now often benefit from extended user activity—even when that activity involves argument or exposure to harmful content. Schreiner warns that in the pursuit of clicks, some sites have relaxed safety measures, sacrificing healthy conversations for engagement metrics.

While disconnecting from social media might seem like a solution, it is deeply embedded in our daily routines. Despite its drawbacks, social media still enriches communication, business, and service personalization. Professor Reyes emphasizes the need for ongoing research and innovation to leverage social media positively. With thoughtful planning and strategy, social media can remain a force for connection and progress—perhaps even returning to its roots as a space for sharing life's meaningful moments with friends.

Sociala medier har förändrat hur vi knyter kontakter och ger oss möjligheten att interagera med gamla vänner, kollegor och träffa personer med liknande intressen som vi annars kanske aldrig skulle ha mött. Dessa band är ovärderliga och om det var sociala mediers enda syfte skulle deras påverkan vara odiskutabelt positiv.

Dock har flera studier de senaste åren visat att sociala medier också kan ha negativa effekter – många användare känner sig argare, mer olyckliga och mer isolerade. Utöver de personliga konsekvenserna har dessa plattformar blivit kanaler för desinformation och missinformation, vilket fördjupar sociala klyftor.

Professor Ubaldo Reyes, samordnare för företagsekonomiprogrammet på CETYS University, konstaterar att vi har omfamnat omedelbar kommunikation, global kontakt och gemenskapsbyggande online sedan internets barndom. Plattformar som Hi5, MySpace och Facebook fokuserade ursprungligen på social interaktion genom foton, musik och spel.

Sociala medier har därefter utvecklats till nav för personlig uttrycksförmåga, varumärkesprofilering och nyhetsförmedling. Introduktionen av funktioner som "gilla" och "följare" har fundamentalt förändrat interaktionerna online och förflyttat fokus från genuina relationer till bekräftelse och engagemang kring innehåll.

Teknikanalytikern Susan Schreiner på C4 Trends minns 2000-talets "gyllene era" för sociala medier, då det präglades av livliga, lekfulla interaktioner och användarvänliga plattformar som MySpace, LinkedIn och Facebook. Fokus låg då på att skapa och underhålla relationer.

Med tiden har sociala medier dock förvandlats till platser där både personliga och kommersiella identiteter formas, ofta med prioritering av marknadsföring. Det utbredda mobilanvändandet möjliggjorde direkt delning, men bidrog även till en mer utvald och ibland mindre autentisk självpresentation.

Enligt Schreiner förstärkte covid-19-pandemin redan befintliga problem genom ökad isolering och mindre fysisk interaktion, vilket påskyndade polarisering, konspirationsteorier och fientlighet på nätet. Fler sökte grupptillhörighet online – ibland till priset av ekokammare och splittring.

Dessa tendenser har gjort sociala medier till primär nyhetskälla för många, ofta med engagemang snarare än noggrannhet i fokus. Plattformarna gynnas nu av att användare är aktiva länge – även om det innebär konflikter eller exponering för skadligt innehåll. Schreiner varnar för att vissa sajter, i sin jakt på klick, släppt på säkerhetsåtgärder och offrat god samtalston för engagemangssiffror.

Att helt koppla bort sig från sociala medier kan verka som en lösning, men de är djupt integrerade i vår vardag. Trots nackdelarna berikar sociala medier fortfarande kommunikation, affärsliv och personlig service. Professor Reyes betonar vikten av fortsatt forskning och innovation för att använda sociala medier på ett positivt sätt. Med rätt planering och strategi kan sociala medier fortsätta vara en kraft för kontakt och framsteg – kanske till och med återgå till sina rötter som en plats där vi delar livets viktiga ögonblick med vänner.

article_content: If your Christmas wish is to have a physique like a Victoria’s Secret lingerie model, there may be a new way to reach your goal. Michael Olajide Jr., a former boxing champion who trains Victoria's Secret Angels such as Karlie Kloss, Adriana Lima, and Kate Upton, has released online fitness videos featuring the exercises he uses in their routines. His workouts incorporate boxing-based movements like The Pyramid Stance, Pyramid Power Punch, Aero Jumps, Aero Squats, and Shuffle Squats, aiming to work multiple muscle groups at once. These videos are available for around £3 at aerospacehpc.com. Recently, Kloss and fellow Angels Lily Aldridge, Candice Swanepoel, Doutzen Kroes, and Alessandra Ambrosio traveled to London by private jet for the Victoria’s Secret Christmas fashion show. In other health news, Tetris is being trialed as a therapy for road accident victims. Patients arriving at John Radcliffe Hospital in Oxford may be asked to play the game within six hours of an accident. Researchers believe the visual and spatial activity disrupts the formation of traumatic memories, potentially reducing flashbacks linked to post-traumatic stress disorder. Earlier studies at Oxford University showed that participants who played Tetris after watching a distressing film experienced fewer flashbacks. Starting next week, cafes and restaurants across the EU will be required to clearly inform customers about allergenic ingredients in food and drink. While labeling rules previously applied only to packaged foods, eateries will now need to list major allergens (such as peanuts, eggs, milk, and shellfish) on menus or have staff provide the information verbally. The Anaphylaxis Campaign, started after a tragic fatality caused by accidental peanut ingestion, endorses this regulation. An NHS campaign called 'Be Clear On Cancer' has resulted in hundreds of lives being saved by promoting early diagnosis of lung cancer. GPs made approximately 3,000 additional referrals after the first campaign wave, resulting in around 700 extra diagnoses—400 at an early, more treatable stage, and 300 who received potentially life-saving surgery. The campaign featured the message, 'Been coughing for three weeks? Tell your doctor.' The results appeared in the British Cancer Journal. Additionally, Harvard neuroscientists found that meditating for just 27 minutes a day for eight weeks increased the density of grey matter in the hippocampus, the brain region linked to memory, learning, compassion, and self-awareness. Participants engaged in a Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction Program and underwent MRI scans before and after the program, with meditation guided by audio recordings.

article_content: Joe White, an amateur astronomer from Bristol, UK, closely inspects images from NASA’s Curiosity rover, searching for possible traces of life on Mars. While reviewing these images, Joe recently identified several rock formations that resemble familiar Earth items: a crocodile, a cannon, traffic lights, and even a cannonball. These discoveries quickly sparked interest and debates online, with some people likening the formations to traffic lights or totem poles. However, most experts and observers believe these are simply unusual rock shapes rather than proof of alien life. Joe shares his findings on his ArtAlienTV YouTube channel, analyzing each distinctive formation. Notable examples include a rock resembling a crocodile’s snout and another collection of rocks stacked in a way that looks like traffic lights. Despite the attention these finds receive, NASA has yet to comment. Curiosity has been exploring Mars since August 2012 and comes equipped with 17 cameras. Weighing about as much as a Mini Cooper, the rover is currently examining Mount Sharp, a region considered scientifically significant for its potential to reveal Mars’ watery and possibly habitable past. Scientists suggest that some round rocks Joe and others have found are likely ‘Martian concretions’—natural geological formations caused by minerals hardening over time. These intriguing shapes remind us how Mars can echo patterns from Earth, inspiring wonder and curiosity. While the likelihood of these formations being signs of alien life is low, their discovery highlights human imagination and our tendency to find familiar shapes in unexpected places.

article_content: Deputy, whose customers include Ace Hardware, develops software specifically for shift workers, offering advanced scheduling and workforce management solutions. These kinds of jobs—often held by people with disabilities—tend to be hourly and shift-based, with workers frequently feeling underappreciated. Silvija Martincevic, who became Deputy’s CEO in February, has a personal history connected to shift work. Growing up in a family of shift workers inspired her to use technology for the benefit of marginalized communities. Currently, Deputy’s platform is used by more than 340,000 businesses in over 100 countries, facilitating over 500 million shifts for 1.4 million workers. The company emphasizes employee engagement, well-being, and compliance with labor regulations. Deputy’s ethos—happy staff create happy managers—reflects its drive to provide modern digital tools for a workforce that has historically lagged behind office workers in terms of technological advancement. Martincevic points out that although shift workers comprise about 80% of the global workforce, their technology is often outdated. The company's aim to foster thriving workplaces underpins its innovations, like the Shift Pulse feature, which lets companies easily collect employee feedback right after shifts. This feedback helps managers make improvements and enables Deputy to enhance its offerings. Positive testimonials from users, such as shift worker Ana, highlight the platform’s ability to ease scheduling and reduce stress. To recognize shift workers’ essential roles, Deputy founded Shift Worker Sunday, a global holiday held on the last Sunday of November. Martincevic is committed to bridging the digital gap for shift workers, believing improved workplace technology can increase productivity and help workers feel more valued and connected. Her vision is for Deputy to grow into a global platform that transforms shift workers’ experiences for the better.

article_content: Taylor Swift remains a force on the Billboard Hot 100, achieving her third No. 1 single in 2023. Her track "Is It Over Now?" has claimed the top spot from her previous hit, “Cruel Summer.” Notably, each of Swift's chart-toppers this year comes from a different album: 'Anti-Hero' from Midnights, 'Cruel Summer' from Lover, and now 'Is It Over Now?' from 1989 (Taylor’s Version). Swift is now the first woman to have three Hot 100 No. 1 hits in a year, each from separate albums—a rare achievement last accomplished by the Jackson 5 in 1970. The all-time record is held by The Beatles, who had six No. 1 songs from five albums in 1964. "Is It Over Now?" is featured on 1989 (Taylor’s Version), which debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, marking Swift’s biggest career launch.

Det unika är att alla Swifts listettor i år kommer från olika album: 'Anti-Hero' från Midnights, 'Cruel Summer' från Lover och nu "Is It Over Now?" från 1989 (Taylor's Version). Swift är nu den första kvinnan att ha tre etttor på Hot 100 under ett år, alla från olika album – något som tidigare bara Jackson 5 har lyckats med, redan 1970. Beatles håller rekordet med sex listettor från fem album under 1964. "Is It Over Now?" finns med på 1989 (Taylor's Version), som också debuterade på förstaplats på Billboard 200 och blev Swifts största lansering hittills.

article_content: Janice Khoo, 57, paid £360 for hair extensions, a cut, and a blow dry at Future Lengths Hair Salon in Swindon, Wiltshire. Unsatisfied with the styling, she left a critical review on the salon's Facebook page, mentioning that her hair looked flat and untidy. Salon owner Drew Carlton responded publicly with a series of insulting and unprofessional messages, including removing Mrs. Khoo from the salon after she requested changes. Carlton continued posting inappropriate remarks on Facebook, which resulted in the salon’s online ratings dropping sharply. Mrs. Khoo reported the abusive comments to Wiltshire Police, who are treating the incident as anti-social behaviour and have begun an investigation. Following public backlash, the salon’s business page was deleted. Mr. Carlton later apologized to Mrs. Khoo, offering her a full refund and admitting his reaction was inappropriate. He stated he would no longer use social media for his business. A spokesperson for Wiltshire Police confirmed officers had spoken to Mrs. Khoo and intended to contact Mr. Carlton regarding the case.

Editor's note: Jane Velez-Mitchell is the host of "Issues with Jane Velez-Mitchell," a topical show on HLN airing nightly at 7 p.m. ET.

New York (HLN) -- Horse racing season is upon us in America, with celebrated events like the Kentucky Derby, Preakness, and Belmont Stakes inviting fanfare, fancy hats, and champagne. Yet, behind these festivities lies a troubling reality for the horses at the heart of the sport.

These remarkable animals cannot advocate for themselves, and many suffer exploitation within the racing industry. When thoroughbreds are no longer competitive—after losing races, developing injuries, or failing to meet expectations—thousands end up being slaughtered for horse meat. While many imagine retired racehorses spending their days on pastoral farms, the truth is that keeping horses is expensive. When deemed unprofitable, these horses often face grim fates.

Some find refuge in sanctuaries, but most are auctioned off, packed into overcrowded trailers, and transported—often without food or water—over long distances to slaughter plants, mainly in Mexico and Canada. Tragically, some do not survive the journey. The Humane Society of the United States (HSUS) reports that tens of thousands of live horses are moved each year across the border for slaughter. These animals are sold by the pound, sometimes for as little as a few hundred dollars.

The issue is exacerbated by the racing industry’s practice of breeding for perfection, resulting in a surplus of unwanted horses. Not every foal becomes a champion, riding, or school horse. Overbreeding has caused a significant horse overpopulation crisis, for which the industry must accept responsibility and take action.

There have been victories for horse advocates. U.S.-based foreign-owned horse slaughterhouses were shut down years ago, and the HSUS estimates that previously, about 100,000 horses were slaughtered annually in the United States. However, some continue to push for the reopening of horse slaughter plants, despite widespread public opposition.

A bill in Congress—H.R. 503, the Horse Slaughter Prohibition Act—would ban the shipping, transporting, selling, or donating of horses to be slaughtered for human consumption, but it has stalled after passing the House of Representatives in 2006.

It is time for American compassion to prevail. The racing industry must take responsibility for the welfare of its horses and invest in retirement homes for all who pass through its gates. The public is called upon to urge their representatives to support legislation ending slaughter and to address the crisis of overbreeding. The industry’s hidden problems can no longer be ignored—the time for meaningful action is now.

The opinions expressed in this commentary are solely those of Jane Velez-Mitchell.

New York (HLN) -- Galoppsäsongen har startat i USA, med stora evenemang som Kentucky Derby, Preakness och Belmont Stakes. Fina hattar och champagne är vanliga inslag – men bakom festligheterna döljer sig en mörk verklighet för hästarna.

Dessa fantastiska djur kan inte tala för sig själva och många utnyttjas i galoppsporten. När fullblod inte längre är konkurrenskraftiga – till följd av förluster, skador eller bristande resultat – skickas tusentals till slakt för hästkött. Många föreställer sig att pensionerade galopphästar får leva ett fridfullt liv på landet, men sanningen är att det är dyrt att ha hästar. När de inte längre anses lönsamma möter de ofta en dyster framtid.

Vissa hittar en fristad, men de flesta säljs på auktion, packas i överfulla trailers och transporteras – ofta utan mat eller vatten – långa sträckor till slakterier, framför allt i Mexiko och Kanada. Tragiskt nog överlever vissa inte resan. The Humane Society of the United States (HSUS) rapporterar att tiotusentals hästar transporteras över gränsen varje år för slakt. Hästarna säljs på vikt, ibland för bara några hundra dollar.

Problemet förvärras av branschens satsning på att avla fram den perfekta hästen, vilket leder till ett stort överskott på oönskade hästar. Alla föl blir inte vinnare, rid- eller ridskolhästar. Överavel har lett till en allvarlig överpopulationskris och branschen måste ta ansvar och agera.

Djurrättsförespråkare har vunnit vissa framgångar. Amerikanska slakterier i utländsk ägo har stängts för flera år sedan, och HSUS uppskattar att tidigare slaktades omkring 100 000 hästar årligen i USA. Trots detta försöker vissa parter åter öppna slakterier, trots stort motstånd.

Ett lagförslag i kongressen – H.R. 503, Horse Slaughter Prohibition Act – skulle förbjuda transport, försäljning eller donering av hästar till slakt för mat, men har stannat upp efter godkännande i representanthuset 2006.

Nu är det dags för medkänsla. Galoppsporten måste ta ansvar för hästarnas välfärd och investera i pensionshem för sina hästar. Allmänheten uppmanas att kontakta sina politiker för att stödja lagstiftning mot slakt samt ta itu med överavelskrisen. Branschens dolda problem kan inte längre ignoreras – det är dags för verklig handling.

De åsikter som uttrycks i denna kommentar är uteslutande Jane Velez-Mitchells.

article_content: Abraham Lincoln is remembered for his role as the 'Great Emancipator' during the Civil War, his leadership in preserving the Union, and the abolition of slavery. However, another significant yet often overlooked accomplishment was the Yosemite Valley Grant Act, which he signed into law on June 30, 1864. Passed while the Civil War raged on, this legislation preserved California’s Yosemite Valley and Mariposa Grove for 'public use, resort, and recreation ... for all time.' This act marked the first time the federal government protected land primarily for its scenic value, setting a precedent for the development of the U.S. national park system. Yosemite became the nation’s third national park in 1890, joining a collection of lands valued for their beauty and profound spiritual and patriotic importance to millions of Americans. Yet, the creation of national parks had serious consequences for Native American peoples across the continent. Research on the religious history of U.S. national parks shows that religious motives often contributed to the persecution and exclusion of Indigenous tribes. Recently, the National Park Service has begun acknowledging and addressing this history. Annually, over 300 million people visit the U.S. National Park System. These parks feature remarkable landscapes, wildlife, recreation, and the sites of significant historical events. But their importance goes beyond natural beauty. National parks, battlefields, and historic sites managed by the National Park Service are considered sacred within an American civil religion—a set of symbols, rituals, and traditions imbuing the nation with a sense of higher purpose. Sociologist Robert Bellah described this civil religion, which coexists with faiths like Christianity and Buddhism and has its own revered figures, spaces, and ceremonies. U.S. civil religion includes figures like George Washington and Martin Luther King Jr., symbols like the flag and the Pledge of Allegiance, and holidays such as Independence Day. Many of the most symbolic places in this tradition are managed by the National Park Service—from Independence Hall and the Statue of Liberty to Mount Rushmore. The National Park System is closely linked to Manifest Destiny—a 19th-century American belief that the nation was destined to expand westward under divine providence. Historian Anders Stephanson characterizes Manifest Destiny as “a catchword for a providential or historically sanctioned right to continental expansion.” The expansion came at great cost for Native Americans and others inhabiting those lands, with many Americans justifying it by interpreting the beauty of places like Yosemite and Yellowstone as evidence of divine favor. Parks like Yellowstone (established in 1872), Sequoia, Yosemite, and Mount Rainier emerged from this ethos. Their dramatic landscapes embodied U.S. exceptionalism for many, but establishing these parks also resulted in the displacement of Indigenous peoples, as detailed by historian Mark David Spence. Establishing Yellowstone led to the forced relocation of the Tukudika (Sheep Eater Shoshone) to a reservation in Wyoming, and the Nitsitapii (Blackfeet) lost their treaty rights when Glacier National Park was created. The Ahwahneechee people of California, a Miwok band, remained in Yosemite for decades, but by 1969 had been entirely excluded through strict regulations and economic and societal pressures. In the past few decades, the National Park Service has taken meaningful steps to recognize Native American relationships to parklands and address the consequences of Manifest Destiny. The Service collaborates with the Interior Department to promote tribal co-management of federal lands, and park managers increasingly involve tribal authorities. Deb Haaland, the first Native American Cabinet Secretary, spearheaded a review and replacement of derogatory place names, renaming 24 National Park System locations and eliminating terms like 'squaw.' Cooperation now includes integrating Indigenous fire management practices to support healthy ecosystems—a regular aspect of fire management in the parks today. Tribes also partner with national parks to restore bison herds, a species vital to tribal diets, culture, and spirituality. Programs like the 2020 Bison Conservation Initiative and the InterTribal Buffalo Council have enabled bison from Yellowstone, Badlands, and Grand Canyon National Parks to return to Native lands. Visitors increasingly encounter the history and culture of Native Americans through museum exhibits, ranger programs, interpretation panels, and the National Park Service’s digital platforms. These initiatives amplify Indigenous voices and contribute to reconciliation and healing, supporting a more inclusive vision of American civil religion.

Nationalparker som Yellowstone (grundad 1872), Sequoia, Yosemite och Mount Rainier uppstod ur denna föreställning. Deb Haaland, den första urfolkspersonen på kabinettspost i USA, ledde en översyn och förändring av kränkande platsnamn. Samarbetet omfattar nu även användning av urfolkens traditionella eldhantering för att stödja friska ekosystem—en praxis som idag är en självklar del av parkernas skötsel. Urfolk arbetar också med nationalparker för att återinföra bisonhjordar, ett djur av central betydelse för kost, kultur och andlighet. Initiativ som 2020 års Bison Conservation Initiative och InterTribal Buffalo Council har gjort att bison från Yellowstone, Badlands och Grand Canyon har återinsatts på urfolkens marker. Besökare möter allt oftare urfolkens historia och kultur genom utställningar, guideprogram, informationsskyltar och National Park Services webbplats. Dessa initiativ stärker urfolkens röster och bidrar till försoning och helande, vilket leder till en mer inkluderande och demokratisk civilreligion i USA.
