article_content: When this year's United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP28) begins in late November 2023, it will mark a pivotal moment for realignment. Seven years ago, nearly every nation signed the Paris Agreement, aiming to limit global warming with key targets to be achieved by 2030. A major goal of COP28 is to assess countries’ progress at the halfway point toward the 2030 deadlines. However, reports indicate the world is not currently on track. Simultaneously, concerns about energy security and disputes about compensating nations for climate-related loss and damage are making emission reduction agreements harder to reach. Still, there are signs of progress, according to energy and environmental policy researchers. A key element of COP28 is the conclusion of the global stocktake—a review of worldwide efforts to tackle climate change, designed to identify shortcomings and guide countries in recalibrating their climate strategies. A recent report on the stocktake stressed that the Paris Agreement has prompted global climate action. Yet, current policies and pledges to cut greenhouse gas emissions fall well short of keeping warming below 1.5°C (2.7°F) compared with preindustrial levels. Another UN-led report released in early November found that governments plan to produce twice as much fossil fuel in 2030 as is compatible with the 1.5°C pathway. Limiting warming to 1.5°C instead of 2°C (3.6°F) could deliver global benefits exceeding US$20 trillion. Escalating greenhouse gas emissions, mainly from fossil fuels—which are responsible for over three-quarters of total emissions—are the primary driver of rising global temperatures. To avoid overshooting 1.5°C of warming, worldwide greenhouse gas emissions need to fall about 45% from 2010 levels by 2030 and reach net zero around 2050, according to the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change. However, emissions rose in 2022, surpassing pre-pandemic levels, and average global temperatures briefly exceeded the 1.5°C threshold in March and June 2023. The global stocktake makes clear that to meet the Paris targets, countries must be more ambitious in cutting emissions. This means quickly reducing carbon emissions across economic sectors, accelerating renewable energy adoption (like solar and wind), strengthening policies to halt deforestation, and scaling up clean technologies such as heat pumps and electric vehicles. The report repeatedly highlights the need to 'phase out all unabated fossil fuels.' Fossil fuels currently provide 80% of the world’s energy and led to a record 36.8 gigatons of CO2 emissions in 2022. Despite climate risks, governments continue to provide substantial subsidies—about US$1.3 trillion in explicit subsidies in 2022, with China, the US, Russia, the EU and India as the largest providers. These subsidies increased sharply after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in 2022. UN Secretary-General António Guterres has emphasized the necessity of moving away from fossil fuels, criticizing the large profits retained by entrenched interests in the industry. African countries, in the Nairobi Declaration at the first Africa Climate Summit in 2023, also called for eliminating inefficient fossil fuel subsidies and supported a global carbon tax on fossil fuel trade. Ending fossil fuel subsidies is essential to removing economic barriers that slow the transition to clean energy. The report’s reference to 'unabated fossil fuels' is controversial, as it allows continued fossil fuel use if technologies like carbon capture and storage are used—but these technologies aren’t yet widely deployed. Several recent initiatives aim to accelerate the transition away from fossil fuels. In July 2023, Canada unveiled a strategy to end inefficient fossil fuel subsidies, becoming the first G20 nation to do so, with some exceptions. The European Union is expanding its carbon market to cover more sectors, while the United States' Inflation Reduction Act allocates US$10 billion for clean energy projects and offers $4 billion in tax credits to communities affected by the coal industry's decline. A newer financing tool, Just Energy Transition Partnerships, supports sustainable energy infrastructure in low-income countries. This approach enables cooperation where developed nations help phase out coal in economies still reliant on fossil fuels. South Africa, Indonesia, Senegal, and Vietnam have benefited from these partnerships starting in 2021. For example, the EU has pledged to help Senegal transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy, addressing the economic impacts from plant closures and prioritizing affordable, accessible electricity. By COP28, a comprehensive plan for Senegal to pursue a sustainable, low-emission future is expected. France, Germany, Canada, and various development banks have pledged 2.5 billion euros (about US$2.68 billion) to boost Senegal's renewable energy, targeting 40% of the country's energy from renewables by 2030. To align with the Paris Agreement, global efforts to reduce fossil fuel dependence and invest in developing nations' clean energy transitions are vital—not only lowering greenhouse gas emissions but also fostering environmentally responsible economic growth. translated_content: När årets FN:s klimatkonferens (COP28) inleds i slutet av november 2023 blir det en avgörande stund för ny inriktning. För sju år sedan skrev nästan alla länder under Parisavtalet med målet att begränsa den globala uppvärmningen, med viktiga delmål till 2030. Ett av huvudmålen med COP28 är att utvärdera ländernas framsteg halvvägs till 2030. Rapporter visar dock att världen inte är på rätt spår. Samtidigt försvårar energisäkerhetsfrågor och tvister om ersättning för klimatrelaterade skador och förluster möjligheterna till överenskommelser om utsläppsminskningar. Trots detta ser energi- och miljöforskare tecken på framsteg. En central del av COP28 är avslutningen av den globala avstämningen – en granskning av världens insatser mot klimatförändringar, som syftar till att identifiera brister och hjälpa länder att justera sina klimatsatsningar. En ny rapport om avstämningen framhöll att Parisavtalet fått igång klimatåtgärder globalt. Dock räcker nuvarande policyer och löften om minskade växthusgasutsläpp inte till för att hålla uppvärmningen under 1,5°C jämfört med förindustriell tid. En annan FN-rapport från början av november visar att regeringar planerar att producera dubbelt så mycket fossila bränslen 2030 som är förenligt med 1,5-gradersmålet. Att begränsa uppvärmningen till 1,5°C istället för 2°C kan ge globala fördelar som överstiger 20 biljoner dollar. Utsläppen ökar snabbt, särskilt från fossila bränslen som står för över tre fjärdedelar av de totala utsläppen – huvudorsaken till stigande globala temperaturer. För att undvika att överskrida 1,5-gradersmålet måste utsläppen globalt minska med cirka 45 procent till 2030 (jämfört med 2010) och nå netto noll runt 2050, enligt FN:s klimatpanel (IPCC). Men utsläppen steg under 2022, gick över nivåerna före pandemin, och globala temperaturer passerade tillfälligt 1,5°C både i mars och juni 2023. Avstämningen slår fast att länder måste vara mer ambitiösa för att nå Parisavtalets mål. Det innebär snabba minskningar av koldioxidutsläpp inom alla sektorer, snabbare utbyggnad av förnybar energi (som sol- och vindkraft), stärkt arbete mot avskogning och breddad satsning på ren teknik som värmepumpar och elfordon. Rapporten betonar återkommande vikten av att 'fasa ut alla ofiltrerade fossila bränslen.' Fossila bränslen står för 80 % av världens energianvändning och orsakade rekordhöga 36,8 gigaton CO2-utsläpp 2022. Trots klimatrisken fortsätter länder att ge stora subventioner – omkring 1,3 biljoner dollar i explicita subventioner 2022, där Kina, USA, Ryssland, EU och Indien är störst. Dessa stöd ökade kraftigt efter invasionen av Ukraina. FN:s generalsekreterare António Guterres har betonat vikten av att övergå från fossila bränslen och kritiserat höga vinster hos stora aktörer inom branschen. Afrikanska länder krävde i Nairobi-deklarationen på Afrikas första klimattoppmöte 2023 att ineffektiva fossila subventioner slopas och stödde en global koldioxidskatt på fossil handel. Att slopa fossila subventioner är avgörande för att undanröja ekonomiska hinder mot grön energi. Att rapporten talar om 'ofiltrerade fossila bränslen' är kontroversiellt, eftersom det tillåter fortsatt användning om teknik för koldioxidinfångning används – men sådan teknik används ännu inte i stor skala. Flera nya initiativ ska påskynda omställningen från fossila bränslen. I juli 2023 lanserade Kanada en strategi för att slopa ineffektiva subventioner och blev första G20-landet (med vissa undantag). EU breddar också sitt utsläppshandelssystem, och USA:s Inflation Reduction Act satsar 10 miljarder dollar på ren energi samt 4 miljarder i skattelättnader till samhällen påverkade av kolnäringens nedgång. Det nya finansieringsverktyget Just Energy Transition Partnerships stödjer hållbar infrastruktur i låginkomstländer. Modellen innebär att rika länder samarbetar för att fasa ut kol i länder där fossila bränslen dominerar. Sydafrika, Indonesien, Senegal och Vietnam har dragit nytta av partnerskapet sedan 2021. EU har till exempel lovat att stötta Senegals övergång till förnybar energi, samt ta itu med ekonomiska följder av nedstängningar och säkra tillgången på prisvärd el. Till COP28 väntas en samlad plan för Senegals klimatomställning vara klar. Frankrike, Tyskland, Kanada och flera utvecklingsbanker har lovat 2,5 miljarder euro (ca 2,68 miljarder dollar) till Senegals förnybara energi, med målet att 40 % av energin ska vara förnybar till 2030. För att möta Parisavtalets mål krävs globala satsningar på att minska fossilt beroende och investera i utvecklingsländers omställning till hållbar energi. Det sänker inte bara utsläppen utan gynnar även miljövänlig tillväxt. Denna artikel är återpublicerad från The Conversation under Creative Commons-licens. article_content: Can offering freebies help political parties win elections? This question is soon to be tested in Rajasthan, where the Congress government, led by Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot, has launched multiple welfare schemes and benefits for citizens. While Prime Minister Narendra Modi has criticized such giveaways—referring to them as 'revris'—many observers argue that not all populist measures are mere freebies; some are essential welfare policies. Rajasthan has a long-standing trend of voting out incumbent governments every five years, a pattern observed since 1998. Typically, a wave of support for the opposition is visible ahead of state elections. However, according to recent Economic Times reports, this anticipated shift is less pronounced this year. Many attribute this to the expanding reach of Gehlot's welfare initiatives, which have benefited various segments at the grassroots level. Ultimately, the effectiveness of these schemes will only become clear once election results are announced. The incumbent Congress faces a strong BJP campaign focused on corruption and communal issues. Historically, the margin of victory in Rajasthan has shrunk over the years. In 1998, Congress won with an 11.9% vote share lead over BJP. This dropped to 2.5% in 2008 and just 0.5% in 2018. In this context, the so-called 'floating vote,' rather than the fixed support bases of Congress or BJP, is often decisive. What influences these floating voters? Some believe welfare measures may sway them, and the Congress's extensive programs have outpaced the BJP’s in this regard. Gehlot, known for his interest in magic, has sought to reverse the state's habitual rejection of sitting governments by promoting seven major guarantees. These include an annual honorarium for the female head of families, subsidized gas cylinders for over a crore households, a law ensuring the old pension scheme for government employees, laptops/tablets for government college students, family insurance covering up to ₹15 lakh against natural calamities, English medium education, and purchasing cattle dung at ₹2 per kg. In advance of the elections, Gehlot also launched ‘Mehangai Rahat Camps’ (inflation relief camps) in April, issuing guarantee cards to about three crore people, promising benefits on essentials like food, gas, and electricity. His welfare policies have targeted a wide range: from rural poor (free ration kits, expanded health insurance, gas subsidies), to urban residents (employment guarantee schemes, Indira Rasoi), gig workers (Rs 5,000 one-time payment, welfare fund), and government employees (increased allowances). A notable pre-election move was the one-time payment for gig workers to buy helmets, uniforms, and daily-use items, seen as an effort to win over a new segment of urban voters. Gehlot defends these measures as welfare and social security steps, not mere giveaways. The BJP, while criticizing Congress’s tactics, has made similar promises in its manifesto, including a ₹450 gas subsidy, bonus payments on wheat, free scooters and education for girls, girl child savings bonds, and cash transfers for students. Despite these offers, some believe the BJP’s welfare schemes fall short compared to Congress's. The central issues of the BJP's campaign are corruption, governance, and social tensions, alongside electoral strategies based on caste. While some analysts see the BJP as having a potential edge, others believe Gehlot’s extensive schemes have given Congress a fighting chance. In Rajasthan's current scenario—where caste and religious loyalties are not expected to dramatically shift—the floating voter remains key, and government welfare initiatives may be influential. If Congress outshines the BJP in terms of welfare policies, the election result could be interpreted as a popular verdict on freebies. The outcome may set the trend for the upcoming Lok Sabha elections, with both Congress and BJP likely to intensify their focus on welfare measures.

Samtidigt som premiärminister Narendra Modi har kritiserat sådana utdelningar—som han kallat 'revris'—menar många att inte alla populistiska åtgärder bara är gratisförmåner; vissa är nödvändiga välfärdspolitiska insatser. Rajasthan har en långvarig trend där sittande regeringar röstas bort vart femte år, ett mönster som setts sedan 1998. Vanligtvis märks en våg av stöd för oppositionen före delstatsval. Men enligt en färsk rapport från Economic Times är denna förväntade omsvängning mindre tydlig i år. Många menar att detta beror på att Gehlots välfärdsprogram nått breda grupper på gräsrotsnivå. Hur effektiva dessa satsningar är, kommer dock bara att visa sig när valresultaten presenteras. Den sittande Kongressen möter en stark BJP-kampanj med fokus på korruption och samhällskonflikter. Historiskt har vinstmarginalen i Rajasthan minskat över tid. 1998 vann Kongressen med 11,9 procents försprång mot BJP. Detta sjönk till 2,5 % år 2008 och endast 0,5 % år 2018. I detta sammanhang är det ofta de så kallade 'flytande väljarna', snarare än lojalister till Kongressen eller BJP, som avgör. Vad påverkar dessa flytande väljare? Vissa menar att välfärdssatsningar kan vinna deras stöd, och Kongressens omfattande program har överträffat BJP:s på denna punkt. Gehlot, som är känd för sitt intresse för magi, har försökt vända statens vana att rösta bort sittande regeringar genom att satsa på sju stora garantier. Bland dessa finns en årlig ersättning till kvinnliga familjeöverhuvuden, subventionerade gascylindrar till över en miljon hushåll, lagstadgad återgång till det gamla pensionssystemet för statligt anställda, laptops/surfplattor till studenter i statliga högskolor, familjeförsäkringar upp till 1,5 miljoner rupier vid naturkatastrofer, engelskspråkig utbildning och inköp av boskapsgödsel för 2 rupier kilot. Inför valet lanserade Gehlot även 'Mehangai Rahat Camps' (lättnadsläger mot inflation) i april och delade ut garantikort till omkring tre miljoner människor med löften om förmåner på mat, gas och el. Hans välfärdsprogram har riktat sig brett: från fattiga på landsbygden (gratis ransoner, utökad sjukförsäkring, gassubvention), till stadsbor (sysselsättningsgaranti, Indira Rasoi), gig-arbetare (engångsutbetalning på 5 000 rupier, välfärdsfond) och statsanställda (höjda bidrag). Ett särskilt drag före valet var engångsbeloppet till gig-arbetare för att köpa hjälmar, uniformer och nödvändiga saker, vilket sågs som ett försök att vinna nya urbana väljare. Gehlot försvarar dessa åtgärder som välfärd och socialt skydd, inte bara gratisförmåner. Samtidigt har BJP, som kritiserat Kongressens strategi, själva lovat liknande förmåner i sitt manifest, inklusive 450 rupiers gassubvention, bonusbetalningar på vete, gratis scootrar och utbildning för flickor, sparobligationer för flickebarn och kontantbidrag till elever. Trots dessa löften menar vissa att BJP:s välfärdssatsningar inte når upp till Kongressens nivå. BJP:s kampanj har annars stort fokus på korruption, styrning och samhällsspänningar samt kastbaserad valstrategi. Vissa analytiker menar att BJP kan ha ett övertag, men andra anser att Gehlots omfattande program gett Kongressen en reell chans. I dagens Rajasthan, där kasts- och religiösa lojaliteter inte förväntas förändras nämnvärt, är de flytande väljarna fortfarande nyckeln och regeringens välfärdsinsatser kan bli avgörande. Om Kongressen överglänser BJP vad gäller välfärdspolitik kan valresultatet ses som en folkomröstning om gratisförmåner. Utfallet kan sätta trenden inför det kommande riksdagsvalet, där både Kongressen och BJP väntas satsa mer på välfärd.

article_content: Cold Arctic winds are expected to bring some of the coldest August weather to parts of Britain in nearly a century. Temperatures are forecast to drop as a persistent low-pressure system draws in air from the north, with two weeks of wet, windy, and chilly weather anticipated. There is a slight possibility of snow and sleet on the Scottish mountains as overnight temperatures approach freezing. Government data shows the last time August was this cold was in 1919, when temperatures in Yorkshire and Cumbria did not rise above 8.9°C for four days. Waves crashed against the promenade in Marsden near Souter Lighthouse in Sunderland as similar conditions are expected this year. Stormy seas were reported in Blackpool as forecasts predict showers, cool temperatures, and blustery conditions for the next two weeks. Daytime highs in some northern areas may not exceed 9°C this week, with cold winds making it feel even chillier. According to the Met Office, Loadpot Hill in Cumbria may not see temperatures above 8°C on Thursday. The unseasonably cold, wet, and windy spell is being attributed to a low-pressure system north of the UK. Met Office spokesperson Charlie Powell noted that the lowest recorded daily maximum temperature in August for Cumbria, Yorkshire, and Shetland was 8.9°C in 1919, and that Tuesday to Thursday this week will likely have similar readings. Despite the cold, some surfers enjoyed the waves at Longsands Beach in Tynemouth, although the cooler weather may signal the end of summer. Three young women were spotted braving the sea at Brighton Beach, and a couple were seen struggling to set up a tent in windy conditions. Forecasters are predicting a disappointing Bank Holiday weekend with widespread cool and wet weather continuing. Laura Young from the Met Office said much colder air moving in from the north is behind this unseasonable chill, affecting all parts of the UK, especially at night. There is little sign of improvement, with temperatures expected to stay below average and periods of rain forecasted for the rest of August. Earlier this month, Hurricane Bertha brought strong winds and heavy rain to Britain. Temperatures today may reach around 20°C, several degrees below normal for August, with even cooler conditions expected tomorrow. Cold Arctic winds will make it feel even chillier. Heavy showers are expected in eastern regions today, with a three-day forecast predicting rain in eastern and northern areas, sunshine and intermittent showers elsewhere. Music fans at Chelmsford's V Festival endured downpours, seeking shelter on the final day of the event. Dan Williams from the Met Office said no flood warnings have been issued, but showers are forecast throughout the country, particularly in the east. Most places will see temperatures in the high teens. Overnight lows could drop to 3°C in the coldest areas, mainly in Scotland. Showers will persist tomorrow with temperatures peaking near 19°C. Williams added that conditions will become milder by Wednesday as westerly winds bring slightly warmer air. The weather will be unsettled and changeable over the next two weeks. The start of the Bank Holiday may see dry weather and sunshine, but low pressure from the Atlantic could bring rain during Sunday and Monday. Billy Payne from MeteoGroup stated that the next couple of weeks look to be cooler and unsettled, with few reasons for optimism. Showers and cool weather will dominate, especially in the North and West, but some areas in the South East may still reach 20°C. By Thursday, prolonged rain is forecast in the North, spreading southwest by Friday. The early August Bank Holiday forecast calls for cool, breezy conditions with occasional showers for most of next week. This is unwelcome news for organizers of the Notting Hill Carnival, Europe's largest street festival, which will see hundreds of musicians and dancers parading through west London on Sunday and Monday.

Major technology companies such as Google, Microsoft, Yahoo, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Tumblr have disclosed how frequently they provide customer data to the U.S. government for national security investigations. This transparency follows a recent legal agreement that allows them to reveal more detailed information about government data requests related to counter-terrorism and intelligence.

Figures from 2012 and 2013 indicate that companies like Google and Microsoft were ordered to provide data from up to 10,000 customer accounts in a six-month period. Yahoo, in the same timeframe, responded to requests involving over 40,000 accounts. Previously, companies could only disclose limited details, but the new agreement with the Obama administration allows for broader—though still restricted—data sharing. Numbers are released in groupings of 1,000 and cannot be published until at least six months after the reporting period ends.

Tech firms emphasized that, while these requests impact thousands of accounts, they make up only a small portion of their total user base. However, the disclosures underscore the challenges these companies face in balancing commitments to user privacy and compliance with government demands.

Executives and legal representatives criticized the government’s requirement to report only data ranges, saying it limits transparency. Calls continue for narrower reporting bins. LinkedIn’s general counsel, Erika Rottenberg, noted the company advocates for more precise disclosures.

Brad Smith, Microsoft’s General Counsel, publicly reproached the U.S. and allied governments for failing to renounce mass interception of communications. All the companies maintain that they do not provide unfettered access to government agencies, warning that mistrust could reduce online engagement and ultimately impact business.

Some providers, notably Yahoo, reported the highest numbers of accounts included in government requests. These requests can encompass emails, photos, calendars, as well as billing and location data.

Google described the increased transparency as positive and pledged to seek even more openness. Meanwhile, revelations from former NSA contractor Edward Snowden have kept attention on U.S. surveillance tactics, prompting companies to further encrypt user data.

Privacy advocates, including the ACLU, contend that the scope of government surveillance may infringe upon the rights of many Americans. Legal challenges are ongoing; attorney Larry Klayman has asked the Supreme Court to review NSA phone data collection, after Judge Richard Leon found constitutional problems with the program.

In 2023, dedicated PlayStation fans may have noticed their accessory spending rise, with Sony launching several new products, including the DualSense Edge, PlayStation VR2, the latest PS5 model, and the PlayStation Portal. Now, Sony is expanding its audio lineup with the Pulse Explore wireless earbuds, set to debut next month.

The Pulse Explore earbuds are purpose-built for PlayStation devices, utilizing the new PlayStation Link connection system that seamlessly pairs with the PS5. This technology actually replaces Bluetooth on the PlayStation Portal, making the Pulse Explore one of the few wireless audio options available for the handheld this year. This reflects Sony's push to build a more interconnected PlayStation ecosystem, much like Apple’s approach with its products and accessories.

While designed for PlayStation, these earbuds can also serve other devices. For example, they've become my preferred earbuds for the Nintendo Switch OLED model. The Pulse Explore offers standard features for gaming earbuds, but stands out with its AI-powered noise rejection, which uses machine learning to minimize unwanted background sounds. In practical use, it noticeably reduces ambient noise, such as the sound from a nearby heating vent, during recordings.

Audio-wise, the Pulse Explore sports planar magnetic drivers, which Sony claims offer near-perfect accuracy. They are designed to take full advantage of the PS5’s 3D Audio, and in games like Astro’s Playroom, they preserve detailed, multidirectional sound effects. However, the earbuds are somewhat lacking in bass but otherwise deliver clear sound with minimal distortion.

As a companion for the PlayStation Portal, their value is less convincing. Since the Portal streams audio remotely from the PS5, audio quality naturally suffers somewhat, making the investment in both the Portal and earbuds ($200 each) questionable. On PS5, while audio performance is strong, I still prefer the Pulse 3D headset over earbuds.

Interestingly, the Pulse Explore’s compatibility extends to standard Bluetooth connections, allowing use with devices such as the Nintendo Switch. The earbuds’ black-and-white design even matches the Switch OLED’s Joy-Cons by coincidence. Their compact charging case also fits neatly into larger Switch cases. Battery life is about five hours per charge, with ten additional hours from the case—comparable to the Switch’s own battery life.

Potential buyers should note some drawbacks: the Pulse Explore have a bulky design that protrudes from the ears and may not fit all users comfortably. Combined with the steep $200 price tag, they can be a difficult purchase to justify. For those who prioritize matching their hardware or value versatility, however, the Pulse Explore is a stylish and functional accessory for both PlayStation and Switch.

Men om du prioriterar ett matchande utseende eller värdesätter mångsidighet, är Pulse Explore ett stilrent och funktionellt tillbehör till både PlayStation och Switch.

Euphoria executive producer Ron Leshem recently traveled to Spain, reflecting on how Hollywood initially rejected the HBO hit due to concerns about having teenage lead characters. Speaking at Madrid’s Iberseries & Platino Industria (IPI) during a panel focused on Gen Z content, Leshem noted that both Euphoria and the Duffer Brothers’ Stranger Things faced early resistance from networks hesitant to greenlight series centered on teens, unless they conformed to typical teen-drama formats.

“Everyone told us we needed to be more like Skins,” Leshem said, referencing the British drama that launched stars such as Nicholas Hoult and Dev Patel. “But we didn’t want to repeat Skins—we wanted to do something different,” he explained. Leshem collaborated with co-creator Sam Levinson to sell Euphoria to HBO, aiming for an artistic approach inspired by films like Trainspotting, Kids, and Requiem for a Dream.

Leshem credited HBO executives Francesca Orsi and Casey Bloys for their willingness to take creative risks, pairing the Euphoria team with the “genius filmmaker’s soul” of Sam Levinson to create a distinctive series. Euphoria follows a group of teenagers in a fictional Californian town as they navigate love, loss, hope, and addiction. Penned primarily by Levinson, the show is adapted from an Israeli series developed by Leshem and Daphna Levin over a decade ago. Leshem and Levin serve as executive producers on the U.S. version, alongside Levinson, Gary Lennon, and star Zendaya.

Leshem observed that many teen-led dramas at the time were “didactic” and premised on the idea that Gen Z struggles to form connections. He stated that Euphoria sought to break from this mold. The series is preparing for its third season on HBO and is credited with launching the careers of Zendaya and Sydney Sweeney (playing Rue and Cassie, respectively). Angus Cloud, who portrayed Fezco, passed away in July after an accidental overdose. The second season became HBO’s top-rated show since 2004, after Game of Thrones, with House of the Dragon later surpassing it.

Addressing the "eight-second attention span" myth, Leshem explained that this misconception came from a misinterpretation of a 2021 Google report. According to Leshem, it means creators have eight seconds to capture attention, not that Gen Z’s attention lasts only eight seconds. He argued this applies to viewers of all ages in today’s content-saturated world, urging creators to employ fresh storylines, innovative visuals, and genre crossovers—citing examples like Barbie, Money Heist, and Squid Game.

Panel participant Vicky Gazalla, Strategic Partner and Manager for TV and Film at YouTube Spain, added insights about Gen Z viewing habits, describing them as the most disruptive generation. She emphasized Gen Z’s desire for seamless digital experiences across devices and their preference for YouTube, which they regard as both a favorite platform and a place where creators are seen as celebrities. Top content categories among Gen Z include music, gaming, movie trailers, educational content, and lifestyle segments such as wellbeing and meditation. Gazalla noted that Gen Z enjoys both short-form “snack” content for quick engagement and longer-form videos on the platform.

Under ett panelsamtal på Iberseries & Platino Industria (IPI) i Madrid, inriktat på innehåll för Gen Z, berättade Leshem att både Euphoria och Duffer-brödernas Stranger Things först mötte motstånd från tv-bolag som tvekade att satsa på serier centrerade kring tonåringar om de inte följde typiska format för ungdomsdrama.

"Men vi ville inte göra samma sak som Skins – vi ville skapa något annorlunda," förklarade han. Leshem samarbetade med medskaparen Sam Levinson för att sälja Euphoria till HBO och siktade på ett konstnärligt uttryck inspirerat av filmer som Trainspotting, Kids och Requiem for a Dream.

Leshem tackade HBO:s Francesca Orsi och Casey Bloys för deras vilja att ta kreativa risker, och för att de kopplade ihop Euphoria-teamet med "filmskapargeni" Sam Levinson – vilket ledde till en unik serie. Euphoria följer en grupp tonåringar i en fiktiv stad i Kalifornien när de navigerar kärlek, förlust, hopp och missbruk. Serien är främst skriven av Levinson och baserad på en israelisk serie som Leshem och Daphna Levin utvecklade för över tio år sedan. Leshem och Levin är exekutiva producenter på den amerikanska versionen, tillsammans med Levinson, Gary Lennon och huvudrollsinnehavaren Zendaya.

Leshem noterade att många ungdomsdraman vid den tiden var "didaktiska" och byggde på idén att Gen Z har svårt att skapa relationer. Han menade att Euphoria ville bryta mot detta mönster. Serien förbereder nu sin tredje säsong på HBO och har banat väg för karriärerna för Zendaya och Sydney Sweeney (i rollerna som Rue och Cassie). Angus Cloud, som spelade Fezco, gick bort i juli efter en olyckshändelse med överdos. Säsong två blev HBO:s mest sedda serie sedan 2004 efter Game of Thrones, tills House of the Dragon gick om den.

När Leshem tog upp myten om "åtta sekunders uppmärksamhetsspann" förklarade han att detta missförstånd grundar sig i en missuppfattning av en Google-rapport från 2021. Enligt Leshem betyder det att skapare har åtta sekunder på sig att fånga tittarnas intresse, inte att Gen Z bara kan fokusera i åtta sekunder. Han menade att detta gäller för publiken i alla åldrar i dagens innehållsfyllda värld och uppmanade skapare till nytänkande berättelser, visuella innovationer och genreblandningar – med hänvisning till Barbie, Money Heist och Squid Game.

Paneldeltagaren Vicky Gazalla, strategisk partner och TV- och filmchef på YouTube Spanien, bidrog med insikter om Gen Z:s tittarvanor och beskrev dem som den mest omvälvande generationen. Hon betonade Gen Z:s önskan om sömlösa digitala upplevelser på alla enheter och deras förkärlek för YouTube, som de ser som både favoritplattform och där skapare betraktas som kändisar. Bland Gen Z:s populäraste innehåll på YouTube finns musik, datorspel, filmtrailers, utbildande videor och livsstil såsom välmående och meditation. Gazalla noterade att Gen Z gillar både korta “snack”-videor för snabba intryck och längre videor på plattformen.

article_content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has presented an ambitious vision for a potential third term, pledging to make India’s economy the world’s largest if re-elected. Modi pointed to economic achievements since 2014, highlighting that India now ranks as the world’s fifth-largest economy, surpassing the United Kingdom, its former colonial ruler. Addressing a rally in Madhya Pradesh, Modi stated, 'From ground to space, India is being applauded everywhere.' He criticized Congress-led governments in Chhattisgarh and Rajasthan, accusing their chief ministers of involvement in activities such as illegal betting and generating black money. Modi reflected on India’s economic progress, noting that in 2014 its global ranking was 10th. Since then, India moved to 9th, 8th, 7th, and 6th, with the milestone achievement of overtaking the UK to become 5th, which drew international attention. With Lok Sabha elections nearing, Modi emphasized ongoing development, warning that a Congress return would mean a revival of the '85 percent commission system,' citing comments from former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi about only 15 percent of government funds reaching beneficiaries. He also addressed Congress’s planned complaint to the Election Commission over his proposal to extend the free ration scheme for five more years, reaffirming his focus on people’s welfare. In business news, Tata Group has signed a $750 million agreement to acquire Wistron’s manufacturing facility, becoming the first Indian company to assemble iPhones. India has surpassed Mainland China in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2024, now having the highest representation among Asian countries. This milestone reflects improvements in Indian higher education and research. In another corporate development, directors of Religare Enterprises Ltd have raised allegations of fraud and regulatory breaches against the Burman family’s takeover efforts, and have reported these concerns to financial regulators.

Därefter har Indien klättrat till plats 9, 8, 7 och 6 – och det stora genombrottet kom när Indien gick om Storbritannien till plats 5 vilket gav internationell uppmärksamhet. Inför det kommande parlamentsvalet (Lok Sabha) betonade Modi vikten av fortsatt utveckling och varnade för att Kongressens återkomst skulle medföra en återgång till det så kallade '85-procentiga kommissionssystemet', med hänvisning till tidigare premiärminister Rajiv Gandhis kommentar att endast 15 procent av offentliga medel nådde till mottagarna. I affärsvärlden har Tata Group tecknat ett avtal på 750 miljoner dollar för att förvärva Wistrons tillverkningsanläggning, vilket gör Tata till det första indiska företaget som monterar iPhones. article_content: United Airlines has released a festive short romantic comedy called 'Love in Plane Sight' on its YouTube channel. Despite being billed as a 'Full Film,' the production is a brisk, under-six-minute rom-com. The story follows astronomer Elle Towe, who, while traveling home for Christmas, bumps into a stranger at the airport—literally spilling coffee on herself in the process. Fate puts them together as seatmates on a United flight, leading to romance and, a year later, a honeymoon trip to Hawaii with United. Packed with familiar holiday rom-com elements, the short includes several appearances by Santa Claus and some United employees disguised as elves. United’s own description asks viewers whether they believe in 'love at first flight,' positioning Elle’s adventure as both a journey through the skies and of the heart. The film has been met with a blend of entertained mockery and lighthearted enjoyment. The Washington Post’s Natalie Compton dubbed it ideal 'hate-watch' material, highlighting how her team's group chat came alive dissecting its array of holiday-movie clichés. Scenes such as calming a crying baby onboard and playful seatmate antics drew both criticism and amusement, with reviewers debating the appeal of chatty fellow travelers. Business Insider’s Alexandra Karplus reported that United’s Instagram teaser for the film gathered thousands of likes as well as pointed remarks about the company’s labor practices, with some commenters questioning the airline’s spending priorities. She observed that the film’s brief runtime could make it tolerable as passing entertainment during a flight—particularly if other options are lacking. In the end, 'Love in Plane Sight' is widely seen as a cheeky, lighthearted promo rather than a serious movie.

article_content: Indian Army Chief General Manoj Pande stated that India remains a 'bright spot' amid global instability caused by geopolitical tensions such as the Russia-Ukraine war and conflicts in West Asia. Speaking at the Chanakya Defence Dialogue, he emphasized India's commitment to respecting sovereignty, territorial integrity, and resolving disputes peacefully. Against the backdrop of ongoing border issues with China, Gen Pande noted that India is establishing defence wings globally and aims to increase joint military training with partner countries. He described the contemporary world as shifting from globalization towards decoupling and de-risking, but maintained confidence in India's positive trajectory. Gen Pande highlighted the growing importance of national security in international affairs, pointing to economic turbulence, radicalisation, terrorism, piracy, illegal migration, and climate change as global concerns. Strategic affairs expert Lisa Curtis noted increasing competition in the Indo-Pacific and suggested the Quad is evolving as a successful multilateral organization, while acknowledging China’s growing influence. India, according to Gen Pande, has a unique and credible voice rooted in national values and actively contributes to cooperative security, economic development, innovation, and diplomacy. He stressed that technology is transforming geopolitical competition and warfare, with new global divisions emerging. Despite challenges, India's resilient, consumer-driven economy has weathered global downturns. The Chanakya Defence Dialogue, organized by the Indian Army with CLAWS, is focused on regional security and collaboration in South Asia and the Indo-Pacific. In business news, Apple Inc reported record revenue in India for the September quarter, luxury car buyers are getting younger, and Punit Goenka's role in the proposed Sony-Zee merger faces uncertainty due to regulatory investigation.

Vid Chanakya Defence Dialogue betonade han Indiens hängivenhet för respekt för suveränitet, territoriell integritet och fredliga lösningar på tvister. Med pågående gränstvister med Kina nämnde general Pande att Indien inrättar försvarsavdelningar i nya delar av världen och strävar efter att öka gemensam militär träning med partnerländer. Han beskrev hur världen nu rör sig bort från globalisering mot ökad frikoppling och riskhantering, men uttryckte fortsatt tilltro till Indiens positiva utveckling. General Pande framhöll den växande betydelsen av nationell säkerhet i internationella sammanhang och pekade på ekonomisk oro, radikalisering, terrorism, piratverksamhet, illegal migration och klimatförändringar som globala bekymmer. Strategiexperten Lisa Curtis påpekade ökad konkurrens i Indo-Pacific och tror att Quad utvecklas till en framgångsrik multilateral organisation, samtidigt som Kinas inflytande växer. Enligt general Pande har Indien en unik och trovärdig röst rotad i nationella värderingar och bidrar aktivt till säkerhetssamarbete, ekonomisk utveckling, innovation och diplomati. Han underströk att teknologins roll i geopolitik och krigföring växer, med nya globala skiljelinjer som uppstår. On October 12, 2022, Valve released an updated version of its popular handheld gaming PC, the Steam Deck, now featuring an enhanced OLED display, longer battery life, and additional improvements over the original model. A recent report from PC Gamer noted that many fans initially worried about possible inventory shortages, recalling the challenges Valve faced with the first Steam Deck launch in February 2022. At that time, preorder supplies sold out within hours, and a lengthy reservation list left many customers waiting months for their devices. Valve had underestimated demand, which led to widespread frustration.

This time, however, Valve appears to have learned from past experience. On launch day for the new OLED models, estimated delivery dates for the $549 and $649 versions remain short—just 3 to 5 business days. This availability suggests that Valve prepared ample stock in advance to meet customer demand. Additionally, the original $399 Steam Deck continues to be available for rapid delivery.

Valve spokesperson Jay Shaw told media earlier this month, “We’re confidently hoping that everything holds up well and people aren’t slipping into reservations for months and months out.” So far, that preparation seems to have paid off. Aside from minor payment processing issues and a specific OLED shipment delay in Taiwan, most buyers have reported a smooth purchasing experience and swift delivery estimates. While Valve has not yet announced a full successor to the Steam Deck, the new OLED model currently offers the premium Steam Deck experience, thanks to its vibrant display and refined design.

Photo by Rafael Guajardo.
translated_content:
Den 12 oktober 2022 släppte Valve en uppdaterad version av sin populära handhållna spel-PC, Steam Deck, nu med en förbättrad OLED-skärm, längre batteritid och andra förbättringar jämfört med originalmodellen. En färsk rapport från PC Gamer noterade att många fans till en början oroade sig för möjliga lagerbrister, med tanke på de problem Valve stötte på vid det första Steam Deck-släppet i februari 2022. Då såldes förhandsbeställningarna slut inom några timmar, och en lång reservationslista gjorde att många kunder fick vänta månader på sina enheter. Valve hade underskattat efterfrågan, vilket ledde till stor frustration.

Den här gången verkar Valve dock ha lärt sig av tidigare misstag. På lanseringsdagen för de nya OLED-modellerna ligger de uppskattade leveransdatumen för 549- och 649-dollarsversionerna kvar på endast 3 till 5 arbetsdagar. Denna tillgänglighet tyder på att Valve förberett ett rejält lager inför lanseringen för att möta efterfrågan. Dessutom går det fortfarande att få tag på den ursprungliga Steam Decken för 399 dollar med snabb leverans.

Valves talesperson Jay Shaw sa till media tidigare denna månad: "Vi hoppas med tillförsikt att allt håller sig bra och att folk inte hamnar på väntelistan i månader och åter månader." Hittills verkar den förberedelsen ha lönat sig. Bortsett från mindre problem med betalningshantering och en särskild OLED-försening i Taiwan, har de flesta köpare rapporterat att köpupplevelsen varit smidig och att leveranstiderna varit snabba. Även om Valve ännu inte har presenterat en riktig efterträdare till Steam Deck, levererar den nya OLED-modellen nu den bästa Steam Deck-upplevelsen tack vare sin levande skärm och förbättrade design.

Foto: Rafael Guajardo.

article_content: Below are WhatsApp message exchanges between Oscar Pistorius and Reeva Steenkamp, read in court during Pistorius's murder trial.  January 11, 2013: OP to RS: Angel, please don't say anything to anyone. Darren told people it was his fault. I can't afford for that to come out. The guys promised not to say anything. RS to OP: I have no idea what you're talking about :) RS to OP: But thank you for telling me, I appreciate it x  January 19, 2013: RS to OP: Baba. OP to RS: Yes. RS to OP: There are a lot of things that could make us both feel bad. RS to OP: I'm just very honest. RS to OP: I don't always think before I say something, but appreciate that I'm not a liar. OP to RS: I know. It's just that when you got back from Tropica, you made it sound like you'd only smoked weed once, and then last night something else came out. I don't know how many times you took it, or if you tried other things, or what you did when on them. RS to OP: I'm sorry if it upset you, that wasn't my intention. OP to RS: I do appreciate it. I could never be with someone who lied. RS to OP: Me neither. RS to OP: It's like I see rabbit things in your house, and when we go places, you take pictures of them everywhere. I wonder who you have that connection with. The same things probably cross your mind. At the end of the day, this is now, not then. RS to OP: I wasn't a stripper or anything like that. RS to OP: I've never been a prude; I've had fun, but always innocently and without harm.  January 27, 2013: RS to OP: I'm not sure why I'm writing first, but maybe it says a lot about what's happening. Today was a good friend's engagement. I wanted to stay longer and enjoy myself, but it's over now. You've been picking on me a lot since you got back from Cape Town, and I get that you're sick, but it's been hard. Yesterday wasn't good for either of us, but we managed to communicate and show we care more than the drama. I wasn't flirting with anyone today. I feel sick that you suggested that and made a scene at the table, making us leave early. I'm very disappointed in how the day ended.  We're living in a relationship where you can be mad at how I deal with things but act cold when you're upset. I always hear about how you dated other girls, but you get upset if I mention a story about a previous boyfriend. I do everything to make you happy. You get upset with me in front of others. I've been upset by you for two days now. I left Darren's party early and can't get that day back. Sometimes, I'm scared of you and how you snap at me or react. You make me happy most of the time, and I think we're great together, but I'm not someone who's trying to bring you down. I'm the girl who let go and fell in love with you. But I also get sidelined when you're in a bad mood. You criticize my accents and voices; when I show affection, you ask me to stop. I'm sorry if you truly thought I was flirting with Sam's husband. Maybe we're struggling. I just want us both to be happy.  OP to RS: Please let me know when I can phone you. RS to OP: I'm here. OP to RS: I want to talk to you and sort this out. I want us to have an amazing relationship. I'm sorry for the things I say without thinking and for taking offense at your actions. Being sick and tired isn't an excuse. I was upset you went to talk to a guy after we got food; I was standing there watching you touch his arm and ignore me. When I said something, you introduced me, but then kept talking to him. I didn't know the song Martin played in the car, and I get that you were tired. I know you don't like it when I drive fast, and I was late picking up Gina, but you could've asked her to drive herself. I was starving when we left and upset. You didn't come to talk to me. I'm sorry I told you to stop tapping my neck, I know you were just being loving. I had a bad headache and should have just communicated that. I'm sorry for asking you not to do an accent last night.  February 8, 2013: RS to OP: I like to think I make you proud when I attend functions with you. I present myself well and can talk to people while you are busy with fans and friends. I also knew people there, and while you were having photos taken, I was saying goodbye to colleagues, and Fitz wanted a picture with me. I was being polite as you were busy. I understood your urgency to leave and tried to help by getting to the exit before you since it's hard to walk fast in heels. I thought I was helping us leave without you getting hassled. I didn’t expect to be criticized for it, especially so loudly. I might act tomboyish sometimes, but I see myself as a lady and didn't feel like one after tonight. I appreciate you invited me and I know it's hard for you at times, but I'm really trying to make you happy, even though I feel you never are. I can't be criticized by others for being with you and then also hurt by you—the person who should protect me.
translated_content: Nedan är WhatsApp-meddelanden mellan Oscar Pistorius och Reeva Steenkamp som lästes upp i domstol under Pistorius mordrättegång.  11 januari 2013: OP till RS: Älskling, säg ingenting till någon. Darren sa till folk att det var hans fel. Jag har inte råd att det kommer ut. Killarna lovade att inte säga något. RS till OP: Jag har ingen aning om vad du pratar om :) RS till OP: Men tack för att du berättade, jag uppskattar det x  19 januari 2013: RS till OP: Baba. OP till RS: Ja. RS till OP: Det finns många saker som kan få oss båda att må dåligt. RS till OP: Jag är bara väldigt ärlig. RS till OP: Jag tänker inte alltid innan jag säger något, men uppskatta att jag inte ljuger. OP till RS: Jag vet. Det är bara det att när du kom tillbaka från Tropica, fick det att låta som att du bara rökt gräs en gång, och igår kväll kom något annat fram. Jag vet inte hur många gånger du prövat eller om du testat annat, eller vad du gjorde när du var påverkad. RS till OP: Förlåt om det gjorde dig ledsen, det var inte min mening. OP till RS: Jag uppskattar det. Jag skulle inte kunna vara med någon som ljuger. RS till OP: Inte jag heller. RS till OP: Det är som när jag ser kaninsaker hemma hos dig och när vi är ute tar du bilder på dem överallt. Jag undrar vem du har den kopplingen till. Samma saker går säkert genom ditt huvud. I slutändan är det här nu, inte då. RS till OP: Jag har aldrig varit strippa eller något sådant. RS till OP: Jag har aldrig varit pryd; jag har haft kul, men alltid oskyldigt och utan att någon tagit skada.  27 januari 2013: RS till OP: Jag vet inte varför jag skriver först, men kanske säger det mycket om vad som händer. Idag var det en av mina bästa vänners förlovning. Jag ville stanna längre och hade roligt, men nu är det över. Du har varit hård mot mig sedan du kom tillbaka från Kapstaden, och jag förstår att du är sjuk, men det har varit jobbigt. Igår var inte bra för oss, men vi lyckades prata och visa att vi bryr oss mer än om dramat. Jag flörtade inte med någon idag. Jag mår dåligt för att du antydde det och skapade en scen så vi gick hem tidigt. Jag är besviken på hur dagen slutade.  Vi lever i en relation där du kan vara arg på hur jag hanterar saker men blir kall när du är ledsen. Jag får höra om hur du dejtat andra tjejer, men du blir sur om jag nämner en gammal pojkvän. Jag försöker göra dig lycklig och inte säga saker som orsakar problem. Du blir arg på mig inför andra. Jag har varit ledsen på grund av dig i två dagar nu. Jag gick hem tidigt från Darrens fest och kan aldrig få tillbaka den dagen. Ibland är jag rädd för dig och hur du ryter till eller reagerar. Du gör mig glad för det mesta, och jag tycker vi är fantastiska tillsammans, men jag är inte en som försöker förstöra för dig. Jag är tjejen som släppte taget och blev kär i dig. Men jag blir också åsidosatt när du är på dåligt humör. Du klagar på mina dialekter och röster; när jag visar kärlek ber du mig sluta. Förlåt om du verkligen trodde att jag flörtade med Sams man. Kanske har vi det svårt. Jag vill bara att vi båda ska vara lyckliga.  OP till RS: Säg till när jag kan ringa dig. RS till OP: Jag är här. OP till RS: Jag vill prata och reda ut det här. article_content: Ohio health officials have denied reports that the flesh-eating drug krokodil has appeared in the state after investigating three suspected cases. According to the Central Ohio Poison Control Center, none of the cases tested positive for codeine, the primary ingredient that would indicate krokodil use. The most notable case, from Columbus, was determined to be an infection resulting from the use of contaminated needles. A spokesperson from the Poison Control Center suggested that the absence of krokodil in Ohio may be due to the widespread availability of heroin. 'Sadly, it’s much easier for people to obtain heroin here,' the spokesperson said, pointing out that heroin and other opiates remain plentiful in Ohio. Krokodil, also known as desomorphine, is infamous for causing severe, flesh-eating wounds due to its toxic additives. The drug is more prevalent in Russia, where codeine is easier to obtain than heroin. In the US, suspected cases in states like Arizona, Illinois, and Oklahoma have often turned out to be misidentified heroin or infections from unsterile needle use. At least one user, Amber Neitzel from Illinois, described to MailOnline how she and her sister developed serious wounds after using what they believed was krokodil. Although initially convinced of the drug’s spread, further testing by authorities did not confirm the presence of krokodil in the samples. The Drug Enforcement Administration echoed this, stating that their labs had yet to identify krokodil in any US samples. In one Illinois case, a substance thought to be krokodil was tested and found to be heroin instead. Despite the lack of confirmed cases, experts remain alert. Dr Marcel Casavant of the Poison Control Center emphasized that while nothing rules out isolated cases of krokodil use, he does not expect it to become a widespread problem in Ohio as is seen in Russia. Both officials and former users continue to warn against the dangers posed by injectable drug use and the risks of untested, potentially dangerous substances.

article_content: Denis MacShane, a former Labour MP and Europe minister, pleaded guilty in court to filing 19 falsified expense claims, totaling nearly £13,000, for supposed research and translation work. He used the funds for travel to various European destinations, including Paris for a literary event. His sentencing at London’s Old Bailey was postponed until Monday to give the judge more time to deliberate. The maximum possible sentence is seven years in prison, though a shorter term is expected. MacShane was released on bail until sentencing, with the judge emphasizing that this did not indicate the likely outcome. Several former colleagues spoke in his favor, emphasizing his expertise in European affairs and his positive reputation. MacShane’s defense counsel, Mark Milliken-Smith QC, pointed out the personal tragedies MacShane faced, such as the loss of his daughter and his divorce, and noted that he accepted responsibility from the outset, even after initial indications that prosecution was unlikely. Parliament began investigating his expense claims in 2009, as part of the broader UK MPs' expenses scandal. The Metropolitan Police were initially hindered by parliamentary privilege, which restricted access to critical evidence. Only after further documentation was released by Parliament did the police resume their investigation and press charges in 2013. Between 2005 and 2008, MacShane made 19 claims for payments to the European Policy Institute (EPI), a think tank he had established in 1992. The forged invoices were signed using the alias 'E.J. Matthews.' His brother denied any involvement, stating the think tank had become inactive years earlier. In his statement, MacShane said he created the false name to avoid public association with pro-European causes, fearing damage to his political career. Prosecutors highlighted his efforts to disguise his personal involvement through the use of various names on the invoices. Having resigned as MP for Rotherham amid the investigation in 2012, MacShane expressed regret, though he asserted that he did not personally benefit from the fraud. He is one of several MPs and peers prosecuted in the UK's expenses scandal, a group that includes Elliot Morley, David Chaytor, Jim Devine, Eric Illsley, Margaret Moran, and Conservative peers Lord John Taylor of Warwick and Lord Paul White of Hanningfield, all convicted for similar abuses.

Han använde pengarna för resor till olika europeiska städer, bland annat till Paris för ett litteraturevenemang. Domen vid Old Bailey i London sköts upp till måndag för att domaren skulle få mer betänketid. Det högsta straffet är sju års fängelse, men ett kortare fängelsestraff väntas. MacShane släpptes mot borgen fram till dom, och domaren betonade att detta inte ger någon antydan om påföljden. Flera före detta kollegor gav honom goda vitsord och betonade hans expertis om Europa och goda anseende. Parlamentet inledde sin granskning 2009 inom ramen för den bredare brittiska utgiftsskandalen bland parlamentsledamöter. You might expect dishes like brown rice salads, chipotle pulled pork, and balsamic strawberry soda to come from a hip inner-city café, but in Sydney's Camperdown district, they’re being served up at a McDonald’s outlet now rebranded as 'The Corner.' This marks McDonald’s first global experiment turning a McCafe into an entirely new concept, both in menu and ambiance.

'"The Corner" acts as a 'learning lab' for McDonald’s, offering gourmet options that veer far from their classic Big Macs and cheeseburgers as part of a $1 billion revamp. The rotating menu features customizable salads with Moroccan chicken, brown rice, lentils, chipotle pork, and a selection of sauces from chutney to chimichurri.

According to Field Service Manager Cameron Newlands, the café serves smoothies, craft sodas, freshly brewed barista coffee, cakes, and pastries, alongside staple items like breakfast bacon-and-egg rolls and avocado feta sourdough. The goal is to align more closely with modern café culture.

Located just 600 meters from Newtown’s King St—where a McDonald’s closed in 1998 after local resistance to fast food—the café presents a significant shift towards health-conscious and upmarket offerings.

The update comes on the heels of McDonald’s announcing gourmet build-your-own burgers, which will be launched in all Australian restaurants over the next six to nine months. Customers pick from 19 fillings via digital touch-screens, with creations served on wooden platters and delivered to their tables.

McDonald’s Australia CEO Andrew Gregory says this overhaul is customer-driven and part of a five-year modernization plan. The company will open three more 'Customer Learning Labs' this year and another ten in early 2015 before rolling out these changes across the country.

Additional upgrades include self-service kiosks, digital menus, and home delivery for the new gourmet burgers.

Gregory emphasized, 'All our innovations respond to Australian customer feedback. We want to make future Macca’s restaurants exactly what Aussies want.' The revamped service model even changes how staff interact with patrons.

McDonald's first arrived in Australia in 1971 and now runs roughly 930 locations, serving 1.7 million customers daily and employing up to 90,000 people. The new initiatives are expected to reach all Australian restaurants within the next year.

article_content: Thick grey clouds swept across much of the UK this morning, ending what had been an exceptionally warm and sunny weekend. In Teesside, swallows basked in the sun; in Devon, bees collected nectar; and in South-West London, grasshoppers could be heard chirping — all signs more typical of May than mid-November. With just six weeks until Christmas, Britain enjoyed unseasonably high temperatures over the weekend. However, optimism quickly faded as sunshine gave way to mist and fog, reducing visibility throughout much of the country. During the commute, London landmarks like St Paul’s Cathedral and the London Eye were shrouded in thick fog, with visibility sometimes falling to a few hundred metres. Only Northern Ireland and the coast of North West Scotland avoided the gloom, though temperatures there were no higher than 10°C. According to the Met Office, this November remains on track to be the warmest since records began in 1659, after weekend highs reached 18°C (65°F). The mild spell is expected to continue, with forecasts of up to 15°C (59°F) in the South and 11°C (52°F) in the North this week. Notably, Sussex experienced warmer temperatures than Syria, while Cardigan in Wales was warmer than Corfu. So far, this month’s average temperature is nearly as high as a typical May, at around 11.2°C. Day-trippers flocked outdoors to enjoy the sunshine, especially in the West and South, where temperatures approached 18°C. In London, Hyde Park filled with people soaking up the sun, and many pubs reopened their beer gardens — a rare occurrence in mid-November. Temperatures nearly doubled England’s typical November average of 9.5°C (49°F), and summer flowers, insects, and birds were seen across much of the country. The temperature came within 3°C of the UK’s latest-ever record for this time of year — 20.7°C (69°F), set at Aber, North Wales, on November 17, 1997. By contrast, Hamah, Syria, saw just 9°C, and Corfu reached only 16°C (61°F). Met Office forecaster Charlie Powell explained that mild air from southeast Europe, including France and Germany, was responsible for the unusual warmth, which is expected to last several more days. The average temperature in Central England so far this month is 10.7°C (51°F), nearly 3°C above the long-term average, with records dating back 353 years and covering London, Manchester, and Bristol. The mild weather is also affecting wildlife and plant life, prompting unusual animal activity and late blooming. Members of the Eton College Rowing Centre enjoyed time on the Thames, while couples relaxed on Brighton’s seafront and strawberries ripened near Oxford. Jonathan Powell, of Positive Weather Solutions, stated that with an especially warm second half of November expected, the month could be the warmest on record. September and October have already ranked among the warmest ever recorded, and the current warm spell has led to out-of-season crop growth and animal behavior. National Trust ecologist Matthew Oates noted that the countryside is unusually flowery, and some frogs are croaking — typically a springtime sound — weeks before Christmas. Rutland Water reserve in Leicestershire has seen large numbers of birds arriving, attributed to the milder temperatures, and tomatoes have been ripening in North London gardens.

article_content: Traveling abroad? Experts recommend blending in with locals to avoid standing out as a tourist, as this can make you a target for theft or crime. Recent events—including the arrest and release of Arizona resident Yanira Maldonado in Mexico—have prompted travel experts to share essential safety tips. According to the U.S. State Department, over 2,500 Americans are arrested abroad each year, with 30% linked to illegal drug incidents. Maldonado spent time in a Mexican jail before her release due to lack of evidence, highlighting how travelers can face unexpected trouble. Travel expert Pauline Frommer recommends careful research using resources like the U.S. State Department and the U.K. Foreign & Commonwealth Office's online travel advisories. Frommer prefers the U.K.'s advisories for their detailed and regularly updated information, such as specific crime reports. While some areas of Mexico—like certain border regions and Acapulco—are considered unsafe, Frommer notes that many destinations remain enjoyable, citing her own trips to Cancun, Cozumel, and Mexico City. U.S. citizens arrested abroad are subject to local laws and may not receive the same protections as in the U.S. The State Department can assist within its authority and international law. Travelers detained where the U.S. has consular representation are entitled to a visit from a government official, says Alex Puig of International SOS. Blending in with appropriate dress can reduce your risk of being targeted, Puig advises, noting that obvious tourist attire (like jeans, white sneakers, or college shirts) can attract attention. Carry minimal cash and valuables, using credit cards instead, which are widely accepted and replaceable. Ensure your credit card permits cash advances for emergencies, recommends Texas attorney Louis Lopez. Be aware of your surroundings, especially on public transport. Puig observes that Americans traveling in Mexico are now more cautious, often checking their seats after cases like Maldonado's, where drugs were allegedly found under a bus seat. Access local news online for country-specific insights. Remain vigilant, especially near borders known for drug trafficking, like the route from Mexico to the U.S., as traffickers may try to use unsuspecting travelers.

Se till att ditt kreditkort tillåter kontantuttag vid nödsituationer, råder Texas-advokaten Louis Lopez. Var uppmärksam på din omgivning, särskilt vid resor med kollektivtrafik. Puig menar att amerikaner som reser i Mexiko nu är mer försiktiga och ofta kontrollerar sina säten efter incidenter som Maldonados, där droger påstås ha hittats under ett bussäte. Läs lokala nyheter online för specifik information om ditt resmål. Var särskilt vaksam vid gränser berömda för narkotikasmuggling, såsom rutten Mexiko–USA, då smugglare kan använda ovetande resenärer.

article_content: An Oregon couple expressed unusual appreciation for their service at a high-end steakhouse in Seaside by leaving a tip in the form of crystal methamphetamine. Authorities reported that 40-year-old Ryan Benson and 37-year-old Erica Manly dined at Twisted Fish Steakhouse on Thursday night, enjoying their meal and several drinks. When it came time to pay, the pair, lacking cash, used a gift card to settle their bill. Instead of a traditional tip, Manly handed the waitress an envelope with a question mark drawn on it. The envelope contained crystal-like rocks, later identified as crystal meth. Steve Keszler, manager of the downtown steakhouse, told the Oregonian, 'We’re not a little dive bar or hole in the wall. We’re a classy place.' Police arrived at the restaurant while the couple was still present and took them into custody. Authorities discovered approximately 20 ounces of methamphetamine, valued at $1,500, in Manly's purse during a preliminary search. A subsequent search of the couple’s hotel room at the nearby Holiday Inn Express revealed equipment commonly used to manufacture meth, such as a small torch and batteries. Benson was charged with possession and manufacture of methamphetamine, while Manly faced charges for possession, delivery, and manufacture of the drug.

När det var dags att betala använde paret, som saknade kontanter, ett presentkort för att betala notan. Istället för traditionell dricks gav Manly servitrisen ett kuvert med ett frågetecken ritat på. Kuvertet innehöll kristalliknande stenar, som senare identifierades som kristallmetamfetamin. Steve Keszler, chef för steakhouse-restaurangen i centrum, sa till Oregonian: 'Vi är inte en kvarterskrog eller ett hål i väggen. Vi är ett fint ställe.' Polisen anlände till restaurangen medan paret fortfarande var kvar och grep dem på plats. Myndigheterna hittade cirka 570 gram metamfetamin, värt omkring 15 000 kronor, i Manlys handväska vid en första genomsökning. En senare genomsökning av parets hotellrum på närliggande Holiday Inn Express visade utrustning som vanligtvis används vid tillverkning av metamfetamin, såsom en liten brännare och batterier. Benson åtalades för innehav och tillverkning av metamfetamin, medan Manly åtalades för innehav, överlåtelse och tillverkning av drogen.

article_content: US Senator Robert Menendez, already facing corruption charges, has now been accused of acting as a foreign agent for Egypt. The latest indictment alleges that Menendez and his wife Nadine provided sensitive US government information that benefited Egypt’s government. These new allegations follow bribery charges filed weeks earlier, to which the couple pleaded not guilty. Senator Menendez has called the accusations false and denied any wrongdoing. In September, prosecutors accused Menendez and his wife of accepting bribes—including cash, gold bars, payments toward a home mortgage, and a luxury vehicle—from three New Jersey businessmen. The alleged scheme sought to use Menendez’s influence to increase US aid and military sales to Egypt. During a search of Menendez’s New Jersey home last year, investigators reportedly found $480,000 in cash hidden throughout the property and 13 gold bars worth about $155,000. Prosecutors claim these were part of the bribery scheme. The new indictment, filed by federal prosecutors in New York, alleges Menendez abused his position to benefit the Egyptian government. While serving on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, which he has since stepped down from, Menendez allegedly encouraged other senators to release $300 million in aid to Egypt and provided sensitive US information to Egypt. Prosecutors say the conspiracy occurred between January 2018 and June 2022. The indictment also includes photos of Menendez and his wife dining with Egyptian officials in Washington, DC. Nadine Menendez reportedly asked, "What else can the love of my life do for you?" as alleged by prosecutors. According to the indictment, public officials—including Members of Congress—are prohibited from acting as agents of a foreign principal under the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA). In last month’s indictment, both Menendez and his wife face three criminal counts: conspiracy to commit bribery, conspiracy to commit honest services fraud, and conspiracy to commit extortion under color of official right. In a statement, the 69-year-old senator defended himself, saying, "Piling new charge upon new charge does not make the allegations true. I have been, throughout my life, loyal to only one country—the United States of America." More than 30 Senate Democrats—including fellow New Jersey Senator Cory Booker—have called for Menendez’s resignation. On Thursday, Pennsylvania Senator John Fetterman urged the Senate to move forward with a resolution to expel Menendez, stating, "We cannot have an alleged foreign agent in the United States Senate. This is not a close call."

Swampland is sometimes marketed to investors as promising large tax deductions by dedicating land to a conservation easement, supported by questionable business plans suggesting luxury developments. As the year-end approaches—a popular period for tax shelters—the IRS has issued new proposed regulations to address so-called syndicated conservation easement transactions. This comes after a previous attempt with Notice 2017-10 was invalidated for not following proper rulemaking procedures under the Administrative Procedures Act (APA).

The new proposal aims to comply with the APA and follows the Secure 2.0 Act of 2022, which prevents entities taxed as S-corporations or partnerships (including LLCs treated as partnerships) from claiming a deduction for a conservation easement if the claimed contribution exceeds the owner's tax basis by over 250%. Members of these entities must now fulfill more detailed reporting requirements when pursuing these deductions.

Syndicated conservation easements are tax shelters in which land is placed into an entity (often an LLC), and ownership shares are sold to investors seeking large deductions. Promoters make the property appear much more valuable than its purchase price, boosted by appraisals with inflated valuations. Once the land is subjected to a conservation easement—intended to protect the environment—it enables a substantial artificial tax deduction for investors.

A notable example is the U.S. Tax Court case Mill Road 36 Henry LLC v. Commissioner (October 26, 2023), where property in Georgia purchased for $315,000 was later appraised at $9 million after being planned (but not developed) for senior living. Similar nearby parcels saw plans for development, but in each case, the land was donated as a conservation easement to generate deductions. The Tax Court limited deductions to the actual tax basis ($416,563) and imposed penalties for overstatement.

Additionally, a Georgia federal court convicted Jack Fisher and James Sinnott for conspiracy to commit wire fraud and other offenses related to the sale of syndicated conservation easements. According to a September 22, 2023, IRS press release, Fisher and Sinnott purchased land through client funds and quickly had their companies donate it or its easement—using artificially high appraisals (sometimes over ten times the purchase price). They also backdated documents and helped clients claim illegitimate deductions. The IRS estimates over $1.3 billion in fraudulent tax deductions resulted from the scheme, with Fisher, Sinnott, and others earning more than $41 million.

Appraiser Walter "Terry" Douglas Roberts II also pled guilty to participating in 18 deals with inflated appraisals, sometimes over 70% above true value (per a May 12, 2023, IRS release).

In summary, syndicated conservation easements offer attractive deductions, but such deductions often fail in court, can lead to penalties, and may even result in criminal charges for those involved. Despite ongoing enforcement, promoters continue to offer these questionable investment opportunities.

Träskmarker marknadsförs ibland till investerare som möjligheter till stora skatteavdrag genom att skänka marken till ett bevarandeavtal, ofta med tveksamma affärsplaner om lyxiga framtida utvecklingsprojekt. När året går mot sitt slut – en populär period för skatteupplägg – har IRS utfärdat nya föreslagna regler för att hantera så kallade syndikerade bevarandeavtal. Detta sker efter att ett tidigare försök, Notice 2017-10, ogiltigförklarades eftersom det inte följde korrekta procedurer enligt Administrative Procedures Act (APA).

Det nya förslaget syftar till att följa APA och bygger på Secure 2.0 Act från 2022, som hindrar företag med S-corporation- eller partnershipsbeskattning (inklusive aktiebolag som beskattas som partnerships) från att göra avdrag om gåvobeloppet för bevarandeavtalet överstiger ägarens skattemässiga anskaffningsvärde med mer än 250%. Medlemmar i dessa företag måste nu också uppfylla mer detaljerade rapporteringskrav om de vill få avdrag.

Syndikerade bevarandeavtal är ett sorts skatteupplägg där mark placeras i ett företag (ofta ett aktiebolag), och ägarandelar säljs till investerare som söker stora avdrag. Anordnare får marken att verka mycket mer värdefull än inköpspriset, ofta med hjälp av överdrivna värderingar. När marken väl blivit föremål för ett bevarandeavtal – i miljöskyddets namn – kan investerare erhålla konstgjorda stora skatteavdrag.

Ett tydligt exempel är domstolsfallet Mill Road 36 Henry LLC v. Commissioner (26 oktober 2023), där egendom i Georgia köpt för 315 000 dollar senare värderades till 9 miljoner dollar efter påstådda – men aldrig verkliga – utvecklingsplaner för seniorboende. Likadana avdrag genererades för närliggande fastigheter. Domstolen begränsade dock avdragen till det faktiska anskaffningsvärdet (416 563 dollar) och utdömde dessutom straffavgifter.

I Georgia dömdes även Jack Fisher och James Sinnott i federal domstol för konspiration till bedrägeri och andra brott i samband med försäljning av syndikerade bevarandeavtal. Enligt ett pressmeddelande från IRS, 22 september 2023, köpte Fisher och Sinnott mark med klientmedel och lät snabbt företagen donera marken eller bevarandeavtal på den – med överdrivna värderingar (ibland mer än tio gånger inköpspriset). De backdaterade även dokument och hjälpte klienter begära felaktiga avdrag. IRS uppskattar att över 1,3 miljarder dollar i felaktiga skatteavdrag uppstod ur upplägget medan Fisher, Sinnott och andra tjänade mer än 41 miljoner dollar.

Värderaren Walter "Terry" Douglas Roberts II erkände också sig skyldig till medverkan i 18 upplägg med överdrivna värderingar, ibland över 70% för högt (enligt IRS, 12 maj 2023).

Sammanfattningsvis: Syndikerade bevarandeavtal lockar med stora avdrag, men dessa håller sällan i domstol och kan leda till böter eller brottsåtal för inblandade. Trots ökade kontroller fortsätter anordnare att marknadsföra dessa tveksamma investeringar.

article_content: Collette Moreno, a 26-year-old mother from Kansas City, tragically lost her life in a car crash while on her way to Lake Ozark, Missouri, for her bachelorette party. She was riding with her best friend, Ashley Theobald, on Missouri Highway 5 when the accident happened on Friday afternoon. Theobald, trying to overtake a truck because exhaust fumes were triggering Moreno's asthma, collided with a 1999 Dodge Ram that appeared over a hill coming in the opposite direction. Moreno was rushed to University Hospital in Columbia but succumbed to her injuries three hours later. Her death has deeply affected her fiancé, Jesse Arcobasso, and her five-year-old son, Braden, especially since her wedding was only a month away. Both Theobald and the Dodge Ram's driver, Melvin E. Garber, suffered only minor injuries. Theobald recounted that both vehicles attempted to avoid each other as the Dodge came over the hill, leading to the collision. Shortly before the accident, Moreno posted selfies and photos on social media expressing excitement for the weekend celebration. While Theobald will not face criminal charges, family and friends have organized a fundraising campaign to help cover funeral costs and allow Moreno's relatives—many residing in California—to come to Missouri for the funeral.

Theobald försökte köra om en lastbil eftersom avgaserna triggade Morenos astma, och då kolliderade de med en 1999 Dodge Ram som plötsligt dök upp över en kulle i mötande riktning. Moreno fördes akut till University Hospital i Columbia men avled av sina skador tre timmar senare. Hennes bortgång har djupt påverkat hennes fästman, Jesse Arcobasso, och hennes femårige son, Braden, särskilt eftersom bröllopet bara var en månad bort. Både Theobald och föraren av Dodge Ram, Melvin E. Garber, fick endast lindriga skador. Theobald berättar att båda fordonen försökte väja när Dodgen kom över kullen, vilket ledde till krocken.
