article_content: Hershey Co. has reached a settlement with Let's Buy British Imports (LBBI), requiring the importer to stop distributing British-made candy bars in the United States. LBBI, a major distributor of UK, South African, and Australian food brands, agreed to stop selling popular confections like Maltesers and Toffee Crisps to American retailers and restaurants. Hershey, established in 1894, owns more than 80 brands globally, including Reese's and York. In August, Hershey filed a lawsuit against LBBI, citing trademark infringement. The company argued that some British candies have packaging similar to Hershey products, which could mislead consumers. Jeff Beckman, a Hershey spokesperson, stated, 'Given the immeasurable value of our brands, we work hard to protect these important intellectual assets and defend them against infringement.' However, some US-based retailers specializing in British goods, like the New York shop Tea & Sympathy, have criticized the move and encouraged fans to contact the Hershey CEO. In a Facebook post, Tea & Sympathy wrote, 'May we politely suggest that if you think Toffee Crisps look like Reese's Peanut Butter Cups your eyesight is a much bigger problem than your chocolate bar confusion.' Many American fans of British chocolate have expressed their dissatisfaction on social media, some using the hashtag #BoycottHershey and supporting efforts to overturn the import ban. Hershey holds the US license to manufacture Cadbury chocolate products, so the restrictions also apply to UK-made Cadbury and Kit Kat bars. These products are made with different recipes in the US than in the UK. According to UK law, milk chocolate must contain at least 20% cocoa and milk solids and a minimum of 25% fat, while US standards allow for lower percentages. At the time of publication, close to 15,000 people had signed a petition opposing the ban.

article_content: Mark Knopfler, best known as the leader of Dire Straits, is auctioning over 120 guitars and amplifiers from his personal collection, with 25% of the proceeds going to charity. The selection includes famous items like the 1983 Les Paul that featured on 'Money For Nothing' and 'Brothers In Arms', as well as being played during Live Aid in 1985. Knopfler told the BBC he's eager for these instruments to find new owners who will play them, instead of keeping them locked away. Christie's in London will host the auction in January, offering guitars and amps that span Knopfler's entire 50-year career. Highlights include a 1959 Gibson Les Paul—considered by many the 'Holy Grail' of electric guitars—estimated between £300,000 and £500,000. There are also more affordable pieces, like a mandolin formerly owned by blues musician Yank Rachell and expected to fetch £300–£500. Knopfler insists he cherishes each instrument, regardless of how much it’s worth. Widely regarded as a guitar virtuoso, Knopfler is famous for his fingerstyle technique (learned without formal lessons) and his solos on tracks such as 'Sultans of Swing.' He recalls falling in love with the guitar as a child, inspired by stars like Elvis Presley and Hank Marvin, and dreaming of owning his own instrument while visiting music shops in Newcastle. His first guitar, a Höfner Super Solid, is included in the auction. Asked about letting go of these sentimental instruments, Knopfler attributes the decision to age, stating that many of his guitars are rarely played anymore. He admits it's sorrowful to part with some, but he still has plenty to keep playing. Dire Straits, formed by Knopfler and his brother David in 1977 alongside bassist John Illsley and drummer Pick Withers, went on to release hit albums and achieve worldwide success—including their multi-million-selling album 'Brothers in Arms.' Knopfler also worked extensively as a session musician, collaborated with noted artists, and moved on to a solo career involving film soundtracks and roots-inspired music. Profit from the auction will support the Red Cross, Tusk, and Brave Hearts of the North East. The guitar collection will be displayed in New York and London ahead of the London auction on January 31, 2024. Knopfler joked that despite selling many guitars, he might use some proceeds to buy new ones.

Urvalet inkluderar kända instrument som en Les Paul från 1983, som hörs på 'Money For Nothing' och 'Brothers In Arms', och som också användes på Live Aid 1985. Knopfler berättade för BBC att han gärna ser att dessa instrument får nya ägare som faktiskt spelar på dem, istället för att ha dem liggande oanvända. article_content: The Orwell Sofa is an innovative piece of furniture designed to create a private, peaceful space within your home. Resembling a cabin-like futon, it features a roll-down blind that allows you to cocoon yourself inside, blocking out light and dampening sound. Created by young Barcelona-based designers Álvaro Goula and Pablo Figuera, the 'private urban fort' was developed to help homeowners recapture the sense of intimacy that can sometimes be lost in modern living environments. When the curtain is down, the sofa offers not only visual privacy but some sound insulation, giving users a unique moment of tranquility. The versatile hybrid futon can function as a daybed, a bunker, or a traditional sofa, depending on how it’s adapted. With its high back, expansive surface area, and removable, foldable cover, the Orwell Sofa invites both sitting and lying down without feeling confined. Its design is said to be inspired by the nostalgic experience of building childhood forts. Goula and Figuera write that the Orwell Sofa 'resuscitates that childhood memory of a cabin – the magical, hidden place all children wish for.' Adults, too, can relive that sense of comfort and private retreat, but now in a stylish and sophisticated way. For more information on availability, the designers can be contacted directly. Early models include detailed flat plans and mock-up drawings showcasing the unique, bunker-like structure.

article_content: A dramatic photograph has emerged from Chiconautla, a town in Ecatepec de Morelos, Mexico, showing an alleged child kidnapper lying injured on the ground as a crowd surrounds him. According to local reports, the 25-year-old man was suspected of involvement in the disappearance of several children and young women from the area. Yesterday, up to 1,000 residents detained the suspect for about three hours, confronting him outside a local school. Some members of the crowd were reportedly armed with sticks. The man was tied up and beaten in an attempted lynching before authorities arrived. Federal police arrived on the scene in the evening. To disperse the large crowd and rescue the suspect, they used tear gas. The suspect was transported from the scene by ambulance. Community anger had been mounting since last Friday following the recent disappearances. The incident underscores the tense atmosphere and mistrust between residents and law enforcement in Chiconautla.

article_content: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has played a significant role in fostering favorable conditions for foreign investors, regularly consulting with overseas entities to clarify operational procedures, according to sources. With India's recent inclusion in the JP Morgan Emerging Market Bond Index, many associated funds—primarily actively managed—may direct overseas investment flows to India as early as December 2023, when global investors set allocations for the coming year. JP Morgan index managers stated that approximately 75% of more than $300 billion in assets under management (AUM) linked to the bond indices is actively managed. This may lead to investment pre-positioning between December 2023 and March 2024, provided that Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) are registered in India. Actively managed funds give managers greater flexibility over investments, unlike passive funds which simply track index performance and typically exhibit less trading activity. Index managers noted improvements in the settlement process and faster FPI registration turnaround times, leading to positive investor feedback about India's inclusion in the index. This year, 73% of investors representing 90% of AUM supported India's inclusion, up from 50% last time. JP Morgan announced that India will join its GBI-EM Global Index suite by June 2024. Indian government bonds are expected to make up to 10% of the GBI-EM Global Diversified Index across a 10-month integration. This index currently represents $213 billion of the $236 billion benchmarked to the family. At present, 23 government bonds under the RBI's Fully Accessible Route (FAR) qualify for index inclusion. Index managers will monitor trading metrics—including bid-offer spreads and liquidity—and can exclude less liquid bonds, replacing them with more tradeable securities. Weights will be determined by the size of each bond's outstanding amounts. Ongoing discussions continue between investors and the Ministry of Finance on tax issues, with investors suggesting that index inclusion could lower government borrowing costs. Conversations about using the Euroclear clearing platform are also ongoing, though lack of its use is not seen as a major obstacle by investors.

Efter att Indien nyligen inkluderats i JP Morgans Emerging Market Bond Index kan många associerade fonder—främst aktivt förvaltade—börja rikta internationella investeringsflöden till Indien redan från december 2023, när globala investerare fastställer sina allokeringar inför nästa år. Förvaltare på JP Morgan har uppgett att cirka 75 % av över 300 miljarder dollar i förvaltat kapital (AUM) kopplat till obligationsindexen förvaltas aktivt. Det kan innebära omallokeringar mellan december 2023 och mars 2024, förutsatt att Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) är registrerade i Indien. Aktivt förvaltade fonder ger förvaltare större möjlighet att fatta investeringsbeslut jämfört med passiva fonder, som enbart följer indexutvecklingen och ofta har mindre handelsaktivitet. Indexförvaltarna påpekade förbättringar i avvecklingsprocessen och snabbare FPI-registrering vilket har lett till positiv återkoppling om Indiens inkludering. I år stödde 73 % av investerarna, som representerar 90 % av AUM, Indiens inkludering—en klar ökning från 50 % förra gången. JP Morgan meddelade att Indien kommer att ingå i GBI-EM Global Index-suite från juni 2024. Indiska statsobligationer förväntas få upp till 10 % vikt i GBI-EM Global Diversified Index under en period av tio månader. Detta index omfattar nu 213 miljarder dollar av de 236 miljarder dollar som benchmarkas inom familjen. För närvarande är 23 statsobligationer under RBIs 'Fully Accessible Route' (FAR) kvalificerade för indexinkludering. Indexförvaltare övervakar handelsstatistik, såsom spreadar och likviditet, och kan ersätta mindre likvida obligationer med mer lättomsatta. Vikterna bestäms av varje obligations utestående belopp. Samtal pågår mellan investerare och finansministeriet om skattefrågor, där investerare påpekar att indexinkludering kan minska statens upplåningskostnader. Diskussioner om användning av Euroclear fortsätter, men dess frånvaro ses inte som ett stort hinder av de flesta investerare.

After India's six-wicket loss to Australia in the ODI World Cup 2023 final on Sunday, former Pakistani cricketer Shoaib Malik commented on KL Rahul’s batting approach. Speaking on A Sports, Malik said Rahul should have focused more on rotating the strike, especially when it was difficult to hit boundaries. “KL Rahul seemed intent on batting through the 50 overs. Instead, he should have tried to rotate the strike and play his natural game. With conditions tough and boundaries hard to come by, it’s crucial to keep the scoreboard ticking — but there were too many dot balls,” said Malik. Malik further remarked that Rahul, the Indian wicketkeeper-batter, often takes responsibility when the team loses early wickets, but his innings of 66 off 107 balls against Australia was uncharacteristic. “He went into a zone where he seemed focused only on lasting the fifty overs instead of being proactive,” Malik added.

He also highlighted how the long side boundaries at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad were advantageous for Australia, who used them well against India. Malik praised Australia for adapting better to Indian conditions, noting: “The Australians used these boundaries effectively, preventing Indian batters from playing down the ground and encouraging shots square of the wicket. Their bowlers varied their deliveries well and had a solid plan.”

Former Pakistan captain Misbah-ul-Haq suggested that Rahul did not fully trust the other batters and was focused on getting India to a total of 250, which proved challenging. “KL plays spin well, as we have seen throughout the tournament. He is strong square and in front of the wicket, using his feet effectively. But his approach suggested he was waiting and perhaps not trusting his teammates. He seemed intent on reaching 250, which made things more difficult,” Misbah said.

After the match, Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Indian dressing room to console the players after their defeat.

(with ANI inputs)

Istället borde han ha försökt rotera strike och spela sitt naturliga spel. När förhållandena är svåra och boundaries inte kommer lätt, är det viktigt att hålla poängtavlan igång – men det blev för många prickbollar,” sa Malik. Malik påpekade också att Rahul, Indiens wicketkeeper-batter, ofta tar ansvar när laget förlorar tidiga wickets, men hans insats på 66 runs på 107 bollar mot Australien var ovanlig för honom. ”Han hamnade i en zon där han verkade mest fokuserad på att spela alla femtio overs istället för att vara mer proaktiv,” tillade Malik.

Han lyfte även fram att de långa sidogränserna på Narendra Modi-stadion i Ahmedabad gynnade Australien, som utnyttjade dem väl mot Indien. Malik berömde Australien för hur de anpassade sig bättre till de indiska förhållandena och sa: ”Australierna utnyttjade dessa gränser effektivt, hindrade indiska slagmän från att spela rakt nedför planen och uppmuntrade istället slag åt sidorna. Deras bowlers varierade sina kast väl och hade en tydlig plan.”

Tidigare pakistanske kaptenen Misbah-ul-Haq menade att Rahul inte helt litade på de andra slagmännen och var fast besluten om att ta Indien till en total på 250 poäng, vilket blev svårt. ”KL spelar spin bra, vilket vi har sett under hela turneringen. Han är stark både åt sidorna och rakt fram och använder fötterna skickligt. Men hans tillvägagångssätt visade att han väntade och kanske inte litade på lagkamraterna. Han verkade inriktad på att nå 250, vilket gjorde det svårare,” sa Misbah.

article_content: Taylor Swift fans gathered at the Nilton Santos Olympic Stadium in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, on Saturday, November 18, 2023, awaiting her Eras Tour concert amid a heat wave. The previous night, a 23-year-old fan, Ana Clara Benevides Machado, died from cardiac arrest caused by the extreme heat at the show, according to concert organizers. Although it is currently spring in the Southern Hemisphere, much of South America has faced summer-like temperatures for months, with repeated heat waves breaking records. Last week in Rio de Janeiro, a city of nearly 12 million, intense heat and humidity created hazardous conditions. Fans waited in line for hours in sweltering, humid weather with little wind before the concert, and conditions remained stifling inside the venue. Ana Clara Benevides Machado received medical attention from paramedics at the stadium but later died at a nearby hospital. Temperatures in Rio surpassed 100°F, with the heat index—combining temperature and humidity—making it feel closer to 140°F. Such conditions can become life-threatening after only a few hours. Brazil's Ministry of Culture acknowledged the extreme and dangerous heat in a statement expressing condolences for Machado’s death and emphasized that climate change must now be considered a major risk for large events like concerts. Taylor Swift postponed her Saturday night concert due to the ongoing hazardous heat. Lincoln Alves, a climate scientist at Brazil's National Institute for Space Research, said the recent heat wave was the country's eighth major one this year, most likely aggravated by climate change. He and his colleagues found that a similar heat wave in September was at least 100 times more likely to occur because of climate change. Chilean climate scientist Raul Cordero highlighted that the last six months have all consecutively broken regional heat records. Each month, from May to October, has set new highs. The El Niño weather phenomenon has worsened regional temperatures, but it adds to the long-term warming caused mainly by burning fossil fuels. The effects are widespread, not just in Rio. Areas across Brazil, Bolivia, Paraguay, and the Gran Chaco are experiencing increased temperatures and severe droughts. In São Paulo, average temperatures have risen by over 3°F since the 1960s, while the number of extreme heat days has jumped from about seven per year to over 50, and that number is expected to grow. High humidity makes it difficult for sweat to evaporate, reducing the body’s ability to cool itself. Climate expert Daniel Vecellio explains that when it's very humid, sweating doesn't help much because it can't evaporate, heightening the risk of heat-related illnesses, including cardiac issues. Stagnant, humid air was a major factor at the concert. Extreme heat also stresses the heart as the body tries to cool down. While Brazilians are accustomed to hot weather, these extreme temperatures are causing unprecedented strain, even for those used to such a climate, according to Alves. Marisol Yglesias-González, a climate expert based in Costa Rica, stressed that providing advance warnings for extreme heat and creating emergency heat plans at public venues can reduce hazards. Cities can introduce green spaces or cooling centers, and meteorological agencies can issue timely warnings. Brazil’s meteorological agency had issued heat advisories before the concert. The Ministry of Culture encouraged event organizers to recognize and prepare for climate-related risks. Prohibiting water bottles at the stadium contributed to dehydration among fans. After the incident, Brazil’s Justice Minister announced that water bottles would be permitted in venues in the future. Yglesias-González emphasized that everyone—from event organizers to governments and nonprofits—needs to develop heat adaptation plans. Because of the heat, Taylor Swift postponed the Saturday show. According to Billboard, at least 30 concerts in 2023 were postponed or canceled because of extreme weather linked to climate change. Scientists emphasize that both adapting to more frequent heat events and reducing greenhouse gas emissions are crucial. An Oxfam report this week stated that the wealthiest 1% of the global population is responsible for about 20% of worldwide emissions.
translated_content: Taylor Swift-fans samlades på Nilton Santos Olympiastadion i Rio de Janeiro, Brasilien, lördagen den 18 november 2023 och väntade på hennes Eras Tour-konsert mitt i en värmebölja. Kvällen innan avled en 23-årig fan, Ana Clara Benevides Machado, av hjärtstillestånd orsakat av extrem värme på konserten, enligt arrangörerna. Även om det nu är vår på södra halvklotet har stora delar av Sydamerika drabbats av sommarvärme i flera månader, med upprepade värmeböljor som slagit rekord. Förra veckan, i Rio de Janeiro – en stad med nästan 12 miljoner invånare – skapade intensiv värme och fuktiga förhållanden farliga situationer. Fans stod i kö i timmar i svettig, fuktig värme utan vind innan konserten, och inne på arenan var det lika kvavt. Ana Clara Benevides Machado fick medicinsk hjälp av paramediker på arenan men avled senare på ett närliggande sjukhus. Temperaturen i Rio låg över 38°C, och värmeindexet – som kombinerar temperatur och luftfuktighet – gjorde att det kändes som nästan 60°C. Sådana förhållanden kan snabbt bli livshotande. Brasiliens kulturministerium erkände den extrema och farliga värmen i ett uttalande där de uttryckte kondoleanser till Machados familj och betonade att klimatförändringar numera måste betraktas som en stor risk vid evenemang som konserter. Taylor Swift ställde in sin lördagskonsert på grund av den fortsatt farliga värmen. Lincoln Alves, klimatforskare vid Brasiliens nationella institut för rymdforskning, sade att den senaste värmeböljan var den åttonde stora i år, och att den sannolikt förvärrats av klimatförändringar. Han och hans kollegor fann att en liknande värmebölja i september var minst 100 gånger mer sannolik på grund av klimatförändringarna. Chilenska klimatforskaren Raul Cordero påpekade att de senaste sex månaderna i rad har slagit värmerekord i regionen. Varje månad, från maj till oktober, har varit varmare än någonsin tidigare. Väderfenomenet El Niño har försämrat temperaturerna i regionen, men det läggs ovanpå den långsiktiga uppvärmningen som främst beror på förbränning av fossila bränslen. Effekterna märks över hela Sydamerika, inte bara i Rio. Områden i Brasilien, Bolivia, Paraguay och Gran Chaco har drabbats av både höga temperaturer och svår torka. I São Paulo har medeltemperaturerna ökat med över 1,5°C sedan 1960-talet, och antalet dagar med extrem värme har ökat från ungefär sju per år till över 50, och siffran väntas fortsätta stiga. Hög luftfuktighet gör det svårt för kroppen att svettas effektivt, vilket minskar kroppens förmåga att kyla sig. Klimatforskaren Daniel Vecellio förklarar att när det är mycket fuktigt hjälper inte svettningen eftersom den inte kan avdunsta, vilket höjer risken för värmesjukdomar och hjärtproblem. Stilla, fuktig luft var en starkt bidragande faktor vid konserten. Extrem hetta stressar också hjärtat eftersom kroppen försöker kyla ner sig. Även om brasilianare är vana vid värme orsakar dessa extrema temperaturer nu en ovanlig ansträngning, även för folk som är vana vid varmt klimat, enligt Alves. Marisol Yglesias-González, en klimatexpert i Costa Rica, betonade vikten av att ge förhandsvarningar om extrem värme och att skapa akuta värmeplaner vid publika evenemang för att minska riskerna. Städer kan skapa gröna ytor eller svala tillflyktsplatser, och meteorologiska institut kan skicka ut varningar i tid. Brasiliens meteorologiska institut skickade ut värmevarningar före konserten. Kulturministeriet uppmanade arrangörer att ta klimatrelaterade risker på allvar och vara förberedda. Att förbjuda vattenflaskor på arenan bidrog till uttorkning bland fansen. Efter händelsen meddelade Brasiliens justitieminister att vattenflaskor kommer att tillåtas på evenemang i framtiden. Yglesias-González framhöll att alla – från arrangörer till myndigheter och ideella organisationer – behöver utveckla planer för att hantera extrem värme. Forskare betonar att både anpassning till allt vanligare värmeböljor och att minska utsläppen är avgörande. article_content: On December 7, 2023, the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) Court in Abuja will rule on interim measures in a dispute involving Niger, a group of Nigerien organizations, and the ECOWAS Authority of Heads of State and Government. Niger, six organizations, and a Nigerien national are contesting ECOWAS sanctions, implemented under the leadership of Nigerian President Bola Tinubu, which they argue have severely affected ordinary Nigeriens by causing shortages of food, medicine, and electricity due to border closures and Nigeria's suspension of power supply. The applicants are urging the court to order an immediate suspension of the sanctions, contending that Niger has received harsher and less justified treatment compared to other ECOWAS states with recent coups (Mali, Burkina Faso, Guinea). ECOWAS, represented by François Kanga-Penond, rejects these claims, asserting that only democratically elected governments, like that of ousted President Mohamed Bazoum, can lawfully bring cases before the court. They note that Bazoum himself has already filed a separate case challenging the junta's legitimacy. The applicants further request the court to annul all ECOWAS-imposed sanctions and decisions, including any plans for military intervention in Niger made during meetings on July 30 and August 10, 2023. At the same time, ECOWAS parliamentarians, including Nigerian senators Ali Ndume and Abdullahi Salame, have called for the lifting of sanctions. They highlight the severe impact on border communities, with food shipments stranded at the border, goods spoiling, and economic and security issues intensifying. Salame and Ndume both emphasized the humanitarian crisis, noting that thousands of trucks filled with food are stuck at the border and security has deteriorated because of the situation. The applicants and supporting parliament members are focused on the urgent humanitarian consequences, while ECOWAS officials stress the need to restore constitutional order and to follow proper legal procedures.

De menar att sanktionerna slagit hårt mot vanliga nigerier, med brist på mat, medicin och el till följd av stängda gränser och stoppad el från Nigeria. ECOWAS, genom François Kanga-Penond, avvisar detta och menar att endast demokratiskt valda regeringar, som den avsatte presidenten Mohamed Bazoum, har rätt att ta ärenden till domstolen. article_content: The family of Bob Stevens, who was the first victim of the 2001 anthrax letter attacks, is set to receive $2.5 million from the U.S. government after a legal settlement. Stevens, a photo editor at American Media Inc. in Boca Raton, Florida, passed away on October 5, 2001, after inhaling anthrax spores believed to have arrived through mailed correspondence. Investigators connected the source of the anthrax to Bruce Ivins, a civilian scientist at an Army laboratory in Fort Detrick, Maryland. Ivins, who had a documented history of mental health problems, died by suicide in 2008 before any formal charges could be filed. The Stevens family originally sued for $50 million in 2003, contending that the Maryland lab should have enforced higher security precautions. Court documents filed on November 23 in the Southern District of Florida confirm a settlement. Under this agreement, the government does not accept liability, and the family's lawyer fees—capped at 25%—will be paid from the settlement. Richard Schuler, the family's attorney, described the settlement as a vindication after considerable obstacles. He expressed that Maureen Stevens, Bob’s wife of 27 years, continues to experience profound loss. Schuler noted the traumatic nature of Stevens’ death and the lasting impact on the family. A report issued in February by the National Academy of Sciences stated that it could not conclusively determine the specific source of the anthrax, although investigative agencies reaffirmed that their scientific evidence pointed to Ivins’ laboratory. Since the attacks, nearly $19 billion has been funneled into biodefense by the federal government. Currently, approximately 15,000 U.S. lab workers are authorized to handle hazardous germs, including anthrax—twice the pre-attack number. Worker background checks have become standard, but proposed measures such as routine psychological screening or requirements for lab partners have been dismissed as too burdensome or invasive by experts.

article_content: Lawmakers began a new session of Congress with the memory of the Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting in Newtown, Connecticut, still fresh — prompting renewed efforts to pass gun laws aimed at preventing future tragedies. On the first day, members of the House of Representatives introduced nearly a dozen bills related to gun violence. Rep. Carolyn McCarthy (D-New York), a longtime gun control advocate, spearheaded the Democratic initiatives. She is sponsoring legislation to require background checks for all gun sales, including at gun shows, and to ban online sales of ammunition. McCarthy is also co-sponsoring a bill with Rep. Diana DeGette (D-Colorado) to ban high-capacity magazines. DeGette represents the district that includes Columbine High School and is adjacent to Aurora, the site of a 2012 mass shooting in a movie theater. "These assault magazines help put the 'mass' in 'mass shooting,' and anything we can do to stop their proliferation will save lives in America," said McCarthy, whose husband was killed and son wounded in the 1993 Long Island Railroad shooting. "These devices are designed to kill as many people as possible in the shortest time, and we owe it to innocent Americans to keep them away from dangerous individuals." Meanwhile, Republican freshmen Rep. Steve Stockman of Texas and Rep. Thomas Massie of Kentucky have proposed bills to permit more guns around schools. In the Senate, Sen. Dianne Feinstein (D-California) plans to introduce legislation banning the sale, transfer, importation, and manufacture of over 100 firearms. Her bill would also restrict certain semiautomatic rifles, handguns, and shotguns with detachable magazines, as well as any semiautomatic rifle or handgun with a fixed magazine holding more than ten rounds. The previous assault weapons ban, also championed by Feinstein, expired in 2004. She is currently seeking bipartisan support. Sen. Frank Lautenberg (D-New Jersey) and Sen. Chuck Schumer (D-New York) are backing similar bills to ban high-capacity magazines and enhance background checks, measures that are matched by proposals in the House. Gun control remains a divisive issue. The National Rifle Association, the nation’s leading gun rights lobby, opposes tighter laws, maintaining that Congress cannot infringe on Second Amendment rights. Following the Newtown shootings, NRA Executive Vice President Wayne LaPierre advocated for armed officers in every school, questioning the effectiveness of gun bans and arguing they might endanger communities. He criticized 'Gun-Free School Zones' as ineffective deterrents. Many gun owners worry new legislation could threaten their rights. Any gun control effort needs bipartisan backing — which remains uncertain, as no Republicans have yet signed on to new gun restrictions, and some Democrats also oppose them. As John Gramlich of CQ Roll Call notes, NRA influence spans both parties, with half of new senators earning high ratings from the group. The NRA’s solution to recent violence is more armed presence in schools, complicating prospects for additional gun restrictions. Some limited measures, like banning high-capacity magazines, may pass, but broader reforms face significant hurdles. Gun control supporters hope President Obama’s involvement will be decisive. After the Newtown tragedy, Obama announced that Vice President Joe Biden would lead a task force to recommend ways to reduce gun violence, including new regulations. Recommendations are expected this month, with the goal of passing legislation this year. Proponents are cautiously optimistic but acknowledge the challenge ahead. 'The current climate feels different than after other shootings,' said Shams Tarek, McCarthy's communications director. Sen. Feinstein echoed the uphill nature of the effort, stating, 'It may take a year, two, or three, but we are not giving up.' The gun control debate must also compete with other priorities like debt ceiling negotiations and budget agreements. According to Gramlich, political timing and party dynamics will play a major role, as recent fiscal negotiations have already strained bipartisan cooperation. Whether House leadership will compromise on gun control remains an open question.
translated_content: Lagstiftare inledde en ny kongressession med minnet av skjutningen på Sandy Hook Elementary School i Newtown, Connecticut, fortfarande färskt — vilket ledde till nya försök att införa vapenlagar för att förhindra framtida tragedier. Under första dagen lade ledamöterna i representanthuset fram nästan ett dussin lagförslag om vapenvåld. Representant Carolyn McCarthy (D-New York), en långvarig förespråkare för vapenreglering, ledde det demokratiska initiativet. Hon föreslår lagstiftning som kräver bakgrundskontroller för alla vapenförsäljningar, inklusive på vapenmässor, samt ett förbud mot onlineförsäljning av ammunition. McCarthy är också med och föreslår ett förbud mot magasin med hög kapacitet tillsammans med representant Diana DeGette (D-Colorado). DeGette representerar distriktet som inkluderar Columbine High School och gränsar till Aurora, platsen för en masskjutning på en biograf år 2012. "Dessa magasiner för automatvapen är det som gör masskjutningar möjliga, och allt vi kan göra för att stoppa spridningen sparar liv i USA," sa McCarthy, vars make dödades och son skadades i Long Island Railroad-skjutningen 1993. "Dessa anordningar är utformade för att döda så många som möjligt på kortast möjliga tid, och vi är skyldiga oskyldiga amerikaner att hålla dessa borta från farliga personer." Samtidigt har de republikanska nykomlingarna Steve Stockman från Texas och Thomas Massie från Kentucky lagt fram lagförslag om att tillåta fler vapen runt skolor. I senaten planerar Dianne Feinstein (D-Kalifornien) att introducera lagstiftning som förbjuder försäljning, överföring, import och tillverkning av över 100 olika sorters vapen. Hennes lagförslag skulle även begränsa vissa halvautomatiska gevär, pistoler och hagelgevär med löstagbara magasin samt alla halvautomatiska gevär eller pistoler med fast magasin som rymmer mer än tio skott. Det tidigare förbudet mot automatvapen, som också drevs av Feinstein, löpte ut 2004. Hon söker nu stöd från båda partierna. Senator Frank Lautenberg (D-New Jersey) och Chuck Schumer (D-New York) stöder liknande förslag om att förbjuda magasin med hög kapacitet och skärpa bakgrundskontroller, initiativ som också återfinns i representanthuset. Vapenreglering är fortsatt en splittrande fråga. National Rifle Association, landets största vapenlobby, motsätter sig hårdare lagar och anser att kongressen inte kan inskränka andra tillägget. Efter Newtown-skjutningen förespråkade NRA:s vice vd Wayne LaPierre att beväpnade vakter skulle finnas på alla skolor och ifrågasatte om förbud mot vapen verkligen ger trygghet, samt kritiserade 'vapenfria zoner' vid skolor som ineffektiva. Många vapenägare oroar sig för att nya lagar ska inskränka deras rättigheter. Alla försök till vapenreglering behöver stöd från båda partierna — vilket fortfarande är osäkert, eftersom inga republikaner stött nya vapenbegränsningar och vissa demokrater också motsätter sig dem. Som John Gramlich på CQ Roll Call noterar har NRA inflytande över båda partier, då hälften av de nya senatorerna fått höga betyg av organisationen. NRA:s lösning på senaste tidens våld är fler beväpnade på skolor, vilket försvårar möjligheterna för nya restriktioner. Vissa begränsade åtgärder, såsom förbud mot magasin med hög kapacitet, kan gå igenom, men bredare reformer väntar stora hinder. Förespråkare för vapenreglering hoppas att president Obamas engagemang blir avgörande. Efter tragedin i Newtown meddelade Obama att vicepresident Joe Biden skulle leda en arbetsgrupp för att ge rekommendationer om hur vapenvåldet kan minska, inkluderande nya regleringar. Rekommendationerna väntas i månad och målet är att få igenom lagstiftning under året. Förkämpar är försiktigt optimistiska men inser utmaningarna. 'Klimatet känns annorlunda än efter andra skjutningar,' säger Shams Tarek, McCarthys pressekreterare. Senator Feinstein bekräftade den tuffa kampen: 'Det kan ta ett, två eller tre år, men vi ger inte upp.' Debatten om vapen måste dessutom samsas med andra prioriterade frågor som förhandlingarna om skuldtak och budgetavtal. Gramlich menar att politisk tajming och partidynamik blir avgörande, då de senaste budgetförhandlingarna redan ansträngt det samarbete som behövs över partigränser för att nå framgång i vapenfrågan.

article_content: The debut of the Apple Watch sparked mixed reactions in the fashion world a month ago. While outlets like GQ and British Vogue editor Alexandra Shulman expressed reservations about wearable tech, publications such as Vogue.com and Marie Claire welcomed Apple's new accessory. Vogue China made history by being the first fashion magazine to feature the Apple Watch on its cover for the November 2014 issue, with supermodel Liu Wen modeling the device. This marks a notable moment where technology steps into high fashion. Angelica Cheung, editorial director of Vogue China, stated that featuring the Apple Watch continues Vogue's tradition of embracing modern trends and offering readers an early look at innovative tech that also serves as a desirable accessory. She emphasized that the blend of technology, fashion, and lifestyle in the watch could influence lifestyles. The cover—styled by Karl Templer and photographed by David Sims, with Liu Wen dressed in Céline—captures a fresh and energetic look aligned with Vogue China's outlook. When Apple unveiled the Watch, it drew attention from both tech and fashion communities, indicating Apple’s intention to engage style-oriented consumers, not just technology fans. This was furthered by Apple hiring notable fashion executives from Burberry, YSL, and Tag Heuer. Scheduled for release next year in the UK with prices starting at £216, the Apple Watch is available in sport, standard, and luxury editions. Finishes range from stainless steel to gold, with customizable displays and bands in leather, steel, and a variety of colors—including the luxury 18-carat gold model seen on the Vogue cover. Fashion editors had different views: GQ’s Daniel Dumas praised the technology but questioned pairing it with formal attire, while Vogue.com’s Suzy Menkes described the look as neutral and liked its customizable visuals. Alexandra Shulman noted the successful blend of function and design, but wondered how eager people are to wear such high-tech devices. There’s growing interest in other wearable tech as well, including items from Rebecca Minkoff, Intel, and Ringly, with speculation about future designer collaborations. The Vogue China issue with the Apple Watch went on sale October 12, 2014.

article_content: Amid an increased U.S. military presence following Israel's offensive in Gaza, Iran has showcased an upgraded version of its hypersonic missile at a military exhibition attended by the country's supreme leader. On Sunday, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei visited a university in Tehran, managed by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) aerospace division, where the enhanced Fattah hypersonic missile was displayed. Other newly revealed weaponry included the Iranian-made Gaza drone, a new model in the Shahed unmanned aerial vehicle series, and updated missile defense systems: the 9-Dey, capable of launching short- to medium-range projectiles, and the Mehran system, which reportedly uses solid-fuel missiles. The original Fattah missile was first introduced in June, placing Iran among a select group of nations—including China and Russia—with hypersonic weapons. Iranian state media described the Fattah II as a hypersonic glide vehicle (HGV), providing greater maneuverability than traditional ballistic warheads due to its ability to glide toward its target after launch. While additional technical details about the upgrade were not disclosed on Sunday, Iran previously stated that the Fattah could travel at speeds up to Mach 15 (5.1 km or 3.2 miles per second) and reach ranges of 1,400km (870 miles). IRGC officials have also mentioned plans to extend the missile's range to 2,000km (1,242 miles), which would place Israel within range. During the event, Iran's supreme leader again condemned Israel and its Western supporters for the ongoing war in Gaza, which has resulted in over 12,000 Palestinian deaths, nearly half of them children. He characterized Israel as a symbol of racism and accused Western leaders who back Israel's military actions of sharing these views. Khamenei criticized attacks on hospitals in Gaza as evidence of Israeli frustration and urged Islamic governments to sever political relations with Israel, at least temporarily, and to halt energy and goods supplies. The unveiling came as the U.S. deployed significant military resources to the region, including two carrier strike groups and a nuclear submarine. The Iran-backed 'resistance axis,' consisting of groups like Lebanon’s Hezbollah and Yemen’s Houthis, has engaged in cross-border hostilities with Israel in solidarity with Hamas. Israel reported that, on Sunday, the Houthis seized a British-owned, Japanese-operated cargo ship in the southern Red Sea, calling the action an 'Iranian act of terrorism.'

Ayatollah Ali Khamenei besökte på söndagen ett universitet i Teheran, som drivs av Islamiska revolutionsgardets (IRGC) flyg- och rymdavdelning, där den förbättrade Fattah-hypersoniska missilen visades upp. Bland de andra nya vapnen fanns den iransktillverkade Gaza-drönaren, en ny modell i Shahed-serien av obemannade flygfarkoster samt uppdaterade luftvärnssystem: 9-Dey, som kan avfyra kort- till medeldistansprojektiler, och Mehran-systemet, som uppges använda fastbränsleraketer. Den ursprungliga Fattah-missilen introducerades först i juni, vilket placerade Iran bland ett fåtal nationer – inklusive Kina och Ryssland – med hypersoniska vapen. Iransk statlig media beskrev Fattah II som ett hypersoniskt glidfordon (HGV), vilket ger större manövrerbarhet än traditionella ballistiska stridsspetsar tack vare dess förmåga att glida mot sitt mål efter uppskjutning. Ytterligare tekniska detaljer om uppgraderingen offentliggjordes inte på söndagen, men Iran har tidigare sagt att Fattah kan nå hastigheter upp till Mach 15 (5,1 km eller 3,2 miles per sekund) och ha en räckvidd på 1 400 km (870 miles). Företrädare för IRGC har dessutom nämnt planer på att förlänga missilens räckvidd till 2 000 km (1 242 miles), vilket skulle innebära att Israel är inom räckhåll. Under evenemanget fördömde Irans högsta ledare återigen Israel och dess västerländska allierade för det pågående kriget i Gaza, som har lett till över 12 000 palestinska dödsfall, varav nästan hälften är barn. Han beskrev Israel som en symbol för rasism och anklagade västerländska ledare som stöttar Israels militära insatser för att dela dessa åsikter. Khamenei kritiserade attacker på sjukhus i Gaza som bevis på israelisk frustration och uppmanade islamiska regeringar att bryta de politiska relationerna med Israel, åtminstone tillfälligt, samt att stoppa leveranser av energi och varor. Avtäckningen kom samtidigt som USA skickade betydande militära resurser till området, däribland två hangarfartygsgrupper och en kärnvapenubåt. Den Iranstödda ‘motståndsaxeln’, som består av grupper som Hizbollah i Libanon och Huthierna i Jemen, har varit inblandad i gränsöverskridande strider med Israel i solidaritet med Hamas. Israel rapporterade att Huthierna på söndagen beslagtog ett brittiskägt, japanskdrivet fraktfartyg i södra Röda havet, och kallade detta för en ‘iransk terrorhandling’.

article_content: Paris riot police confronted crowds who tried to enter the Champs-Elysees in Paris today during a major protest against a proposed law allowing same-sex couples to marry and adopt children. Up to 300,000 people—including conservative activists, families, retirees, and priests—gathered in the capital in a last effort to stop the bill. Many traveled from across France. The French parliament's lower house approved the 'marriage for all' bill last month, and the Senate is expected to vote on it soon. Riot police used tear gas on some demonstrators during clashes on the Champs-Elysees. One protester was seen throwing a traffic cone at officers. Both parliamentary chambers are dominated by President Francois Hollande’s Socialist Party and its allies. Ongoing protests led by opposition conservatives in France, a traditionally Catholic country, have affected support for the bill in recent months. Organizers hoped that Sunday’s march would influence the Senate debate. The protest started peacefully, but as it was meant to end, about 100 young people tried to get past police barricades onto the Champs-Elysees, a famous avenue popular with tourists. Due to the sensitive nature of the issue, protesters were not permitted to march on the Champs-Elysees. Christine Boutin, leader of the French Christian Democratic Party, was photographed on the ground after being affected by tear gas during the demonstration. She has previously stated strong opposition to same-sex marriage, saying it could lead to polygamy. Many people arrived from outside Paris to boost turnout before the protest turned violent. Thousands of French conservatives, families, and activists joined the demonstration. Police struggled to contain the youths, eventually firing tear gas to push them back. More protesters then used side streets to reach the avenue, blocking important intersections on the route to the presidential Elysee Palace. Police fired more tear gas but could not prevent crowds from moving onto the avenue. Protestors chanted for President Hollande to resign and sang the French national anthem, 'La Marseillaise.' These demonstrations have allowed citizens to voice frustration with Hollande’s presidency. According to a Paris police spokesperson, two people were arrested and there were no reported injuries. Violence erupted after several hundred youths rushed toward the Champs-Elysees, which was under a protest ban. Demonstrators waved flags, chanted slogans, and some dressed in French Revolution costumes or wore gags. Placards included messages such as 'We want jobs, not gay marriage.' The police estimated 300,000 participants in Sunday’s demonstration, slightly fewer than a similar protest in January, while organizers claimed over 1.2 million people attended. Polls suggest that while a majority of French voters still support gay marriage—which is legal in several European countries and some US states—there is less support for adoption by same-sex couples. Frigide Barjot, a leading protest organizer, said that the protest movement continues, saying, 'It's the second round. It's not the last battle.'

Polisen uppskattade deltagarantalet till 300 000 under söndagens demonstration, något färre än vid en liknande protest i januari, medan arrangörerna hävdade att över 1,2 miljoner deltog. Opinionsmätningar visar att en majoritet av fransmännen fortfarande stödjer samkönade äktenskap – som är lagliga i flera europeiska länder och vissa delstater i USA – men stödet för adoption av samkönade par är lägre. article_content: Imagine traveling back 4.6 billion years to witness the birth of our Sun. What would you see? Thanks to a stunning new image from the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), we now have a glimpse. The photo captures HH212, located in the Orion constellation about 1,300 light-years away. At the center, a protostar — likely less than 50,000 years old — is in the process of being born, similar in age to our Sun in its infancy. The protostar itself is obscured by a dense, spinning disc of gas and dust, but the JWST reveals striking pinkish-red jets of molecular hydrogen shooting out in opposite directions. These jets are thought to regulate the star’s formation by balancing its angular momentum. According to Professor Mark McCaughrean from the European Space Agency, as the protostar contracts and spins, jets and outflows help expel excess angular momentum, preventing the star from breaking apart. The characteristic color seen in the image signals the presence of molecular hydrogen, made up of two bonded hydrogen atoms. Shockwaves within the outflows energize the material, causing the jets to glow brightly. The image was taken primarily in infrared light at a wavelength of 2.12 microns using JWST’s NIRCam instrument. While a few mature stars can be seen, most points of light in the image are distant galaxies. Bowshock structures are observed within the jets—these occur where faster material collides with slower-moving gas, creating symmetrical knot patterns. However, in the JWST image, one side appears more diffuse, likely due to varying densities of gas and dust. HH212 has been studied for three decades, but the clarity offered by JWST is ten times greater than previous observations. This enhanced resolution enables astronomers to track changes in the jet structures, even estimating their speed at over 100 kilometers per second. The term 'HH' in HH212 refers to Herbig-Haro objects, named after astronomers George Herbig and Guillermo Haro. JWST’s advanced instruments don’t just provide sharper images—they also capture a broader range of colors, unveiling new details about star formation. Nearby, another object known as HH211 in the Perseus constellation—an even younger protostar—offers glimpses into the early stages of stars like our Sun. The JWST is a collaborative project among the US, European, and Canadian space agencies, continuing to transform our understanding of the universe.
translated_content: Föreställ dig att resa tillbaka 4,6 miljarder år för att bevittna vår sols födelse. Vad skulle du se? Tack vare en fantastisk ny bild från James Webb-rymdteleskopet (JWST) har vi nu en inblick. Fotot visar HH212, belägen i stjärnbilden Orion cirka 1 300 ljusår bort. I centrum finns en protostjärna – troligen mindre än 50 000 år gammal – som är på väg att födas, ungefär lika gammal som vår sol var i sin barndom. Själva protostjärnan döljs av en tät, snurrande skiva av gas och stoft, men JWST avslöjar slående rosa-röda strålar av molekylärt väte som skjuter ut i motsatta riktningar. Dessa strålar tros hjälpa stjärnans utveckling genom att balansera dess rörelsemängdsmoment. Enligt professor Mark McCaughrean vid Europeiska rymdorganisationen hjälper strålar och utflöden till att göra sig av med överskottsmoment i takt med att protostjärnan dras samman och roterar, så att stjärnan inte slits isär. Den karakteristiska färgen på bilden visar förekomsten av molekylärt väte, som består av två sammansatta väteatomer. Stötvågor inom utflödena ger materia energi och får strålarna att lysa starkt. Bilden togs huvudsakligen i infrarött ljus med en våglängd på 2,12 mikrometer, med JWST:s instrument NIRCam. Några mogna stjärnor syns i bilden, men de flesta ljuspunkter är avlägsna galaxer. Strukturer av bågchocker kan observeras i strålarna – de uppstår där snabbare material kolliderar med långsammare gas och bildar symmetriska knutpunkter. I JWST:s bild är dock ena sidan mer diffus, troligen på grund av variationer i tätheten av gas och stoft. HH212 har studerats i tre decennier, men skärpan JWST erbjuder är tio gånger bättre än tidigare observationer. Den förbättrade upplösningen gör det möjligt för astronomer att följa förändringar i strålstrukturerna och att uppskatta deras hastighet till över 100 kilometer per sekund. Förkortningen 'HH' i HH212 står för Herbig-Haro-objekt, efter astronomerna George Herbig och Guillermo Haro. JWST:s avancerade instrument ger inte bara skarpare bilder – de fångar också ett bredare färgspektrum och avslöjar nya detaljer om stjärnbildning. I närheten finns ett annat objekt, kallat HH211, i Perseus stjärnbild – en ännu yngre protostjärna – som ger en inblick i hur stjärnor som vår sol föds. JWST är ett samarbetsprojekt mellan amerikanska, europeiska och kanadensiska rymdorganisationerna och fortsätter att förändra vår förståelse av universum.

article_content: Five years after the devastating Camp Fire, Paradise, California, is gradually rebuilding. Resident Cindy Foudray continues to live in an RV on her former property, coping with lasting stress and uncertainty since the inferno destroyed her home in November 2018. The Camp Fire, sparked by downed power lines during one of the driest autumns on record, resulted in 85 deaths and the loss of nearly 19,000 structures. It was the world’s costliest climate disaster in 2018. Foudray and her family managed to escape, but lost their home and are still navigating a difficult recovery. She expresses sympathy for wildfire survivors in other places, like Hawaii, who face similar trials. Paradise’s population has declined sharply from about 26,000 residents to roughly a third of its former size. The recovery is drawn out, hindered by extensive destruction and a largely elderly, low-income constituency. Many were forced to relocate as they searched for affordable housing. Physically, Paradise has changed significantly. One million trees have been cleared, opening up new views of surrounding mountains. Roads are being rebuilt, power lines are being buried underground, and construction activity is ever-present. All new homes must now meet stricter wildfire codes, including bans on flammable materials near structures. Former Mayor Jody Jones, among the first to rebuild, notes the community is striving for resilience. She advises leaders in other disaster-stricken communities, like Lahaina in Hawaii, that recovery takes years. Despite added challenges from the global pandemic, progress continues: Paradise is now averaging 600 rebuilt homes per year, up from a dozen annually before the fire. However, higher costs for building and living mean not all original residents can return. Town leaders are streamlining rebuilding, offering preapproved fire-resistant home designs, while recognizing that affordability is a major barrier for many. Much of the disaster relief has been directed toward public infrastructure rebuilding instead of private homes. Ed Mayer of the Butte County Housing Authority points out ongoing struggles to provide affordable housing, noting about 3,000 new units are in development, most outside Paradise. Many evacuees settled in nearby cities and some remain in limbo years later. Bernadette Grant and her partner Richard Fox, whose homes burned, are building an off-grid home from the lumber of trees cleared on their land that was spared by the fire. They are frustrated by the slow recovery process and delays in compensation from PG&E, the power company whose equipment started the blaze. Despite persistent wildfire risks and uncertainty linked to climate change, many residents remain determined to rebuild and adapt. As Grant observes, nowhere is completely immune from natural disasters.
translated_content: Fem år efter den förödande Camp Fire återuppbyggs Paradise, Kalifornien, sakta men säkert. Invånaren Cindy Foudray bor fortfarande i en husbil på sin tidigare tomt och kämpar med långvarig stress och osäkerhet sedan hennes hem förstördes i november 2018. Camp Fire, som startade på grund av nedfallna kraftledningar under en av de torraste höstarna någonsin, resulterade i 85 dödsfall och förstörelsen av nästan 19 000 byggnader. Det var den dyraste klimatrelaterade katastrofen i världen år 2018. Foudray och hennes familj lyckades fly men förlorade sitt hem och står fortfarande inför en svår återhämtningsprocess. Hon känner medlidande med andra offer för skogsbränder, som i Hawaii, som går igenom liknande prövningar. Paradises befolkning har minskat kraftigt från cirka 26 000 invånare till ungefär en tredjedel av det ursprungliga antalet. Återhämtningen går långsamt, hindrad av omfattande förstörelse och en till stor del äldre och låginkomsttät befolkning. Många har tvingats flytta när de letat efter prisvärda boenden. Paradise har förändrats fysiskt. En miljon träd har röjts bort, vilket öppnar nya vyer över de omgivande bergen. Vägar byggs om, elledningar grävs ner, och byggarbeten pågår ständigt. Alla nya bostäder måste nu följa striktare brandskyddskoder, inklusive förbud mot brännbara material nära byggnader. Tidigare borgmästaren Jody Jones, en av de första att bygga nytt, säger att samhället satsar på motståndskraft. Hon ger råd till ledare i andra katastrofdrabbade samhällen, som Lahaina på Hawaii, om att återhämtning tar tid. Trots extra utmaningar från pandemin fortsätter arbetet: Nu byggs det i snitt 600 nya hus per år i Paradise, jämfört med ett dussin årligen före branden. Men de högre bygg- och boendekostnaderna innebär att inte alla ursprungliga invånare kan återvända. Kommunledningen försöker förenkla återuppbyggnaden genom färdiggodkända, brandsäkra hustyper, men är medvetna om att många har svårt att ha råd att flytta tillbaka. Mycket av katastrofhjälpen har gått till offentlig infrastruktursuppbyggnad snarare än privata bostäder. Ed Mayer vid Butte Countys bostadsmyndighet pekar på fortsatta svårigheter att ordna prisvärt boende och berättar att cirka 3 000 nya enheter byggs, de flesta utanför Paradise. Många evakueringsoffer bosatte sig i närliggande städer och vissa lever fortfarande i osäkra förhållanden flera år efteråt. Bernadette Grant och hennes partner Richard Fox, som båda förlorade sina hem, bygger nu ett självförsörjande boende av virke från träd som röjts på deras tomt som skonades från branden. De är frustrerade över den långsamma återhämtningen och förseningarna i kompensation från PG&E, elbolaget vars utrustning orsakade branden. Trots kvarstående risk för nya bränder och osäkerhet kopplad till klimatförändringar är många invånare fast beslutna att bygga upp sina liv igen och anpassa sig. Som Grant säger finns det ingen plats som är helt säker från naturkatastrofer.

article_content:
Vassar College officials disclosed that two students—one being Genesis Hernandez, a transgender student and leader of the Bias Incident Response Team (BIRT)—were responsible for creating and falsely reporting some recent incidents of offensive and racist graffiti on campus. These two students have been definitively linked to two of the six reported bias graffiti incidents; investigations into the remaining cases continue. Officials stated that the individuals not only produced the graffiti but also claimed to be unrelated when reporting the messages. Some graffiti targeted both transgender people and African Americans.

The Vassar community was first notified in an email about six instances of graffiti found on dorm room doors, and a subsequent message revealed that some of the incidents had been staged by the very students who reported them. While Genesis Hernandez was not formally named in official statements, his departure from the college and student government roles soon after the allegations brought attention to his involvement.

Director of Media Relations Jeff Kosmacher confirmed that there is clear evidence linking the two students to a portion of the cases, but noted that criminal charges are not being pursued at this time. College president Catharine Hill expressed sadness over the events and emphasized the damage caused to trust and community wellbeing.

Dessa två personer har definitivt kopplats till två av sex rapporterade klotterincidenter med fördomsfullt innehåll; utredningar kring övriga fall pågår fortfarande. Enligt skolans representanter var studenterna inte bara ansvariga för att skapa klottret, utan de rapporterade också händelserna som om de själva var oskyldiga. Vissa meddelanden riktade sig både mot transpersoner och afroamerikaner.

Vassar informerade först studenter och personal om sex fall av klotter på studentrumsdörrar via e-post, och i ett senare utskick framkom att några av dessa incidenter hade arrangerats av de studenter som rapporterat dem. article_content: British military advice was provided to Indian authorities ahead of the 1984 massacre at the Golden Temple in Amritsar, Foreign Secretary William Hague confirmed. An SAS officer traveled to India and advised military leaders prior to the assault. However, a government investigation found that the advice had a limited impact. The officer's recommendations were mostly ignored, as Indira Gandhi’s government opted for a direct frontal assault—Operation Blue Star—which killed 575 at the temple and resulted in up to 3,000 deaths in the subsequent riots. The inquiry, led by Cabinet Secretary Sir Jeremy Heywood, was prompted by documents released under the 30-year rule. It confirmed the SAS officer advised the Indian government on dealing with Sikh dissidents at the temple, but his advice for a surprise, helicopter-borne operation to minimize casualties was not followed in the June 1984 raid. Hague stated that the UK's involvement was limited, advisory, unrelated to defense sales, and that there was no evidence the British government received advance notice of the operation. Prime Minister David Cameron has urged the Sikh community to forgive the Conservative Party after it was revealed Margaret Thatcher approved the SAS officer's visit. Lord Butler of Brockwell, Thatcher's private secretary at the time, emphasized that she considered the decision very carefully. Cameron reiterated that the adviser’s input occurred about four months before the operation and was not acted upon. He stressed that there is no evidence the UK government was involved in the assault itself. Community leaders, including Lord Indarjit Singh and Dabinderjit Singh of the Sikh Federation UK, criticized the official report and statements, describing them as dismissive and disappointing. Jasvir Singh of the City Sikhs Network said the information evokes colonial-era attitudes. The attack on the Golden Temple ultimately led to the assassination of Indira Gandhi by her Sikh bodyguards several months later.
translated_content: Brittisk militär rådgivning gavs till indiska myndigheter inför massakern vid Golden Temple i Amritsar 1984, bekräftade utrikesminister William Hague. En SAS-officer reste till Indien och rådgjorde med militära ledare före attacken. En regeringsutredning fann dock att råden hade begränsad påverkan. Officerens rekommendationer ignorerades till största delen, då Indira Gandhis regering valde ett direkt frontalangrepp—Operation Blue Star—vilket dödade 575 vid templet och ledde till upp till 3 000 dödsfall i de efterföljande upploppen. Utredningen, ledd av kabinettsekreterare Sir Jeremy Heywood, startades på grund av dokument som offentliggjordes enligt 30-årsregeln. Den bekräftade att SAS-officeren gav råd till den indiska regeringen om hur de skulle hantera sikhska dissidenter vid templet, men hans råd om ett överraskningsanfall med helikoptrar för att minimera förluster följdes inte vid räden i juni 1984. Hague förklarade att Storbritanniens inblandning var begränsad, rådgivande, inte relaterad till försäljningsavtal om försvarsmaterial, och att det inte finns några bevis för att den brittiska regeringen fick information om operationen i förväg. Premiärminister David Cameron har uppmanat det sikhska samhället att förlåta det konservativa partiet efter avslöjanden om att Margaret Thatcher godkände SAS-officerens besök. Lord Butler of Brockwell, Thatchers privata sekreterare vid den tiden, betonade att hon övervägde beslutet mycket noggrant. Cameron betonade att rådgivningen ägde rum cirka fyra månader före operationen och inte följdes. Han underströk att det inte finns några bevis för att den brittiska regeringen var involverad i själva attacken. Samhällsledare, däribland Lord Indarjit Singh och Dabinderjit Singh från Sikh Federation UK, kritiserade den officiella rapporten och uttalandena och beskrev dem som nedlåtande och besvikelse. Jasvir Singh från City Sikhs Network ansåg att informationen påminner om kolonialtiden. Attacken mot Golden Temple ledde till slut till mordet på Indira Gandhi av hennes sikhska livvakter flera månader senare.

article_content: Ben Foden, recently seen on TV, played a low-key role as Northampton Saints pulled off a gritty Premiership win against Harlequins at Twickenham in front of 82,000 fans. The victory ended a historic year for Saints at the stadium where they had previously lifted the title. George North delivered a crucial try and Samu Manoa drove over for the Saints’ first points, making an impact even with limited chances. Manoa and Salesi Ma’afu, both set to transfer to Toulon, played significant roles—Ma’afu received a yellow card but Saints nonetheless increased their lead while down a man. Although Harlequins dominated early possession (71% in the first half), they lagged at halftime, missing key players Chris Robshaw and Joe Marler. Saints’ captain Dylan Hartley was also absent due to a ban. George Lowe struck first for Harlequins, with Tim Swiel and Stephen Myler swapping penalties. Northampton’s determination took center stage as Manoa scored from a line-out drive, and Myler later added points before North’s pivotal try following a block. Alex Corbisiero returned from injury to strengthen Saints’ defense. Harlequins’ Jack Clifford narrowed the gap, but Kahn Fotuali’i added Saints’ third try to secure the win, despite a late score from Sam Twomey. The contest featured outstanding efforts from several internationals, with Northampton’s collective resilience and teamwork shining through to close their landmark year on a high note.

George North levererade ett avgörande försök och Samu Manoa tog sig in med Saints första poäng, trots få chanser. Manoa och Salesi Ma’afu, båda på väg till Toulon, spelade viktiga roller—Ma’afu drog på sig ett gult kort men Saints ökade ändå sin ledning med en man mindre. Trots att Harlequins dominerade bollinnehavet tidigt (71 % i första halvlek) låg de under i paus, saknande nyckelspelarna Chris Robshaw och Joe Marler. Saints kapten Dylan Hartley var också borta på grund av avstängning. George Lowe stod för matchens första försök för Harlequins, medan Tim Swiel och Stephen Myler bytte straffar. Northamptons beslutsamhet syntes då Manoa rusade in poäng efter en inkastmaul, och Myler fyllde på innan Norths viktiga försök efter en block. Alex Corbisiero var tillbaka efter skada och förstärkte Saints försvar. Harlequins Jack Clifford minskade avståndet, men Kahn Fotuali’i gjorde Saints tredje försök och säkrade vinsten, trots ett sent försök av Sam Twomey. Matchen bjöd på fina insatser från flera landslagsspelare, där Northampton visade stor laganda och avslutade ett rekordår på bästa sätt.

Aine Davis, a British man who spent two years with the Islamic State in Syria and was acquainted with the militant known as Jihadi John, has been sentenced to eight years in prison for terrorism offences. At the Old Bailey, Davis received five and a half years for possessing a firearm for terrorist purposes, and two and a half years for two counts of fundraising—offences under the Terrorism Act. He will also serve two years on licence after his release.

Davis was deported to the UK in August 2022 after serving a prison term in Turkey for terrorism offences. Born in west London in 1984, Davis had several prior drug convictions and was jailed in 2004 for possessing a firearm. After converting to Islam and sometimes using the name Hamza, he became a committed Islamist extremist and travelled extensively in the Middle East, visiting Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Yemen, and Egypt. He attended the same west London mosque as Mohamed Emwazi, known as 'Jihadi John.'

Intelligence services once suspected Davis of being a member of the IS 'Beatles' group, which tortured and killed hostages, but he is no longer believed to have been part of that cell. Davis admitted his motivations had been shaped by images of the Syrian war, believing it was his 'religious obligation' to join the conflict—a decision he now recognises as terrorism. His barrister described him as naïve and said Davis wished to apologise to the people of Syria, his family, and the court.

Judge Mark Lucraft KC, in sentencing, emphasised that evidence showed Davis’s contact with fighters in Syria and clarified that judgment was only for proven offences, not media speculation. Davis attempted to obtain €20,000 (£17,460) from his wife, Amal El-Wahabi, for terrorism purposes—a crime for which she was also convicted.

Although Davis knew members of the Beatles cell, including Alexanda Kotey (now serving a life sentence in the US), he has always denied being a member himself. After returning to Turkey in 2013 and spending two years with Islamic State, Davis was arrested there in 2015 and convicted for membership in a terrorist organisation. After his release, he was deported to the UK and arrested again.

Despite speculation and investigations, including consideration for extradition to the United States, US authorities have not prosecuted him. Law enforcement leaders have emphasised their ongoing resolve to prosecute terror cases regardless of how much time has passed. Davis’s specific activities with IS during those two years remain unclear.

article_content: At Rupertswood Farm in Hagley, Northern Tasmania, Anna and Rowan Clark have once again transformed their fields, this time creating a poppy-shaped maze in their sorghum crop to commemorate ANZAC Day. Building on last year’s success with their Tasmanian Tiger (thylacine)-themed maze, which attracted over 2,000 visitors, the Clarks wanted to provide another memorable and meaningful experience. With expert support from UK-based maze designers Mazescapes, the Clarks utilized GPS technology and a ride-on mower to shape the intricate poppy pattern. Rowan mapped the maze over seven hours, and the couple keeps the paths clear by trimming them regularly as the crops grow quickly. The poppy maze, set to open on weekends beginning February 21, offers an engaging and educational adventure for families, school groups, and tourists. Activities include interactive games and puzzles—a tradition started with last year’s maze, where participants hunted for tiger footprints and unscrambled words. The inspiration for the mazes came after an English visitor shared stories of crop mazes in Europe, motivating the Clarks to bring this experience to Tasmania. Their goal is to encourage agricultural tourism and offer a space for visitors to enjoy and reflect on important occasions. Anna and Rowan are already generating new ideas for future mazes, aiming to continue sharing unique creations with the community and beyond.

Efter förra årets succé med en labyrint i form av den tasmanska tigern, som lockade över 2 000 besökare, ville paret Clark skapa ännu en minnesvärd och meningsfull upplevelse. article_content: Petroineos, owner of Scotland’s sole oil refinery at Grangemouth, is considering ceasing refinery operations as soon as 2025 due to ongoing global market challenges. The company has outlined plans to transform the site into a fuel import terminal, which would result in at least 400 job losses. The transition is expected to take up to 18 months, after which around 100 staff will remain to operate the terminal. Grangemouth is run by Petroineos, a joint venture between Chinese state-owned PetroChina and UK-based INEOS, and currently employs around 2,000 people across several business units. Approximately 500 work in the refinery, 450 support the Forties pipeline from the North Sea, and about 1,000 are involved in INEOS’s petrochemical operations. An end date for refining has not been confirmed but is likely to be in spring 2025, with the site expected to continue regular operations until then. The new import terminal will be able to receive petrol, diesel, aviation fuel, and kerosene for distribution throughout Scotland. Petroineos notes it is communicating with stakeholders, including the Scottish and UK governments, and plans to share more details as decisions progress. CEO Franck Demay says day-to-day activities continue for now, but that this shift is required to address falling demand for their traditional fuel products. The exact timing for the changes remains undecided. Scotland’s First Minister, Humza Yousaf, acknowledged the significant impact of the potential job cuts and said the government is prepared to support affected workers through the transition. He emphasized the necessity of a fair transition for employees to sustainable opportunities. Yousaf also pointed out that oil and gas licensing is a matter for the UK government, while stressing Scotland’s commitment to work with company representatives and trade unions to secure the site’s future. The Grangemouth complex has played a central role in Scotland’s industry since 1919 and was among the UK’s earliest oil refineries. It was acquired by Jim Ratcliffe’s INEOS group in a major 2005 agreement. The facility supplies the bulk of Scotland’s fuel for cars and planes and is vital to the operation of the Forties oil pipeline. Covering 1,700 acres, Grangemouth sends about 70% of Scotland’s fuel to filling stations, as well as supplying Northern Ireland and northern England. Company sources claim the refinery accounts for 4% of Scotland’s GDP and 8% of manufacturing, though the Fraser of Allander Institute estimates a lower GDP contribution of 0.25–0.3%. Grangemouth has recently been the scene of labor strikes and climate protests, with environmental activists blocked and arrested for direct action, and staff participating in industrial actions for better pay and working conditions. Unite, the site’s principal union, strongly opposes the shutdown plan and is determined to campaign against job losses. Union leaders contend that the closure will harm workers and could undermine Scotland’s energy security.

Företaget har presenterat planer på att göra om anläggningen till en importterminal för bränsle, vilket beräknas leda till minst 400 förlorade jobb. Omvandlingsarbetet väntas ta upp till 18 månader, och därefter kommer omkring 100 personer behövas för att driva terminalen. Grangemouth drivs av Petroineos, ett samriskföretag mellan kinesiska statliga PetroChina och brittiska INEOS, och har idag cirka 2 000 anställda inom olika områden. Runt 500 arbetar på raffinaderiet, 450 är verksamma vid Forties-pipelinen från Nordsjön och omkring 1 000 inom INEOS petrokemiska verksamhet. Något exakt slutdatum för raffinaderiets verksamhet är inte fastställt men sannolikt våren 2025, då verksamheten väntas pågå som vanligt fram till dess. Den nya importterminalen kommer att kunna ta emot bensin, diesel, flygbränsle och fotogen för vidare distribution i Skottland. Petroineos uppger att de samråder med intressenter som den skotska och brittiska regeringen, och kommer att lämna mer information efterhand. VD Franck Demay säger att verksamheten är opåverkad för tillfället, men att omställningen är nödvändig på grund av sjunkande efterfrågan på traditionella bränsleprodukter. Exakt tidsplan är dock oklar. Skottlands försteminister Humza Yousaf har bekräftat att de möjliga jobbförlusterna är stora och att regeringen är redo att stödja de drabbade genom omställningen. Han understryker behovet av en rättvis övergång till hållbara arbetstillfällen. Yousaf påpekar också att licensbeslut kring olja och gas tas av brittiska regeringen, men betonar Skottlands vilja att samarbeta med företaget och facket för att trygga anläggningens framtid. Grangemouth-komplexet har varit en viktig del av industrin i Skottland sedan 1919 och är en av Storbritanniens äldsta raffinaderier. Anläggningen köptes av Jim Ratcliffes INEOS-grupp 2005. Komplexet levererar huvuddelen av drivmedel till fordon och flyg i Skottland och har en avgörande roll för Forties-ledningens drift. Grangemouth omfattar 1 700 tunnland och försörjer cirka 70 % av Skottlands bränsle till bensinstationer, samt levererar till Nordirland och norra England. Enligt företaget står raffinaderiet för 4 % av Skottlands BNP och 8 % av tillverkningsindustrin, men Fraser of Allander Institute bedömer att BNP-bidraget snarare är 0,25–0,3 %.  På sistone har Grangemouth varit plats för arbetskonflikter och klimatprotester, där miljöaktivister blockerat ingångar och blivit gripna. Personalen har också strejkat för bättre löner och arbetsvillkor. Unite, som är den huvudsakliga fackföreningen på platsen, är starkt emot nedläggningsplanerna och kommer att kämpa för att skydda jobben. Fackliga företrädare menar att en nedläggning drabbar både arbetare och äventyrar Skottlands energisäkerhet.

article_content: On Friday morning, Mount Tavurvur in Papua New Guinea erupted, projecting ash up to 60,000 feet into the atmosphere. According to meteorologist Craig Earl-Spurr of the Darwin Volcanic Ash Advisory Center in Australia, the eruption was forceful and highly visible. Social media posts captured scenes of the volcano spewing both lava and dense ash columns that could be observed from across the bay. Located only a few kilometers from the town of Rabaul on New Britain's island, Mount Tavurvur previously erupted alongside nearby Mount Vulcan in 1994, an event that led to Rabaul's destruction. Meanwhile, elsewhere, flight restrictions in Iceland were lifted after authorities downgraded the alert concerning a volcano there.

article_content: An American scientist suggests that personality traits may influence whether someone enjoys spicy foods, such as chili peppers. Research at Pennsylvania State University examined how personality types relate to a preference for foods with hot spices. The study found that people who actively seek adventure and intense sensations tend to enjoy spicy food more than those who avoid risky situations. Nadia Byrnes, a doctoral candidate at the university, conducted the study with 184 non-smoking participants aged 18 to 45, predominantly Caucasian and 63% female, without any taste impairment. The participants' personality traits were measured using the Arnett Inventory of Sensation Seeking (AISS), which identifies individuals who seek novel and intense experiences. Participants above the average AISS score (higher sensation-seekers) were more open to risks and new experiences, while those below were less so. The participants were given 25 micrometers of capsaicin—the compound responsible for chili pepper heat—and asked to rate their preference for spicy meals as the sensation became more intense. Individuals below the mean AISS score quickly disliked the meal as the burn from the capsaicin increased. Conversely, those above the mean AISS maintained consistent enjoyment of the meal even as the heat intensified. Participants with average scores enjoyed the meal less as the heat increased, but their decline was less dramatic than that of the lower-scoring group. Byrnes commented: 'Theoretically, we know that burn intensity and liking should be linearly related—the more irritating a food is, the less people should like it. However, that's not always the case.' She presented these findings at the 2013 Institute of Food Technologists annual meeting and food expo. In a separate presentation, Dr. Shane McDonald, principal flavor chemist at Kalsec, discussed introducing 'tingling' spices to American foods. He noted that such sensations are uncommon in the U.S. diet, except for carbonation. Dr. McDonald cited 'Ma La,' a traditional Szechuan cuisine that uses chili peppers for heat and Szechuan peppers for their tingle, as promising for U.S. food manufacturers. He suggested that blending the two sensations could enhance tingling and reduce heat, potentially making spicy foods more appealing to American consumers.

Studien visade att personer som aktivt söker äventyr och intensiva upplevelser oftare tycker om stark mat än de som undviker riskfyllda situationer. Deltagarnas personlighetsdrag mättes med hjälp av Arnett Inventory of Sensation Seeking (AISS), som identifierar personer som söker nya och intensiva upplevelser. Deltagare över genomsnittet på AISS (de med högre sensationssökande) var mer öppna för risker och nya erfarenheter, medan de under genomsnittet var mindre öppna. Deltagarna fick 25 mikrometer capsaicin – ämnet som ger chilipeppar dess hetta – och ombads betygsätta hur mycket de gillade starka maträtter i takt med att hetta och sveda ökade. Han föreslog att kombinationen av de två sensationerna kan förstärka pirret och mildra hettan, vilket potentiellt kan göra stark mat mer attraktiv för amerikanska konsumenter.
