article_content: Scottish actor Sean Connery is urging people in Scotland to vote for independence in the referendum taking place in September. Connery, who has long advocated for an independent Scotland, told The Sun on Sunday that the chance to separate from the UK is an opportunity that shouldn't be overlooked. At 83, Connery believes that independence could revitalize Scotland's film and creative sectors and bring fresh employment opportunities. Although born in Edinburgh, Connery currently lives outside Scotland, but feels strongly that those who live and work there should be the ones to decide the country’s future. He argues that a vote for independence would ignite renewed appreciation for Scottish culture, heritage, and creativity. Connery's views contrast with those of music legend David Bowie, who, via a message read by supermodel Kate Moss at the Brit Awards, encouraged Scottish voters to stay in the United Kingdom. UK Prime Minister David Cameron welcomed Bowie's message, expressing happiness at the call for unity. Best known as the original James Bond and a passionate supporter of the SNP, Connery has praised Scotland's First Minister, Alex Salmond, and the SNP government since they assumed power in 2007. He remains optimistic about Scotland's future, noting that with the Scottish Parliament’s win in 1997 and the SNP’s election, the country is closer than ever to achieving independence—something he hopes to see in his lifetime. Connery once refused a knighthood because of his political stance, but later accepted the title in the New Year's Honours of 2000.

article_content: Two sisters of Coronation Street actor Michael Le Vell were hospitalized within days of each other, reportedly due to severe stress brought on by his upcoming child sex abuse trial. Reports indicate Susan Westcott was admitted to hospital after suffering chest pains, while her sister Glenis Gill was hospitalized two days later with severely low blood pressure. Michael Le Vell, 48, known for his long-standing role as Kevin Webster on Coronation Street, faces 19 child sex offence charges in a trial set for September in Manchester. The accusations, all from a single complainant, span incidents alleged to have occurred between 2001 and 2010. The charges include six counts of rape, six counts of indecent assault, and seven counts of sexual activity with a child. Le Vell firmly denies all allegations. Medical staff reportedly told the sisters their illnesses could be linked to the emotional burden of their brother’s legal case. Susan Westcott, 54, stayed overnight in hospital, while Glenis Gill spent eight days at Oldham General Hospital, Greater Manchester, according to the Sunday Mirror. Le Vell, who has not appeared on Coronation Street since February, has recently started seeing Blanca Fouche, a mother of four. He voiced concern for his sisters but noted the ordeal had drawn them closer as a family. Westcott described the experience as extremely traumatic but stressed the family’s unwavering support for her brother. Comments on this case remain disabled for legal reasons.

article_content: The corruption trial of former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Olmert concluded on Tuesday with a mixed verdict. Olmert was found guilty of breach of trust but acquitted on two corruption-related charges. The allegations dated from 2002 to 2006, during which Olmert served a second term as mayor of Jerusalem and held cabinet positions under then-Prime Minister Ariel Sharon. Prosecutors accused Olmert of double-billing government agencies for travel, accepting cash from an American businessman in exchange for official favors, and acting on behalf of clients of his former law partner. 'The court decided that I breached trust. I honor the decision and will learn the lessons from this,' Olmert stated outside the courtroom. 'I want to remind you the court said there were procedural problems, not corruption. I never received anything in return. I acted incorrectly procedurally, and I accept that.' He did not comment on his political future and thanked his lawyers for their work. Olmert still faces legal issues as one of 16 suspects in the ongoing Holyland corruption trial, which involves allegations that developers paid bribes to senior Jerusalem municipal officials for expedited approval of construction permits. Olmert became prime minister in 2006, succeeding Sharon after his stroke. He announced his resignation in August 2008 following police recommendations for charges. He left office in March 2009 when a new government took power. Earlier this year, Olmert told CNN's Christiane Amanpour that millions of dollars from the 'extreme right wing' in the United States helped remove him from office and hindered a peace plan with the Palestinians. In 2008, Olmert pursued a comprehensive peace agreement with the Palestinians, aiming for a two-state solution based on 1967 borders. The plan was not realized, and Olmert was forced to resign after being accused of corruption, which he denied. 'I had to fight against powerful forces, including millions of dollars sent from the United States by extreme right-wing individuals who sought to depose me as Prime Minister of Israel. There is no doubt about it,' Olmert told CNN. When asked for specifics, Olmert responded, 'Next time.' CNN's Elise Labott and Michal Zippori contributed to this report.

Anklagelserna sträckte sig från 2002 till 2006, då Olmert tjänstgjorde som borgmästare i Jerusalem för andra gången och hade ministerposter under dåvarande premiärminister Ariel Sharon. Åklagare anklagade Olmert för att ha dubbeldebiterat statliga myndigheter för resor, tagit emot kontanter från en amerikansk affärsman i utbyte mot officiella tjänster och för att ha agerat för sin tidigare juridiska partners klienter. 'Domstolen har beslutat att jag bröt mot förtroendet. Jag respekterar beslutet och kommer att dra lärdom av detta,' sa Olmert utanför rättssalen. article_content: German Chancellor Angela Merkel stated on Saturday that prospects for peace in Ukraine are 'uncertain' after talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Merkel and French President Francois Hollande met with Putin in Moscow on Friday. Speaking at the annual Munich Security Conference on Saturday, Merkel said it is still unclear if their discussions were successful, but stressed the importance of pursuing diplomacy. She emphasized that Europe's borders are 'inviolable' and accused Russia of disregarding peace and territorial integrity, stating that Moscow's actions in Ukraine violate their commitments and threaten escalation by altering borders through force. The French, German, and Russian leaders convened to develop a new proposal for ending the conflict in eastern Ukraine, with talks continuing into early Saturday. According to the Kremlin, further discussions by phone are planned for Sunday. Merkel commented, 'We want to shape security with Russia, not against it.' US Vice President Joe Biden, in remarks following Merkel at the conference, urged Russia not only to agree to peace—as outlined in the September ceasefire signed in Minsk, Belarus—but to put it into action. 'Too many times, President Putin has promised peace and delivered tanks, troops, and weapons,' Biden said, reiterating Western concerns about Russia's involvement in the conflict. He added, 'We believe we should attempt an honorable peace. We also believe the Ukrainian people have the right to defend themselves,' which was met with strong applause. Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov assured the conference that Russia is committed to peace. 'We are against combat. We would like to see a withdrawal of heavy weapons,' Lavrov said. He called for 'direct negotiation' between Ukrainian government leaders and separatist leaders in Donetsk, within Ukraine's territorial integrity. Lavrov said that talks will continue, expressing cautious optimism about reaching recommendations for conflict resolution. The renewed diplomatic efforts come as violence in eastern Ukraine continues to affect civilians severely. Merkel clarified that any agreement with Russia would not bypass Ukraine's leadership, stating that she 'will not decide anything over the heads of anyone.' She emphasized that the solution must align with the Minsk agreement, although continued fighting has undermined that pact. It is not yet clear how the new proposal differs from the Minsk agreement. Hollande said that the joint proposal for new negotiations would be 'based upon the territorial integrity of Ukraine' and hopes it will be acceptable to all parties. He warned, however, that negotiations and diplomacy could not go on indefinitely. Merkel is scheduled to meet US President Barack Obama in Washington on Monday to discuss Ukraine and other matters. Western leaders and authorities in Kiev accuse Russia of fueling the conflict by supplying weapons and training to pro-Russian separatists in Donetsk and Luhansk, as well as sending Russian troops into Ukraine. Moscow denies these accusations. According to the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, at least 224 civilians were killed and over 540 injured in Ukraine in the last three weeks of January. Reported by Brian Walker, Jason Hanna, Matthew Hoye, and Hande Atay for CNN.
translated_content: Tysklands förbundskansler Angela Merkel sade på lördagen att utsikterna för fred i Ukraina är "osäkra" efter samtal med Rysslands president Vladimir Putin. Merkel och Frankrikes president Francois Hollande träffade Putin i Moskva på fredagen. Under den årliga säkerhetskonferensen i München på lördagen sa Merkel att det fortfarande är oklart om diskussionerna varit framgångsrika, men betonade vikten av att fortsätta diplomatin. Hon underströk att Europas gränser är "okränkbara" och anklagade Ryssland för att bortse från fred och territoriell integritet, och menade att Moskvas agerande i Ukraina bryter mot dess åtaganden och riskerar att förvärra situationen genom att ändra gränser med våld. De franska, tyska och ryska ledarna möttes för att ta fram ett nytt förslag för att lösa konflikten i östra Ukraina, och samtalen pågick till tidigt på lördagen. Enligt Kreml planeras vidare telefonsamtal på söndag. Merkel kommenterade: "Vi vill skapa säkerhet med Ryssland, inte mot det." USA:s vicepresident Joe Biden, som talade efter Merkel vid konferensen, uppmanade Ryssland att inte bara komma överens om fred – som i vapenvilan i september undertecknad i Minsk, Belarus – utan faktiskt genomföra den i praktiken. "Alltför många gånger har president Putin lovat fred och levererat stridsvagnar, trupper och vapen", sade Biden och upprepade västerländska farhågor om Rysslands inblandning i konflikten. Han tillade: "Vi anser att vi ska försöka uppnå en hedervärd fred. Vi tror också att det ukrainska folket har rätt att försvara sig," vilket möttes av starka applåder. Rysslands utrikesminister Sergey Lavrov försäkrade konferensen att Ryssland är engagerat för fred. "Vi är emot strider. Vi vill se ett tillbakadragande av tunga vapen", sade Lavrov. Han uppmanade till "direkta förhandlingar" mellan den ukrainska regeringen och separatistledare i Donetsk, inom Ukrainas territoriella integritet. Lavrov sade att samtalen ska fortsätta och uttryckte försiktig optimism om att kunna ge rekommendationer för en konfliktlösning. De förnyade diplomatiska insatserna sker medan våldet i östra Ukraina fortsätter att drabba civila hårt. Merkel klargjorde att inget avtal med Ryssland kommer att gå över huvudet på Ukrainas ledarskap, och sade att hon "inte kommer att besluta någonting över någons huvud." Hon betonade att lösningen måste följa Minskavtalet, även om fortsatta strider underminerat det. Det är fortfarande oklart hur det nya förslaget skiljer sig från Minskavtalet. Hollande sade att det gemensamma förslaget till nya förhandlingar ska vara "baserat på Ukrainas territoriella integritet" och hoppas att det kommer att accepteras av alla parter. Han varnade dock för att förhandlingar och diplomati inte kan fortsätta i all oändlighet. Merkel är planerad att träffa USA:s president Barack Obama i Washington på måndag för att diskutera Ukraina och andra frågor. Västliga ledare och myndigheter i Kiev anklagar Ryssland för att driva på konflikten genom att tillhandahålla vapen och utbildning till proryska separatister i Donetsk och Luhansk samt att skicka in ryska trupper i Ukraina. Moskva förnekar dessa anklagelser. Enligt FN:s högkommissarie för mänskliga rättigheter dödades minst 224 civila och över 540 skadades i Ukraina under de tre sista veckorna i januari. Rapportering av Brian Walker, Jason Hanna, Matthew Hoye och Hande Atay för CNN.

Former Congressman and ex-New York City mayoral hopeful Anthony Weiner has redirected his efforts toward local community projects, according to reports. After his resignation from Congress in 2011 and his departure from political life, Weiner is now believed to be involved with the Rockaway Restoration Kitchen, a new restaurant initiative in Rockaway, Queens, that will focus on serving healthy, locally sourced food to an area frequently described as a 'food desert.' 

This venture seeks to improve access to nutritious meals and drive economic recovery in a community burdened by high unemployment and the lingering effects of Hurricane Sandy. The restaurant is expected to offer on-the-job training to people overcoming obstacles to employment, including former inmates and individuals recovering from addiction, working closely with local social service organizations.

While still in its planning phase, sources have reported that Weiner has been seeking appropriate sites for the restaurant, though he hasn't made public statements about his role. Known for volunteering at food pantries, Weiner has expressed a commitment to supporting those facing adversity since leaving politics. 

The project’s website outlines its mission to foster a friendly environment where Rockaway residents and guests can enjoy wholesome food while also helping participants build skills and confidence. Media coverage in the Rockaway Times and New York Post has highlighted Weiner’s community activities, but he has not directly addressed his participation when approached for comment.

article_content: Gucci is expanding its famed Gucci Cosmos exhibition into The Sandbox, a blockchain-based virtual world. The digital version, named Gucci Cosmos Land, recreates the London exhibition currently at 180 The Strand, featuring The Sandbox’s unique voxel graphics. Mirroring the real-world event—created by Es Devlin and curated by fashion historian Maria Luisa Frisa—the virtual Cosmos Land takes users on an interactive journey through Gucci’s heritage with themed spaces and quests. Highlights include a digital interpretation of the Ascending Room, illustrating how founder Guccio Gucci’s time at the Savoy Hotel inspired the brand, the Eden experience that explores the story of the Flora print, and the Gucci Ancora zone drawing from creative director Sabato De Sarno’s debut runway collection. Sebastien Borget, COO and Co-Founder of The Sandbox, says Gucci Cosmos Land provides fashion lovers with an immersive way to explore the celebrated London exhibition from anywhere, uncovering Gucci’s past, present, and future. The fastest 100 players to finish the quests will earn one of four exclusive Gucci avatars, each inspired by iconic runway outfits—from Tom Ford’s 1996 red velvet suit to Sabato De Sarno’s recent designs from Milan Fashion Week. Charles Hambro, CEO of GEEIQ, highlights that in an age of intense digital competition, brands increasingly use virtual environments to build communities around their identities and explore new income streams. He also emphasized the need for communication tailored to these audiences. GEEIQ’s research shows a clear connection between frequent virtual brand activations and Gen Z’s favorite brands. Business of Fashion’s December 2022 survey ranked Gucci as Gen Z’s second-favorite fashion brand after Nike. Players who complete all quests also stand a chance to win a share of The Sandbox’s prize pool totaling 100,000 SAND. Previously, Gucci partnered with The Sandbox to launch its Gucci Vault activation, which brought their experimental online store and the brand’s mix of history and futurism to life. Operated by Animoca Brands, The Sandbox collaborates with several leading fashion, gaming, and cultural brands, while Animoca invests in prominent Web3 projects including Yuga Labs, Polygon, Consensys, and OpenSea.

article_content: In recent years, there has been a concerning increase in violence and unexplained deaths involving Nigerian students abroad. One particularly tragic case is that of Chibuikem Emmanuel Ikem, a 28-year-old nursing student who was killed in Mandaue City, Philippines, allegedly by a group of Chinese nationals following a dispute about his partner’s work commission. Eyewitness accounts detail how Ikem was lured away, gagged, and fatally beaten. Friends and members of the Nigerian community in the Philippines described an atmosphere of hostility and fear, citing discrimination against black students and a lack of adequate support from Nigerian diplomatic missions. Ikem’s family, already dealing with previous losses, expressed devastation and disillusionment over the slow pursuit of justice. Ikem’s case is not isolated. Families and advocates recounted multiple instances of Nigerian students dying under suspicious circumstances in countries such as the UK, Ukraine, Northern Cyprus, South Africa, Malaysia, Russia, Ghana, and India. Investigations into these cases often stall with little to no accountability. Notable cases include Meshioye Remilekun-Toyosi (who died on an EgyptAir flight to London), Opeyemi Adedipe (found dead in the UK), and Fadlullah Agboluaje (who died shortly after arriving in Ukraine). Nigerian parents and experts have frequently voiced concerns about the risks students face overseas. Justice Amina Ahmad Bello called for action after her son’s death at a Northern Cypriot university, which she suspects was not an accident. Reports indicate that over 100 Nigerian students have died in mysterious circumstances in Northern Cyprus alone. Despite assurances from the Nigerians in Diaspora Commission (NiDCOM) and Nigerian embassies, families often see limited progress. While officials acknowledge the problem, they frequently state that these deaths are not always due to targeted attacks, but can result from crime, personal disputes, or other factors. The Nigerian diaspora, however, often feels vulnerable and unsupported. Nigerian academics and legal experts call for stronger support systems and protections for students studying abroad. Suggested measures include embassy-based student registers and more robust legal assistance. They stress the importance of valuing every life and urge both students and the Nigerian government to work together for greater safety. NiDCOM and similar bodies have developed data and reporting platforms for Nigerians abroad, but many unresolved cases remain. This has prompted renewed appeals for justice, transparency, and stronger action from both the Nigerian government and the international community.

Utredningar blir ofta liggande utan att någon hålls ansvarig. article_content: Carolyn Holland, an 80-year-old wealthy widow from Cayucos, California, met David Foute, who was 23 years younger, when he was hired to do some odd jobs for her. Soon after, they entered a romantic relationship. Carolyn described Dave as caring and loving, and Dave expressed his dedication to her. Carolyn’s daughters, Susan and Sally, were convinced Dave was manipulating their mother for financial gain, concerned by the swift progression of their relationship and changes in Carolyn’s behavior. Carolyn, meanwhile, felt unsupported by her daughters until after she met Dave. Dave had arrived in Cayucos homeless and had a history of drug addiction and legal troubles, including time in jail. He stated he had changed, became a regular churchgoer, and was open about his past. Despite some evidence of Dave caring for Carolyn, suspicion lingered. Further investigation revealed a troubling past, including domestic violence and alleged child neglect. Carolyn co-signed a loan enabling Dave to buy a $40,000 van. She later agreed to sell a property and intended to give Dave part of the proceeds. During this time, Carolyn was hospitalized with Covid, after Dave had convinced her not to get vaccinated. While Carolyn was in poor health, her daughters obtained power of attorney over her affairs. Carolyn passed away soon afterward. Her daughters did not notify Dave of her death or hold a funeral, feeling he had taken advantage of her. Experts note that financial abuse of the elderly is widespread and often unreported. Geriatricians warn that cognitive decline can hinder elders’ ability to manage finances. The UK charity Hourglass reported a large increase in elder financial exploitation cases. Dave is now homeless once again and remains in the area where he met Carolyn, reflecting on their relationship and expressing continued affection for her.

Han hävdade att han hade förändrats, blivit en regelbunden kyrkobesökare och var öppen om sitt förflutna. Även om det fanns tecken på att Dave brydde sig om Carolyn, kvarstod misstankarna. Experter konstaterar att ekonomiskt utnyttjande av äldre är utbrett och ofta inte anmäls. Geriatriker varnar för att kognitiv försämring kan försämra äldres förmåga att hantera sin ekonomi. A complex five-week negotiation led to the recent ceasefire deal between Israel and Hamas, as described by a senior US official. The process included a covert coordination cell led by CIA and Mossad heads, and frequent diplomatic engagement by US President Joe Biden, in collaboration with top officials from Israel, Qatar, and Egypt. Talks were often complicated by sudden breakdowns in communication with Hamas, arguments over which hostages would be released, and continued violence.

According to the US official, these secret talks began when Qatar reached out to US and Israeli authorities, proposing the release of hostages taken during the October 7 attacks. Qatar—host to Hamas’ political office and a key US military base—acted as the main mediator, with officials from the US, Israel, and Egypt working together on the issue, sometimes exchanging messages multiple times an hour. President Biden personally participated, holding a video call with hostage families and visiting Israel. The release of two American hostages on October 20 helped establish trust in Qatar’s mediation.

Following this, Mossad director David Barnea and CIA chief William Burns became directly involved. President Biden and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu held several phone conferences in late October. Negotiations, focused on logistics and timing, repeatedly stalled, especially when Hamas was delayed in providing a reliable list of hostages to be freed.

By November, increased pressure from Biden and coordinated efforts with Egyptian intelligence spurred new momentum. Hamas eventually presented details for the release of 50 hostages, and intensive behind-the-scenes talks led to an agreement. The ceasefire was announced, opening the way for hostages and prisoners to be exchanged.

article_content: Mahantesh Sabarad, an independent market expert, notes that the structure of IPOs in India often leads to significant unmet demand, much of which is 'evaporative'—meaning it disappears shortly after the listing date. Sabarad shares that he prefers focusing on sectors, highlighting hospitals as attractive due to capacity expansions and increased revenues post-COVID. He emphasizes looking at company fundamentals and valuations rather than chasing IPO hype. Recent IPOs, such as those of IREDA and Tata Technologies, have experienced substantial oversubscription, signaling strong investor interest. However, a large portion of this demand tends to vanish after the shares are listed. Sabarad advises patience for investors, suggesting those who missed out on IPO allocations should not rush to buy immediately after listing, and those who got shares should be cautious before booking profits. Both IREDA and Tata Technologies are considered quality companies, and while some follow-up buying is possible, most demand is expected to dissipate quickly. Elsewhere, women's participation in boardroom and family business disputes is increasing in India, reflecting a rise in women in senior leadership roles. Tesla is considering investing up to $2 billion to set up a local factory in India if the government allows a concessional 15% import duty on vehicles for the first two years. The Indian government may ask the next Finance Commission to focus more on the Human Development Index and Sustainable Development Goals when recommending state resource allocations.

Sabarad berättar att han föredrar att fokusera på olika sektorer och lyfter fram sjukhus som attraktiva tack vare kapacitetsökningar och ökade intäkter efter covid. Han betonar vikten av att titta på bolagens fundamenta och värderingar istället för att jaga IPO-hajp. Dock tenderar en stor del av denna efterfrågan att försvinna efter att aktierna börjat handlas. Sabarad råder investerare att ha tålamod: de som inte fick tilldelning ska inte skynda sig att köpa direkt efter noteringen, och de som fått aktier bör vara försiktiga innan de säljer för vinst. Både IREDA och Tata Technologies ses som kvalitetsbolag, och även om viss ytterligare efterfrågan kan uppstå, väntas det mesta snabbt avta. article_content: Laura Cattivera, 46, from California, was told she might have to give up running due to focal dystonia, a rare neurological condition that causes involuntary muscle spasms and abnormal postures. Athletes and musicians are often affected by this condition as a result of repetitive muscle use. Despite this, Cattivera discovered she could continue her training by running backwards, as the spasms did not interfere with this movement. Cattivera, passionate about running since childhood, previously competed on the Princeton track team and qualified for the 1992 Olympic trials. Her symptoms began in 1989, leading her to experience abnormal movements in her leg while sprinting, and affecting her performance at the Olympic trials. Doctors diagnosed her with focal dystonia after extensive medical testing, including MRI and CT scans. As the condition progressed, her left leg began moving involuntarily to the side when she ran, preventing her from running in a straight line. Potential treatments, like Botox injections and medications for Parkinson's disease, were either unsuitable or lost effectiveness over time. After Dr. Nicholas Szumski suggested running backwards, Cattivera found she could run without symptoms and regained her sense of adventure. She now enjoys running backwards on the sand at Manhattan Beach and Hermosa Beach, and is organizing a backwards running race to raise awareness about focal dystonia. Dystonia is a disorder characterized by involuntary muscle contractions and abnormal postures. Focal dystonia affects just one part of the body, often only during specific movements. The cause of dystonia is often unknown, though genetic factors or certain medications may trigger it. There is no cure, but some cases can be managed with treatments like Botox. (Source: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke.)

Idrottare och musiker drabbas ofta av detta tillstånd på grund av upprepad muskelanvändning. Trots detta upptäckte Cattivera att hon kunde fortsätta träna genom att springa baklänges, eftersom spasmorna inte påverkade denna rörelse. article_content: On May the 4th, Star Wars enthusiasts worldwide gathered to celebrate the beloved franchise. In Sydney, Australia, the day was particularly special as Dan Steininger, an elite Lego Master Builder from Los Angeles, set a new record by assembling the largest Lego models of Darth Vader and Yoda—standing at four meters and two meters high, respectively. Steininger began his Lego journey inspired by building with his young son. He left a lucrative sales career, despite financial uncertainty and a family to support, to follow his passion for Lego. The joy and satisfaction he finds in connecting Lego bricks drove him to pursue this unconventional path. Now, as one of just seven Lego Master Builders worldwide, Steininger is celebrated for creating giant Lego sculptures for audiences young and old. He calls his job 'getting paid to play,' and often sees both parents and children amazed that someone can turn a childhood pastime into a unique career. His skills in art and sculpture have been put to good use, and he believes activities like Lego building can inspire future innovators. Visiting Australia for Star Wars Day was a highlight for Steininger, an avid Star Wars fan since the original film’s 1977 debut—a movie he remembers as a groundbreaking cultural event. He speaks fondly of characters like Yoda and the saga’s enduring themes. Looking forward, Steininger and others are eager for the next generation of films, now produced by Disney and directed by J.J. Abrams. The upcoming movies promise a mix of original cast members (such as Harrison Ford, Carrie Fisher, Mark Hamill, Peter Mayhew) and new faces (including John Boyega, Oscar Isaac, Adam Driver, Domhnall Gleeson). The article notes, however, that previous prequel films—featuring Natalie Portman, Liam Neeson, Jake Lloyd, and Ewan McGregor—were less embraced by Star Wars purists.

I Sydney, Australien, blev dagen särskilt minnesvärd när Dan Steininger, en av världens sju Lego Master Builders från Los Angeles, satte nytt rekord genom att bygga de största Lego-figurerna av Darth Vader och Yoda – på fyra respektive två meters höjd. Steiningers resa med Lego tog fart när han byggde tillsammans med sin unga son. Han sade upp sig från ett framgångsrikt försäljningsjobb, trots ekonomisk osäkerhet och familjeansvar, för att följa sin passion för Lego. Glädjen och tillfredsställelsen han upplever av att bygga med Lego drev honom att våga satsa. Som en av bara sju Lego Master Builders globalt är Steininger nu känd för att skapa enorma Lego-skulpturer som tilltalar både barn och vuxna. Han beskriver sitt yrke som att 'få betalt för att leka', och ser ofta hur både föräldrar och barn fascineras av någon som lyckas göra ett barndomsintresse till sitt yrke. Hans bakgrund inom konst och skulptur har varit värdefull, och han menar att Lego-byggande kan inspirera framtidens innovatörer. Att få åka till Australien på Star Wars-dagen var en dröm för Steininger, som varit ett stort Star Wars-fan sedan originalfilmens premiär 1977 – en film han minns som en verklig kulturell milstolpe. Han talar varmt om karaktärer som Yoda och sagans tidlösa teman. Framöver ser Steininger och många andra fram emot nästa generation Star Wars-filmer, nu med Disney som producent och J.J. Abrams som regissör. Nästa filmer kombinerar ursprungliga skådespelare (inklusive Harrison Ford, Carrie Fisher, Mark Hamill, Peter Mayhew) med nya stjärnor (bland andra John Boyega, Oscar Isaac, Adam Driver och Domhnall Gleeson). Artikeln nämner dock att prequel-filmerna med Natalie Portman, Liam Neeson, Jake Lloyd och Ewan McGregor varit mindre populära bland inbitna fans.

Dhiraj Relli, MD & CEO of HDFC Securities, brings over two decades of banking experience and shares practical investment advice. Relli compares equity markets to a dynamic stage filled with highs and lows and stresses the need for clear vision and strategy.

He recommends the following steps for investors aiming to grow wealth:

1. Start Early and Stay Consistent: Begin investing as early as possible, and make regular contributions. Early and consistent investing benefits from compounding and helps investors become familiar with handling market risks.

2. Goal-Based Investing: Tie your investments to specific objectives, like retirement, buying a home, travel, or education. Prioritize long-term goals over seeking the quickest returns. Patience often produces better results.

3. Understand Before Investing: Learn about investment basics before putting money into assets like stocks, mutual funds, or real estate. Invest time and resources into financial education to understand different asset classes and money management.

4. Diversify Your Portfolio: Reduce risk and optimize returns by spreading investments across and within various asset classes—such as stocks, bonds, gold, and mutual funds. Adjust your diversification strategy as you gain experience.

5. Be Cautious with Advice: Separate trustworthy guidance from unsolicited advice or information overload. Limit the influence of electronic media tips, and seek input from reliable experts if uncertain.

6. Avoid Chasing Past Performance: Don’t let fear of missing out drive your decisions. Past performance doesn’t guarantee future returns. Review assets that have risen sharply for possible profit booking, and maintain a well-balanced, diversified portfolio.

7. Secure the Future: Make insurance a key part of your financial plan. Protect your family with adequate health and life insurance, and update your coverage as your income and costs rise.

8. Leverage Technology and Review Regularly: Use digital tools for research and portfolio management. Check sources for possible biases and periodically review your assets to remove underperformers and rebalance for better risk and return.

Following these practices can improve both investment experience and outcomes over time.

Trends highlighted in the article include:
- Increased participation and leadership roles for women in Indian boardrooms, particularly in governance conflicts.
- Tesla’s offer to invest $2 billion in an Indian plant, subject to favorable import duty conditions.
- The Indian government may adjust funding distribution among states with greater focus on HDI and SDGs.

Dhiraj Relli, VD och chef för HDFC Securities, har mer än två decenniers erfarenhet inom bankvärlden och delar med sig av praktiska investeringstips. Relli liknar aktiemarknaden vid en dynamisk scen fylld av toppar och dalar, och betonar vikten av en tydlig vision och strategi.

Han rekommenderar följande steg för investerare som vill bygga upp sin förmögenhet:

1. Börja tidigt och var konsekvent: Börja investera så snart som möjligt och gör regelbundna insättningar. Tidiga och konsekventa investeringar drar nytta av ränta-på-ränta-effekten och hjälper investerare att vänja sig vid riskhantering på marknaden.

2. Målbaserade investeringar: Koppla dina investeringar till specifika mål, som pension, bostad, resor eller utbildning. Prioritera långsiktiga mål framför att jaga snabba vinster. Tålamod ger ofta bättre resultat.

3. Förstå innan du investerar: Lär dig grunderna innan du investerar i tillgångar som aktier, fonder eller fastigheter. Investera tid och resurser i ekonomisk utbildning för att förstå olika tillgångsslag och pengahantering.

4. Diversifiera din portfölj: Minska risken och maximera avkastningen genom att sprida investeringarna över och inom olika tillgångsslag — till exempel aktier, obligationer, guld och fonder. Justera din diversifiering i takt med att du får mer erfarenhet.

5. Var försiktig med råd: Skilj på pålitliga rekommendationer och oombedda råd eller informationsöverflöd. Begränsa påverkan av tips från elektroniska medier och sök råd från betrodda experter vid osäkerhet.

6. Jaga inte gamla avkastningar: Låt inte rädsla för att missa något styra dina beslut. Tidigare vinster garanterar inte framtida resultat. Granska tillgångar som stigit kraftigt för att ev. ta hem vinster och håll en välbalanserad, diversifierad portfölj.

7. Trygga framtiden: Gör försäkringar till en viktig del av din ekonomiska planering. Skydda familjen med tillräckligt sjuk- och livförsäkringsskydd och uppdatera skyddet när din inkomst och kostnader ökar.

8. Utnyttja teknik och se över regelbundet: Använd digitala verktyg för research och portföljhantering. Kontrollera om källor har partiska intressen och se över dina tillgångar regelbundet för att rensa bort förlorare samt ombalansera för bättre risk och avkastning.

Att följa dessa råd kan förbättra både investeringsupplevelsen och resultaten över tid.

Artikeln lyfter också fram:
- Kvinnor får allt större roller i indiska styrelserum, särskilt vid interna konflikter och bolagsstyrning.
- Tesla överväger investera upp till två miljarder dollar i en indisk fabrik om förmånliga tullvillkor ges.
- Indiska staten kan ändra resursfördelning med större fokus på HDI och hållbarhetsmål.

article_content: At the Indian Cancer Congress, Dr. Rajendra Badwe, director of Tata Memorial Hospital, recommended India focus its cancer screening on breast, oral, and cervical cancers, citing the effectiveness of current methods and the higher rates of these cancers. He noted that screening for prostate and lung cancers is not presently efficient nor needed due to their lower incidence. Dr. Badwe stated that concentrating on these three cancers could help India manage most of its cancer cases and reduce the overall burden. He added that India's cancer rate is about a third of the US's and could potentially fall to one-ninth with proper screening. Oral cancer accounts for 40% of India's cancer cases, primarily driven by tobacco use. Dr. Pankaj Chaturvedi, deputy director for cancer epidemiology at Tata, called for intensified tobacco control efforts to combat this major public health problem. With forecasts suggesting cancer cases may climb to 2 million by 2040, experts continue to debate the best screening approach for India’s resource-limited setting. Breast cancer is on the rise in urban regions, prompting calls for more prompt detection and treatment. Although cervical cancer incidence is dropping, ongoing screening and improved hygiene are still necessary to sustain progress. Dr. Badwe recommends annual clinical breast exams or a mammogram every two years for women over 50, noting that mammograms cut mortality by up to 30% in this group, but are not shown to save lives for women under 50. A senior health official warned that overextending cancer screenings is impractical given the limited diagnostic and treatment capabilities, especially in rural areas. The Lancet Oncology Commission highlights the challenges: In low- and middle-income countries, a single oncologist must care for around 500 patients, while in high-income countries the number is about 150. Dr. Rajesh Dikshit and Dr. Badwe underscored the urgent need to address obesity, which can increase the risk of at least ten types of cancer.

Han betonade att screening för prostata- och lungcancer för närvarande varken är effektivt eller nödvändigt på grund av lägre förekomst. Dr. Badwe menade att ett fokus på dessa tre cancerformer skulle kunna hjälpa Indien att hantera huvuddelen av landets cancerfall och minska den totala sjukdomsbördan. Munhålecancer står för 40 % av Indiens cancerfall, främst drivet av tobaksanvändning. article_content: Celebrity chef Todd English is once again in the spotlight for his partying habits after a controversial photo surfaced. The image, which appeared last month, shows a sweaty and tired-looking English, 53, in a hot tub with topless young women at the exclusive Provocateur club in Manhattan’s Meatpacking district. Wenjie Song, a derivatives trader from Chicago and close friend of English, denied being in the photo, explaining the women pictured do not match her appearance. Song had previously posted a friendly photo with English on Instagram around Valentine’s Day but emphasized she was not involved in the nightclub scene. According to sources, English, who has an estimated net worth of $15 million from his restaurants, was heavily intoxicated at the time. The night at Provocateur escalated when his ex-girlfriend, fashion designer Candice Sonneman, reportedly threw a drink in his face after seeing him involved with two other women. Sonneman later tweeted a plea for English to stop sending her unpleasant messages and brought up his infidelity. English has had a high-profile social life, especially since ending his engagement to Erica Wang days before their planned 2009 wedding. He also sparked controversy when he fired a fake gun during his birthday party in 2012, an event filmed for his E! series 'Playing With Fire.' English operates several restaurants, including Olives, Figs, and Ca Va, and divorced his ex-wife Olivia Disch English in 2002. They share three grown children: Isabelle, Oliver, and Simon. English’s representatives have not yet commented. His nightlife antics continue to draw public attention for controversial reasons.

article_content: A luxurious and exclusive property has entered the market in Melbourne’s elite area, setting new records at a price around 50 times higher than the city’s average apartment price. The grand residence occupies the eighth floor of the prestigious 150 Clarence Street building in Melbourne East and was listed this week for $23.5 million. The $350 million development offers residents access to a 25-meter indoor pool, gym, 22-seat cinema, wine cellar, and 24-hour room service. Selling agent Anton Wongtrakun of Dingle Partners described the property as an opportunity to acquire a world-class home meant for discerning buyers who seek both space and sophistication. The property overlooks the historic Fitzroy Gardens and comprises three separate apartments, each with its own private entrance. Spanning nearly 1,000 square meters and boasting seven bedrooms, the home includes a billiards room with a marble bar, library, private cinema, and year-round alfresco dining areas with sweeping views of Fitzroy Gardens, Port Phillip Bay, and Melbourne Cricket Ground. The main residence features a spacious formal lounge with a gas fireplace, a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a second kitchen with a meals area and built-in oven, as well as an open-plan formal dining area boasting three-meter-high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows. The master suite offers a king-size bedroom with a hidden television, gas fireplace, sitting area, and terrace access. Two dressing rooms and twin marble ensuites lead to two additional king-sized bedrooms, each with built-in wardrobes. The second and third apartments add further appeal, providing extra master bedrooms with ensuites, marble kitchens, and additional bedrooms. One adjoining apartment offers its own open-plan living and additional bed areas. The Salta Property Group’s notable complex has previously made headlines—a penthouse on the 11th floor sold in 2008 for $18.2 million, combining two apartments and totaling almost four times the Victorian home’s average size. The 150 Clarence Street building continues to set new standards for luxury city living.

article_content: Iran’s foreign minister, Hossein Amirabdollahian, has cautioned that Israel’s continued military operations in Gaza could trigger a broader regional conflict if Hezbollah becomes involved, potentially causing severe consequences for Israel. Speaking in Beirut, Amirabdollahian emphasized that Hezbollah is fully prepared for multiple conflict scenarios and urged Israel to stop its attacks on Gaza immediately. Hezbollah, considered Israel’s most significant immediate threat, is estimated to possess around 150,000 rockets and missiles, many capable of reaching anywhere within Israel with precision. The group, composed of battle-hardened fighters—many experienced from Syria’s prolonged conflict—also operates advanced military drones. Tensions along the Lebanese-Israeli border have been high, especially following a large-scale attack by Hamas, a Palestinian militant group, which resulted in hundreds of Israeli civilian and military deaths. Recent cross-border hostilities have intensified: the Israeli military said one of its drone strikes eliminated a group attempting to infiltrate from Lebanon. Hezbollah has responded by launching multiple rockets at Israeli targets, including barrages toward the contested Chebaa Farms area. These exchanges have led to casualties; Lebanese state media reported that an Israeli shelling killed a local couple, and Hezbollah acknowledged the death of one of its fighters. Amirabdollahian conducted meetings in Beirut with the exiled head of Hamas, Saleh Arouri, and Ziad Nakhaleh, leader of the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, as reported by Hezbollah-linked media. While Hamas maintains that last week’s deadly assault on southern Israel was planned and executed solely by its members—denying Iranian involvement—it did not address the contents of Amirabdollahian’s meetings. Iran’s foreign minister’s tour of Iraq, Syria, and Lebanon illustrates Tehran’s broad regional influence. He also met with Hezbollah leader Sayyed Hassan Nasrallah to discuss current conditions. Amirabdollahian reiterated that any significant action by Hezbollah would have serious repercussions for Israel, warning of a disruptive ‘earthquake’ effect. He urged the international community to act swiftly to halt attacks on civilians in Gaza, warning that opportunities for diplomatic resolution are rapidly diminishing. Meanwhile, U.S. President Joe Biden has reaffirmed strong American support for Israel, deployed warships to the area, and warned other regional players against escalating the conflict. Recalling the monthlong 2006 conflict between Hezbollah and Israel—which ended in a stalemate and uneasy calm—there is growing concern that a new front could spark similarly devastating results.

Under ett besök i Beirut betonade Amirabdollahian att Hizbollah är helt förberett på flera konfliktscenarier och uppmanade Israel att omedelbart upphöra med attackerna mot Gaza. Hizbollah anses vara Israels allvarligaste omedelbara hot och tros ha omkring 150 000 raketer och robotar, många med förmåga att nå hela Israel med precision. Gruppen består av stridserfarna soldater—många med erfarenhet från Syriens långvariga konflikt—och använder även avancerade militära drönare. Spänningarna vid den libanesisk-israeliska gränsen har ökat, särskilt efter den storskaliga attacken av Hamas, en palestinsk militant grupp, som resulterade i hundratals döda israeliska civila och soldater. Attackerna har lett till dödsfall; libanesisk statlig media rapporterar att ett lokalt par dödades av israelisk beskjutning, och Hizbollah har bekräftat en förlorad soldat. Amirabdollahian träffade i Beirut den exilbaserade Hamas-ledaren Saleh Arouri samt Ziad Nakhaleh, ledare för Palestinska Islamiska Jihad, enligt Hizbollah-anknutna medier. Hamas hävdar att förra veckans dödliga angrepp mot södra Israel planerades och utfördes helt på egen hand, och förnekar iransk inblandning, men har inte kommenterat innehållet i mötena. article_content: After Hamas killed around 1,400 people and took at least 200 hostages on October 7, Marina—a woman who spent much of her childhood in Israel but now lives in the U.S.—began hearing from friends and family worldwide, who expressed sorrow and concern for her loved ones. Despite sharing videos and photos on social media—where she is typically not active—one of her closest friends, with whom she usually communicated daily, remained silent. The two women had developed a strong bond over the years, connecting through their husbands, attending each other's weddings, vacationing together, and raising children of similar ages. When Marina experienced a personal loss, both members of the other couple showed deep empathy. Marina noted that her friend’s background from a Muslim-majority country only enriched their connection, highlighting the diversity she cherished in America. However, for four days, Marina heard nothing. Eventually, her friend sent a note saying she was hurt by Marina’s social media posts, interpreting them as suggesting that all Muslims were terrorists. Marina was taken aback, clarifying that her posts were pointed only at Hamas, not Muslims or Arab culture. The relationship further deteriorated as Marina’s friend expressed an inability to support the Israeli government’s actions. Marina insisted it was not about politics, emphasizing the impact on innocent lives, particularly children. Later, her friend posted content Marina felt minimized the terror inflicted by Hamas, leaving Marina devastated. Across the U.S., far from the conflict’s frontlines, individuals are grappling with the reality that their friends or relatives may see the situation in Israel and Gaza very differently. Longstanding ties, already tested by past political and cultural debates, are now challenged by deeply personal convictions about the conflict—raising the question of who is 'right' in the Middle East. For many, this disagreement feels even more jarring than previous political disputes, as it involves those they once considered close allies. William Doherty, professor of family social science at the University of Minnesota and director of the Citizen Professional Center, observes that these divides are intensified by the sense of shared values among friends: when those values appear to diverge, the rupture feels profound. Americans, particularly on the political left, are realizing the bonds that once provided unity are more fragile than they believed. Some focus on the victims of the initial October 7 attacks, while others respond to the conditions in Gaza, such as rising casualties, communication blackouts, and limited aid. Claims of misinformation, betrayal, and complicity circulate widely, straining relationships further. Michally and her mother, both with Jewish heritage, had previously argued about Israel's actions. Michally, who was born in the U.S., sees parallels between Israel’s treatment of Palestinians and the trauma her own family experienced fleeing Europe during World War II. Despite her love for her mother, she finds their differences too painful to engage with, leading her to withhold other aspects of her life from her family. Disputes over the Israeli-Palestinian conflict differ from previous U.S. divisions, according to Doherty, because they touch on religion, ethnicity, and life-and-death stakes. Vivid media coverage and imagery further inflame passionate responses. Hailey, studying Judaism and pursuing conversion, has found little support in her liberal, queer community, feeling alienated by the dominant pro-Palestinian views. Attempts to discuss the conflict with family have led to emotional distance. Hailey describes a deep loneliness resulting from these divisions. Part of the strain may stem from the conflict’s prominence in the social media era, where disagreements about power dynamics are amplified and nuance is lost. Doherty notes that the prevailing narrative in the U.S. often focuses on the binary of oppressor versus victim, with both sides presenting themselves as displaced and wronged, shaped by diverse historical perspectives. For individuals like Kiesha, a Black feminist from Washington State, demonstrating solidarity with the oppressed—whom she identifies as Palestinians—outweighs preserving each personal relationship, even amid anxiety and emotional pain. She recognizes that standing by her principles can mean risking or grieving friendships. For Elissa, a writer in Connecticut, the hurt has come more from silence than from direct confrontation. She laments that some friends, perhaps assuming she holds certain views because she is Jewish, have neither checked on her nor acknowledged her personal pain, instead sharing anti-Israeli posts online. She feels unable to have meaningful conversations with them. Doherty stresses that viewing conversations themselves as morally compromising is a concerning trend. He warns that democracy relies on open debate, even about the most challenging issues. Ironically, after the attacks, the first person to contact Elissa was a friend with a Palestinian spouse and son, reaching out with concern and support—offering a reminder that above all, humanity should prevail. Marina concludes that her friendship may never recover. Attempts at reconciliation have failed, and her husband’s outreach to the couple’s mutual friend was unsuccessful. Quoting Tolstoy, she says, 'Betrayal is like having your arms broken: you can forgive, but you can never hug again.' Correction, October 31: The original story misstated Tolstoy’s first name. It is Leo, not Leonid.
translated_content: Efter att Hamas dödade omkring 1 400 människor och tog minst 200 som gisslan den 7 oktober hörde Marina—som tillbringade stora delar av sin barndom i Israel men nu bor i USA—av sig till vänner och familj över hela världen och möttes av sorg och omtanke för sina anhöriga. Trots att hon delade videor och bilder på sociala medier, där hon vanligtvis inte är aktiv, var det en av hennes närmaste vänner, som hon annars hade daglig kontakt med, som inte hörde av sig. De två kvinnorna hade utvecklat en stark vänskap under åren, träffats genom sina män, gått på varandras bröllop, rest tillsammans och haft barn i ungefär samma åldrar. När Marina gick igenom en personlig förlust visade båda i det andra paret stor empati. Marina påpekade att hennes väns bakgrund från ett muslimskt majoritetsland bara gjorde relationen rikare och visade på den mångfald hon uppskattar i USA. Men under fyra dagar hörde Marina ingenting. Till slut skickade hennes vän ett meddelande där hon uttryckte att hon blivit sårad av Marinas inlägg på sociala medier och tolkade dem som att alla muslimer pekades ut som terrorister. Marina blev bestört och förtydligade att hennes inlägg endast handlade om Hamas, inte muslimer eller arabisk kultur. Relationen försämrades ytterligare när Marinas vän sa att hon inte kunde stödja Israels regerings agerande. Marina betonade att det inte handlade om politik, utan om oskyldiga människor—särskilt barn—som drabbas. Senare publicerade hennes vän något som Marina uppfattade som en förminskning av Hamas terror, vilket lämnade Marina förkrossad. Runtom i USA, långt från konfliktens frontlinjer, försöker människor hantera att deras vänner och släktingar kan se på situationen i Israel och Gaza på helt olika sätt. Relationer som redan testats av tidigare politiska och kulturella debatter utmanas nu av djupa personliga övertygelser om konflikten—och väcker frågan om vem som har 'rätt' i Mellanöstern. För många känns denna oenighet ännu mer omskakande än tidigare politiska dispyter, eftersom den involverar dem de tidigare sett som närmaste allierade. William Doherty, professor i familjevetenskap vid University of Minnesota och chef för Citizen Professional Center, menar att dessa splittringar fördjupas av att man trott sig dela värderingar med sina vänner: när värderingarna verkar skilja sig åt blir sprickan desto större. Amerikaner, särskilt på vänsterkanten, märker att de band som tidigare enat dem är bräckligare än de trott. Vissa fokuserar på offren för attacken den 7 oktober, medan andra reagerar på situationen i Gaza—med ökande dödstal, kommunikationsavbrott och begränsat bistånd. Anklagelser om desinformation, svek och delaktighet sprids och tär på relationerna. Michally och hennes mamma, båda med judisk bakgrund, hade tidigare bråkat om Israels agerande. Michally, som är född i USA, ser paralleller mellan Israels behandling av palestinier och den trauma hennes egen familj upplevde när de flydde Europa under andra världskriget. Trots kärleken till sin mamma upplever hon att deras skillnader är för smärtsamma att hantera, vilket gjort att hon även undanhållit annat i sitt liv från familjen. Oenigheter om Israel-Palestina-konflikten skiljer sig från tidigare amerikanska motsättningar enligt Doherty, eftersom de handlar om religion, etnicitet och livsavgörande frågor. Intensiv mediabevakning och starka bilder eldar på känslorna. Hailey, som studerar judendom och vill konvertera, har svårt att hitta stöd i sitt liberala, queera nätverk och känner sig utanför i de starka pro-palestinska stämningarna. Försök att prata med familjen har lett till ökad distans. Hailey beskriver en djup ensamhet som följd av dessa konflikter. Delar av denna ansträngning kan bero på att konflikten nu är så framträdande i sociala medier, där nyanser försvinner och meningsskiljaktigheter om maktförhållanden förstärks. Doherty noterar att berättelsen i USA ofta fokuserar på förtryckare versus offer, där båda sidor ser sig som fördrivna och orättvist behandlade—utifrån olika historiska perspektiv. För personer som Kiesha, en svart feminist från Washington, är solidariteten med de förtryckta—i hennes ögon palestinier—viktigare än enskilda vänskapsband, även om det innebär ångest och smärta. Hon inser att stå upp för sina principer kan betyda att man måste sörja förlorade vänskaper. För Elissa, författare i Connecticut, handlar det mest om tystnad snarare än direkt konfrontation. Hon sörjer att vänner, som kanske antar att hon har vissa åsikter för att hon är judinna, varken hört av sig eller uppmärksammat hennes personliga smärta utan istället delat anti-israeliska inlägg på nätet. Hon känner att hon inte kan ha meningsfulla samtal med dem. Doherty betonar att det är oroväckande om själva samtalen ses som moraliskt komprometterande. Han varnar för att demokratin är beroende av öppen debatt, även om de svåraste frågorna. Ironiskt nog var den första som kontaktade Elissa efter attackerna en vän med en palestinsk make och son, som hörde av sig med omtanke och stöd—och påminde om att mänsklighet alltid bör gå först. Marina avslutar med att hon inte tror att vänskapen någonsin kan återställas. Försök till försoning har misslyckats och hennes mans försök att nå deras gemensamme vän var förgäves. Med ett citat från Tolstoj säger hon: 'Förräderi är som att få armarna brutna: du kan förlåta, men du kan aldrig krama igen.' Rättelse, 31 oktober: Ursprungsartikeln angav fel förnamn på Tolstoj. Det är Leo, inte Leonid.

article_content: John Crout, aged 63, ended the life of his wife Sheila in a tragic act intended to free her from extreme pain caused by severe arthritis and persistent migraines. After suffocating Sheila with a pillow as she rested on their sofa at home in Newcastle, John attempted to end his own life but was stopped by police on the Tyne Bridge. He told the officers, 'I have put my wife to sleep. She’s not in pain any more.' John and Sheila had shared 44 years of marriage after meeting as teenagers and had been looking forward to their retirement. Sheila’s condition quickly worsened, leaving her unable to move much and confined to their house. John, meanwhile, was also grappling with depression and anxiety, especially while recovering from hip surgery and seeing his wife’s constant struggle. Admitting manslaughter on the grounds of diminished responsibility, John received a 12-month sentence suspended for two years, so he avoided imprisonment. Judge Paul Sloan described the case as 'desperately sad,' noting John’s devotion to his wife and his mental health issues. At Newcastle Crown Court, the prosecutors detailed Sheila’s unbearable pain and near-immobility. John’s barrister, Nicholas Lumley QC, called the case 'tragic' and stressed that John’s mental health difficulties drove his actions. John’s family, including their daughter Nicola, spoke in his support, understanding his struggle and continuing to love and stand by him. John expressed his sorrow in a statement to the court, saying he never intended harm and everything he did was out of love for Sheila. The family continues to grieve Sheila’s absence and wishes she were still with them.

Familjen fortsätter att sörja Sheilas bortgång och önskar att hon fortfarande vore med dem.

Hazel Lockwood, 84, is suing Moorfields Eye Hospital after losing her sight during a cataract procedure in which her surgeon, Dr. Jaheed Khan, suddenly collapsed. Lockwood, who had relied on her right eye since a childhood accident damaged her left, says her surgery was interrupted when Dr. Khan felt ill and lay down, stating he could not continue. Court documents indicate a 30-minute delay followed before another surgeon took over, during which Lockwood’s vision was lost.

Lockwood’s family describes the incident as devastating, noting how it has impacted her daily life. Initially wary of the surgery, Lockwood went ahead after her husband's successful cataract operation. She underwent the procedure in September 2011 at the Moorfields Eye Centre located at St George’s Hospital in South London.

Legal filings claim Dr. Khan tried to reassure Lockwood but did not fully detail the operation’s risks. Dr. Khan denies this, saying all risks were discussed and Lockwood provided informed consent, having also received written information in advance. The consent form outlined a severe and permanent sight loss risk of one in 1,000, but her lawyers argue her risk was actually one in 333 due to her particular case.

Shortly after surgery started, Dr. Khan experienced dizziness and chest discomfort, prompting him to halt the operation. Consultant Dr. Antonella Berry-Brincat arrived after half an hour, discovering the eye’s internal contents had leaked. She, with assistance from another surgeon, completed the procedure, but Lockwood was left blind in her right eye.

Lawyers contend Dr. Khan’s collapse resulted from exhaustion caused by a demanding work schedule. The hospital and Dr. Khan dispute these allegations. Lockwood’s daughter, Julia Laine, says her mother’s life has been irreversibly affected. Medical staff also linked the outcome partly to Lockwood’s high blood pressure and the unique vulnerability of her eye. Moorfields Eye Hospital declined further comment, citing ongoing legal proceedings.

article_content: British Airways is rolling out 'Know Me,' an initiative designed to personalize service for frequent and high-profile passengers. This program enables BA staff to identify notable travelers by searching Google Images, striving to offer a familiar, restaurant-level recognition, according to Jo Boswell, head of customer analysis. Passenger details—such as seat assignments, travel history, and meal preferences—are compiled into a central database accessible on staff iPads during flights and in lounges. This system lets staff tailor their service, for example, by quickly identifying passengers affected by delays or addressing individuals personally using image searches. BA asserts that the program helps staff deliver more attentive and discreet service, like apologizing for past inconveniences or quietly reaching out to VIPs. BA spokesman Philip Allport explained that only prominent figures, such as business leaders or celebrities, are identified this way—a convenience many would value. On the other hand, privacy advocates, including Emma Carr from the group Big Brother Watch, criticize the measure as invasive and say that BA never explicitly requested passengers’ consent for image searches. This has sparked concern about how much passenger data airlines collect and share. Allport added that there have been no complaints about 'Know Me' over its 18-month trial, emphasizing that the airline is simply consolidating information it already collects on travelers for staff use.

Uppgifter om passagerare—som sittplats, resehistorik och matpreferenser—samlas i en central databas som personalen har tillgång till via iPads under flyg och i lounger. Systemet gör det möjligt att anpassa servicen, till exempel genom snabbt identifiera vilka resenärer som påverkas av förseningar och att tilltala dem personligen med hjälp av bildsökning. Enligt BA hjälper programmet personalen att ge mer uppmärksam och diskret service, som att be om ursäkt för tidigare problem eller att diskret kontakta VIP-passagerare. BA:s talesperson Philip Allport betonar att det bara är välkända personer, exempelvis företagsledare eller kändisar, som identifieras på detta sätt—en service många uppskattar. Samtidigt kritiserar integritetsförespråkare, bland annat Emma Carr från Big Brother Watch, programmet som påträngande och menar att BA inte uttryckligen inhämtat passagerarnas samtycke till bildsökning. Detta har väckt oro kring hur mycket information flygbolag samlar in och kan komma att dela. Allport tillägger att inga klagomål inkommit under de 18 månader som 'Know Me' testats, och betonar att flygbolaget endast samordnar redan befintlig information om resenärerna för personalens användning.

article_content: Lewis Hamilton's bid for a second Formula One world championship was given a late emotional boost by the unexpected arrival of his girlfriend Nicole Scherzinger, father Anthony, and brother Nicolas in Abu Dhabi. Before the race, Hamilton appeared downcast, but the presence of his loved ones, including Scherzinger – who performed in Zurich the previous night – seemed to lift his spirits ahead of the season finale. All were present in the paddock, just as they had been when Hamilton clinched his first championship at the 2008 Brazilian Grand Prix. After his victory, Scherzinger congratulated Hamilton, and both his brother Nicolas and Scherzinger embraced the Mercedes driver amid a swarm of cameras. Hamilton’s stepmother Linda joined in the celebrations, as did Anthony and Scherzinger, who were sprayed with champagne during the festivities. Scherzinger appeared amazed as her boyfriend secured the world title for a second time. Hamilton started the race behind pole-sitter Nico Rosberg but stormed to victory at Yas Marina Circuit, ultimately securing the championship after Rosberg was sidelined by engine trouble and did not finish in the points. ‘The energy from the crowd and seeing the flags means the world to me,’ Hamilton said. ‘I hope we can put on a good show for them. I will always race to win and do my best to get as far ahead as possible.’ Earlier in the week, Hamilton said he didn’t expect much family support in Abu Dhabi, aside from a few cousins in the stands, but was surprised and delighted by the arrival of his closest relatives. Meanwhile, Rosberg's wife Vivian and friends celebrated enthusiastically in the Mercedes garage after the German driver secured pole position the previous day.

Före loppet verkade Hamilton nedstämd, men närvaron av hans nära och kära, inklusive Scherzinger – som uppträdde i Zürich kvällen innan – verkade höja hans humör inför säsongsfinalen. Jag kommer alltid köra för att vinna och göra mitt bästa för att komma så långt fram som möjligt.” Tidigare i veckan sade Hamilton att han inte förväntade sig mycket familjestöd i Abu Dhabi, bortsett från ett par kusiner på läktaren, men blev glatt överraskad av sina närmaste släktingars ankomst. Samtidigt firade Rosbergs fru Vivian och vänner glatt i Mercedes-garaget efter att den tyske föraren tagit pole position dagen innan.

article_content: A study conducted by Carroll University in Wisconsin has found that cat owners scored higher on intelligence tests compared to dog owners. The age-old debate between cat and dog lovers over which animal makes the best companion has long persisted, but recent research indicates that cat owners may be smarter, regardless of their pet's intelligence. The study also revealed notable personality differences: cat owners are generally more sensitive and open-minded, while dog owners tend to be more energetic, outgoing, and obedient to rules. According to Professor Denise Guastello, who presented at the annual Association for Psychological Science meeting in Chicago, cat owners are more likely to be introverted and better at breaking rules. Professor Guastello suggests that these personality differences may be influenced by the environments pet owners are attracted to. She explains that people who prefer dogs are often more social and enjoy outdoor activities, which align with the needs of dogs. In contrast, more introverted individuals might prefer to stay in and read, activities that suit cat ownership. Data from Kickstarter shows that projects involving dogs attract more funding—$3.58 million compared to $2.21 million for cats—but cat-related projects have a higher success rate (44% versus 39%) and more backers per project. As of April this year, 735 dog-related and 459 cat-related projects had been launched. The survey, part of the study, included 600 students who identified their personality traits and preferences for cats or dogs. 60% considered themselves 'dog people,' which is about six times the number who identified as cat lovers. Around a third said they liked or disliked both animals equally. Professor Guastello believes individuals often select pets that reflect their own personality traits—energetic people are drawn to energetic dogs, for example. While the study is lighthearted, the research may help improve the effectiveness of pet therapy by better matching pets to their owners’ personalities.

After beginning the tournament with victories over the Netherlands and Sri Lanka, 1992 champions Pakistan have suffered losses to India, Australia, and Afghanistan. Every remaining match is now critical for their tournament survival. All-rounder Shadab Khan remains optimistic, saying, “We have not played well, but we have bounced back from difficult situations before. If you have belief, miracles can happen. Stand-in skipper Aiden Markram praised de Kock’s ability to assess pitch conditions and his importance to the team.

article_content: As global attention focuses on the Israel-Hamas conflict, international military training for Ukrainian troops continues to make a significant impact. In rural France, Ukrainian soldiers practiced assaulting enemy trenches and dugouts, confronting realistic battle scenarios staged with blanks and role-playing French 'opponents.' These exercises, though simulated, prepare the trainees for the harsh realities they will soon face on Ukraine’s front lines. As Russia’s invasion persists into its second winter and casualties rise into the hundreds of thousands, Western-backed training programs bolster Ukraine’s resilience and prospects. France aims to train around 7,000 Ukrainians this year in multiple locations as part of an EU mission that has surpassed its original goal, now targeting 35,000 personnel. The vast majority of EU nations and Norway have contributed training or instructors. The US has delivered training for over 18,000 Ukrainians, mostly in Germany, with more planned, while the UK has provided instruction to 30,000 troops in the past 17 months, marking its largest such initiative since World War II. Instruction covers a wide array of skills, from weapons handling and battlefield medical aid to advanced tasks like mine clearance, amphibious attacks, repair work, and leadership development. French trainers work to mentally toughen Ukrainian soldiers with realistic conditions, including exposure to animal remains and trench warfare, striving for both efficacy and emotional detachment, as the risks the trainees face upon return are high. Due to operational security and emotional challenges, trainers avoid forming close personal connections. 'You have to burn bridges, otherwise you question yourself about casualties,' explained Capt. Xavier. As the Ukraine conflict endures with no clear end in sight, allied support through training remains a crucial lifeline, reflecting a sustained commitment to Ukraine’s defense.

article_content: French innovator Stephane Rousson has developed a unique wind-powered maritime vehicle called the 'aerosail'. Rousson and his team aim to create an innovative, efficient, and silent vessel that relies entirely on wind for propulsion. By the end of October, he hopes to complete a crossing of the Mediterranean Sea, traveling from Nice to Calvi on the island of Corsica. Recently, Rousson conducted a test run in Roquebrune-Cap-Martin in southeastern France. The aerosail works by allowing the operator to pilot an airship connected via cable to a stabilized keel, known as the Seaglider. The cable functions as a mast while the airship acts as the sail. During his trials, Rousson was in good spirits as the aerosail, a large balloon connected to the Seaglider, took to the water. The Seaglider provides stability and can assist if the pilot encounters difficulties. In 2008, Rousson was forced to abandon an attempt to cross the English Channel in a pedal-powered airship due to strong winds. He is hoping for calmer conditions during his Mediterranean challenge. If the weather remains mild, the aerosail should be steerable by the pilot, ensuring a smoother journey.

I slutet av oktober hoppas han genomföra en färd över Medelhavet från Nice till Calvi på Korsika. Nyligen genomförde Rousson en testrunda i Roquebrune-Cap-Martin i sydöstra Frankrike. Aerosail fungerar genom att operatören styr ett luftskepp som via en kabel är kopplat till en stabiliserad köl, kallad Seaglider. Kabeln fungerar som en mast medan luftskeppet fungerar som segel. Under testerna var Rousson på gott humör när aerosailen, en stor ballong kopplad till Seaglider, sjösattes. Seaglider ger stabilitet och kan hjälpa till om piloten skulle hamna i svårigheter. Om vädret förblir milt bör aerosailen kunna styras av piloten, vilket gör färden smidigare.

article_content:
Apple’s App Store released its list of the most popular apps of 2014, spotlighting both free and paid titles for iPhone and iPad users. Facebook Messenger topped the free iPhone download charts, surpassing WhatsApp, Snapchat, Instagram, and Tinder. For the second year straight, Minecraft was the best-selling paid app on both iPhone and iPad, with Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, Cut The Rope 2, 7 Minute Workout, and Football Manager Handheld 2014 also making strong showings.

The trend of lucrative in-app purchases continued, with Clash of Clans leading earnings on iPad and Candy Crush Saga on iPhone. Kim Kardashian: Hollywood also ranked high, placing eighth in revenue.

On iPad, Skype and Facebook Messenger were the most downloaded free apps, and Netflix, YouTube, and Microsoft Word rounded out the top five—remarkably, Word reached the list despite launching as a free download in November. 

Apple’s editorial picks included Replay Video Editor as iPhone App of the Year (showcased at Apple’s October event), Threes! as iPhone Game of the Year, and Monument Valley—developed by British studio ustwo—as iPad Game of the Year. Pixelmator, originally a desktop app, made its debut on iPad and was named iPad App of the Year.

Industry experts like Jack Parsons emphasized the growing success of indie games and the ongoing financial strength of freemium titles such as Candy Crush and Clash of Clans. Overall, the 2014 App Store rankings show a dynamic mix of well-known names and innovative new apps, underlining changing tastes and habits among mobile users.

article_content: On a stormy night in January 1992, 29,000 plastic bath toys—yellow ducks, blue turtles, and green frogs—fell from a cargo ship into the Pacific Ocean and were lost at sea. Over the past 21 years, these durable toys have drifted across the globe, passing places like the site of the Titanic’s sinking, landing on shores in Japan, Alaska, Hawaii, and even spending years frozen in Arctic ice. The toys were originally packed in a 40-foot steel shipping container, but rough seas and large waves knocked them overboard, along with several other containers that immediately sank to the ocean floor. Some estimates suggest up to 10,000 shipping containers fall into the ocean each year. However, the World Shipping Council, which represents roughly 90% of the world’s container ship capacity, claims this number is exaggerated and estimates that an average of no more than 350 containers are lost annually. Severe weather, accidents, or improper stowage cause containers to be scattered on seafloors worldwide. While some may float or release their contents, most eventually sink, forming 'stepping stones' across the ocean. Oceanographer and beachcomber Curt Ebbesmeyer explains that containers are usually lost when ships roll side to side at angles greater than 55 degrees, resulting in violent episodes as containers collide and fall overboard. Approximately 90% of global cargo travels by sea, highlighting the scale and importance of container shipping. Drewry Shipping Consultants note that 183 million TEUs (20-foot equivalent units) move by sea each year, with about 6.7 million containers in transit at any given moment. Peter Glover, Master Mariner and Senior Associate at Norton Rose Fulbright, points out there is no global mandate requiring shipping companies to report lost containers—unless the loss constitutes a marine accident, poses navigational danger, or breaches pollution regulations. In June of this year, the five-year-old container ship MOL Comfort broke apart in heavy weather off Yemen. While no crew were harmed, all 7,000 containers, carrying items like electronics and clothing, were lost, resulting in insurance claims estimated between $300 and $400 million. Over time, unusual cargo has washed up around the world. For example, in 2006, thousands of sealed Doritos bags washed up on North Carolina’s Outer Banks, still dry and edible. In 1990, a storm washed 21 containers into the North Pacific, spilling 60,000 Nike shoes from Korea to the U.S., with hundreds later found along shores from Canada to Oregon. Notably, the drifting bath toys have greatly aided scientific research on ocean currents—sometimes called the planet’s 'engine.' For 21 years, Curt Ebbesmeyer has tracked reports of these toys, helping map the vast ocean conveyor belt. While only a small percentage of sightings are reported, the last noted find was a frog in August of this year. Ebbesmeyer estimates only a few hundred remain, subject to winds and currents. Beyond the bath toys, Ebbesmeyer tracks other cargo spills for research, such as 34,000 hockey gloves and 5 million Lego pieces lost 16 years ago. Reflecting on the mystery of the oceans, Ebbesmeyer remarks, 'It’s strange to live on a planet and not know what’s in 70% of it. You never know what might wash ashore.' Eoghan Macguire contributed to this article.

Leksakerna var ursprungligen packade i en 12 meter lång stålcontainer, men hårt väder och höga vågor slog dem överbord, tillsammans med flera andra containrar som genast sjönk till havsbotten. World Shipping Council, som representerar cirka 90% av världens containerfartygskapacitet, menar dock att detta antal är överdrivet och uppskattar att i genomsnitt inte mer än 350 containrar går förlorade per år. Kraftigt väder, olyckor eller felaktig lastning gör att containrar sprids ut över havsbottnarna världen över. Vissa kan flyta eller öppnas och släppa ut sitt innehåll, men de flesta sjunker så småningom och bildar 'stegstenar' över havet.
