Ungefär 90% av världens gods transporteras till sjöss, vilket visar på containertransportens omfattning och betydelse. Drewry Shipping Consultants noterar att 183 miljoner TEU (20-fots ekvivalenter) fraktas med båt varje år, med cirka 6,7 miljoner containrar i rörelse vid varje given tidpunkt. Peter Glover, sjökapten och Senior Associate på Norton Rose Fulbright, påpekar att det inte finns något globalt krav på att fartygsbolag måste rapportera förlorade containrar—om inte förlusten utgör en marin olycka, utgör fara för navigering eller bryter mot miljöregler. I juni i år bröts det fem år gamla containerfartyget MOL Comfort sönder i hårt väder utanför Jemens kust. Ingen besättningsmedlem skadades, men alla 7 000 containrar, med bland annat elektronik och kläder, gick förlorade. Försäkringskraven uppskattas till mellan 300 och 400 miljoner dollar. Genom åren har ovanlig last spolats upp på stränder runt om i världen. 2006 spolades exempelvis tusentals förseglade påsar Doritos upp på North Carolinas Outer Banks, fortfarande torra och ätbara. 1990 spolade en storm 21 containrar ut i norra Stilla havet, vilket ledde till att 60 000 Nike-skor på väg från Korea till USA hamnade i havet, och hundratals senare hittades på stränder från Kanada till Oregon. De drivande badleksakerna har varit särskilt värdefulla för forskningen om havsströmmar—ibland kallade planetens 'motor.' Under 21 år har Curt Ebbesmeyer spårat leksakernas rapporterade fynd och hjälpt kartlägga havens transportband. Även om endast en liten andel rapporteras, var det senaste fyndet en groda i augusti i år. Ebbesmeyer uppskattar att bara några hundra finns kvar, påverkade av vindar och strömmar. Förutom badleksakerna spårar Ebbesmeyer även andra containerspill för forskning, som 34 000 hockeyhandskar och 5 miljoner Lego-bitar som förlorades för 16 år sedan. När han reflekterar över havens mysterier säger Ebbesmeyer: 'Det är märkligt att leva på en planet och inte veta vad som finns i 70% av den. Man vet aldrig vad som kan flyta iland.' Eoghan Macguire bidrog till den här artikeln.

article_content: Bumble Inc. announced that its revenue forecast for the fourth quarter is below what analysts anticipated, a result of ongoing inflation and rising competition, which are impacting how much users are spending on its dating apps. Following the news, Bumble's stock dropped over 6% in after-hours trading. This guidance comes just after Bumble revealed that founder Whitney Wolfe Herd is stepping down as CEO, with ex-Slack executive Lidiane Jones set to replace her—marking the second major leadership change at the company in recent times. Competition has intensified with Match Group—owners of Tinder and Hinge—rolling out new features like weekly subscriptions and upgraded privacy controls. To drive higher user engagement, both Bumble and Match Group are exploring artificial intelligence-based features on their platforms. Bumble anticipates a $1 million decrease in fourth quarter revenue due to instability in the Middle East, reflecting ongoing industry challenges. In the third quarter, Bumble increased its total number of paying users (across Bumble, Badoo, and Fruitz) to 3.8 million, up from 3.3 million a year ago, while average revenue per paying user climbed to $23.42 compared to $22.96 last year. For the third quarter, Bumble reported revenue of $275.5 million—slightly under analyst forecasts—but beat earnings expectations with a profit of $0.12 per share versus the expected $0.07.

Efter beskedet sjönk Bumbles aktie med över 6% i efterhandeln. Denna prognos presenterades kort efter att Bumble sa att grundaren Whitney Wolfe Herd avgår som vd och ersätts av tidigare Slack-chefen Lidiane Jones—det andra stora ledarskiftet i företaget på senare tid. Konkurrensen har ökat i och med att Match Group, som äger Tinder och Hinge, lanserat nya funktioner som veckovisa abonnemang och förbättrade integritetsinställningar. För att öka användarengagemanget utforskar både Bumble och Match Group AI-drivna funktioner i sina appar. Bumble räknar med att intäkterna för fjärde kvartalet minskar med 1 miljon dollar på grund av instabiliteten i Mellanöstern, vilket visar på branschens utmaningar. Under tredje kvartalet ökade antalet betalande användare (på Bumble, Badoo och Fruitz) till 3,8 miljoner från 3,3 miljoner året innan. Genomsnittlig intäkt per betalande användare ökade till 23,42 dollar jämfört med 22,96 dollar förra året. För tredje kvartalet redovisade Bumble intäkter på 275,5 miljoner dollar—något under analytikernas prognoser—men slog vinstförväntningarna med ett resultat på 0,12 dollar per aktie mot förväntade 0,07 dollar.

article_content: Professional wildlife photographer Andy Rouse captured a playful family of lions during his visit to Kenya's Masai Mara. On the first day, two lion cubs appeared innocent and clean, their wide eyes and spotless coats making them the picture of cuteness. However, when Rouse returned the next day, the scene had changed—both cubs were completely covered in mud. Their mother quickly noticed their messy appearance and seemed to chastise them, springing forward to intercept one of her rambunctious offspring. Despite attempts to feign innocence or escape, the muddy cubs could not avoid their mother's disapproval. Mr. Rouse described the experience as a privilege, recalling how the cubs played with each other and their mother by pulling tails, jumping around, and generally causing havoc in harmless fun. He noted he wasn’t sure how the cubs had gotten so dirty overnight, but it was clear they had thoroughly enjoyed themselves.

Första dagen såg de två lejonungarna oskyldiga och rena ut, med stora ögon och fläckfri päls—verkligen söta. Men när Rouse kom tillbaka nästa dag hade allt förändrats—båda ungarna var täckta av lera från topp till tå. Mamman märkte snabbt deras smutsiga utseende och verkade tillrättavisa dem när hon rusade fram för att fånga en av sina busiga ungar. Trots försök att se oskyldiga ut eller smita undan kunde de leriga ungarna inte undgå mammans missnöje. Rouse beskrev upplevelsen som ett privilegium och berättade hur ungarna lekte med varandra och med mamman genom att dra i svansar, hoppa omkring och ställa till med allmän oreda av ren glädje. Han visste inte hur ungarna blivit så smutsiga under natten, men det var tydligt att de hade haft väldigt roligt.

U.S. Ambassador Caroline Kennedy officially presented her credentials to Japan's Emperor Akihito today, arriving at Tokyo’s Imperial Palace by horse-drawn carriage. The event attracted hundreds of onlookers who took photos and waved as Kennedy—daughter of the late President John F. Kennedy—greeted them from the carriage. In a rare move, Japan’s national broadcaster NHK aired Kennedy's arrival live, even showing aerial footage as her entourage entered the palace gates.

It is traditional for newly appointed ambassadors to meet the emperor to present their credentials. Kennedy’s procession included palace officials in European-style ceremonial attire and was led by a white horseman. As the first woman to serve as U.S. ambassador to Japan, her appointment marks a significant milestone.

Kennedy’s selection followed her active support of President Barack Obama’s re-election campaign. She has close ties to President Obama, having endorsed him during the pivotal 2008 Democratic primaries. Experts say her direct relationship with the president is a key asset for her new post.

Upon her arrival at Narita airport, Kennedy conveyed greetings from President Obama and emphasized her commitment to strengthening U.S.-Japan relations. She also acknowledged her father’s legacy, noting that President John F. Kennedy had hoped to be the first sitting U.S. president to visit Japan.

The U.S. and Japan maintain a strong alliance, but there are a number of ongoing issues, such as negotiations over the Trans-Pacific Partnership, the U.S. military presence in Okinawa, and updates to defense cooperation. Observers note that the personal relationship between President Obama and Prime Minister Shinzo Abe is less close than some would prefer, possibly due to policy differences.

After presenting her credentials, Kennedy expressed her honor in serving as ambassador and highlighted the importance of her role as a potential model for women in Japan, where women’s roles have historically been limited.

In Washington, State Department spokeswoman Jen Psaki praised the warm reception Kennedy received, attributing it to the strong partnership between the United States and Japan and expressing confidence in Kennedy’s ability to work closely with Japanese officials despite her lack of prior diplomatic experience. Ambassadorial experts categorize Kennedy as someone with direct presidential access, joining her predecessor John Roos and other notable appointees in this group.

Kennedy was accompanied to Japan by her husband, Edwin Schlossberg. She also met with Japan’s Vice Minister for Foreign Affairs, Akitaka Saiki, at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Tokyo.

article_content: The American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) has obtained thousands of U.S. military records highlighting grave concerns about detainee treatment and reporting multiple deaths labeled as 'unjustified homicides' at American-run prisons in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Guantanamo Bay. Released following a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit, these documents include autopsy reports and investigative findings covering 190 detainee deaths. While certain cases had previously been reported, the released files also reveal incidents that had not been publicized before. For instance, one investigation details a sergeant who killed a wounded detainee and then directed fellow soldiers to cover up the incident. The same file notes a corporal later shot the already deceased detainee. The ACLU also referenced a case involving a soldier who was tried but acquitted for killing an unarmed Afghan civilian. According to the ACLU, this trove of documents increases uncertainty rather than providing clarity, underscoring a continued lack of accountability for senior military officials implicated in detainee mistreatment. The group warned that failure to address these issues could result in further human rights abuses. The Department of Defense (DoD) strongly disputes accusations of systematic misconduct, emphasizing that all detainee deaths are reported and investigated promptly. Officials stated that numerous autopsies and inquiries reflect the department’s commitment to transparency and accountability. According to Army representatives, probable cause for murder was found in 13 cases, leading to 19 convictions, including lengthy prison terms. Military officials highlighted that the majority of detainee deaths involved factors other than direct actions by U.S. personnel—such as violence between prisoners, pre-existing health issues, battlefield injuries, or natural causes. The DoD notes that over 100,000 detainees have been in their custody, and asserts that stringent protocols are in place for oversight. Even so, the ACLU is alarmed by the finding that cardiac issues contributed to over 25% of the deaths, suggesting this may reflect on detention or interrogation practices. The organization is pursuing further investigation regarding these concerns. The document collection, submitted in response to a 2009 FOIA request, comprises 2,624 pages, including about 124 autopsy and 133 investigation reports related to detainee deaths.

Dessa dokument, som släpptes efter en stämning enligt Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), innehåller obduktionsrapporter och undersökningsresultat som rör 190 fångars död. Medan vissa fall tidigare har rapporterats innehåller de publicerade dokumenten också händelser som tidigare inte varit kända. Exempelvis beskriver en utredning hur en sergeant dödade en sårad fånge och sedan beordrade andra soldater att dölja händelsen. Samma rapport noterar att en korpral senare sköt den redan avlidne fången. ACLU hänvisade också till ett fall där en soldat ställdes inför rätta men friades för att ha dödat en obeväpnad afghansk civilperson. Enligt ACLU ökar denna mängd dokument osäkerheten snarare än att ge klarhet, och belyser en fortsatt avsaknad av ansvarstagande för högt uppsatta militärer som anklagas för misshandel av fångar. Organisationen varnar för att utan att ta itu med dessa frågor kan ytterligare människorrättsövergrepp inträffa. USA:s försvarsdepartement (DoD) avvisar bestämt anklagelser om systematiska övergrepp och understryker att alla dödsfall bland fångar rapporteras och utreds omedelbart. Tjänstemän påpekar att det stora antalet obduktioner och utredningar visar avdelningens åtagande för transparens och ansvar. Enligt arméns representanter fann man sannolika orsaker till mord i 13 fall, vilket ledde till 19 fällande domar, där vissa gav långa fängelsestraff. Militära tjänstemän poängterade att de flesta dödsfall bland fångar orsakades av andra faktorer än direkta handlingar från amerikansk personal—såsom våld mellan fångar, redan existerande hälsoproblem, stridsskador eller naturliga orsaker. DoD nämner att över 100 000 fångar har varit i deras vård och hävdar att strikta rutiner för översyn finns. Trots detta är ACLU oroad över att hjärtproblem låg bakom över 25% av dödsfallen, vilket kan tyda på problem med förvarings- eller förhörsmetoder. Organisationen undersöker nu detta vidare. Dokumentsamlingen, som mottogs efter en FOIA-begäran från 2009, omfattar 2 624 sidor och innehåller cirka 124 obduktionsrapporter och 133 utredningar kring fångars död.

article_content: As summer draws to a close, The Wylde Green pub in Sutton Coldfield, Birmingham, has jumped ahead to the festive season by putting up its Christmas tree 110 days before December. The pub has already served its first Christmas lunch, with around 40 customers enjoying a turkey dinner on August 26. Lisa Evans, the 39-year-old assistant manager, explained that the early decorations are meant to attract Christmas bookings. She said, 'We like to get it up early to show what we have planned and encourage as many bookings as possible.' Evans noted that the response has been good so far, with several reservations already made. Some locals have expressed surprise, saying it's too early, but Evans mentioned that all Hungry Horse pubs are encouraged to promote their Christmas offerings early, and many will follow soon. Alongside the decorations, the pub held a themed weekend featuring a visit from Santa and offering deals like two Christmas dinners for £10. Children pulled festive crackers, while guests enjoyed a taste of the holidays. The Wylde Green is owned by Greene King brewery. Its spokesman, Greg Gibbons, said, 'We are already 50 percent booked, so it serves as a reminder for customers. With only four paydays left until Christmas, it encourages people to plan ahead.' Supermarkets such as Morrisons in Wokingham, Berkshire, and Tesco across the nation have also started promoting Christmas products since late August. This early start has sparked discussion and some frustration on social media. Rod Lewis, a clergyman from the Black Country, criticized the commercialization of Christmas, saying, 'It seems to get earlier every year, shifting the emphasis from the birth of Christ to profit. The true meaning of Christmas is being lost.'

Lisa Evans, 39 år och biträdande chef, förklarade att de tidiga dekorationerna är till för att locka julbokningar. Hon sa: 'Vi vill sätta upp den tidigt för att visa vad vi har planerat och få så många bokningar som möjligt.' Evans noterade att responsen hittills har varit positiv och flera bokningar har redan gjorts. Några lokalbor har uttryckt sin förvåning över tidpunkten, men Evans nämnde att alla Hungry Horse-pubar uppmuntras att marknadsföra sina julpaket tidigt, och att många snart lär följa efter. Utöver dekorationerna höll puben en temavecka där tomten hälsade på och det fanns erbjudanden, som två julmiddagar för tio pund. Barnen drog julsmällkarameller, och gästerna fick en tidig julstämning. The Wylde Green ägs av bryggeriet Greene King. Deras talesperson Greg Gibbons sa: 'Vi är redan 50 procent bokade, så det fungerar som en påminnelse för kunderna. Med bara fyra löner kvar till jul kan det få folk att planera i god tid.' Stormarknader som Morrisons i Wokingham, Berkshire och Tesco över hela landet har också börjat lägga ut julvaror sedan slutet av augusti. Den tidiga starten har väckt diskussioner och viss frustration på sociala medier. Julens verkliga innebörd håller på att gå förlorad.'

article_content: For the first time, New Ways Ministry—a Maryland-based LGBT Catholic advocacy group—received VIP treatment during Pope Francis' weekly address in St. Peter’s Square, according to the group’s executive director, Francis DeBernardo. Although they remained classified simply as a lay Catholic group and did not get a private meeting with the pope, Vatican officials arranged for the 50-member group to sit on an elevated level, a recognition they had never experienced under previous papal visits. Their past pilgrimages to the Vatican, under Popes Benedict XVI and John Paul II, ended without acknowledgment.  DeBernardo called the gesture an 'incredible honor,' marking what he views as significant progress for the LGBT community within the Church, while also expressing hopes that the Catholic hierarchy will go further, especially regarding official support for same-sex marriage and adoption rights. He noted that despite some changes in tone since Francis' ascension to the papacy—such as the pope’s famous 'Who am I to judge?' remark—there have been no substantial modifications to the Church’s official stance on LGBT issues. Even so, DeBernardo said this limited recognition and the Pope’s openness have inspired hope and begun meaningful conversation.
translated_content: För första gången fick New Ways Ministry – en HBTQ-katolsk intresseorganisation baserad i Maryland – VIP-behandling under påve Franciskus veckovisa tal på Petersplatsen, enligt organisationens verkställande direktör, Francis DeBernardo. Trots att gruppen fortfarande klassificerades som en lekmannagrupp inom katolska kyrkan och inte fick något privat möte med påven, ordnade Vatikanens tjänstemän så att de 50 medlemmarna fick sitta på samma nivå som påven – en uppmärksamhet de aldrig fått vid tidigare besök. Under deras tidigare vallfärder till Vatikanen, under påve Benedikt XVI och Johannes Paulus II, blev de inte erkända alls.  DeBernardo kallade gesten en 'otrolig ära' och beskrev det som ett betydande framsteg för HBTQ-gemenskapen inom kyrkan, även om han hoppas att kyrkans ledare kommer att gå längre, särskilt angående officiellt stöd för samkönade äktenskap och adoptionsrättigheter. Han noterade att även om tonen har blivit mjukare sedan Franciskus blev påve – till exempel genom hans välkända kommentar 'Vem är jag att döma?' – så har det inte skett några större förändringar i kyrkans officiella hållning i HBTQ-frågor. Ändå menar DeBernardo att detta begränsade erkännande och påvens öppenhet har väckt hopp och startat en viktig diskussion.

article_content: Benoit Assou-Ekotto continues to earn £40,000 per week from Tottenham Hotspur, despite not playing for the first team for more than 18 months. The defender currently does not train with the main squad as he prepares for a potential move in the January transfer window. Tottenham manager Mauricio Pochettino excluded Assou-Ekotto from his first-team plans upon arriving at the club and prefers to keep him separate from the squad. The left-back, who spent last season on loan at Queens Park Rangers in the Championship, now follows a separate training program with his own fitness coach. Assou-Ekotto, who joined Tottenham from Lens in 2006 for a reported £3.5 million, has experienced a mixed career in English football and has had disagreements with several Spurs managers. His relationship with Tottenham chairman Daniel Levy has also been difficult, with the two rarely reaching consensus on club matters since Assou-Ekotto’s arrival. The Cameroon international, now 30, created further frustration at the end of the summer transfer window when he declined several loan offers from Championship clubs. He has also openly stated in interviews that he views football mainly as a job and is motivated by financial reasons. In a 2010 interview with The Guardian, he said: 'It’s only a job. Yes, it’s a good, good job and I don’t say that I hate football, but it’s not my passion. I don’t understand why everybody lies.' Assou-Ekotto explained that, like many players, he is driven by financial security, and questioned why this attitude is often criticized in football. He spent last season on loan at QPR and was a regular starter for Tottenham in previous years. He received a three-match ban after publicly supporting Nicolas Anelka’s controversial 'quenelle' gesture. Earlier this year, he drew criticism for inviting Dieudonne M’bala M’bala to a Tottenham match. Tottenham’s management has made it clear that Assou-Ekotto is free to leave should another club meet his wage requirements.

article_content: When Matthew Briggs, 32, from Huntington in North Yorkshire, saw a photo of himself and his father posted on Facebook, he was initially pleased. However, he was shocked by his appearance in the picture. Two years later, he has managed to lose an impressive 17 stone and, this November, will be running the New York marathon in memory of his mother, Susan, who passed away from multiple sclerosis when he was 18. Matthew says, 'In March 2000, my mother lost her battle with Multiple Sclerosis. She has always been my inspiration—I am the person I am today because of the woman she was.' Funds raised from Matthew's 26-mile run will be donated to the Multiple Sclerosis Society, a charity dedicated to fighting the disease and supporting those affected by it. Matthew, whose weight went from 31 stone to just under 14 stone, previously consumed a diet of ready meals, takeaways, and drank two liters of Coca-Cola daily. After seeing the photo and betting his father, Matthew joined his local Slimming World group and lost more than 17 stone over two years. Along with switching to three healthy meals a day, Matthew took up running to help him lose weight and developed a passion for the sport. He has already taken part in the London marathon and a local race, and now will compete in New York. He is paying for his own ticket and accommodation so that every penny raised goes directly to the Multiple Sclerosis Society. Speaking about his mother, he says, 'I inherited so many qualities from her. She used every ounce of strength and determination to fight her illness. I used the same strength and determination during my weight loss journey. If you'd told me on that first night that I would end up running marathons, I wouldn't have believed it—but here I am, getting ready for my third.' To sponsor Matthew's run, visit: justgiving.com/MattBriggsNYC2014/ Matthew's story highlights how unhealthy diets can lead to excessive weight gain, but with motivation and support, significant change is possible. Inspired by his mother's legacy, he is now running the New York marathon in her memory.

article_content: For the third year in a row, the University of Canberra in Australia's capital city hosted a petting zoo as part of its beloved 'stress less week' before final exams. Students had the chance to spend time with cute baby animals to help manage exam stress. According to campus life coordinator Dave McCarthy, this tradition has become increasingly popular, with each semester offering extras like a free breakfast, barbecues, and live acoustic music. The stress less week aims to help students as they prepare for exams, and McCarthy notes that more students join each year. 'Holding a kitten can lift your spirits, and students are always surprised and delighted to see animals like goats on campus,' he said. This semester featured kittens, lambs, puppies, chickens, rabbits, guinea pigs, a pig, and goats—though the mice weren’t as popular. Students such as Kollie Chan and Dragomir Mladenovic enjoyed cuddling the animals, with kittens especially drawing attention. One of the highlights was watching students try to take selfies with the goats. The animals visit twice a year, and their presence before finals is now a much-anticipated way for students to unwind and have fun.

article_content: Nineteen-year-old Bournemouth defender Baily Cargill is preparing for a memorable test as his team faces Liverpool in the Capital One Cup quarter-finals. Just a few years ago, Cargill was a devoted Southampton fan, cheering on stars like Rickie Lambert and Adam Lallana—he even celebrated their 2012 Premier League promotion on the pitch. Now, he could be lining up against those same players. Although he hasn't made a Championship appearance this season, Cargill has played every minute of Bournemouth's League Cup journey so far, helping deliver clean sheets against Exeter, Northampton, and Cardiff, before contributing to a win over West Bromwich Albion. His performances earned him a place in England's Under-20 squad, where he marked his debut with a goal. Cargill credits his character and improvement to time spent out on loan with Welling, where he faced tough, physical matches in non-league football. 'Those experiences played a huge part in my progress,' he reflected. 'Back then, facing Liverpool seemed impossible.' Currently, high-flying Bournemouth are unbeaten in twelve matches, while Liverpool, under pressure, seek a turnaround. Cargill, whose family are passionate Southampton supporters, is particularly thrilled by the opportunity to face former Saints heroes Lambert and Lallana. He also singles out manager Eddie Howe’s influence, saying that Howe’s background as a defender has been invaluable. This clash against Liverpool stands as both a personal dream and a professional milestone for Cargill.

article_content: Jigar Mistry, Co-founder of Buoyant Capital, discusses the changing ownership dynamics in Indian stocks. He notes that Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) hold about 42% of free float largecap stocks, while retail investors own nearly 49% in smallcaps. Largecap stocks have been relatively quiet recently, continuing a trend from prior weeks. Looking long-term, Mistry believes India's strong fundamentals will attract substantial investment inflows. However, he cautions that many retail investors joined post-Covid and have yet to see a market correction. He highlights that since March 2023, over 150 businesses with lower free float and smaller market caps have more than doubled in share price. Drawing parallels to 2018-19, he recalls that the introduction of long-term capital gains tax and new mutual fund rules triggered a significant correction in smallcaps, despite profit growth—resulting in a 38% fall for the BSE Smallcap Index and even larger declines for some companies. Buoyant Capital shifted its portfolio allocation from 60% small and midcap stocks in March 2023 to below 40% in October, using the rally as an opportunity to move into largecaps. Their approach remains flexible, with allocations adjusted as needed. The firm’s largest sector exposure is to banking and financials, with additional focus on insurance, cement, and pharmaceutical stocks where strong value is observed. Recent portfolio additions include ICICI General Insurance, RR Kabel, and Aavas Financiers. Discussing pharma, Mistry says the focus is on select stocks like Aurobindo, Alembic, and Zydus—believed to be well-positioned for a turnaround in US generic drug pricing. Key risks include the possibility of prolonged high US interest rates, normalization of surplus cash in the US, decreasing net FDI in India, and a need to ensure order backlogs turn into real earnings. Mistry stresses that true earnings growth is essential for stock price gains to be sustained. While there are selective opportunities by sector, overall market valuations and broader macro risks need close monitoring, especially in small and midcap stocks.

Largecap-aktier har varit relativt stillastående den senaste tiden, vilket fortsätter en trend som pågått i flera veckor. article_content: After days of mass demonstrations, Egypt's military removed Mohamed Morsy, the nation's first democratically elected president, marking the country's second revolution in two years. Morsy, an Islamist associated with the Muslim Brotherhood, rejected a military ultimatum to resolve the ongoing crisis within 48 hours, creating a standoff with Egypt's powerful armed forces. In a televised speech, General Abdel-Fattah El-Sisi stated that Morsy 'did not achieve the goals of the people' during his year in office. El-Sisi announced that Adly Mansour, head of the Supreme Constitutional Court, would serve as interim president, and Mansour was sworn in on Thursday. The military's roadmap includes suspending and rewriting the constitution adopted after Hosni Mubarak's ousting, and planning new parliamentary and presidential elections at an unspecified later date. Mansour stated at his inauguration that Egyptians had given him the authority 'to amend and correct' the outcomes of the 2011 revolution. Adly Mansour, aged 67, became head of Egypt's Supreme Constitutional Court only on Monday and was appointed interim president two days later. He served as vice president of the court since 1992 during Mubarak's nearly three-decade rule. According to CNN sources, Mansour may serve in an interim capacity for 9 to 12 months. The removal of Morsy provoked celebrations and fireworks in Tahrir Square, where hundreds of thousands had recently protested, demanding his resignation. Many were concerned about the Muslim Brotherhood's influence on lawmaking, high unemployment, rising crime, and living costs. Despite being elected with 52% of the vote in 2012, Morsy maintains significant support, with large pro-Morsy rallies in areas such as Nasr City. Supporters denounce the military's move as an illegitimate coup and insist that Morsy remains the rightful president. Nationwide clashes followed the military's actions, with reports of at least eight people killed and over 300 injured. Political violence had escalated in the days before Morsy's removal. Morsy was arrested by presidential guards and is reportedly under house arrest with no outside contact, according to Muslim Brotherhood spokesman Gehad El-Haddad. Large numbers of Muslim Brotherhood members have also been detained, including leaders Saad el-Katatni and Rashad Al-Bayoumi. State media reported that 300 Brotherhood members were being sought by police. In the crackdown, Al Jazeera's Cairo studio was raided during a live broadcast, with staff briefly detained after airing a statement from Morsy. While Morsy has called on his supporters to protest peacefully and seek dialogue, observers fear the military’s measures could provoke a violent backlash. Some analysts warn that mainstream Islamists may grow disillusioned, increasing the risk of radicalization. International reactions are mixed. U.S. President Barack Obama has expressed concern over the ouster of an elected leader and announced a review of aid to Egypt, but avoided labeling the event as a 'coup.' U.N. Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon called for a return to civilian rule and urged calm. In contrast, Saudi Arabia and the UAE welcomed the military’s actions. The characterization of the military's intervention remains debated, with some calling it a coup and others describing it as a necessary correction reflecting the will of millions of Egyptians. The issue is significant, as the classification affects international response. As analysts note, the military remains the central authority regardless of who is named interim president.

Avsättningen av Morsy ledde till firande och fyrverkerier på Tahrirtorget, där hundratusentals nyligen protesterat och krävt hans avgång. Många oroade sig över Muslimska brödraskapets inflytande på lagstiftningen, hög arbetslöshet, ökande brottslighet och levnadskostnader. Många medlemmar har också gripits, däribland ledarna Saad el-Katatni och Rashad Al-Bayoumi. Statliga medier rapporterade att polisen söker efter 300 brödraskapsmedlemmar. I samband med tillslagen rädades Al Jazeeras studio i Kairo under en direktsändning, och personalen frihetsberövades kort efter att de visat ett uttalande från Morsy. Även om Morsy har uppmanat sina anhängare till fredliga demonstrationer och dialog, befarar observatörer att militära åtgärder kan utlösa våldsamma motreaktioner. Vissa analytiker varnar för att moderata islamister kan bli desillusionerade, vilket ökar risken för radikalisering. Internationella reaktioner är blandade. USA:s president Barack Obama har uttryckt oro över att en folkvald ledare avsatts och har beordrat en översyn av biståndet till Egypten, men undvek att kalla händelsen för en 'kupp'. FN:s generalsekreterare Ban Ki-moon har uppmanat till återgång till civilt styre och bett om lugn. I kontrast har Saudiarabien och Förenade Arabemiraten välkomnat militärens agerande. Hur militärens ingripande ska definieras är omstritt, vissa kallar det en kupp medan andra beskriver det som en nödvändig korrigering i enlighet med många egyptiers vilja. Frågan är viktig då benämningen påverkar det internationella svaret. Analytiker poängterar att militären förblir den centrala makten oavsett vem som tillsätts som tillförordnad president.

article_content: Following recent increases in respiratory ailments in China, India's Union Health Ministry has taken precautionary actions to boost preparedness. The ministry has advised all Indian states and Union territories to urgently review and strengthen their public health systems and hospital readiness. This move relies on updated Covid-19 surveillance guidelines, aiming to reinforce medical infrastructure at both state and district levels. A key priority is the diligent monitoring of Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases. Surveillance teams are expected to closely observe these patterns. Recent updates indicate a notable rise in respiratory illnesses in China, especially among children. Experts point to well-known sources like influenza, Mycoplasma pneumonia, and SARS-CoV-2 as the main culprits. Indian officials have emphasized that while vigilance remains important, there is no immediate danger at this time. In response, China's health authorities are increasing the availability of fever clinics, given this is the country's first winter after lifting Covid-related restrictions. The World Health Organization (WHO) has requested supplementary data from China, after reports surfaced of clusters of undiagnosed pneumonia in young patients. According to WHO, however, no novel or unusual pathogens have been detected so far. These events have brought up renewed questions about reporting transparency, an issue that was also raised during the early days of the Covid-19 outbreak in 2019. Indian health authorities continue their close surveillance and have outlined precautionary steps to address any future risks.

article_content: Russia has halted both the import and use of Monsanto’s genetically modified corn after new research from a French university suggested connections to breast cancer and organ problems in rats. The study, which lasted the rats’ entire lives, also pointed to potential risks from the herbicide Roundup. In response, the European Food Safety Authority is conducting its own investigation into the research. Authorities in Russia, specifically the consumer protection agency Rospotrebnadzor, are seeking evaluations from both national and EU sources before making a final decision. The move could inspire other nations to reconsider GM crop approval. Traditionally, GMO safety studies funded by the biotech industry have observed animals for 90 days, but this French investigation took place over two years, finding elevated rates of cancer and organ damage. Both the GM corn, labeled NK603, and Roundup are Monsanto products. Many consumers in the UK and Europe remain skeptical toward GMOs, leading to their rare presence on grocery shelves, though they are still commonly used in animal feed. Monsanto stands by the safety of its corn, arguing that the French research does not provide grounds to change regulatory approval, as official reviews are still in progress. The scientific community is divided: While some researchers dispute the methodology and findings, others argue the study is one of the most extensive to date and merits repetition by independent labs. Academic experts like Professor Mustafa Djamgoz from Imperial College London consider the findings noteworthy, but call for further studies to confirm the risks. It is expected to take several years before scientists reach a conclusive verdict on the safety of these GM products.

Studien, som pågick under hela råttornas liv, pekade också på potentiella risker med ogräsmedlet Roundup. Som svar genomför Europeiska myndigheten för livsmedelssäkerhet en egen granskning av forskningen. Ryska myndigheter, särskilt konsumentskyddsorganet Rospotrebnadzor, söker nu utvärderingar från både nationella och EU-källor innan ett slutgiltigt beslut fattas. Akademiska experter som professor Mustafa Djamgoz vid Imperial College London menar att resultaten är intressanta men att fler studier krävs för att bekräfta riskerna. Liberty University, a prominent Christian higher education institution, has come under scrutiny for its handling of sexual assault reports. Multiple investigative reports have alleged that the university discouraged victims from coming forward and failed to accurately report incidents of sexual violence on campus. A USA Today article from October 3 outlines federal findings that students feared retaliation if they reported sexual assaults. A 2021 ProPublica report similarly described a pattern of the university dismissing and discouraging student reports of sexual misconduct. In April 2022, The Washington Post covered new legal claims asserting that Liberty University had mishandled a student's sexual assault report.

In recent developments, a leaked report from the U.S. Department of Education alleges that Liberty University systematically underreported campus crimes and failed to comply with federal safety regulations. The university’s current president, Dr. Dondi E. Costin, has criticized the leak, arguing that it may impact ongoing negotiations with the Department of Education and claiming that the report includes factual errors. Liberty University maintains that the report is inaccurate.

This controversy follows the resignation of Jerry Falwell Jr., who led the university for 13 years before stepping down amidst a personal sex scandal. According to public reports, Falwell Jr. and his wife, Becki, became involved in a long-term relationship with Giancarlo Granda, a 20-year-old pool attendant they met in 2012. Falwell Jr. later acknowledged his wife's involvement in an "improper relationship," while Granda stated that Falwell Jr. was aware of and sometimes participated in their encounters. Granda provided messages and recordings as evidence, as reported by Reuters.

article_content: Although most Americans today have no living memory of President John F. Kennedy, his assassination remains a powerful historical moment, commemorated each year since November 1963. Over six decades, new evidence about his death has not surfaced, yet speculation and conspiracy theories persist, often overshadowing Kennedy’s actual legacy from his final months as president. In the summer and fall of 1963, Kennedy called upon Americans to address what he termed a 'moral crisis'—the enduring presence of racial injustice in the United States. His actions and words during this period left a lasting impression on the nation, demonstrating the profound impact a president’s leadership can have during times of division. Despite landmark federal court decisions such as Brown v. Board of Education in 1954, racial segregation remained entrenched. Kennedy’s progress on civil rights had been limited, despite his campaign promises. However, mass protests led by civil rights activists, especially in Birmingham, Alabama, drew national attention after local authorities used brutal tactics—such as unleashing police dogs and fire hoses—against demonstrators, including children. Public outrage following these incidents did little to curb staunch segregationist resistance. In June 1963, Alabama Governor George Wallace infamously blocked African American students Vivian Malone and James Hood from enrolling at the University of Alabama, defying federal desegregation orders. Ultimately forced to step aside, Wallace continued to denounce what he viewed as 'federal interference.' On June 11, 1963, the same evening as the showdown in Alabama, President Kennedy delivered a historic televised address, explicitly condemning segregation as morally wrong. He reminded the nation, 'One hundred years of delay have passed since President Lincoln freed the slaves, yet their heirs...are not fully free.' Kennedy vowed to introduce sweeping civil rights legislation targeting the heart of Jim Crow. The response to Kennedy’s speech was immediate and deeply divided. While telegrams from citizens expressed both fervent support and anger—some offering heartfelt praise, others voicing open hostility—his words gave hope to many in the African American community. Myrlie Evers, wife of NAACP leader Medgar Evers, recalled being moved by the speech. Tragically, Medgar Evers was murdered by a Ku Klux Klansman hours later, highlighting the violence faced by civil rights leaders. In the weeks that followed, activists organized the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, pushing Congress to pass Kennedy’s proposed legislation. The president’s commitment triggered political challenges, threatening Democratic Party unity and his reelection prospects. To address divisions, Kennedy embarked on a multi-city tour in Texas that November, where he was warmly received. Kennedy’s assassination in Dallas ended his journey but intensified public debate and mourning. Letters flooded the White House, many expressing grief and introspection. Martin Luther King Jr. reflected that Kennedy had been killed by a 'morally inclement climate' of hatred and violence. Others echoed a sense of shared responsibility for failing to fully support Kennedy's vision. As we remember Kennedy, it is important to focus on his determination to advance civil rights despite resistance. His call for change inspired hope and helped lay the groundwork for the Civil Rights Act of 1964, passed under Lyndon Johnson. Though progress toward racial equality remains incomplete, Kennedy’s leadership at a pivotal moment is a legacy worth remembering. Sharron Wilkins Conrad is an associate professor of history at Tarrant County College and senior fellow at Southern Methodist University’s Center for Presidential History. Ellen Fitzpatrick is presidential chair and professor emerita at the University of New Hampshire. Both are accomplished historians and authors.

Under sex decennier har inga nya avgörande bevis om hans död kommit fram, men spekulationer och konspirationsteorier består, vilket ofta överskuggar Kennedys verkliga arv från hans sista månader som president. Under sommaren och hösten 1963 uppmanade Kennedy amerikanerna att ta itu med vad han kallade en ‘moralisk kris’ – den bestående rasorättvisan i USA. Hans handlingar och ord under denna period gjorde ett djupt intryck på nationen och visade vilken stor betydelse en presidents ledarskap kan ha under splittrade tider. Trots banbrytande federala domstolsbeslut som Brown v. Board of Education 1954 förblev rasåtskillnaden utbredd. Kennedys framsteg kring medborgerliga rättigheter hade varit begränsade trots vallöften. Men massprotester ledda av medborgarrättsaktivister, särskilt i Birmingham, Alabama, fick nationell uppmärksamhet efter att lokala myndigheter använde brutala metoder – som att släppa lös polishundar och använda brandslangar – mot demonstranter, inklusive barn. Den allmänna vreden efter dessa händelser gjorde lite för att minska det envisa motståndet från segregationister. I juni 1963 blockerade Alabamas guvernör George Wallace berömt de afroamerikanska studenterna Vivian Malone och James Hood från att registrera sig vid University of Alabama, i trots mot federala beslut om avskaffad segregering. Wallace tvingades till slut backa men fortsatte att kritisera vad han såg som ‘federal inblandning’. Den 11 juni 1963, samma kväll som konfrontationen i Alabama, höll president Kennedy ett historiskt tv-sänt tal där han uttryckligen fördömde segregation som moraliskt fel. Han påminde nationen: 'Ett hundra år av försening har passerat sedan president Lincoln befriade slavarna, men deras arvtagare... är ännu inte fullt fria.' Kennedy lovade att införa omfattande medborgarrättslagstiftning riktad mot raslagarna i södern. Reaktionen på Kennedys tal var omedelbar och starkt splittrad. Medan telegram från medborgare uttryckte både starkt stöd och ilska – vissa gav värmande beröm, andra uttalade öppen fientlighet – gav hans ord många i det afroamerikanska samhället hopp. Myrlie Evers, hustru till NAACP-ledaren Medgar Evers, berättade att hon blev djupt berörd av talet. Tragiskt nog mördades Medgar Evers av en medlem i Ku Klux Klan bara timmar senare, vilket visade det våld som medborgarrättsledare utsattes för. Under de följande veckorna organiserade aktivister Marschen mot Washington för jobb och frihet för att pressa kongressen att anta Kennedys lagförslag. Presidentens engagemang ledde till politiska utmaningar som hotade det demokratiska partiets enhet och hans chanser till omval. För att minska splittringen åkte Kennedy på en flerstadsturné i Texas i november där han togs emot med värme. Kennedys mord i Dallas avslutade hans resa men intensifierade den offentliga debatten och sorgen. Vita huset fylldes av brev, många uttryckte sorg och eftertanke. Martin Luther King Jr. reflekterade över att Kennedy blivit dödad av ett ‘moraliskt missgynnande klimat’ av hat och våld. Andra uttryckte en känsla av delat ansvar för att inte fullt ut ha stött Kennedys vision. När vi minns Kennedy är det viktigt att fokusera på hans beslutsamhet att driva medborgerliga rättigheter framåt trots motstånd. Hans krav på förändring inspirerade hopp och bidrog till att lägga grunden för Civil Rights Act från 1964 som antogs under Lyndon Johnson. Även om framstegen mot rasjämlikhet fortfarande är ofullständiga, är Kennedys ledarskap vid denna avgörande tid en arv som är värt att minnas. Sharron Wilkins Conrad är docent i historia vid Tarrant County College och senior fellow vid Southern Methodist University’s Center for Presidential History. Ellen Fitzpatrick är presidialt anknuten och professor emerita vid University of New Hampshire. Båda är framstående historiker och författare.

article_content: Inflation continues to influence the price of many products, and now the climate crisis is set to make things worse for some of the most popular beers — especially IPAs. A new study published in Nature by researchers at the Global Change Research Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences shows that rising temperatures in Europe are reducing hop production. This is significant for the beer industry because India Pale Ales (IPAs) and similar styles rely on aroma hops for their distinctive scents and bitterness. Beer producers are already dealing with increased costs for transportation, energy, labor, and other ingredients. With the drop in hop supply and growing demand due to the rise of microbreweries, the price of hops is expected to increase, which will likely lead to higher beer prices for consumers. One alternative for breweries is to use lower-quality hops, but the high-quality hops needed for IPAs to achieve their unique flavors and aromas are already more costly, making these beers typically more expensive than traditional styles. According to Untappd, a social platform for beer enthusiasts, the average 16-ounce draft of an American IPA costs $6.88, compared to $4.94 for a light beer. Using data since 1970, researchers examined changes in hop production in Germany, the Czech Republic, and Slovenia as temperatures have risen. These regions produce about 90% of the world's hops. Their models predict hop yields in these regions will decrease by 4 to 18% by 2050. This decline is partly due to hops ripening around 20 days earlier, causing harvest losses of up to 19.4%, depending on the region. The chemical makeup of hops is also being affected, with alpha acid content — responsible for bitterness — projected to fall by 20 to 31% by 2050. Aroma hops are typically grown in small areas with unique environmental conditions, making them more vulnerable to climate change than crops grown in more diverse regions. As climates shift, traditional hop-growing areas are becoming less suitable, though new regions may emerge. Some farmers have already adapted by moving crops to higher elevations, though suitable land may be limited or already in use. According to the study, compensating for lower yields and declining alpha acid levels would require expanding aroma hop-growing areas by 20%. Farmers are also responding with irrigation, changing planting methods, and switching to more resistant hop varieties. There is promising news from the US: hop production there is rising and extending beyond the Yakima Valley in Washington to other regions, including the East Coast. The study’s authors emphasize the need for urgent adaptation measures to stabilize the global hop market, noting that this will affect the economics and future prospects of European hop production. In summary: unless temperatures and droughts decrease and high-quality hops become more widely available, IPA prices are likely to keep rising in the near future.

En ny studie publicerad i Nature av forskare vid Global Change Research Institute vid Tjeckiens vetenskapsakademi visar att stigande temperaturer i Europa minskar humleproduktionen. Detta är betydelsefullt för ölindustrin eftersom India Pale Ale (IPA) och liknande stilar är beroende av aromhumle för sina unika smaker och bitterhet. Öltillverkare har redan att göra med ökade kostnader för transport, energi, arbetskraft och andra ingredienser. Med minskad humleutbud och ökad efterfrågan på grund av fler mikrobryggerier förväntas humlepriset öka, vilket sannolikt leder till högre ölpriser för konsumenterna. Ett alternativ för bryggerier är att använda humle av lägre kvalitet, men den högkvalitativa humle som krävs för att IPA ska få sina speciella smaker och aromer är redan dyrare, vilket gör dessa öl generellt dyrare än traditionella sorter. Enligt Untappd, en social plattform för ölentusiaster, kostar en genomsnittlig 16-ounce IPA $6,88 jämfört med $4,94 för en ljus lager. Med hjälp av data sedan 1970 har forskare undersökt förändringar i humleproduktionen i Tyskland, Tjeckien och Slovenien i takt med att temperaturen stigit. Dessa regioner står för cirka 90 % av världens humleproduktion. Deras modeller förutspår att humleskördarna i dessa områden kommer att minska med 4 till 18 % till år 2050. Minskningen beror delvis på att humlen mognar cirka 20 dagar tidigare, vilket kan minska skördarna med upp till 19,4 %, beroende på region. Humlens kemiska sammansättning påverkas också, där alfasyrahalten — som ger bitterheten — beräknas minska med 20 till 31 % till 2050. Aromhumle odlas oftast i små områden med speciella miljöförhållanden, vilket gör dem mer sårbara för klimatförändringar än grödor som odlas i mer varierande miljöer. När klimatet förändras blir traditionella odlingsområden för humle mindre lämpade, även om nya kan uppstå. Vissa odlare har redan anpassat sig genom att flytta odlingarna till högre höjder, även om lämplig mark kan vara begränsad eller redan använd. Studien visar att för att kompensera minskade skördar och alfasyrahalter behöver arealen för odling av aromhumle öka med 20 %. Odlare svarar också genom att installera bevattningssystem, ändra planteringsmetoder och byta till tåligare humlesorter. Det finns positiva nyheter från USA: humleproduktionen ökar och sprider sig utanför Yakima Valley i Washington till fler regioner, inklusive östkusten. Studieförfattarna betonar behovet av snabba anpassningsåtgärder för att stabilisera den globala humlemarknaden och påpekar att detta kommer att påverka ekonomin och framtiden för den europeiska humleproduktionen. Sammanfattningsvis: om inte temperaturer och torka minskar och högkvalitativ humle blir mer tillgänglig, kommer IPA-priser troligen fortsätta att stiga inom en överskådlig framtid.

article_content: On September 8, France’s highest administrative court upheld the government's ban on abayas in public schools, a measure first announced in August on the grounds of maintaining secularism in education. The following week, nearly 300 girls wore abayas to school, with about 67 sent home for refusing to change. This ban is the latest in a series of actions by the French government aimed at regulating religious attire in the name of laïcité (secularism). Previous measures include the 2004 ban on hijabs in state schools, the 2010 ban on full-face veils in public, and restrictions on burkinis in municipal pools since 2016. In November 2022, then-Education Minister Pap Ndiaye introduced a plan to discourage the wearing of clothing deemed 'religiously affiliated' in schools. The plan guides school staff to monitor students wearing long skirts and long-sleeved outfits and to take disciplinary action, including denying school entry, if students refuse to comply. Critics argue that these policies disproportionately target the Muslim minority, particularly women and girls, by focusing on attire without regard to actual religious significance. There are concerns that such measures increase marginalization and contribute to rising Islamophobia. According to the Collectif Contre l’Islamophobie en Europe (CCIE), reports of anti-Muslim incidents in France rose by over 30% in 2022 compared to the previous year. The majority of cases in the education sector involved female Muslim students facing discrimination or sanction. French authorities justify these policies as essential to upholding secular values and combating perceived separatism. However, many affected individuals and advocacy groups maintain that the restrictions undermine personal freedoms and perpetuate harmful stereotypes. Efforts by Muslim civil society organizations to challenge these policies continue, while Muslim women and girls face significant social pressure and discrimination yet persist in asserting their autonomy and right to choose their attire. The opinions expressed in this article reflect the author’s perspective and do not necessarily represent Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
translated_content: Den 8 september fastställde Frankrikes högsta förvaltningsdomstol regeringens förbud mot abayan i offentliga skolor, ett beslut som först annonserades i augusti med motiveringen att upprätthålla sekularism inom utbildningen. Följande vecka bar nästan 300 flickor abaya till skolan, varav cirka 67 skickades hem för att de vägrade byta om. Detta förbud är det senaste i en rad åtgärder från den franska regeringen för att reglera religiösa kläder i laïciténs (sekularismens) namn. Tidigare åtgärder inkluderar förbudet mot hijab i statliga skolor 2004, niqabförbudet 2010 och restriktionerna mot burkini i kommunala bad sedan 2016. I november 2022 introducerade dåvarande utbildningsministern Pap Ndiaye en plan för att motverka användningen av kläder som anses vara 'religiöst förknippade' i skolor. Planen instruerar skolpersonal att övervaka elever med långa kjolar och långärmade plagg samt att vidta disciplinära åtgärder, inklusive att neka tillträde till skolan, om eleverna vägrar att följa reglerna. Kritiker menar att dessa policys oproportionerligt riktar in sig på den muslimska minoriteten, särskilt kvinnor och flickor, genom att fokusera på klädsel utan att ta hänsyn till faktisk religiös innebörd. Det finns oro för att sådana åtgärder ökar marginaliseringen och bidrar till växande islamofobi. Enligt Collectif Contre l’Islamophobie en Europe (CCIE) ökade rapporterade islamofobiska incidenter i Frankrike med över 30 % år 2022 jämfört med året innan. De flesta fall inom utbildningssektorn gällde muslimska flickor som utsatts för diskriminering eller sanktioner. Många berörda individer och aktivistgrupper menar dock att restriktionerna undergräver personliga friheter och förstärker skadliga stereotyper. article_content: Following the end of the U.S. Open of Surfing in Huntington Beach, California, on Sunday evening, a fight among the departing crowd escalated into a riot. The once-celebratory atmosphere of the multi-day surfing and skateboarding competition shifted as groups began vandalizing city vehicles, toppling portable toilets, and damaging street fixtures along the palm-lined roads. Police intervened, using pepper-spray pellets to disperse the crowds and detaining at least eight individuals who reportedly did not comply with dispersal orders. The Huntington Beach Police Department reported that there were no injuries, though various types of public property suffered damage. Bystanders and participants were caught in the chaos; some sought refuge in local stores, while others documented the event on their phones. Video footage depicted people overturning toilets and fighting in the streets as a large crowd looked on. The situation was contained by 9 p.m., according to authorities. Police asked for public help in gathering more evidence by submitting photos or videos. Meanwhile, U.S. Open of Surfing organizers expressed regret and sadness over the disturbances that occurred after the event’s conclusion.

Polisen ingrep, använde pepparsprejspellets för att skingra folkmassorna och grep minst åtta personer som inte följde order om att lämna området. Huntington Beach-polisen rapporterade att ingen ska ha skadats, men att olika typer av offentlig egendom skadades. Åskådare och deltagare fångades upp i kaoset; vissa sökte skydd i närliggande affärer, medan andra filmade händelsen med sina mobiler. Filmmaterial visade hur personer välte toaletter och slogs på gatorna medan många i publiken såg på. Enligt myndigheterna var situationen under kontroll vid 21-tiden. Polisen uppmanade allmänheten att bidra till utredningen med foton eller videor. Samtidigt uttryckte arrangörerna av U.S. Open of Surfing stor besvikelse och sorg över de oroligheter som skedde efter evenemangets slut.

article_content: The Mumbai Film Festival has announced a line-up of 250 films, featuring the inaugural South Asia Competition with 14 selected titles. This addition is part of the festival's expanded vision to become a hub for films from South Asia and the South Asian diaspora. Supported by Reliance Jio, the festival returns as an in-person event and will be based at the Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre (NMACC) in Mumbai, with screenings across eight venues and 20 screens. Organized by the Mumbai Academy of Moving Image (MAMI), the 10-day festival opens with a red carpet event at NMACC on October 27 and runs until November 5, with the awards ceremony on November 3. The South Asia Competition features debut and sophomore filmmakers from India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal, and diaspora filmmakers from the UK and Germany. Selected films include Kanu Behl’s 'Agra', a co-production between India and France that premiered at Cannes, Bhutan’s 'The Monk And The Gun', and the Nepal-Sri Lanka co-production 'The Red Suitcase'. Beyond the competition, the festival includes 22 features and 24 non-features in the Focus South Asia section, and eight titles in the Icons: South Asia section, such as 'Paradise' by Prasanna Vithanage (Sri Lanka), and 'Something Like An Autobiography' from Mostofa Sarwar Farooki (Bangladesh). The Gala Premier South Asia section will present films such as Anurag Kashyap’s 'Kennedy', Tahira Kashyap’s 'Sharmajee Ki Beti', and Rajat Kapoor’s 'Everybody Loves Sohrab Handa'. Deepti Dcunha, Artistic Director, stated: “We are proud to have curated such a diverse range in our South Asia section in the first year of expanding our vision to focus on new cinematic voices from South Asia and its diaspora. This extends beyond film screenings to facilitate idea exchanges, collaborations, and business opportunities while bringing global cinema to Mumbai.” The festival will feature 40 world premieres, 45 Asia premieres, and over 70 South Asia premieres. The World Cinema section will showcase more than 90 films from over 35 countries, including highlights like Cannes Palme d'Or winner 'Anatomy Of A Fall', Bradley Cooper's 'Maestro', and Madeleine Gavin’s 'Beyond Utopia', which won the Audience Award at Sundance. Anu Rangachar, Head of International Programming, mentioned: “We have curated some of the most thoughtful international titles for our audience. Apart from buzzworthy films, several entries are their countries' official submissions to the Academy Awards. Some hidden gems that might not be released in India otherwise will also be available to watch.” Festival Director Anupama Chopra said: “With each edition, we aim to create greater impact for filmmakers and audiences. Our commitment to cinema stands at the heart of the festival, and we aspire to be a melting pot of global talent while creating more opportunities for South Asian films and filmmakers.” Co-Director Maitreyee Dasgupta added: “We look forward to hosting a 10-day festival offering a platform for both established and emerging filmmakers, encouraging co-creation and business opportunities. Through various programs, the festival fosters empowerment, inclusivity, and celebrates the impact of cinema.” Other categories include Marathi Talkies (Marathi cinema), Dimensions Mumbai and Royal Stag Barrel Select Large Short Films competition (short films), After Dark (curated by Jongsuk Thomas Nam), Restored Classics, MAMI Tribute, Retrospective, and Recap (featuring selections from 2020-2022 when the festival was online). Jio MAMI will also feature an Industry Programme with screenings, networking, labs, workshops, and masterclasses. Anupama Bose, who oversees the Year Round Programme, is organizing a ‘Trade Talk’ section focused on film distribution. Notable entries in the South Asia Competition include 'Against The Tide' (India), 'Agra' (India, France), 'Bahadur The Brave' (India), 'Barir Naam Shahana' (Bangladesh, UK), 'Dilli Dark' (India), 'Guras' (India), 'Which Colour?' (India), 'Mithya' (India), 'Rapture' (India, China, Netherlands, Qatar, Switzerland), 'Shivamma' (India), 'A Match' (India), 'The Sentence' (India), 'The Monk And The Gun' (Bhutan, France, US, Taiwan), and 'The Red Suitcase' (Nepal, Sri Lanka).

article_content: Argentina’s President Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner is taking a medical leave to have surgery for thyroid cancer. The operation will be done at Austral Hospital, located about 60 kilometers from Buenos Aires, according to reports from the state news agency Telam. During her recovery, Vice President Amado Boudou will assume her presidential duties until January 24. Supporters held a vigil outside the hospital before her surgery, decorating the area with banners and flags to show their support. One sign, quoted by Telam, read, 'There is nothing healthier than the love between people and their president.' Recent tests revealed that Fernandez has papillary carcinoma, a frequently diagnosed and treatable form of thyroid cancer. Her spokesman, Alfredo Scoccimarro, confirmed that the illness remains confined to her thyroid gland. Fernandez, aged 58, was recently re-elected for another four-year term after winning more than 54% of the vote. In office since 2007, she succeeded her late husband Nestor Kirchner, who led the country from 2003 to 2007. Under her leadership, Argentina’s economy has consistently grown by about 8% each year. According to the U.S. National Library of Medicine, papillary carcinoma is the most common kind of thyroid cancer and has an excellent prognosis, with over 95% of adult patients surviving at least 10 years. Treatment usually involves surgery and medication, and sometimes radioactive iodine. Possible risks from the operation include damage to the nerve controlling the vocal cords or accidental removal of the gland that helps manage calcium levels in the blood. Several current and former South American presidents have also faced cancer diagnoses. Paraguayan President Fernando Lugo was treated for non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, Venezuelan President Hugo Chavez underwent chemotherapy for an unspecified cancer, and Brazil’s current and former presidents, Dilma Rousseff and Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, have both received cancer treatment.

article_content: A loyal dog who survived more than 10 weeks beside her owner, who died of hypothermia while hiking in the Colorado mountains, has regained most of the weight she lost and is back on the trails, according to the family. Rich Moore, 71, of Pagosa Springs, Colorado, set out with his Jack Russell terrier, Finney, to climb Blackhead Peak on August 19, but did not return home. Searchers spent several days looking between the peak and his vehicle, but were unsuccessful. A hunter later discovered Moore’s body and a very protective Finney in the San Juan Mountains of southwestern Colorado on October 30. Officials reported Finney had lost about half her body weight, her ribs visibly showing. Less than three weeks later, 'Finney is doing well,' Moore's wife, Dana Holby, said Thursday. 'She has gained almost all of her weight back and her strength is almost where it was. She is the miracle dog.' Holby added Finney has an injury on her snout that may leave a scar. 'She is now 3, quite clingy and will not let me out of her sight,' Holby said. 'Her appetite was ravenous at first, but now it has calmed down.' Finney’s story of survival has made her a local celebrity on the trails around Pagosa Springs, said Holby. 'People ask, “Is that Finney?” and I say, “Yes!”' Holby described Finney as a source of comfort and a great hiking companion, covering 4 to 5 miles (6.5 to 8 kilometers) a day. 'I know she was with Rich to the very end, and somehow that brings comfort. I don’t know how she managed, but she was there when he needed her,' Holby said.

Rich Moore, 71 år, från Pagosa Springs, Colorado, gav sig ut med sin Jack Russell-terrier, Finney, för att bestiga Blackhead Peak den 19 augusti, men kom aldrig hem igen. Sökandet pågick i flera dagar mellan toppen och hans bil, men var utan framgång. En jägare hittade senare Moores kropp och en mycket beskyddande Finney i San Juan-bergen i sydvästra Colorado den 30 oktober. Tjänstemän rapporterade att Finney hade tappat ungefär hälften av sin kroppsvikt och hennes revben syntes tydligt. Mindre än tre veckor senare sa Moores fru, Dana Holby, på torsdagen: 'Finney mår bra. Hon har återfått nästan all sin vikt och hennes styrka är nästan tillbaka där den var. Hon är mirakelhunden.' Holby tillade att Finney har en skada på nosen som kanske lämnar ett ärr. 'Hon är nu tre år, väldigt klängig och låter mig inte ur sikte', sa Holby. 'Hennes aptit var glupsk i början, men har nu lugnat ner sig.' Finneys överlevnadshistoria har gjort henne till en lokal kändis på lederna runt Pagosa Springs, berättar Holby. article_content: A rare annular ('ring of fire') solar eclipse will occur on Saturday, October 14, 2023, offering a spectacular astronomical event visible across parts of the United States and beyond. This phenomenon occurs when the new moon is at a more distant point in its orbit, appearing smaller and covering about 90% of the sun, leaving a bright ring visible along a narrow path. The eclipse path crosses nine U.S. states: Oregon, California, Idaho, Nevada, Utah, Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico, and Texas, directly affecting approximately 6.5 million people, with another 68 million living within 200 miles of the path. Following its route through the United States, the 'ring of fire' will also be visible in Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula, Belize, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama, Colombia, and Brazil. A partial eclipse will be visible to the rest of the U.S. and nearby countries. Safety is crucial: Special solar eclipse glasses must be worn at all times during any phase of the eclipse to prevent serious eye damage, and any photographic equipment should have solar filters in place. Iconic national parks such as Crater Lake, Bryce Canyon, Glen Canyon, Capitol Reef, Chaco Canyon, Mesa Verde, Monument Valley, and Lost Maples State Natural Area will lie in the eclipse’s path, making for memorable viewing backdrops. Many of these parks have promoted eclipse-viewing opportunities. Popular cities in the path include San Antonio in Texas, Albuquerque in New Mexico, and Eugene in Oregon. The Albuquerque Balloon Fiesta, which draws around 100,000 visitors, will coincide with the eclipse this year. NASA will be present to broadcast the event on NASA TV and distribute approximately 80,000 eclipse viewing glasses. Notable observing events include the Ring of Fire Eclipse Festival in Ely, Nevada (October 11-16), organized gatherings at Goosenecks State Park in Utah, and Mission San José in San Antonio, Texas. Travelers to remote locations should be prepared, as facilities may be limited. Essentials like fuel, food, water, cash, and other supplies should be brought along. The last annular solar eclipse occurred in Canada on June 10, 2021, and the next is expected on October 2, 2024, in South America and Easter Island. For more information, visit WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com or refer to 'The Complete Guide To The Great North American Eclipse of April 8, 2024.' Clear skies and happy viewing are wished to all eclipse-watchers.

Bemärkta observationsevenemang inkluderar Ring of Fire Eclipse Festival i Ely, Nevada (11–16 oktober), organiserade samlingar vid Goosenecks State Park i Utah och Mission San José i San Antonio, Texas. Den senaste ringformiga solförmörkelsen inträffade i Kanada den 10 juni 2021, och nästa förväntas den 2 oktober 2024 i Sydamerika och på Påskön. För mer information, besök WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com eller se ”The Complete Guide To The Great North American Eclipse of April 8, 2024.” Klart väder och trevlig observation önskas alla solförmörkelseentusiaster!

article_content: Britain’s contributions to the European Union budget are set to increase by nearly £500 million this year. The EU has agreed to raise its total budget by £3.8 billion, bringing the annual figure to £110 billion. As a result, the UK’s annual contribution will rise to £12 billion, or £11.6 billion after a rebate, with an additional payment of £420 million. The proposed budget changes will be discussed by ambassadors later today and are scheduled for a vote in the European Parliament later this month. The £420 million payment is in addition to the approximately £11.6 billion that former Prime Minister David Cameron agreed to pay for 2014. This sum is separate from a £700 million surcharge, which former Chancellor George Osborne accepted last month after the UK’s economy outperformed other European countries. Downing Street has stated that the EU’s next seven-year budget, which begins this year, will be smaller in real terms than the previous period’s budget. Pawel Swidlicki of Open Europe remarked that the latest increase demonstrates the need for reforms in how the EU allocates taxpayer funds, suggesting cuts to outdated farm subsidies and greater control for wealthy countries like the UK over regional development funds could save billions. EU Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker has agreed to the budget increase. However, campaign group Business for Britain has warned that this hike may be the beginning of further increases, with chief executive Matthew Elliot commenting that such rises are frequent and unwelcome for the UK, especially as contributions reach record highs.

EU har beslutat att höja sin totala budget med 3,8 miljarder pund, vilket innebär att den årliga siffran blir 110 miljarder pund. Som en följd stiger Storbritanniens årliga bidrag till 12 miljarder pund, eller 11,6 miljarder pund efter rabatt, plus en extra betalning på 420 miljoner pund. De föreslagna budgetändringarna ska diskuteras av ambassadörer senare idag och är planerade att röstas om i Europaparlamentet senare denna månad. Betalningen på 420 miljoner pund är utöver de cirka 11,6 miljarder pund som tidigare premiärminister David Cameron gick med på att betala för 2014. Denna summa är separat från en extra avgift på 700 miljoner pund, som före detta finansministern George Osborne accepterade förra månaden efter att Storbritanniens ekonomi presterat bättre än andra europeiska länder. Downing Street har uppgett att EU:s nästa sjuårsbudget, som börjar i år, kommer att vara mindre i reala termer än den föregående perioden. Pawel Swidlicki från Open Europe menar att den senaste ökningen visar behovet av reformer i hur EU fördelar skattebetalares pengar och föreslår att nedskärningar av föråldrade jordbruksstöd och ökad kontroll för rika länder som Storbritannien över regionala utvecklingsfonder kan spara miljarder. EU-kommissionens ordförande Jean-Claude Juncker har godkänt budgetökningen. Samtidigt har kampanjgruppen Business for Britain varnat för att denna höjning kan vara början på fler ökningar. Vd:n Matthew Elliot menar att sådana höjningar är vanliga och inte välkomnas i Storbritannien, särskilt när bidragen redan är rekordhöga.

article_content: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Saturday emphasized the need to restore people-centric governance across India, stating that the BRS government in Telangana is 'incapable' of addressing people's needs. He shared a video on his YouTube channel from a recent visit to the family of a Telangana farmer who committed suicide in 2020. In his post with the video, Gandhi highlighted Congress' guarantees for Telangana, saying they are intended to ensure a minimum standard of living. He quoted Mahatma Gandhi, saying, 'the most important voice is the one last in the line,' referencing Kummari Chandrayya, a small farmer from Telangana, who died by suicide due to debt. Gandhi said that the 'Dorala' BRS government failed him and his family. Gandhi claimed that timely government support could have prevented Chandrayya's suicide and asserted that both BRS and BJP governments have failed the people of Telangana. He reiterated Congress' welfare promises: 'Would a Congress government make a difference? Absolutely, yes!' Gandhi described Congress' guarantees as a reflection of the aspirations of those who feel neglected. Congress pledges in Telangana include the Mahalakshmi scheme (Rs 2,500 per month for women), free bus travel, gas cylinders at Rs 500, Rythu Bharosa (Rs 15,000 per year to farmers), and Rs 12,000 per year to agricultural laborers. Gandhi said, 'Our fight now is to ensure justice for all our people. It is time to bring back people-centric governance across India.' In the video, Gandhi is seen listening to the family's difficulties and instructing a local Congress leader to organize soil testing for their land and transfer ownership to the widow. The Congress party is aiming to unseat Chief Minister K Chandrashekhar Rao's Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) government in the upcoming Telangana election. Separately, India’s industrial growth slowed to 5.8% in September, down from 10.3% in August, mainly due to high base effects and heavy rainfall affecting production. Ranjan Pai, chairman of Manipal Education and Medical Group, has invested Rs 1,400 crore (about $168 million) in Aakash Institute, a Byju’s subsidiary. Manufacturing companies are hiring more graduates from the class of 2024 who are skilled in digital technology, according to JSW Group's HR chief, Dilip Pattanayak.

article_content: In 1830s London, the Royal Academy exhibition was a premier social and artistic event, drawing society's elite, artists, critics, and wealthy collectors. For artists, exhibiting at the Academy could define or derail their careers. More than a thousand works were displayed each year, closely hung from floor to ceiling, with the Hanging Committee wielding significant influence over an artist's fortunes. In 1833, John Constable’s 'The Opening of Waterloo Bridge' was hung opposite J.M.W. Turner’s 'Helvoetsluys.' Prime placement could lead to prestigious commissions, while poor positioning risked obscurity. The competition was intense, with last-minute adjustments on exhibition days fraught with tension. The rivalry between Constable and Turner, leading British landscape painters, became famous that year. Turner, eager to stand out, visited the gallery several times and ultimately added a vivid red mark to his painting, later transforming it into a buoy. Constable interpreted this as a bold, perhaps provocative gesture. Critics were unkind to Constable, some unfavorably comparing him to Turner. Turner, from Covent Garden and the son of a barber, was dedicated and solitary, uninterested in societal approval, and maintained a close relationship with his father. Timothy Spall’s award-winning portrayal of Turner highlights these traits. Constable, born in rural Suffolk to a prosperous miller, was deeply attached to his family, especially his wife Maria Bicknell. He took inspiration from the countryside and started showcasing his work later in life than Turner but achieved notable success. Artistically, Turner favored dramatic scenes of storms and industrial transformation, using expressive color and technique. Constable’s work captured light, weather, and the everyday landscape, evoking nostalgia and gentle beauty. Their rivalry was marked by competition and personal slights, emblematic of the charged atmosphere within the Royal Academy. Today, their legacies live on in major exhibitions at Tate Britain and the Victoria & Albert Museum, fueling the ongoing debate about their impact. Turner’s turbulent energy and Constable’s romantic vision both transformed landscape painting, leaving a lasting imprint on the art world.
