Fler än tusen verk visades varje år, tätt hängda från golv till tak, och Hanging Committee hade stor makt över konstnärernas öden. År 1833 hängdes John Constables 'The Opening of Waterloo Bridge' mittemot J.M.W. Turners 'Helvoetsluys.' En bra placering kunde leda till prestigefyllda uppdrag, medan en dålig placering riskerade att man hamnade i skymundan. Konkurrensen var hård, och de sista dagarna för att justera verken inför öppningen var laddade. Rivaliteten mellan Constable och Turner, två ledande brittiska landskapsmålare, kulminerade det året. Turner, ivrig att sticka ut, besökte galleriet flera gånger och lade till ett iögonfallande rött märke på sitt verk, som han senare gjorde om till en boj. Constable såg detta som ett djärvt – kanske utmanande – drag. Kritikerna var hårda mot Constable, och några jämförde honom ogynnsamt med Turner. Turner, från Covent Garden och son till en barberare, var hängiven och ensam, ointresserad av andras åsikter, och hade en nära relation till sin far. Timothy Spalls prisbelönta tolkning av Turner fångar dessa drag. Constable, född i lantliga Suffolk där hans pappa var mjölnare, var starkt knuten till sin familj och särskilt till hustrun Maria Bicknell. Han hämtade inspiration från landsbygden och började ställa ut först sent i livet, men nådde stor framgång. Konstnärligt föredrog Turner dramatiska scener av stormar och industrialisering, med uttrycksfull färg och teknik. Constable fokuserade på ljus, väder och vardagens landskap, och skapade en känsla av nostalgi och skönhet. Deras rivalitet präglades av tävlan och personliga pikar – typiskt för den laddade stämningen på Royal Academy. Idag lever deras arv vidare genom stora utställningar på Tate Britain och Victoria & Albert Museum, som fortfarande väcker debatt om deras påverkan. Turners vilda energi och Constables romantiska vision förändrade båda landskapsmåleriet och satte varaktiga spår i konstvärlden.

The Congress party has pledged to enhance Rajasthan’s Chiranjeevi Health Insurance Scheme if re-elected in the upcoming state election. The proposed improvements include raising the insurance coverage limit from Rs 25 lakh to Rs 50 lakh and adding In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) treatment to the scheme. This move acknowledges the emotional and social challenges faced by couples dealing with infertility.

Currently, the Chiranjeevi Health Insurance Scheme provides residents with free treatment for serious health conditions, such as cancer, heart disease, and organ transplants. Congress leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Jairam Ramesh, have publicly praised the initiative, describing it as a model for the nation. Ramesh’s social media remarks emphasized how the scheme serves as a vital safety net, especially for poor and middle-class families.

State Assembly elections in Rajasthan are scheduled for November 25, with Congress showcasing its healthcare achievements as a key campaign issue.

article_content: Meta’s Quest 3 VR headset comes in two storage sizes: 128GB and 512GB. Both share identical hardware, featuring 8GB RAM and the latest display technology, but neither model offers expandable storage—what you buy is what you get. The 128GB version suits most people, especially newcomers or those with modest VR needs. Meta’s cloud save lets you delete and reinstall games without losing your progress, though you'll have about 100GB of actual free space after accounting for system files. If you expect to collect many games or already have a big Quest library, the 512GB Quest 3 might serve you better. With several games now exceeding 9GB and more on the way, this model helps prevent constant uninstalling and reinstalling. The higher storage version also provides six months of Meta Quest Plus, letting you add 12 free games to your collection, and offers Asgard’s Wrath 2 at no extra cost. The extra space comes at a $150 premium. Data on recent Quest games show average sizes of 2–3GB, but top titles are often larger and get bigger with updates. The 128GB headset can typically hold a few dozen games before you need to make tough choices, while the 512GB version is ideal for VR enthusiasts or anyone installing custom apps or movie files. Meta encourages developers to keep game sizes in check to accommodate all users. Still, if you prefer convenience or want to guard against growing file sizes, the 512GB model is the smart, future-proof choice. Ultimately, if you're a new or casual VR user who doesn't mind managing your games, the 128GB model will likely suffice. But for dedicated gamers or those who hate running out of space, the 512GB Quest 3—despite its higher price—is a worthwhile upgrade.

article_content: The idea of a spot bitcoin Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) has been a major focus among bitcoin and investment communities. Although the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has not yet approved such a fund, understanding the SEC’s updated regulatory approach offers insights into the possible path to approval. A spot ETF differs from a conventional ETF by tracking the real-time price of an asset—like bitcoin—and providing greater liquidity and potentially more favorable tax treatment for investors. These advantages make spot ETFs an attractive option for various market participants. Traditionally, a financial institution wishing to launch an ETF must submit a detailed application to the SEC outlining its structure, goals, and risks. The SEC’s 2018 proposal aimed to simplify this process by introducing one rule to replace multiple exemptive orders. This change would allow qualifying ETFs to enter the market faster, without needing separate exemptions. Once an application is submitted, the SEC examines it with a focus on investor protection and market integrity. Under the new framework, standard requirements would apply across all ETFs, helping to ensure fairness and investor safety. Despite the SEC’s protective mandate, its approach to spot bitcoin ETFs has raised questions about its effectiveness. While the SEC has approved bitcoin futures ETFs, some critics argue that these products don’t provide the same direct bitcoin exposure as spot ETFs. Members of Congress have even sent an open letter to SEC Chairman Gary Gensler, requesting more transparency about the commission’s policy. During the review process, the SEC may engage in multiple rounds of communication with applicants, requesting clarifications or more information as needed. This iterative process continues until a final decision is reached. The SEC typically invites public comments during the ETF approval process, which remains important under the modernized framework. The proposed rule also requires daily disclosure of an ETF’s portfolio on its website, giving investors real-time insights into holdings. A spot bitcoin ETF following the proposed rule could utilize 'custom baskets' instead of strictly pro-rata portfolios. Additionally, there is a focus on openly sharing historical data on premiums, discounts, and bid-ask spreads via the ETF’s website. After a comprehensive evaluation and consideration of public input, the SEC makes its final decision. If approved, the ETF can begin operating and trading on major stock exchanges, providing regulated access to bitcoin. In summary, the SEC is moving towards spot bitcoin ETF approval, considering factors like custody, surveillance, liquidity, and arbitrage. Public feedback is important, and while the timeline is uncertain, approval would offer investors easier and regulated access to bitcoin. Cathy Wood and other experts suggest that when approval comes, it could involve multiple spot bitcoin ETFs at once, bringing clarity to the regulatory environment as bitcoin matures.
translated_content: Idén om en spot-bitcoinbörshandlad fond (ETF) har varit i fokus bland bitcoin- och investeringsgemenskaperna. Även om den amerikanska finansinspektionen SEC ännu inte har godkänt en sådan fond, ger förståelsen av SEC:s uppdaterade regleringsansats insikter om vägen till ett eventuellt godkännande. En spot-ETF skiljer sig från en konventionell ETF genom att spåra realtidspriset på en tillgång—som bitcoin—och erbjuda högre likviditet samt potentiellt mer fördelaktig skattebehandling för investerare. Dessa fördelar gör spot-ETF:er attraktiva för många marknadsaktörer. Traditionellt måste en finansiell institution som vill lansera en ETF lämna in en detaljerad ansökan till SEC som beskriver dess struktur, mål och risker. SEC:s förslag från 2018 syftade till att förenkla processen genom att införa en regel som ersätter flera undantagsbeslut. Ändringen skulle göra att kvalificerade ETF:er kan nå marknaden snabbare, utan individuella undantag. När en ansökan har lämnats in granskar SEC den med fokus på investerarskydd och marknadens integritet. Under det nya regelverket skulle standardkrav gälla för alla ETF:er för att säkerställa rättvisa och investerarskydd. Trots SEC:s skyddande syfte har dess hantering av spot-bitcoin-ETF:er väckt frågor om effektiviteten. Samtidigt som SEC har godkänt bitcoin-futures-ETF:er menar vissa kritiker att dessa produkter inte ger samma direkta exponering mot bitcoin som spot-ETF:er. Kongressledamöter har skickat ett öppet brev till SEC:s ordförande Gary Gensler för att efterfråga mer transparens kring kommissionens policy. Under granskningsprocessen kan SEC föra en löpande dialog med de sökande och begära förtydliganden eller ytterligare information flera gånger innan beslut fattas. SEC brukar bjuda in till allmänna synpunkter under ETF-godkännandeprocessen, vilket även gäller enligt det nya regelverket. Det föreslagna regelverket kräver även att ETF:er dagligen redovisar portföljens innehav på sin webbplats, så att investerare får insyn i realtid. En spot-bitcoin-ETF enligt det nya regelverket skulle kunna använda 'anpassade korgar' istället för strikt proportionella portföljer. Dessutom läggs vikt vid att historiska data om premier, rabatter och spreadar öppet redovisas på ETF:ens webbplats. Efter en omfattande granskning och beaktande av allmänhetens synpunkter fattar SEC sitt slutgiltiga beslut. Vid godkännande kan ETF:en starta verksamhet och börja handlas på större börser, vilket ger reglerad tillgång till bitcoin. Sammanfattningsvis går SEC mot ett eventuellt godkännande av spot-bitcoin-ETF:er där faktorer som förvaring, övervakning, likviditet och arbitrage beaktas. Allmänhetens synpunkter är viktiga, och även om tidslinjen är oklar skulle ett godkännande erbjuda enklare och reglerad tillgång till bitcoin för investerare. Cathy Wood och andra experter tror att om SEC ger klarsignal, kan flera spot-bitcoin-ETF:er godkännas samtidigt, vilket skulle skapa tydlighet på den regleringsmässiga marknaden när bitcoin mognar.

article_content: Guy Kurlandski, Executive Director at Liquidity Group, observes that fintech is entering a new era. Previously, fintech firms in payments and investment faced criticism for focusing on technology at the expense of regulatory concerns. However, Kurlandski believes this is shifting, with 'fintech 3.0' placing a strong emphasis on financial inclusion. Unlike earlier waves centered on digital payments and blockchain, this phase aims to extend financial capabilities beyond traditional elites and into local communities. According to Kurlandski, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning are fundamental to improving access. Startups such as ZestFinance, led by former Google CIO Douglas Merrill, and Pentaip, are utilizing AI to offer fairer lending, seeking to reduce long-standing biases like redlining by focusing on financial data rather than personal traits. AI is also enhancing customer service. Companies like Kasisto and Posh.ai enable banks to overcome language and geographical barriers, improving customer engagement globally. These systems also help bank employees stay informed on regulations and internal procedures, all while safeguarding sensitive financial data. For digital security, fintech leverages advanced authentication tools. Firms including Hooyu and Veriff use innovative technology to verify identities, significantly strengthening mobile security. Despite digital advancements, widespread use of new fintech solutions remains limited. Kurlandski highlights the importance of 'network effects'—where a product becomes more valuable as more people use it—for achieving broader inclusion. He suggests that partnering with local influencers can raise trust and awareness, especially in communities where word-of-mouth is influential. Persistent barriers exist, particularly affecting women in developing nations, who often encounter limited access to mobile technology, lower digital literacy, and cultural obstacles. Tackling these divides is key to achieving genuine financial inclusion. Kurlandski's recommendations include investing in digital infrastructure, simplifying banking procedures, and prioritizing financial education. He believes that, with these improvements, digital finance can significantly benefit underserved populations, provided ongoing work addresses remaining gaps. The Forbes Business Council is cited as a leading networking organization for business executives.

article_content: A leaked memo alleges that Gordon Ramsay’s company avoided paying over £2.2 million in taxes through questionable methods. The memo, reportedly written by Ramsay’s former finance boss Trevor James, describes actions taken to evade significant sums during a past tax investigation. This disclosure has prompted a serious investigation into Ramsay’s restaurant group by HMRC. Trevor James, a former tax inspector, claims he assisted Ramsay's company by making inaccurate declarations to HM Revenue & Customs and by removing potentially incriminating documents. The memo details VAT claims for refurbishments to Ramsay’s South London home, with James stating that they claimed at least £211,450 more than allowed. It also alleges that Ramsay personally received £375,000 from a fund meant for restaurant staff tips and that James convinced HMRC to reduce tax owed on these tips without substantial justification. In the memo, James characterizes their actions as ‘legitimate, of course,’ yet acknowledges the possibility of prosecution should all details become known. He writes, ‘We have skated on some very thin ice here, but we have got away with it,’ admitting to having removed documents from company files to avoid greater scrutiny. The memo came to light after The Mail on Sunday reported on HMRC’s investigation into Gordon Ramsay Holdings in August, amid allegations of serious tax fraud. Ramsay has denied any involvement, with his spokesperson stating that he was unaware of the memo, those involved were dismissed, and Ramsay informed authorities upon learning about it. Other allegations include saving around £20,000 in tax on an Aston Martin by claiming it spent most of the time under repair and not declaring £42,640 in income from 2000 to 2003. James concedes that while HMRC accepted his argument, their position was actually correct. Anonymous sources claim Ramsay was aware of and discussed the memo’s contents with James during a call, but Ramsay’s representatives insist there is no evidence of wrongdoing. James, who joined Ramsay's company in 2007 after previously investigating it, resigned as director this year when the new HMRC investigation began. HMRC declined to comment on the ongoing investigation but emphasized that it can prosecute anyone found to have illegally avoided tax. Repeated attempts to reach James for comment were unsuccessful.

Ernst Stavro Blofeld, the iconic archvillain often seen stroking a white cat, may soon return to the James Bond films. This potential comeback follows a recent settlement among MGM, production company Danjaq, and the estate of Kevin McClory. McClory, who co-wrote the 1965 James Bond film 'Thunderball' with author Ian Fleming, was entangled in a legal dispute over Bond movie rights for more than 50 years.

On Friday, it was announced that Danjaq and MGM have acquired all rights and interests relating to James Bond from the McClory estate. The specific terms of the settlement remain undisclosed. According to the McClory family's law firm, McClory created both Ernst Stavro Blofeld and the global criminal syndicate SPECTRE (Special Executive for Counter-intelligence, Terrorism, Revenge and Extortion)—characters and organizations not introduced in Fleming's original novels.

William Kane, the lawyer representing the McClory estate, stated that the settlement 'will benefit James Bond film fans throughout the world.' The dispute dates back to 1959, six years after Fleming published his first Bond novel, 'Casino Royale.' The McClory estate maintains that McClory proposed to Fleming the idea of setting a James Bond story in the Bahamas, a concept that became 'Thunderball.' Fleming later allegedly adapted this story into his novel 'Thunderball' without giving McClory proper credit.

Following lengthy legal battles, McClory was able to produce the 1965 film 'Thunderball' and later the 1983 Bond film 'Never Say Never Again,' which featured Sean Connery's return as Agent 007. 'Never Say Never Again' has been considered outside the official Bond canon, absent from the franchise’s official website and from the 2012 'Bond 50' collection, which recognized only the 22 film series ending with 'Skyfall.'

With this settlement, there is speculation that previously excluded films like 'Never Say Never Again' could now become part of the official franchise. The 24th James Bond film, directed once again by Sam Mendes, is scheduled for release in late 2015.

article_content: Research shows that people with disabilities have historically been marginalized in societies worldwide. Over time, the language used to describe disability has generally become more positive and inclusive. Many advocates prefer 'people with disabilities' instead of 'the handicapped' or 'the disabled.' However, for many Indigenous peoples, the word 'disability' itself can be stigmatizing, as it does not exist in their traditional vocabulary and does not reflect their beliefs about impairments. Among the Xhosa AmaBomvane community in South Africa’s Eastern Cape, disability is not seen as defining a person. Their worldview, rooted in collectivism and the philosophy of ubuntu, does not allow discrimination. Ubuntu, an African philosophy, emphasizes the common good and the interconnectedness of all people. In other cultures, people with disabilities are often seen as different from the 'norm.' For my Ph.D. in health sciences rehabilitation, I spent three years studying the experiences of people with disabilities in the context of Xhosa rituals and traditions, to understand how these rituals affect health and well-being. I found that good health and well-being are closely tied to rituals among the Bomvana people, and that everyone, including people with disabilities, is entitled to health and participation. This provides valuable lessons in inclusion. For my study, I interviewed 50 people from three rural villages—Gusi, Hobeni, and Xhora—in Elliotdale district, with help from local chiefs and community members. Participants included adults with disabilities, elders, caregivers, parents, traditional birth attendants, healers, a circumcision surgeon, and a social worker. The Bomvana are recognizable by the red ochre they use to adorn their faces and the beaded red blankets worn at traditional events. Their strong belief system supports cultural continuity and ensures traditional knowledge is passed down orally. I focused on three key rituals: Efukwini (birth), which involves the mother and child staying separate for 10 days to protect the child, fostering connections to ancestors; Intonjane, a female initiation rite, performed for all young women regardless of disability; and Ulwaluko, a male circumcision ritual, which is also inclusive, teaching boys about identity and social responsibility. My findings show that AmaBomvane treat people with disabilities with dignity and respect during rituals. Exclusion is believed to bring ancestral disapproval and misfortune. They also believe illness can be prevented by performing rituals for ancestors, who act as intermediaries between humans and God. These rituals strengthen health, stability, and resilience. Rituals create safe, inclusive spaces for people with disabilities, encouraging respect and compassion. The Bomvana view of disability is also spiritual: it is seen as something external to the person, with sayings like 'the soul is not disabled.' However, negative attitudes do exist outside of rituals, often linked to colonial and Western influences—for example, missionaries opposing circumcision rituals. There are reports of mistreatment and economic exploitation, such as misuse of disability grants. Changing times and family structures put traditional values like ubuntu at risk. The Bomvana example suggests that ubuntu—emphasizing social justice and equality—could serve as a model for wider inclusion of people with disabilities. Ubuntu’s embrace of equality resonates with South Africa’s constitutional values, which hold that all people are equal before the law. In this worldview, disability is not a problem to be fixed but a human state deserving of respect and equal treatment.
translated_content: Forskning visar att personer med funktionsnedsättningar historiskt sett har varit marginaliserade i samhällen världen över. Med tiden har språket kring funktionsnedsättningar generellt blivit mer positivt och inkluderande. Många föredrar 'personer med funktionsnedsättningar' istället för 'handikappade' eller 'funktionshindrade.' För många urfolk kan dock ordet 'funktionsnedsättning' i sig vara stigmatiserande, eftersom det inte finns i deras traditionella vokabulär eller speglar deras syn på funktionsvariationer. I Xhosa AmaBomvane-samhället i Östra Kapprovinsen i Sydafrika ses funktionsnedsättningar inte som något som definierar en person. Deras världsbild, som bygger på kollektivism och ubuntu-filosofin, tillåter inte diskriminering. Ubuntu, en afrikansk filosofi, handlar om det gemensamma bästa och människors samhörighet. I andra kulturer ses personer med funktionsnedsättningar ofta som avvikande från 'normen.' Under mina doktorandstudier inom rehabiliteringsvetenskap tillbringade jag tre år med att studera personer med funktionsnedsättningar inom ramen för Xhosas ritualer och traditioner, för att förstå hur ritualerna påverkar hälsa och välbefinnande. Jag fann att god hälsa och välmående hos Bomvana-folket är tätt sammankopplat med ritualer, och att alla, även personer med funktionsnedsättningar, har rätt till hälsa och delaktighet. Detta ger värdefulla insikter om inkludering. Jag intervjuade 50 personer från tre byar—Gusi, Hobeni och Xhora—i Elliotdale-distriktet, med hjälp av lokala hövdingar och bybor. Deltagarna var vuxna med funktionsnedsättningar, äldre, vårdgivare, föräldrar, traditionella barnmorskor, helare, en omskärelse-kirurg och en socialarbetare. Bomvana-folket känns igen på sin röda ockra som de dekorerar ansiktena med och de pärlprydda röda filtarna de bär på traditionella tillställningar. Deras starka trossystem bevarar den kulturella kontinuiteten och garanterar vidareförmedling av traditionell kunskap. Jag fokuserade på tre viktiga ritualer: Efukwini (födelse), där mor och barn vistas åtskilda i tio dagar för barnets skydd och för att knyta band till förfäderna; Intonjane, en kvinnlig initieringsrit som utförs för alla unga kvinnor oavsett funktionsnedsättning; samt Ulwaluko, en manlig omskärelsesrit, där pojkar, även de med funktionsnedsättningar, lär sig om identitet och socialt ansvar. Resultaten visar att AmaBomvane behandlar personer med funktionsnedsättningar med värdighet och respekt under ritualerna. Uteslutning tros leda till förfäders ogillande och otur. De tror också att riter för förfäderna skyddar mot sjukdom, då förfäderna fungerar som mellanhänder mellan människa och Gud. Ritualerna stärker hälsa, stabilitet och resiliens. Ritualerna skapar trygga och inkluderande miljöer som uppmuntrar respekt och medkänsla. Bomvanas syn på funktionsnedsättning är också andlig: det ses som något utanför personen, med uttrycket att 'själen är inte funktionsnedsatt.' Samtidigt förekommer negativa attityder utanför ritualerna, ofta kopplade till koloniala och västerländska influenser—exempelvis missionärer som motsatte sig omskärelsesritualer. Det rapporteras också om misskötsel och utnyttjande, bland annat genom missbruk av funktionshinderbidrag. Förändrade tider och familjestrukturer hotar värden som ubuntu. Bomvanas exempel tyder på att ubuntu—med fokus på social rättvisa och jämlikhet—kan vara en modell för bredare inkludering av personer med funktionsnedsättningar. Ubuntu överensstämmer med Sydafrikas grundlag där alla är lika inför lagen. I detta synsätt ses funktionsnedsättning inte som ett problem som måste lösas, utan som ett mänskligt tillstånd som förtjänar respekt och lika behandling.

article_content: At a massive climate protest in Amsterdam, activist Greta Thunberg was briefly interrupted on stage after she welcomed Palestinian and Afghan women to share their perspectives. Thunberg addressed tens of thousands, highlighting the need to uplift voices of those facing oppression and fighting for justice, stating that true climate justice relies on international solidarity. After the women—among them Sahar Shirzad from Afghanistan—spoke, a man unexpectedly came onstage, saying he wanted a climate demonstration, "not a political view," before being escorted away. He was linked to the Water Natuurlijk group, according to his jacket, although his identity was unclear. Earlier, a small group of protesters near the stage waved Palestinian flags and chanted in support of Palestine, causing a brief disruption. Thunberg remained focused, later seen dancing as a band played. The event drew approximately 70,000 participants, making it reportedly the largest climate demonstration in Dutch history. People of all ages—including groups of medics in white coats holding a banner reading, "Climate crisis = health crisis"—joined the protest. Pediatrician Laura Sonneveld emphasized the risk climate change poses to children, saying she was standing up for their rights. The timing of the protest comes just ahead of the national elections, with climate action front and center in policy debates. Political figures like former EU climate chief Frans Timmermans, currently leading a center-left coalition, also addressed the crowd, calling for significant changes in political decisions to address ongoing crises. Organizer Climate Crisis Coalition, alongside movements like Fridays for Future, stressed the intertwined nature of current crises and the need for a different approach. Spanish teacher and youth mentor Margje Weijs said she hoped the protest would sway election outcomes, emphasizing the urgency for government action.

Thunberg talade inför tiotusentals åskådare och betonade behovet av att lyfta fram röster från människor som är förtryckta och kämpar för rättvisa. Hon sa att äkta klimaträttvisa kräver internationell solidaritet. Efter att kvinnorna – däribland Sahar Shirzad från Afghanistan – hade talat, gick en man oväntat upp på scenen. Han sa att han kommit för en klimatdemonstration, "inte en politisk åsikt", innan han avlägsnades. Han bar en jacka med organisationen Water Natuurlijk, men hans identitet är oklar. Barnläkaren Laura Sonneveld betonade att klimatförändringar riskerar att drabba barn särskilt hårt och att hon står upp för deras rättigheter. Protesten hölls inför det stundande parlamentsvalet, där klimatpolitik är en central fråga. Politiska ledare som tidigare EU:s klimatchef Frans Timmermans, nu ledare för en center-vänsterkoalition, talade till publiken och krävde politiska förändringar för att hantera pågående kriser. article_content: A probationary police sub-inspector from Bengaluru was arrested for allegedly participating in a kidnapping and extortion racket. Siddarooda Bijjananavar, who was assigned to Madiwala police station, is accused along with a police constable, a home guard, and a businessman. Authorities say the group abducted VS Kartik, a digital marketing director, and forced him to transfer about $180,000 (Rs 1.5 crore) in cryptocurrency and Rs 20 lakh in cash to their accounts. The suspects were accused of impersonating police officers and threatening to implicate Kartik in a drug case. The case unfolded when Kartik filed a complaint at KG Halli police station. He reported that his friend, Vamshikrishna, invited him for business discussions but, once in the car, Kartik was coerced into transferring large sums of money. The gang demanded an additional Rs 60 lakh for his release. Kartik managed to escape with help from relatives after being taken to their home. The Central Crime Branch's economic offences wing took over the investigation, leading to the arrest of Bijjananavar and the three other suspects, who were then sent to Bengaluru Central Prison. Investigators also found that the group had threatened to frame Kartik in a fake drug case.

Enligt myndigheterna ska gruppen ha kidnappat VS Kartik, chef för ett digitalt marknadsföringsföretag, och tvingat honom att föra över cirka 180 000 dollar (1,5 crore rupier) i kryptovaluta och 20 lakh rupier i kontanter till deras konton. De misstänkta utgav sig för att vara poliser och hotade att sätta dit Kartik i ett narkotikafall. Fallet uppdagades när Kartik gjorde en polisanmälan vid KG Halli-polisen. Han berättade att hans vän Vamshikrishna bjöd in honom för affärsärenden, men att han väl i bilen tvingades överföra stora summor pengar. Gänget krävde ytterligare 60 lakh rupier för att släppa honom. Kartik lyckades fly med hjälp av sina släktingar efter att ha förts till deras hem. Central Crime Branchs sektion för ekonomiska brott tog över utredningen och det ledde till att Bijjananavar och de tre andra misstänkta greps och fördes till Bengaluru Central Prison. Utredningen visade också att gruppen hotade att sätta dit Kartik i ett falskt narkotikafall.

article_content: Millions of adults are affected by anxiety disorders, where persistent worrying interferes with daily life. Now, scientists have identified a brain region involved in controlling fear, offering hope for improved treatments. Researchers in the US have described a neural circuit in mice that regulates fearful memories and behaviors, providing insight into the development of anxiety disorders. They found that the paraventricular nucleus of the thalamus (PVT) is involved in learning and recalling fear, with its neurons extending into the central amygdala. Disrupting this connection significantly impaired fear learning in mice. Associate Professor Bo Li, who led the research at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL) in New York, explained that earlier research showed fear learning and memory are coordinated by neurons in the central amygdala. The PVT is highly sensitive to stress and acts as a sensor for psychological and physical tension. Researchers sought to determine the PVT's role in fear learning and memory in mice. Professor Li said, 'We found that the PVT is specifically activated as animals learn to fear or as they recall fear memories.' The team found that neurons from the PVT extend deeply into the central amygdala, and disrupting this connection significantly impairs fear learning. The researchers believe that the PVT-central amygdala link is a crucial component of fear learning and could be targeted with drugs to potentially treat anxiety disorders. Building on these findings, scientists analyzed data from people with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) to identify chemical messengers between the PVT and the central amygdala. They focused on brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF), a molecule associated with anxiety disorders, known to promote new neuron growth and connections in the brain. Previous studies suggest that individuals with anxiety disorders often have mutations in BDNF, implying a role in fear learning and memory. Using mice, researchers examined whether BDNF affects fear responses and the connection between the PVT and the central amygdala. They discovered that BDNF in the central amygdala activates neurons, causing mice without prior fear conditioning to react fearfully and leading to long-term fear memory formation. Professor Li stated, 'We established that this is a regulatory circuit controlling fear in mice, with BDNF serving as the messenger that allows the PVT to influence the central amygdala.' He added, 'Our research provides mechanistic insight into a novel fear circuit in the brain and offers a promising target for future anxiety disorder treatments.' In related research, curcumin—a compound found in the popular curry spice turmeric—may help erase bad memories. Psychologists from The City University of New York observed that rats given a curcumin-rich diet failed to freeze in response to a sound previously associated with fear, indicating that their fear memories were erased. Professor Glenn Schafe, who led the curcumin study, said, 'This suggests that people suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder and other conditions characterized by fearful memories may substantially benefit from a diet enriched with curcumin.'
translated_content: Miljontals vuxna lider av ångestsyndrom där konstant oro påverkar vardagen. Nu har forskare identifierat ett hjärnområde som styr rädsla och öppnar för bättre behandlingar. Amerikanska forskare har beskrivit ett nervkretslopp hos möss som reglerar rädslominnen och beteenden, vilket ger insikt om hur ångestsyndrom kan utvecklas. De fann att den paraventrikulära kärnan i thalamus (PVT) är inblandad i att lära sig och återkalla rädsla, med neuroner som sträcker sig in i den centrala amygdalan. Om man stör denna koppling försämras förmågan att lära sig rädsla hos möss. Docent Bo Li, som ledde forskningen vid Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL) i New York, förklarade att tidigare forskning visat att inlärning och minne av rädsla koordineras av neuroner i den centrala amygdalan. PVT är mycket känslig för stress och fungerar som en sensor för både psykologisk och fysisk spänning. Forskare ville fastställa PVT:s roll i rädsloinlärning och minne hos möss. Professor Li sa: 'Vi fann att PVT aktiveras specifikt när djur lär sig att frukta eller när de minns rädslominnen.' Teamet fann att neuroner från PVT sträcker sig djupt in i den centrala amygdalan, och att en störning av denna koppling försämrar förmågan att lära sig rädsla. Forskarna tror att länken mellan PVT och centrala amygdalan är en avgörande komponent i rädsloinlärning och kan vara ett mål för läkemedel vid framtida behandling av ångestsyndrom. Med dessa fynd i grunden analyserade forskarna data från personer med posttraumatiskt stressyndrom (PTSD) för att identifiera kemiska budbärare mellan PVT och centrala amygdalan. De fokuserade på hjärnhärledd neurotrofisk faktor (BDNF), ett ämne kopplat till ångestsyndrom och känt för att stödja nybildning av neuroner och kopplingar i hjärnan. Tidigare studier tyder på att personer med ångestsyndrom ofta har mutationer i BDNF, vilket antyder en roll i rädsloinlärning och minne. Med möss undersökte forskarna om BDNF påverkar rädslorespons samt kopplingen mellan PVT och centrala amygdalan. De upptäckte att närvaro av BDNF i centrala amygdalan aktiverar neuroner, vilket gör att möss utan tidigare rädsloinlärning reagerade med rädsla och skapade långvariga rädslominnen. Professor Li konstaterade: 'Vi fastställde att detta är ett reglerande kretslopp som kontrollerar rädsla hos möss, där BDNF fungerar som budbärare och låter PVT påverka centrala amygdalan.' Han tillade: 'Vår forskning ger mekanistisk insikt i en ny rädslekrets i hjärnan och erbjuder ett lovande mål för framtida behandlingar av ångestsyndrom.' I relaterad forskning kan curcumin — en förening som finns i populära kryddan gurkmeja — hjälpa till att radera dåliga minnen. Psykologer vid City University of New York observerade att råttor som fick en curcuminrik kost inte frös vid ljud som tidigare associerats med rädsla, vilket tyder på att deras rädslominnen raderades. Professor Glenn Schafe, som ledde studien om curcumin, sa: 'Detta antyder att personer som lider av posttraumatiskt stressyndrom och andra tillstånd präglade av rädslominnen kan ha stor nytta av en diet rik på curcumin.'

For generations, Wakhi shepherdesses in Pakistan have traveled to remote mountain pastures to graze their flocks. Their work provided vital income that helped improve healthcare, education, and supported the construction of the first road out of their isolated valley. As this way of life wanes, BBC 100 Women joined the remaining shepherdesses on one of their last journeys.

The route to the Pamir pastures is perilous. Narrow, twisting mountain trails hold deadly risks with every step. As the women guide sheep, goats, and yaks, their calls keep the animals from straying and falling.

"There used to be many more cattle," says Bano, now in her late seventies. "The animals would wander off; some returned, some didn’t." In previous times, dozens of Wakhi shepherdesses undertook this arduous trek each summer across the rugged Karakoram mountains, carrying young children on their backs while the men stayed behind to farm in the Shimshal valley below. Today, only seven shepherdesses remain.

They walk up to eight hours daily through rain, snow, and heat. The trek that once took three days now takes five. Yet, the older shepherdesses still outpace the newcomers as everyone adjusts to the high altitude. Landslides are a constant threat; the pounding hooves of sheep can trigger falling rocks and dust.

Conditions were tougher in the past. Without thermal jackets or walking shoes, the women wore simple robes, even venturing barefoot on ice. Annar, 88, recalls these hardships. Afroze, now 67, became the first woman in the valley to own shoes when her brother gifted her pairs on her wedding. "People came just to see them, often borrowing my shoes and dress for weddings," she laughs.

Upon reaching Pamir, nearly 5,000 meters above sea level, lush green pastures and glacial streams shimmer beneath snow-capped peaks. "We’ve walked these lands with our mothers and grandmothers, making butter and yogurt," says Annar as the women sing and dance.

A group of 60 stone houses, now locked and deserted, signal a vanishing lifestyle. Annar, as the eldest, kisses the door of one ranch, prays, and enters carrying a hotplate with burning leaves. "Our elders taught us to use the spandur plant to ward off trouble," she explains, ensuring the smoke touches every animal.

To protect against wolves and leopards, the women slept on rooftops, even in harsh weather, made traps, and kept fires burning all night. "It was pitch black," says Annar. "We had no lights or torches, sometimes not realizing what we’d lost until morning."

Personal hardships were severe. Without doctors or clinics, Annar remembers one summer when they buried 12 children in the pastures—including her own son and daughter. "I was left empty-handed," she sighs, her pain still fresh after nearly 60 years.

Over time, the shepherdesses became self-sufficient businesswomen. "We made yogurt and other products from milk, sheared sheep, and took our goods to the village," recalls Bano. The community bartered for services; in return for their products, others built houses for the women. Afroze managed to build two homes from her earnings. "This place gave me so much—it paid for my children's weddings and education."

The partnership between women shepherds and male farmers changed the community, once isolated from the world until the early 2000s. Together, they funded the only road out of Shimshal valley, connecting it to the Karakoram highway between Pakistan and China. Journeys that took days now take hours, with new access to healthcare, education, and opportunities.

Bano's son, Wazir, now runs a tourism company organizing trekking and cultural tours. "Our priorities changed after the road was built; that’s when I started my business," he says.

Fazila, 24, owns the valley’s first guest house, built by her late father. Her mother, a former shepherdess, could not make the journey this year due to ill health. "Our mothers urged us to focus on education and not endure the same hardships," Fazila explains. "Now, we are free to choose our futures. Without education, I’d be living the same difficult life."

Driving through the mountains, Wazir says, "Because of our mothers, we now have doctors, engineers, and other professionals."

The elderly shepherdesses feel pride seeing their children thrive but also sadness for the loss of their way of life. "Shepherding is more than a job; we feel a deep bond to Pamir—it is our treasure," says Afroze.

Annar, visiting the graveyard where her children are buried, wishes to be laid to rest in Pamir. "When I return to the pastures, I return to them," she says, eyes filled with tears.

I generationer har Wakhi-herdinnor i Pakistan vandrat till avlägsna bergsbeten för att valla sina djur. Deras arbete har gett viktig inkomst som förbättrat sjukvård, utbildning och hjälpt till att bygga den första vägen ut ur deras isolerade dal. När detta levnadssätt nu håller på att försvinna följde BBC 100 Women de sista herdinnorna på en av deras sista resor.

Vägen till Pamir-betena är farlig. Smala, slingrande bergsstigar innebär livsfara vid varje steg. Medan kvinnorna leder får, getter och jakar, håller deras rop djuren från att irra bort och falla.

"Det brukade finnas många fler djur," säger Bano, nu i slutet av sjuttioårsåldern. "Djuren sprang iväg – några återvände, andra inte." Förr i tiden vandrade dussintals Wakhi-herdinnor denna ansträngande väg varje sommar över de karga Karakorumbergen, bärande små barn på ryggen medan männen stannade kvar för att bruka jorden i Shimshal-dalen nedanför. Idag finns bara sju herdinnor kvar.

De vandrar upp till åtta timmar om dagen genom regn, snö och hetta. Vandringen som en gång tog tre dagar tar nu fem. Ändå ligger de äldre herdinnorna alltid före de andra medan alla vänjer sig vid den höga höjden. Jordskred är ett ständigt hot – fårens dova steg kan få sten och damm att rasa ner.

Förr var förhållandena ännu tuffare. Utan termojackor eller promenadskor bar kvinnorna enkla rockar, ibland barfota på isen. Annar, 88, minns dessa svårigheter. Afroze, nu 67, blev den första kvinnan i dalen med skor när hennes bror gav henne två par till bröllopet. "Folk kom bara för att titta på dem, ofta lånade de skorna och min klänning till bröllop," skrattar hon.

När de når Pamir, nästan 5 000 meter över havet, breder frodiga grönbeten och glittrande glaciärbäckar ut sig under snöklädda toppar. "Vi har vandrat här med våra mödrar och mormödrar, gjort smör och yoghurt," säger Annar när kvinnorna sjunger och dansar.

En grupp på 60 stenhushus, nu låsta och övergivna, vittnar om en försvinnande livsstil. Annar, äldst bland dem, kysser dörren till ett av husen, ber en bön och går in med en bricka med brinnande blad. "Våra äldre lärde oss att använda spandurväxten för att hålla olycka borta," förklarar hon och låter röken röra varje djur.

För att skydda mot vargar och leoparder sov kvinnorna på taken, även i hårt väder, tillverkade fällor och höll eldar igång hela natten. "Det var kolsvart", säger Annar. "Vi hade inga lampor eller ficklampor och ibland märkte vi först på morgonen vad vi hade förlorat."

De personliga svårigheterna var stora. Utan läkare eller kliniker minns Annar en sommar då de begravde 12 barn uppe på betena – däribland hennes egen son och dotter. "Jag stod tomhänt kvar," suckar hon, hennes sorg är fortfarande påtaglig nästan 60 år senare.

Med tiden blev herdinnorna självförsörjande affärskvinnor. "Vi gjorde yoghurt och andra produkter av mjölken, klippte fåren och tog våra varor till byn," minns Bano. Gemenskapen bytte till sig tjänster – i utbyte mot sina varor byggde andra hus åt kvinnorna. Afroze lyckades bygga två hem för sina intjänade pengar. "Den här platsen har gett mig så mycket – den betalade mina barns bröllop och utbildning."

Samarbetet mellan kvinnor och männens jordbruk förändrade samhället, som var isolerat fram till början av 2000-talet. Tillsammans finansierade de den enda vägen ut ur Shimshal-dalen, som nu binder samman byn med Karakoram-vägen mellan Pakistan och Kina. Resor som tidigare tog dagar sker nu på timmar och ger tillgång till bättre sjukvård, utbildning och nya möjligheter.

Banos son, Wazir, driver idag ett turistföretag med vandrings- och kulturresor. "Våra prioriteringar förändrades efter att vägen byggdes, det var då jag startade mitt företag," berättar han.

Fazila, 24, äger dalens första gästhus, byggt av hennes avlidne far. Hennes mamma, tidigare herdinna, kunde inte följa med till betena i år på grund av hälsan. "Våra mödrar uppmuntrade oss att satsa på utbildning och att inte utstå samma svårigheter," förklarar Fazila. "Nu kan vi välja våra egna vägar. Utan utbildning hade jag levt samma tuffa liv."

När Wazir kör sin jeep genom bergen säger han: "Tack vare våra mödrar har vi idag läkare, ingenjörer och andra yrken."

De äldre herdinnorna känner stolthet över att deras barn lyckas men också sorg över den livsstil som försvinner. "Herdeyrket är mer än ett jobb – vi känner starka band till Pamir, det är vår skatt," säger Afroze.

Annar, som besöker kyrkogården där hennes barn är begravda, vill vila i Pamir när hon dör. "När jag återvänder till betena återvänder jag till dem," säger hon med tårade ögon.

article_content: Unrest has intensified in Aceh, Indonesia, where approximately 600 Rohingya refugees arrived over a three-day period. Several boats landed on the province’s shores, with passengers—many being women and children—described as exhausted after weeks at sea. Local reactions varied, with some communities providing water and food, while others refused entry, forcing boats away and even escorting refugees back to their vessels. The increase in arrivals has been linked to ongoing conflicts in Myanmar and dire conditions in Bangladesh refugee camps, especially following the military coup in Myanmar in 2021. Though the journey at sea is hazardous, particularly during the monsoon season, many refugees continue to attempt it in hopes of finding safety. Historically supportive of newcomers, Acehnese communities are now struggling to cope with repeated arrivals. Local frustrations have grown, particularly as some residents have faced legal action on charges related to human trafficking after assisting refugees. Advocacy groups, including KontraS and Geutanyoe Foundation, have criticized the Indonesian government for its lack of a coordinated refugee policy, referencing a 2016 decree that mandates humanitarian cooperation. The Indonesian government has noted that Indonesia is not a party to the 1951 UN Refugee Convention, framing their efforts as humanitarian but not binding. Nonetheless, human rights groups warn that forcing refugees back to sea violates international norms, specifically the principle of non-refoulement. Other regional nations like Thailand and Malaysia have fended off refugee boats, while countries further away also limit migrant arrivals. Indonesian authorities have expressed concerns over the possibility of people-smuggling networks exploiting the situation. Amid ongoing uncertainty about the fate of all refugee boats, aid workers are calling for the government to urgently address both the needs of Rohingya refugees and the pressures on local communities.
translated_content: Oroligheterna har intensifierats i Aceh, Indonesien, där cirka 600 rohingya-flyktingar har anlänt under en tre-dagarsperiod. Flera båtar nådde provinsens kust, med passagerare – många kvinnor och barn – som var utmattade efter veckor till sjöss. De lokala reaktionerna varierade; vissa samhällen erbjöd vatten och mat medan andra vägrade ta emot flyktingarna, tvingade bort båtar och eskorterade till och med flyktingar tillbaka. Den ökade tillströmningen kopplas till pågående konflikter i Myanmar och svåra förhållanden i flyktinglägren i Bangladesh, särskilt efter militärkuppen i Myanmar 2021. Trots den farliga resan, särskilt under monsunperioden, försöker många flyktingar ändå ta sig över till säkerhet. Aceh-befolkningen har historiskt varit gästvänlig mot flyktingar, men de återkommande ankomsterna har nu lett till ökad frustration lokalt. Missnöjet har förvärrats av att vissa invånare åtalats för människosmuggling efter att ha hjälpt flyktingar. Organisationer som KontraS och Geutanyoe Foundation kritiserar den indonesiska regeringen för brist på samordnad flyktingpolitik, trots ett dekret från 2016 som kräver humanitärt samarbete. Regeringen påpekar att Indonesien inte är part till 1951 års FN:s flyktingkonvention och beskriver sina insatser som humanitära, men inte förpliktande. Människorättsgrupper varnar däremot att det strider mot internationella normer och principen om non-refoulement att tvinga flyktingar tillbaka till havet. Länder som Thailand och Malaysia har också avvisat flyktingbåtar, och även stater längre bort försöker stoppa migranter från att ta sig i land. Indonesiska myndigheter uttrycker oro för att situationen kan utnyttjas av människosmugglare. I osäkerheten om flyktingbåtarnas öde manar hjälporganisationer regeringen att snarast agera för både rohingya-flyktingarna och de belastade lokala samhällena.

article_content: Around one million people gathered at Times Square in New York City to celebrate New Year's Eve. The crowd watched the iconic crystal ball descend 70 feet, a tradition expertly led this year by Mayor Michael Bloomberg and Medal of Honor recipient Staff Sgt. Salvatore Giunta. As 2010 came to an end, the nearly 12,000-pound ball, covered in 2,668 crystals and lit by over 32,000 LEDs that can create millions of colors, made its way down as people counted the final seconds together. When the clock struck midnight, more than a ton of confetti rained down, much of it featuring handwritten wishes in over 25 languages—a practice embraced for the past three years. To help light up the giant 2011 numerals, each standing seven feet tall, visitors powered up LED bulbs earlier in the day by riding stationary bikes, a Duracell initiative promoting energy efficiency. The first ball drop took place in 1907, created by an immigrant metalworker named Jacob Starr. The event paused only in 1942 and 1943 due to World War II energy-saving measures. Since then, it has grown into a global celebration that marks new beginnings. Security at the festivities was tight. Times Square closed to traffic by 3 p.m., and police enforced bans on backpacks and alcohol while ramping up their presence. Police Commissioner Ray Kelly emphasized that each year requires fresh planning and adaptation to ensure everyone’s safety during this massive and historic celebration.
translated_content: Ungefär en miljon människor samlades på Times Square i New York för att fira nyårsafton. Publiken såg den ikoniska kristallbollen sänkas 21 meter, en tradition som i år leddes av borgmästare Michael Bloomberg och medaljbelönade Staff Sgt. Salvatore Giunta. När 2010 tog slut gled den nästan 5 400 kilo tunga bollen, täckt av 2 668 kristaller och upplyst av över 32 000 LED-lampor som kan skapa miljontals färger, ner medan folk räknade ner tillsammans. Vid midnatt regnade över ett ton konfetti—mycket av det med handskrivna önskningar på mer än 25 språk—en sedvana som följts de senaste tre åren. För att lysa upp de stora 2011-siffrorna, som var två meter höga, trampade besökare på motionscyklar tidigare under dagen för att generera el till LED-lamporna, ett Duracell-initiativ för energieffektivitet. Det första bollsläppet hölls 1907, skapat av invandraren och metallarbetaren Jacob Starr. Evenemanget pausades endast 1942 och 1943 på grund av energibesparing under andra världskriget. Sedan dess har det vuxit till en global fest för att markera nya början. Säkerheten var strikt under firandet. Times Square stängdes för trafik vid 15-tiden och polisen såg till att ryggsäckar och alkohol var förbjudna, samtidigt som de ökade sin närvaro. article_content: Powerful storms swept across northern Georgia and the Carolinas on Saturday, bringing gusty winds that toppled trees, caused tornado watches, and led to flood warnings. In Charlotte, North Carolina, a 33-year-old man lost his life in a weather-related car accident. Police reported that the driver was navigating heavy rain when his car left the road, slid on wet grass, and struck a utility pole on the driver's side. Three other passengers, including a toddler, were hospitalized but did not sustain life-threatening injuries. At Raleigh-Durham International Airport, wind gusts reached 85 mph—faster than those recorded during hurricanes Ivan and Fran, according to the National Weather Service. High winds also damaged a condo under construction, leaving debris scattered, as reported by CNN affiliate WTVD. Thousands of customers in North and South Carolina lost power, Duke Energy said. In Georgia, firefighters rescued a 14-year-old girl who was trapped after a tree crashed into her mobile home Saturday morning. Tim Cavender, a spokesman for the Cherokee County Fire Department, stated the girl was in serious condition but alert and communicating with paramedics; a 2-year-old was also rescued with only minor scrapes. Meteorologists explained that a cold front moving eastward produced widespread showers and thunderstorms from the Gulf Coast to New England. Severe storms also slammed into coastal areas of the Southeast. The severe weather wasn’t limited to the South: Browning, Montana saw wind gusts up to 85 mph, the National Weather Service reported.

article_content: U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken deepened his diplomatic mission in the Middle East on Sunday by meeting Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas in the occupied West Bank. Blinken highlighted that the Biden administration is intensifying aid efforts for Gaza’s civilians and emphasized the necessity of Palestinian involvement in shaping Gaza’s future post-conflict. After the Ramallah meeting, Blinken headed to Baghdad to talk with Iraqi Prime Minister Mohammed Shia al-Sudani. This visit happened amid increasing attacks on U.S. military personnel by Iranian-allied militias in the region. On the same day, American forces intercepted another drone aimed at coalition and U.S. troops in Syria, a U.S. official reported. In Ramallah, Blinken’s heavily protected motorcade reflected the heightened security environment. His efforts come as the U.S. seeks to contain the war’s broader regional impact and presses Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to consider temporary pauses for humanitarian aid—something Netanyahu currently refuses, insisting on hostage releases first. Blinken told reporters that implementing humanitarian pauses is a complex process, with Israel expressing significant concerns, especially regarding the safety of hostages. 'We're addressing these issues in depth,' he explained. Though the U.S. remains Israel’s principal supporter after the October 7 Hamas attack, the Biden administration is placing growing pressure on Israel to minimize civilian suffering during continued military operations in Gaza, affecting around 2.3 million residents. Blinken met Abbas the same day Israeli airstrikes struck two refugee camps in Gaza, with at least 53 fatalities reported, including children. Protestors in Ramallah condemned U.S. support for Israel's actions. No public comments followed the Blinken-Abbas meeting. The Palestinian Authority, which governs parts of the West Bank but not Gaza since 2007, stated—via WAFA news agency—that it would only assume control in Gaza as part of a comprehensive political deal. Abbas further condemned the ongoing Israeli attacks and called them 'genocidal,' urging Blinken to intervene. In Baghdad, Blinken praised the Palestinian Authority’s contributions to stability in the West Bank and reiterated the essential role of Palestinian perspectives in determining Gaza’s future. Regional Arab leaders continue to demand an immediate cease-fire and have resisted U.S. suggestions for further involvement in resolving the Gaza crisis, citing Israel’s responsibility. The death toll in Gaza, according to the Hamas-led health ministry, now exceeds 9,700, fueling international protests calling for an end to hostilities. Iran-backed militias have ramped up attacks on U.S. installations in Iraq and Syria, leading to an American counterstrike. The Pentagon reported that 21 U.S. personnel were injured across 32 attacks since October 17, but all have returned to duty. According to U.S. officials, the most recent drone attack closely resembled earlier strikes from Iranian-backed groups.

article_content: Washington (CNN) -- When New Jersey Governor Chris Christie, a frequent critic of President Barack Obama, described the president as 'outstanding' and 'incredibly supportive,' it signaled extraordinary circumstances. This followed Superstorm Sandy, a rare and destructive event that led Christie to declare a state of emergency and seek federal assistance for widespread devastation. In interviews on NBC and CNN, Christie praised Obama's leadership during the crisis, emphasizing that disaster response outweighed political concerns. He highlighted the president’s prompt support of New Jersey and looked forward to Obama’s visit to observe the storm’s effects. Christie’s supportive comments about Obama gained attention, especially given his usual alignment with Republican presidential candidate Mitt Romney. With the election one week away, the storm brought attention to the federal government's role in disaster response. While Obama managed the federal relief efforts, Romney held an event in Ohio that was converted into a storm relief drive. Romney declined to address FEMA’s role directly when asked, instead encouraging supporters to help those affected. Romney and running mate Paul Ryan faced criticism from Democrats for proposing spending cuts and tax breaks without offsetting revenue, sparking debates about potential impacts on the economy and federal deficit. Obama’s campaign questioned Romney’s advocacy for shifting disaster management to states and private organizations as a way to balance the federal budget. At a prior debate, Romney voiced support for returning as many responsibilities as possible from the federal government to the states or private sector and underscored the need to cut unnecessary federal spending, citing concerns about rising debt. As Sandy struck, the Romney campaign stated that Romney believes states should direct emergency responses but also assured that federal disaster aid would continue under a Romney-Ryan administration. FEMA Administrator Craig Fugate reported that the agency had $3.6 billion in its disaster fund, collaborating with state and local agencies and organizations like the American Red Cross to address urgent needs, including housing and debris removal. Vice President Joe Biden praised the effective cooperation among federal, state, and local authorities. The White House noted President Obama's ongoing communication with multiple governors and mayors to coordinate aid. Differing approaches to disaster response underscored broader campaign disagreements over the size and functions of the federal government. Obama and Democrats defended federal programs like Social Security and Medicare, while Republicans called for deficit reduction and smaller government. As Sandy approached, Obama paused campaign activities to lead the federal response, assuring those affected of continued government support and national solidarity. Obama planned to visit New Jersey with Governor Christie to assess the damage, meet residents, and thank responders, while Romney was scheduled for campaign events in Florida. The article concludes with ways to assist in post-storm recovery. Reporters: Rachel Streitfeld, Kevin Liptak, Tom Watkins, Mike M. Ahlers.

Detta följde efter Superstormen Sandy, en ovanlig och förödande händelse som ledde till att Christie utlyste undantagstillstånd och bad om federal hjälp för omfattande skador. I intervjuer med NBC och CNN berömde Christie Obamas ledarskap under krisen och betonade att krishantering var viktigare än politik. Han lyfte fram presidentens snabba stöd till New Jersey och uttryckte förväntan inför Obamas besök för att se stormens konsekvenser. Christies positiva kommentar om Obama väckte uppmärksamhet, särskilt då han vanligtvis stöttar den republikanske presidentkandidaten Mitt Romney. Stormen riktade, en vecka inför valet, fokus mot federala myndigheters roll i katastrofhantering. Medan Obama ledde den federala responsen höll Romney ett evenemang i Ohio, som omvandlats till en insamling till drabbade. När han fick frågor om FEMA:s roll valde Romney att istället uppmana sina anhängare att hjälpa de behövande. Romney och vicepresidentkandidaten Paul Ryan fick kritik av demokrater för att föreslå nedskärningar och skattesänkningar utan extra intäkter, och väckte farhågor kring ekonomin och budgetunderskottet. Obamas kampanj ifrågasatte Romneys idéer om att föra över katastrofansvar till delstater och privata aktörer för att balansera budgeten. Vid en tidigare debatt uttryckte Romney stöd för att flytta federala ansvarsområden till delstater eller den privata sektorn. Han betonade behovet av att minska onödiga federala utgifter och oroade sig för den växande skulden. När Sandy slog till meddelade Romneykampanjen att han anser att delstater ska leda akutinsatser, men samtidigt utlovade fortsatt federal hjälp från en eventuell Romney-Ryan-administration. FEMA:s chef Craig Fugate rapporterade att myndigheten hade 3,6 miljarder dollar kvar för katastrofhjälp och samarbetade med delstatliga myndigheter och Röda Korset för att möta akuta behov som tillfälliga bostäder och bråtröjning. Vicepresident Joe Biden berömde samarbetet mellan federala, delstatliga och lokala myndigheter. Vita huset påtalade även president Obamas dialog med guvernörer och borgmästare i drabbade delstater för att koordinera hjälpen. De olika synsätten på katastrofhjälp reflekterade bredare valfrågor kring statens storlek och roll. Obama och demokraterna värnade om federala trygghetsprogram, medan republikanerna ville minska budgetunderskottet och storleken på staten. Inför stormen pausade Obama kampanjen och fokuserade på ledarskapet för den federala responsen, och försäkrade drabbade om fortsatt stöd och sammanhållning. Obama planerade att besöka New Jersey med Christie för att inspektera skador, träffa boende och tacka räddningsarbetare, medan Romney fortsatt kampanjar i Florida. Slutligen ges information om hur man kan hjälpa efter stormen. Rapportörer: Rachel Streitfeld, Kevin Liptak, Tom Watkins, Mike M. Ahlers.

article_content: Hong Kong celebrated the kickoff of the Gay Games on Saturday, making it the first time this international event is held in Asia. Despite political pushback, athletes gathered for nine days of sports and cultural festivities. Nearly 2,400 athletes from 45 regions—including large contingents from the US, UK, Australia, Hong Kong, and mainland China—are taking part in competitions from swimming and tennis to dragon boat racing and mahjong. The 2023 Games are also being held simultaneously in Guadalajara, Mexico, due partly to travel restrictions from the COVID-19 pandemic. The opening event featured a vibrant athlete parade and performances blending traditional Chinese arts with contemporary dance and theater. LGBTQ+ rights in Hong Kong have advanced recently, with court wins improving protections for same-sex couples regarding housing and inheritance. The government is also considering ways to recognize same-sex partnerships, although same-sex marriage isn’t legally acknowledged and anti-discrimination laws based on sexuality are still absent. Social attitudes are shifting, especially among youth, but divisions remain within the community. Certain lawmakers—especially Junius Ho—voiced opposition, claiming the event promotes ideas violating Hong Kong’s policies and the national security law introduced post-2019 protests. However, Executive Council member Regina Ip defied critics by attending the ceremony and commended Hong Kong’s historic role as the first Asian city to host the Games, reinforcing the city's place among liberal societies. Ip also celebrated the strong participation of local and mainland Chinese athletes. While broader China maintains a conservative approach to LGBTQ+ rights, Hong Kong officials reaffirm the importance of equality. Delegates from Taiwan—Asia’s first region to legalize same-sex marriage—also joined the Games, competing as ‘Chinese Taipei’. Taiwan’s recent Pride events have drawn large, supportive crowds, signaling increasing acceptance among families. Due to health and security concerns, Guadalajara shares hosting duties with Hong Kong this year. Although the security law has discouraged some travelers, local leaders maintain it has helped restore order. Despite complications, the Gay Games continues its mission to advance acceptance and visibility for sexual minorities across Asia, building on its origins in San Francisco in 1982.

Öppningsevenemanget bjöd på en färgstark parad av idrottare och framträdanden som blandade traditionell kinesisk kultur med modern dans och teater. HBTQ+-rättigheter i Hongkong har utvecklats på senare år, med domstolsbeslut som förbättrat skydden för samkönade par rörande bostad och arv. Trots utmaningar fortsätter Gay Games sitt arbete för acceptans och synlighet för sexuella minoriteter i Asien, en strävan som började i San Francisco 1982.

article_content: Sam Bankman-Fried, the former CEO of the collapsed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, appeared in court today at the beginning of his criminal trial. He faces seven charges, including wire fraud, securities fraud, and money laundering. The charges stem from allegations that Bankman-Fried misused billions of dollars in customer funds for personal purchases—such as acquiring more than $200 million in luxury real estate in the Bahamas—and to cover losses at his crypto hedge fund, Alameda Research. Prosecutors say customer funds were funneled to Alameda in two ways: through user deposits directly into Alameda accounts, and via a secret backdoor encoded within FTX’s systems. Authorities from the Southern District of New York assert that more than $8 billion is missing from customer accounts. They also allege that Bankman-Fried defrauded FTX investors by concealing this scheme. Additionally, the government accuses Bankman-Fried of using over $100 million of customer funds to make campaign contributions ahead of the 2022 US midterm elections. Bankman-Fried’s high-profile political donations, his advocacy of the 'effective altruism' movement, and his extensive comments during post-arrest interviews have contributed to intense public and media scrutiny. His actions and the media's fascination with his persona have sparked criticism of pundits who were previously taken in by him. Bankman-Fried is expected to testify in his own defense, though some observers remain skeptical about the outcome.

Anklagelserna bygger på att Bankman-Fried ska ha missbrukat miljardbelopp från kunders pengar till personliga köp – bland annat för över 200 miljoner dollar i lyxfastigheter på Bahamas – samt för att täcka förluster hos hans kryptofond Alameda Research. Åklagare menar att kundernas pengar skickades till Alameda på två sätt: dels via direkta insättningar på Alameda-konton, dels via en hemlig bakdörr i FTX:s kod. Myndigheter från Southern District of New York hävdar att över 8 miljarder dollar saknas från kundkonton. De menar också att Bankman-Fried lurade FTX:s investerare genom att dölja upplägget. Bankman-Fried förväntas vittna till sitt eget försvar, även om vissa bedömare förblir skeptiska till utgången.

article_content: Following recent clashes between Myanmar's military junta and rebel groups near the India-Myanmar border, tensions in Mizoram remain high. Mizoram police and Assam Rifles have boosted security along the border. Mizoram DGP Anil Shukla stated that, after the incident, about 75 Myanmar army personnel crossed into Mizoram and were safely returned to Myanmar by border forces. Many villagers from Myanmar's Kawmoi village, near Zokhawthar, temporarily sought refuge in India; most have returned, but some remain due to continued fears. The police, working with Assam Rifles, provided medical care to injured individuals, admitting them to Champhai Hospital and Aizawl Civil Hospital. While the security situation remains somewhat tense, police report that it is under control. About 500 people from Myanmar's Sekan village also crossed into the Zokhawthar area after airstrikes devastated their community. Indian authorities continue to monitor the border and provide humanitarian aid as needed.

article_content: Toronto Mayor Rob Ford has described rehab as 'amazing' and compared it to 'football camp,' expressing determination to return to the mayoral race in October. Currently on leave to address drug and alcohol issues, Ford shared with the Toronto Sun that he feels 'great' and is benefiting from treatment. From an undisclosed treatment center, Ford stated that group meetings and one-on-one sessions are part of his daily schedule. He likened the experience to a football camp he attended as a child, saying he is exercising daily and learning about himself and his past. Although there is no set timeline for his return, Ford assured supporters he will run for reelection, pledging to 'kick butt' this October. He joked there would be no need to change office locks because he would return. The rehab facility, according to Ford, specializes in treating addictions to alcohol and other substances and is 'worth every penny.' After a week of sobriety, Ford reflected on the events of the past year, expressing hope to make amends and move forward. He said the publicity around his struggles may have been what prompted him to seek help. Ford declined to reveal the name or location of the treatment center, respecting patient confidentiality and not confirming if he is in Canada. He decided to enter rehab after being seen in an apparently intoxicated state at a city pub on April 28 and told his brother, Doug Ford, the next morning. He has remained in touch with his family, speaking regularly with his children, though he has not fully explained the situation to them. Ford called seeking professional help the 'best decision' he's made and wishes he had done so earlier. After announcing his leave, Ford reportedly flew toward Chicago but was not admitted into the U.S., with officials stating he voluntarily withdrew his application rather than being denied entry. Both his brother and lawyer maintain that Ford is in rehab but have not disclosed his location. Political leaders in Toronto have called for more transparency regarding Ford's whereabouts. Some question his credibility, pointing to recent publicized videos that appear to show him using illegal substances and making inappropriate comments about a political rival. Ford has been at the center of multiple scandals since the original video of him allegedly using crack cocaine surfaced.

article_content: During a campaign rally in Harda, Madhya Pradesh ahead of the November 17 Assembly polls, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi accused the BJP-led state government of deep corruption, alleging kickbacks as high as 50% across projects. Gandhi highlighted a video purportedly showing Union Minister Narendra Singh Tomar's son mishandling funds designated for farmers and lower-income groups, and criticized federal agencies like the Enforcement Directorate, CBI, and Income Tax Department for not investigating the incident. Narendra Singh Tomar's son has denied the allegations, asserting that the video is fabricated, and has filed a police complaint against unknown individuals. Gandhi also charged the BJP with undermining the previous Congress-led Madhya Pradesh government, claiming MLAs were purchased following Congress's initiation of large-scale farm loan waivers. He said that during BJP’s rule, more than 18,000 farmers died by suicide due to indebtedness. Gandhi argued that the 2016 demonetisation favored major industrialists, including Gautam Adani, at the expense of small businesses and everyday citizens—contradicting government claims that it would fight black money. He emphasized that small entrepreneurs, not large corporations, are key job creators. He assured voters that a Congress government in Madhya Pradesh would introduce welfare schemes already seen in Congress-led Chhattisgarh: LPG cylinders for Rs 500, farm loan waivers up to Rs 2 lakh, a minimum wheat support price of Rs 2,600 (eventually rising to Rs 3,000), and free electricity for up to 100 units. Gandhi took issue with the BJP labelling tribal communities as ‘vanvasi’ instead of ‘Adivasi,’ and referred to a controversial incident in Sidhi where a BJP member allegedly urinated on a tribal man, highlighting what he described as systemic disrespect for marginalized groups. He claimed that Congress seeks to empower tribal youths to become professionals such as doctors and engineers, while the BJP discourages English education for tribal children. Gandhi was scheduled to continue his campaign with events in Bhopal. In other news, Indian investigative authorities are conducting tax-related probes into Apple, Google, and Amazon. Indian nationals are now the top real estate investors in Dubai, and Razorpay is considering moving its parent company to India via cross-border merger, which may incur significant US tax liabilities.

At the Council on Foreign Relations this week, Senator Marco Rubio addressed the ongoing crisis in Syria, calling for immediate action. "It's time to act now. I don't want to score political points; I want to see this issue resolved," Rubio told Time Magazine's Rick Stengel, the event moderator.

Although Rubio insists his focus is on solutions, his actions are increasingly scrutinized as he is considered a leading vice presidential candidate for Mitt Romney. Many Republicans view Rubio as an ideal running mate—he is a young, charismatic Tea Party favorite from Florida, a crucial swing state. Rubio is also Hispanic, representing a growing demographic in the United States, and one that Democrats have won decisively in past presidential elections.

In the 2008 presidential race, only 31% of Latino voters supported Sen. John McCain, compared to nearly 70% who voted for then-Sen. Barack Obama. The best performance by a Republican among Hispanic voters was George W. Bush's 44% in 2004. GOP strategists argue that nominating a Latino for vice president could help bridge this gap. "Republicans need about 40% of the Hispanic vote to be competitive nationally," said GOP strategist Leslie Sanchez. "Adding a Hispanic candidate demonstrates inclusivity and may encourage Latino independents to reconsider the Republican Party."

Two other Hispanic Republicans, New Mexico Governor Susana Martinez and Nevada Governor Brian Sandoval, are also mentioned as potential vice presidential picks. Martinez is a conservative and the first Latina governor in U.S. history, but has faced criticism from some in New Mexico's Hispanic community for her stance against granting driver's licenses to undocumented immigrants. Sandoval, known for fiscal conservatism, supports abortion rights—a position that could be problematic with some Republican voters. He also does not speak Spanish, despite his Latino heritage.

Alberto Gonzales, the first Latino U.S. attorney general, believes that selecting a Hispanic vice-presidential nominee may have some impact but will not be decisive. "I don't think it would make that much of a difference," Gonzales told CNN. He emphasized experience as crucial, noting Rubio, Martinez, and Sandoval have held their posts for just over eighteen months. Gonzales suggested Romney should pick someone ready to be president from day one.

A Romney source, however, pointed out that in a close election, a Latino running mate could influence the outcome in states with growing Hispanic populations, such as North Carolina and Virginia, in addition to traditional Hispanic strongholds.

One challenge in selecting a Hispanic candidate is the diversity within the Latino community itself. Rubio is Cuban-American, Martinez is Mexican-American, and two-thirds of U.S. Hispanics are of Mexican descent—only about 4% are Cuban. GOP strategist Sanchez highlighted this diversity, stating, "It's very different—different countries, different languages. We're not a monolithic voting bloc."

Some Latino politicians and strategists argue that Hispanics are a natural constituency for the Republican Party due to commonly-held conservative values. Sanchez and other strategists believe that the party's historical lack of outreach to Hispanic voters is the main problem, though recent years have seen improvement. However, tough immigration rhetoric during Republican primaries, especially from Romney, continues to worry Republican Latino strategists.

While opinions differ on whether a Latino vice-presidential candidate will win more Hispanic votes, there is consensus that the gesture would signal greater inclusiveness. If Romney were to select a Hispanic running mate and win, many believe it would be a point of pride for the Hispanic community.
