article_content:
A deadly accident occurred at a prominent construction site in Hamburg, northern Germany, on Monday morning when scaffolding suddenly collapsed. The disaster resulted in the deaths of five workers, while several others remain unaccounted for. The tragedy took place around 9:10am at the large Westfield Hamburg-Überseequartier project in HafenCity, an area undergoing significant redevelopment on the site of Hamburg’s old port.

According to the city's fire department, several workers became trapped beneath the fallen scaffolding, and ongoing rescue operations are underway to find those still missing. Initial reports indicate that the workers who lost their lives were constructing an elevator shaft when the structure gave way. Authorities have not yet determined what caused the collapse.

After the accident, all 700 workers present on the construction site were evacuated for safety. Emergency crews, numbering about 60, were deployed to search through the debris for survivors or additional victims.

Workplace safety data from Germany’s Federal Statistical Office show that fatal incidents at work, though rare, still occur — in 2021, one out of every 100,000 employees died in work-related accidents, the majority in sectors like construction and engineering, and most were men due to the male dominance in these industries.

En dödlig olycka inträffade på en känd byggarbetsplats i Hamburg, norra Tyskland, på måndagsmorgonen när byggnadsställningar plötsligt kollapsade. Olyckan resulterade i att fem arbetare omkom och flera saknas fortfarande. Tragedin ägde rum runt kl. 09:10 vid det stora projektet Westfield Hamburg-Überseequartier i HafenCity, där man bygger om området vid Hamburgs gamla hamn.

Enligt stadens brandförsvar blev flera arbetare fast under de vältande ställningarna och räddningsinsatsen pågår fortfarande för att hitta de saknade. Inledande rapporter anger att de arbetare som omkom byggde ett hisschakt när konstruktionen rasade. Orsaken till olyckan är ännu okänd.

Efter olyckan evakuerades alla 700 arbetare från platsen som en säkerhetsåtgärd. Ungefär 60 räddningsarbetare deltog i sökandet efter överlevande eller fler offer bland rasmassorna.

Enligt statistik från Tysklands federala statistikmyndighet är dödsolyckor på arbetsplatser sällsynta men förekommer – år 2021 omkom en av 100 000 anställda i arbetsrelaterade olyckor, oftast inom bygg- och ingenjörsbranschen där män är i majoritet.

article_content: A family has shared their happiness after being reunited with their escaped pet emu, Rodney. The bird was captured on a doorbell camera at a property in Loose, Kent, on Saturday. Kent Police responded to reports and helped locate the flightless bird on a residential street near its home. Owner Sarah Stribbling-Williams said she was 'delighted to have Rodney back home again.' The six-month-old emu escaped when one of her children accidentally let him out into the garden. 'I wasn't aware that he'd gone missing—I thought he was in his stable, and then a man arrived and said, "Have you lost your emu?"' Mrs Stribbling-Williams recalled. 'He'd walked down the footpath and was found in a neighbor's front garden.' 'We've had him since he was a four-day-old chick. He's a very friendly and tame member of the family,' Sarah added. 'He often comes inside the house, and when he's outside, he’ll come and tap on the kitchen window for treats. He spends his time with our seven children and our other animals—dogs, cats, horses, chickens—and can often be seen running around the garden with the dogs.' Ms Stribbling-Williams said she wasn’t surprised to see Rodney caught on doorbell footage trying to enter the home of local pensioner Maureen Roberts. Mrs Roberts said: 'I didn’t know the emu was in my garden until I saw the footage on my phone. I just couldn’t believe it until I heard the tapping noise at the door.'

article_content: Chris P. Bacon, a piglet born with deformed hind legs, has captured the internet’s heart after being fitted with a custom-made wheelchair. His owner, Clermont, Florida veterinarian Dr. Len Lucero, first built Chris P. a makeshift wheelchair from K’Nex toys to help the little pig move. Footage of ten-day-old Chris P. learning to get around has gone viral, with over half a million views, and the pig now boasts more than 17,000 Facebook fans and 1,250 Twitter followers. As the piglet has grown, he’s already outgrown two K’Nex wheelchairs. Dr. Lucero says Chris P. will soon be able to use a new wheelchair, generously donated by a company that designs mobility devices for animals. Chris P. was brought to Dr. Lucero in January when his original owners couldn’t care for him, and he’s since become famous online for his playful personality and perseverance. Until he’s big enough for his new wheels, Chris P. gets around Dr. Lucero’s office by hopping short distances. The soon-to-be-used wheelchair, which attaches with a harness, will allow Chris P. to propel himself forward with his front legs, as the wheels support his back end and mimic the height of functional hind legs. Dr. Lucero told the Orlando Sentinel that Chris P.’s celebrity has felt like a dream, saying, ‘People just love his story and his happy grunts and snorts.’ On social media, the piglet is a regular presence, tweeting jokes and even wishing followers a ‘Happy Voinkentines day,’ clearly enjoying his newfound fame.

En video på tio dagar gamla Chris P. när han lärde sig använda rullstolen har blivit viral, med över en halv miljon visningar, och nu har grisen över 17 000 Facebook-fans och 1 250 följare på Twitter. Eftersom griskultingen har vuxit har han redan vuxit ur två K’Nex-rullstolar. Dr Lucero säger att Chris P. snart kommer kunna använda sin nya rullstol, generöst donerad av ett företag som tillverkar rörelsehjälpmedel för djur. Chris P. kom till Dr Lucero i januari när hans ursprungliga ägare inte kunde ta hand om honom, och sedan dess har han blivit känd på nätet för sin lekfulla personlighet och envishet. Tills han blivit stor nog för sina nya hjul tar sig Chris P. fram genom att hoppa korta sträckor i Dr Luceros kontor. Den nya rullstolen, som fästs med en sele, kommer låta Chris P. skjuta sig framåt med frambenen medan hjulen stödjer hans bakdel och ger honom samma höjd som fungerande bakben. Dr Lucero berättade för Orlando Sentinel att Chris P.:s kändisskap känns som en dröm och säger: 'Folk älskar verkligen hans historia och hans glada grymtanden.' På sociala medier är kultingen ständigt närvarande, skämtar och önskar till och med följarna en 'Voinkentines-dag', och han verkar verkligen njuta av sitt nyfunna kändisskap.

article_content: A section of a newly constructed overpass in Belo Horizonte, southeastern Brazil, has collapsed onto a busy avenue, resulting in at least two deaths and 19 injuries. The structure, part of Brazil’s push to improve infrastructure ahead of the World Cup, gave way above Pedro I avenue, close to the Mineirao football stadium which has hosted recent tournament matches. Authorities reported that the viaduct landed on a car, two trucks, and a bus. Rescue operations are ongoing as concerns remain that more victims could be trapped under the rubble. Officials named the deceased bus driver among the fatalities, while the car involved was completely crushed by concrete. Witnesses believe the collapse occurred while workers were removing iron scaffolding supporting the viaduct. Rogerio Alves, who witnessed the collapse, described it as terrifying and difficult to grasp. Maria Nilza shared her account of narrowly avoiding the disaster as she saw the bridge fall on vehicles directly ahead. The incident has renewed attention on Brazil’s hurried infrastructure projects tied to the World Cup, which have faced criticism over safety and delays, and have previously resulted in deadly accidents. Authorities acknowledge that eight workers lost their lives on stadium construction sites in World Cup host cities. The collapsed overpass is located near the Minas Tennis Club, soon to be used as a training base for British Olympic and Paralympic athletes before the Rio 2016 Games. World Cup quarterfinal matches are set to take place nearby, adding to ongoing debates about safety amid rapid development.

article_content:
Google is set to launch a web-connected TV box in the UK on July 16, providing free HD video via YouTube. The £200 Sony device is voice-controlled and equipped with a motion-controlled remote for playing games. It allows access to video channels and web searches, and will also be incorporated into Sony Blu-ray players starting in October. Android phone users can use their devices as remotes for the box.

This device is a redesigned version of Google's web-TV service, offering improved processing speed. Earlier Google TV versions received mixed reviews in the US, with companies like Logitech reportedly losing $100 million on similar devices.

"Entertainment content is available through so many channels and sites, and Google TV helps consumers easily find what they want to watch, listen, or play with the freedom of the internet and using the familiar Chrome browser," said Gildas Pelliet, Sony's European Head of Marketing.

The TV box will provide access to the Google Play Store—much like Apple's App Store—offering apps such as Twitter and YouTube. Google states that TV-optimized apps will be added regularly. The remote is dual-sided, with a touchpad for cursor control on one side and a full keyboard for searches, emails, and social media updates on the other.

Google has recently revamped YouTube, introducing new channels and features designed to make it more 'TV-like.' Rumors suggest Apple is developing its own flatscreen TV, illustrating growing competition in the market.

The new Google TV box could represent a modern upgrade to the original Google TV, a web-streaming service launched in 2010 that struggled to achieve widespread popularity.

article_content: In a large-scale effort involving both Italian and Spanish police forces, 58 suspects were detained in connection with international drug trafficking, money laundering, and fraud. Nearly 400 officers, some accompanied by sniffer dogs, executed 96 coordinated searches in Italy, Spain, and Switzerland. The Italian cities of Milan, Turin, Rome, and Catania were among those targeted. During the year-long operation, authorities seized assets totaling €129 million. The probe highlighted the movement of funds via secretive banking operations, reportedly associated with members of the Chinese community. Officials believe the group was responsible for distributing around 30 million tonnes of hashish and marijuana.

article_content: The British Army is set to introduce new shirts with sleeves that can be rolled up in warm weather, addressing long-standing complaints from soldiers about previous uniforms. The current multi-terrain pattern uniforms, introduced in 2011, include foam elbow pads sewn into the sleeves, preventing them from being rolled up in hot environments such as Afghanistan. Starting in September, new shirts designed for improved comfort in warm conditions will become available. However, there are concerns among troops that they may have to wear external elbow pads—similar to those used by skateboarders and BMX riders—to prevent injuries, which some soldiers view as uncomfortable or awkward. According to a Ministry of Defence spokesman, the new shirts are intended for use in barracks and other non-combat or training settings only. He stated: 'Many soldiers have asked for the ability to roll up their sleeves during hot weather. The Army has been considering shirts we can wear in barracks for some time. The new shirt is simply an addition to our current uniform options.' Additionally, a policy change will allow soldiers to roll up the sleeves on their existing uniforms, provided the foam pads are removed and their officers approve, even before the new shirts are issued. The spokesman noted that elbow and knee pads are primarily used by infantry units, while the multi-terrain pattern uniforms are used by other Army sections. Some soldiers have criticized the multi-terrain uniform, calling it poorly fitting, badly designed, poorly made, and 'too American.' There are also complaints that the combat fatigues resemble action figures’ attire. The Ministry of Defence spent £40 million on the new outfits, claiming they offer greater comfort with body armour and improved camouflage.

Singhania’s Abakkus All Cap Approach declined by 3.5%, and his Emerging Opportunities Fund decreased by 1.4%. ASK Investment’s funds lost between 2% and 3%, while Helios Capital’s India Rising Fund was down 2%. A key driver for the negative performance was heavy selling by Foreign Institutional Investors, who unloaded more than Rs 24,000 crore in Indian stocks over concerns about rising bond yields and the Israeli conflict’s effects on international investment flows. Amidst the market downturn, Indian companies celebrated Diwali by giving a diverse array of gifts—including to contract and blue-collar staff—to boost employee morale. Presents ranged from gift hampers and sustainable products to electronics and silver coins. Meanwhile, companies in industries like banking, healthcare, and telecommunications are worried that India’s new data privacy legislation might limit their ability to use customer information for cross-selling various products and services. On the international front, Moody’s downgraded its outlook for US government credit from 'stable' to 'negative', highlighting high fiscal deficits and weaker debt affordability. The move received immediate pushback from President Joe Biden’s administration.

Leica, a renowned manufacturer with a storied legacy, has launched the M11-P, a premium camera costing $9,500. Tailored for professional photojournalists, the M11-P addresses growing concerns over image authenticity by introducing an advanced watermarking feature called Content Credentials. This system leaves a secure, digital signature in every photo’s metadata, essentially certifying each image as authentic.

With generative AI making it easy to create fake visuals—like deepfakes and fully artificial images—digital misinformation is becoming more common. Watermarking, which embeds unmistakable IDs into a file's data, is seen as a key defense, helping users verify whether photos have been altered.

Leica's communications highlight that, as distinguishing real images from edited ones becomes harder, Content Credentials can help restore confidence in photography. This initiative also strengthens Leica’s reputation for reliability in documenting important events.

These Content Credentials comply with the Content Authenticity Initiative (CAI), a coalition of media companies, NGOs, and technology providers promoting a standard for tracking the origins of digital content. Through cryptographic hashing, each photo gains a unique identifier, and if alterations occur, a record of changes is stored in the metadata. Users can then check the authenticity and edit history online, increasing transparency in digital media.

Eftersom generativ AI nu gör det enkelt att skapa fejkade bilder – till exempel deepfakes och helt artificiella foton – ökar digital desinformation snabbt. Vattenmärkning, som innebär att unika ID:n bäddas in i filens data, betraktas som ett viktigt skydd som hjälper användare att avgöra om bilder är manipulerade.

Leica poängterar att det blir allt svårare att avgöra om ett foto är äkta eller redigerat, och att Content Credentials kan återställa förtroendet för fotografi. Det stärker också Leicas roll som pålitligt verktyg för dokumentation av viktiga händelser.

Content Credentials följer standarden från Content Authenticity Initiative (CAI), en sammanslutning av mediebolag, ideella organisationer och teknikföretag som arbetar för spårbarhet och autenticitet för digitalt innehåll. Med hjälp av kryptografiskt hash får varje foto en unik identifierare, och eventuella ändringar sparas som en historik direkt i metadata. Användare kan därefter kontrollera både äkthet och redigeringshistorik online, vilket ökar transparensen kring digitala bilder.

More and more British homeowners are redesigning their gardens for entertainment and relaxation rather than traditional gardening. A OnePoll survey for Lloyds TSB Insurance found that about 1 in 10 UK households now boast a heated hot tub, indicating a growing focus on luxurious outdoor amenities despite the often chilly weather. The British and Irish Spa and Hot Tub Association notes that colder years actually see higher hot tub sales. Instead of nurturing flower beds, people are installing features like hot tubs, outdoor dining spaces, summer houses, and play areas for children, with the average UK garden now valued at £1,928.

While spending on such luxuries climbs, outdoor plant sales have dropped—The Garden Centre Association recorded a 15% fall in plant sales during the first half of 2012. Hot tubs, which arrived in Britain from Scandinavia via America in the 1970s, have become especially popular in the past decade. Prices start at about £3,000 and can exceed £17,500, and running a hot tub typically costs around £1 per day.

Hot tub ownership varies by region: as many as 20% of West Midlands respondents report having one, compared to just 2% in Northern Ireland. Still, not everyone enjoys this trend—noise from spa parties and hot tubs is increasingly cited as a nuisance in neighborhoods, with such complaints noted by BBC Gardeners’ World magazine.

Some, like Paula Tanner of Brighton, have embraced the change, renovating their gardens for leisure after their children left home and hosting friends in their hot tub. Yet gardening experts like ITV’s Frances Tophill hope the classic image of flower-filled British gardens doesn’t disappear as homeowners turn to convenient outdoor luxury.
translated_content:
Allt fler brittiska husägare gör om sina trädgårdar för umgänge och avkoppling istället för traditionell trädgårdsskötsel. En undersökning av OnePoll för Lloyds TSB Insurance visar att ungefär var tionde brittiskt hushåll nu har en uppvärmd bubbelpool, vilket signalerar ett ökande fokus på lyxiga utomhusmiljöer trots det omväxlande vädret. British and Irish Spa and Hot Tub Association rapporterar att försäljningen av bubbelpooler ökar under kalla år. Istället för att plantera blommor satsar fler på bubbelpooler, uteplatser, lusthus och lekområden för barn – och den genomsnittliga brittiska trädgården är nu värd 1 928 pund.

Samtidigt som investeringarna i dessa bekvämligheter ökar, minskar försäljningen av utomhusväxter – Garden Centre Association rapporterade en minskning på 15 procent under första halvåret 2012. Bubbelpooler kom till Storbritannien från Skandinavien via USA på 1970-talet och har blivit särskilt populära under det senaste decenniet. Priserna börjar på cirka 3 000 pund men kan överskrida 17 500 pund, och driftskostnaden ligger vanligtvis runt 1 pund per dag.

Ägarskapet varierar regionalt: i West Midlands har så många som 20 procent en bubbelpool, jämfört med endast 2 procent i Nordirland. Men trenden uppskattas inte av alla – klagomål om störande ljud från spa-partyn och bubbelpooler blir allt vanligare och har tagits upp i BBC Gardeners' World magazine.

Vissa, som Paula Tanner från Brighton, har tagit till sig förändringen och gjort om trädgården för avkoppling och nöje efter att barnen flyttat ut; hon bjuder gärna in vänner till sin bubbelpool. Samtidigt hoppas trädgårdsexperter som ITV:s Frances Tophill att den traditionella bilden av blomstrande brittiska trädgårdar inte går förlorad när husägare väljer bekväm utomhuslyx.

England was eliminated early from the 2014 FIFA World Cup after losing to Italy and Uruguay in Group D. Despite the disappointing results, Football Association (FA) chairman Greg Dyke confirmed that manager Roy Hodgson will remain in charge until at least the 2016 European Championship. Dyke emphasized that Hodgson has the full support of the FA, highlighting the long-term vision for England's national team.

England’s exit was sealed after Costa Rica defeated Italy. This marked the first time England failed to progress from the group stage since 1958. Dyke pointed out that England played well against Italy and suffered narrow defeats, adding that changing managers would not be beneficial. He set a target for England to win the World Cup in 2022 but acknowledged that achieving this would require significant changes in English football.

Hodgson admitted disappointment and accepted responsibility for the team's performance, stating that both he and the players had hoped to make the nation proud. Nonetheless, he expressed confidence in the squad’s young players and their potential for future success.

Goalkeeper Joe Hart echoed Hodgson’s sentiments, expressing respect for the manager and confirming that the team supports him. He noted the quality and leadership within the squad, despite the tough results.

Sir Trevor Brooking, FA director of football development, expressed optimism about the coming years, highlighting England's young talent and the benefits of their World Cup experience.

Trots de svaga resultaten bekräftade Fotbollsförbundets (FA) ordförande Greg Dyke att förbundskapten Roy Hodgson stannar kvar åtminstone till EM 2016. Dyke betonade att Hodgson har FA:s fulla stöd och lyfte fram den långsiktiga visionen för Englands landslag.

Englands uttåg blev klart efter att Costa Rica besegrat Italien. Detta var första gången sedan 1958 som England misslyckades med att ta sig vidare från gruppspelet. Dyke menade att England spelade bra mot Italien och förlorade med liten marginal, och tillade att ett tränarbyte inte skulle vara till någon nytta. Han satte som mål att England ska vinna VM 2022, men medgav att det kräver stora förändringar inom engelsk fotboll.

Hodgson uttryckte besvikelse och tog på sig ansvaret för lagets resultat, och sa att både han och spelarna hade hoppats göra nationen stolt. Han visade dock fortsatt förtroende för lagets unga spelare och deras framtida potential.

Målvakten Joe Hart instämde med Hodgson, hyllade förbundskaptenen och bekräftade lagets stöd för honom. Han framhöll kvaliteten och ledarskapet i truppen trots de tuffa resultaten.

Sir Trevor Brooking, FA:s fotbollsutvecklingschef, uttryckte optimism inför de kommande åren och poängterade betydelsen av Englands unga talanger och deras VM-erfarenheter.

article_content: A committee appointed by the Karnataka government to draft a new State Education Policy (SEP) has set up a sub-committee to assess the effectiveness of the four-year honours undergraduate programme introduced as part of the National Education Policy (NEP). The sub-committee is expected to submit an interim report before the SEP draft is prepared. The main SEP committee has been instructed to deliver the policy proposal by the end of February 2024. A state education department official noted, 'A decision on this issue should be made before the next academic year begins so that colleges can prepare accordingly.' Earlier, the state government scrapped the NEP and pledged to create a new education policy for Karnataka. The four-year undergraduate programme was introduced in 2021 across public and private universities, offering an exit option after three years. The NEP's four-year degree programme attracted criticism from colleges, which reported lacking sufficient infrastructure and resources, and having too little time to implement the changes. Sources suggest the sub-committee will first identify challenges—especially based on teacher input—before drafting alternatives. Academics in Bengaluru have welcomed the commission's decision to urgently review the four-year degree programme. A college principal said, 'The uncertainty around the four-year programme is affecting us. The first batch under NEP is already in its third year, so an immediate decision is needed.' He added, 'We need to know if we should prepare for the next batch, including faculty, infrastructure, and other resources.'
translated_content: En kommitté som utsågs av Karnatakas regering för att ta fram en ny statlig utbildningspolicy (SEP) har tillsatt en underkommitté för att utvärdera effektiviteten hos det fyraåriga hederskandidatprogrammet som infördes som en del av den nationella utbildningspolicyn (NEP). Underkommittén förväntas lämna en interimsrapport innan utkastet till SEP är färdigt. Huvudkommittén har blivit ombedd att lämna sitt policyförslag senast i slutet av februari 2024. En tjänsteman vid utbildningsdepartementet noterade: 'Ett beslut i denna fråga bör fattas innan nästa läsår startar, så att högskolorna kan förbereda sig.' Tidigare avskaffade delstatsregeringen NEP och lovade att skapa en ny utbildningspolicy för Karnataka. Det fyraåriga kandidatprogrammet infördes 2021 vid både offentliga och privata universitet och gav en möjlighet att avsluta efter tre år. Det fyraåriga utbildningsprogrammet enligt NEP har kritiserats av högskolor som pekar på bristande infrastruktur, begränsade resurser och för kort tid för genomförande. Källor menar att underkommittén först kommer att identifiera utmaningar—särskilt med lärarnas inspel—innan alternativa förslag tas fram. Akademiker i Bengaluru har välkomnat kommissionens beslut att snabbt se över det fyraåriga programmet. En rektor sade: 'Osäkerheten kring det fyraåriga programmet påverkar oss. Den första kullen under NEP är redan inne på sitt tredje år, så ett omedelbart beslut krävs.' Han tillade: 'Vi behöver veta om vi ska förbereda oss inför nästa kull, inklusive personal, infrastruktur och andra resurser.'

article_content: Super Eagles midfielder Alex Iwobi has urged Nigerians to be patient with the team, assuring that they are committed to qualifying for the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the USA, Canada, and Mexico. The Nigerian team has had a disappointing start in the African qualification series, collecting only two points from their first two matches—both ending in 1-1 draws against Lesotho in Uyo and Zimbabwe in Rwanda. Following their failure to qualify for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, these recent results have fueled concerns among fans about missing another global tournament. Addressing the media after the draw with Zimbabwe, Iwobi asked for understanding from supporters, assuring that the players will continue to fight for qualification. Iwobi commented, 'Of course, it’s disappointing; we should be getting more points and scoring more goals. However, we will not dwell on this. We’ll push and fight to the end to ensure we qualify.' He acknowledged the challenges of extensive travel between matches, but emphasized that players cannot use this as an excuse. He noted that while the first half against Zimbabwe was poor, the team improved in the second. 'It’s just the beginning,' Iwobi added. 'I urge Nigerian fans to stick with us because we’ll continue to give our best.' Before their next World Cup qualifier against South Africa in June 2024, the Super Eagles will participate in the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON), which will be held in Ivory Coast from January 13 to February 11.
translated_content: Super Eagles mittfältare Alex Iwobi har uppmanat nigerianer att ha tålamod med laget och försäkrar att de är engagerade i att kvalificera sig till VM 2026 i USA, Kanada och Mexiko. Det nigerianska laget har fått en trög start i det afrikanska kvalet, med bara två poäng från de två första matcherna – båda slutade 1-1 mot Lesotho i Uyo och Zimbabwe i Rwanda. Efter att Nigeria missade VM 2022 i Qatar har dessa resultat ökat oron bland supportrarna över att missa ännu en världscup. Efter krysset mot Zimbabwe vädjade Iwobi om förståelse från fansen och lovade att spelarna ska fortsätta kämpa för att kvalificera sig. Iwobi kommenterade: 'Självklart är det besvikelse, vi borde kunna ta fler poäng och göra fler mål. Men vi kommer inte fastna i detta – vi ska kämpa och ge allt för att kvala.' Han medgav att långa resor mellan matcherna varit tufft, men underströk att spelarna inte kan använda det som ursäkt. Han nämnde att den första halvleken mot Zimbabwe var svag, men laget såg förbättringar i den andra. 'Det är bara början,' tillade Iwobi. 'Jag uppmanar de nigerianska fansen att fortsätta stötta oss, för vi kommer att kämpa vidare.' Innan nästa VM-kval mot Sydafrika i juni 2024 kommer Super Eagles spela Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) 2023 i Elfenbenskusten, som pågår mellan 13 januari och 11 februari.

article_content: A tragic incident unfolded ahead of this weekend’s Breeders’ Cup at Santa Anita, as a racehorse collapsed and died after a suspected heart issue. Meanwhile, Arcangelo, the Belmont Stakes winner and a top contender for the $6 million Classic, was withdrawn due to an unresolved issue with his left hind foot. Arcangelo’s trainer, Jena Antonucci—the first female trainer to win the Belmont—explained that, despite efforts to address the problem after the colt’s shoe was removed, there wasn’t enough time to ensure his readiness. Antonucci expressed her commitment to prioritizing the horse’s health, saying, “The left hind foot is resolving, but I want to fully understand the situation before moving forward.” Arcangelo had drawn the No. 1 post position with 7-2 odds; his scratch now leaves 11 horses in the Classic field. Another major contender, Kentucky Derby winner Mage, did not compete after developing a fever and failing to arrive at Santa Anita. Practical Move, who died, was trained by Tim Yakteen and was the early second favorite for Saturday's $1 million Dirt Mile, having notched five wins in eight starts and considerable career earnings. The colt had recently returned to racing, securing a win at Santa Anita in October after missing the Kentucky Derby due to illness. Safety remains a major focus at Santa Anita, now hosting the Breeders’ Cup for a record 11th time—its first since 2019, when 42 horses, including Mongolian Groom (fatally injured in the Classic), died at the track. In response, significant safety and medication reforms were introduced. This year’s event is the first fully overseen by the Horseracing Integrity and Safety Authority, which sets unified safety and medication standards across the sport. Meanwhile, Geaux Rocket Ride, another Classic candidate, is struggling to recover after leg surgery for a repetitive strain injury suffered during a workout. Owner Pin Oak Stud reported that although the colt is comfortable and eating, his recovery is not progressing as hoped. Further evaluation is being conducted at a specialist veterinary hospital. The welfare of racehorses remains a top concern as the Breeders’ Cup approaches, with all involved reaffirming their commitment to equine safety amid recent setbacks.
translated_content: En tragisk incident inträffade inför helgens Breeders’ Cup på Santa Anita då en tävlingshäst föll ihop och dog efter en misstänkt hjärthändelse. Samtidigt har Arcangelo, vinnaren av Belmont Stakes och en av favoriterna till Classic-loppet med prissumman sex miljoner dollar, dragit sig ur på grund av ett olöst problem med sin vänstra bakhov. Arcangelos tränare, Jena Antonucci—den första kvinnliga tränaren att vinna Belmont—förklarade att det, trots försök att åtgärda problemet efter att hästens sko tagits bort, inte fanns tillräckligt med tid för att säkerställa att han var redo. Antonucci uttryckte att hon alltid prioriterar hästens hälsa och sa: ”Hovproblemet är på väg att lösas, men jag vill helt förstå situationen innan vi går vidare.” Arcangelo hade lottats till spår 1 med oddsen 7–2; hans avhopp innebär att det nu är 11 hästar kvar i Classic-fältet. En annan toppkandidat, Kentucky Derby-vinnaren Mage, deltog inte efter att ha fått feber och aldrig anlänt till Santa Anita. Practical Move, som dog, tränades av Tim Yakteen och var tidig andrahandsfavorit till lördagens Dirt Mile på en miljon dollar, med fem segrar på åtta starter och betydande prispengar. Han hade nyligen återvänt till tävlingsbanan efter att ha missat Kentucky Derby på grund av sjukdom, och vann ett lopp på Santa Anita i oktober. Säkerheten är fortsatt i fokus på Santa Anita, som nu arrangerar Breeders’ Cup för rekord elfte gången—första gången sedan 2019 då 42 hästar, inklusive Mongolian Groom (som avled efter en skada i Classic), omkom på banan. Dessa händelser ledde till omfattande reformer kring säkerhet och medicinering. Årets tävling är den första under full tillsyn av Horseracing Integrity and Safety Authority, som sätter gemensamma regler för säkerhet och medicinering i sporten. Samtidigt har Geaux Rocket Ride, ännu en Classic-kandidat, problem med återhämtningen efter en benoperation för en belastningsskada som uppstod under träning. Ägaren Pin Oak Stud rapporterar att hästen är bekväm och äter, men återhämtningen går inte som förväntat. Ytterligare utvärdering pågår nu på ett specialistdjursjukhus. Hästarnas välfärd förblir i centrum inför Breeders’ Cup, och arrangörerna betonar sitt engagemang för djurens säkerhet efter de senaste svårigheterna.

article_content: Climate activist Greta Thunberg has appeared before magistrates, denying a public order offence linked to her arrest at a protest in central London. The 20-year-old Swedish national was detained during a demonstration near the InterContinental Hotel in Mayfair on 17 October, where oil industry executives were meeting. Thunberg pleaded not guilty at Westminster Magistrates' Court to a charge under Section 14 of the Public Order Act 1986. Four other activists from Fossil Free London also pleaded not guilty. For her safety, Thunberg’s address in Stockholm was not read in court, due to reported threats. The protesters were granted unconditional bail, with their trial scheduled for 1 February at City of London Magistrates' Court. Outside Westminster Magistrates' Court, Greenpeace and Fossil Free London supporters gathered, chanting and holding banners that read 'oily money out' and 'make polluters pay.' A large group of photographers and video journalists surrounded Thunberg as she left court. Unable to make her way through the crowd, she abruptly changed direction and ran down Marylebone Road. The Metropolitan Police had placed conditions on the 17 October protest under Section 14 of the Public Order Act, aiming to prevent significant disruption for the community, hotel, and its guests. Dozens of protesters blocked Hamilton Place near Park Lane at the start of the three-day Energy Intelligence Forum—formerly known as the Oil and Money conference—where senior executives from Shell and Total were due to speak. Activists carried banners and distinctive pink umbrellas with eyes painted on, shouted 'cancel the conference,' and set off yellow and pink flares. According to the Met Police, several protesters who refused to move from the road to the pavement were arrested. article_content: A 10-year-old boy has died after suffering a severe head injury when a modified golf cart he was riding in overturned and landed on him at the exclusive Beverly Park community, north of Beverly Hills. Mark Martinez died Sunday evening at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center in Los Angeles, around two hours after the crash. The incident happened in Beverly Park, a gated neighborhood home to many celebrities, including Eddie Murphy, Mark Wahlberg, Denzel Washington, Charlie Sheen, Sylvester Stallone, and Samuel L. Jackson. Fire Department spokesman Brian Humphrey reported that the cart was carrying two men and three boys when it tipped over. Only the 10-year-old boy was seriously injured; the other occupants were unharmed. Mark was transported to the hospital in critical condition but did not survive. The Los Angeles Police Department is investigating the accident, but no further details have been released. Residents of Beverly Park commonly use mopeds, bicycles, and modified golf carts for transportation within the community, which is known for its expensive homes typically valued between $15 million and $50 million. Lisa Vanderpump and Adrienne Maloof, both former stars of The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills, previously lived in the neighborhood. In 2011, Dr. Paul Nassif, Maloof’s then-husband, called 911 to assist neighbor Charlie Sheen, who was experiencing severe abdominal pain.

Mark Martinez dog på söndag kväll på Cedars-Sinai Medical Center i Los Angeles, cirka två timmar efter olyckan. Lisa Vanderpump och Adrienne Maloof, båda tidigare stjärnor i The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills, har bott i området. A recently conducted survey has shown that although many adults have extensive lifetime ambitions—like witnessing the world’s wonders, embarking on an African safari, or swimming with dolphins—the average person achieves only about five items on their bucket list. The poll, carried out with 2,000 adults and commissioned by the outdoor clothing company Helly Hansen, revealed that time shortages, issues with fitness, fear of injury, and sometimes a lack of ambition are common reasons people do not accomplish more of their goals.

The most frequent aspirations include increasing personal wealth, traveling the world, witnessing the Northern Lights, hiking the Great Wall of China, and achieving financial freedom by paying off a mortgage. Additional popular objectives involve writing a novel, learning a new language, visiting famous historical sites like the Egyptian pyramids, road-tripping along Route 66, and experiencing luxury hotels. Some less conventional ambitions listed by respondents involve inventing something transformative, touring New Zealand in a motorhome, driving a Formula One car, and enjoying attractions like gambling in Las Vegas or exploring Harry Potter World.

Despite the range of dreams, over a third of people surveyed cited a lack of time, while one in five feared injury. More than a quarter considered themselves not fit enough, and close to half recognized a need to become more adventurous. Notably, 12% of individuals admitted to not having any particular ambitions.

A Helly Hansen representative commented that it is inspiring to see enthusiasm for new experiences but disheartening that low self-confidence keeps many from pursuing their dreams. They highlighted that outdoor activities can positively impact mental wellness and suggested that setting a new goal each year—even a small one—can be an effective way to improve health and self-assurance.

En nyligen gjord undersökning visar att även om många vuxna har stora drömmar för livet—som att se världens sju underverk, åka på safari i Afrika eller simma med delfiner—så lyckas genomsnittspersonen bara uppfylla omkring fem mål på sin lista. Undersökningen, som omfattade 2 000 vuxna och beställdes av friluftsvarumärket Helly Hansen, visade att tidsbrist, bristande kondition, rädsla för att skada sig samt ibland även avsaknad av ambition ofta gör att människor inte når sina drömmar.

De mest förekommande önskemålen är att bli förmögen, resa jorden runt, se norrskenet, vandra på Kinesiska muren och bli skuldfri genom att betala av sitt bolån. Andra populära mål är att skriva en roman, lära sig ett nytt språk, besöka berömda platser som Egyptens pyramider, bila längs Route 66 och bo på lyxhotell. Några mer ovanliga drömmar är att uppfinna något banbrytande, resa runt Nya Zeeland i husbil, köra en Formel 1-bil och uppleva saker som att spela på kasino i Las Vegas eller besöka Harry Potter-världen.

Trots denna variation av drömmar uppgav över en tredjedel av de svarande att de har för lite tid, en av fem fruktar skador och mer än en fjärdedel känner att de inte är tillräckligt tränade. Nästan hälften anser även att de borde bli mer äventyrliga. Värt att notera är att 12 % av de tillfrågade erkände att de inte har några särskilda drömmar alls.

En representant från Helly Hansen kommenterade att det är inspirerande att människor vill ha nya upplevelser, men också tråkigt att låg självkänsla hindrar många från att förverkliga sina drömmar. Hon framhöll att utomhusaktiviteter kan stärka det mentala välmåendet och föreslog att det kan vara positivt att sätta upp åtminstone ett nytt mål varje år för att förbättra hälsa och självförtroende.

article_content: Manchester City manager Manuel Pellegrini insists that his team's week-long trip to Abu Dhabi did not contribute to their surprising FA Cup defeat against Championship side Middlesbrough. The Premier League champions spent five days before Saturday’s fourth-round match at a warm-weather training camp in the United Arab Emirates, returning to Manchester on Friday evening. After goals from Patrick Bamford and Kike led to a 2-0 defeat at the Etihad Stadium, questions were raised about the timing of the trip. Despite the loss, Pellegrini refused to blame the travel. He and his players arrived back in Manchester around 8pm on Friday, with David Silva and Vincent Kompany heading straight to the club’s training base to prepare for the game. Pellegrini, who could have returned a day earlier after a friendly against Hamburg, denied that the travel schedule was to blame. In his post-match press conference, Pellegrini said, 'I don’t think so,' when asked if the trip was a factor in the defeat. 'I don’t agree but you can have your opinion. I have a different opinion. We had six or seven clear chances to score at the start—I think we played very well. After they scored their goal, we became disorganized and they had another counter-attack and could have scored more. It’s very easy to say the trip is the reason, but I don’t think that is the case. You can analyze the game as you want, but I see it differently.' Patrick Bamford gave Middlesbrough the lead early in the second half and celebrated with his teammates at the Etihad Stadium. City players James Milner, Dedryck Boyata, and Fernando showed their disappointment after conceding. Substitute Kike sealed Middlesbrough’s place in the next round with a late goal in stoppage time. City dominated the first half but were repeatedly denied by Middlesbrough’s former Real Madrid goalkeeper, Tomas Mejias. Bamford’s goal in the 53rd minute changed the momentum of the game, and Kike’s late strike secured the result. Pellegrini reflected: 'We played very well before they scored. After that, Middlesbrough deserved to go through. But it isn’t normal not to score in our last two home games. I believe there are many football reasons for this result, not just the trip to Abu Dhabi.'

Pellegrini, som kunde ha återvänt en dag tidigare efter en träningsmatch mot Hamburg, förnekade att reseschemat låg bakom nederlaget. På presskonferensen efter matchen sade Pellegrini: 'Jag tror inte det', när han fick frågan om resan var en faktor till förlusten. 'Jag håller inte med men du får ha din åsikt. Jag har en annan syn. Vi hade sex eller sju klara målchanser i början — jag tycker vi spelade väldigt bra. Efter deras mål blev vi oorganiserade, och de hade ytterligare en kontring och kunde ha gjort fler mål. Det är väldigt lätt att säga att resan var orsaken, men jag tycker inte det. Du kan analysera matchen på ditt sätt, men jag ser det annorlunda.' City dominerade första halvlek men blev ständigt stoppade av Middlesbroughs tidigare Real Madrid-målvakt Tomas Mejias. Efter det förtjänade Middlesbrough att gå vidare. Men det är inte normalt att vi inte gör mål i de två senaste hemmamatcherna. Jag tror det finns många fotbollsmässiga orsaker till det här resultatet, inte bara resan till Abu Dhabi.'

article_content: Pasadena, California (CNN) -- On Wednesday, NASA's Mars rover Curiosity successfully raised the mast containing many of its instruments, allowing mission controllers to view the ground marked by the rockets that delivered it onto the Martian surface. The car-sized rover landed on Mars early Monday after a dramatic descent, which ended with a 'skycrane' gently lowering it onto its landing spot. Once the mast was elevated, cameras on Curiosity transmitted new images, revealing about half a meter (19 inches) of 'scour marks' left by the rocket exhaust. These marks give mission controllers an early look at the bedrock beneath Gale Crater, according to John Grotzinger, project scientist for Curiosity at the California Institute of Technology. Grotzinger stated there appears to be a harder, rockier material beneath the gravel and pebbles, and noted evidence of impact ejecta. Although Curiosity isn't ready to drive yet, the landing has already created an 'exploration hole' into the crater's surface. Curiosity's objective is to determine whether Mars ever had an environment that could support life. Its main destination is Mount Sharp, the 5,500-meter (18,000-foot) peak at the center of Gale Crater, where scientists plan to study the planet's history in detail. Grotzinger mentioned that the landscape in the latest images may seem familiar, joking that it almost looked like a photo taken in the Mojave Desert. Controllers are still activating Curiosity's instrument package, and all antennas used to communicate data are functioning perfectly, according to mission manager Jennifer Trosper. The onboard weather monitoring unit is reported to be operating well after a brief issue on Tuesday. Trosper added that the high-bandwidth antenna is sending back large amounts of data, and Curiosity is expected to capture a color panorama of its surroundings on Thursday. Vandi Tompkins, one of Curiosity's operators, explained that the images being received will be used to program the rover's movements, since it takes about 14 minutes for a radio signal to travel between Earth and Mars. This delay means operators cannot control the rover in real time. Instead, the team uses the photos to create a plan for the next day, uploads it to the rover, and then receives the results. Curiosity will begin its third full Martian day, or sol, on Thursday; a sol is roughly 40 minutes longer than an Earth day. Curiosity is designed to run for two years, though the earlier Opportunity rover has operated on Mars since 2004, exceeding its original three-month mission. Opportunity's twin rover, Spirit, worked from 2004 until 2010. CNN's John Zarrella contributed to this report.

Karnataka’s political scene is currently marked by a clash between Chief Minister Siddaramaiah and Janata Dal (Secular) state president HD Kumaraswamy, following allegations of corruption over official transfers. Kumaraswamy has claimed that Siddaramaiah and his son, Dr Yathindra, were involved in manipulating the transfers of government officials, presenting a recent video as evidence. The footage shows Dr Yathindra, while his father is present, instructing an official to stick to a specific list of recommended names for transfer. 

Kumaraswamy has used both social media and press statements to challenge Siddaramaiah, insisting on straightforward answers about the incident. In response, Siddaramaiah has denied any wrongdoing and has said he would retire from politics if Kumaraswamy provides proof of financial misconduct. Siddaramaiah further tried to deflect the allegations by referencing similar controversies during Kumaraswamy’s own time as chief minister. 

The confrontation escalated as Kumaraswamy questioned the legal basis for Dr Yathindra’s involvement in official affairs, especially in the Varuna constituency. He accused Siddaramaiah of unofficially transferring responsibilities to his son, calling it an attempt to hand over power indirectly. 

This row comes at a time when assembly elections are approaching in Karnataka. Siddaramaiah and Kumaraswamy were once colleagues in the JDS before Siddaramaiah’s switch to Congress in 2005. Now, the ongoing controversy has put the state’s Congress government in the spotlight just as the election season heats up.

article_content: More student debt relief is coming for borrowers who attended the boot camp Prehired. On Monday, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB), along with 11 states, announced a federal court order requiring Prehired to provide over $30 million in relief to student loan borrowers who entered into income-share agreements (ISAs) with the company. The CFPB and states sued Prehired in July, claiming it misrepresented the nature of the ISAs offered to students in its 12-week online training program. Typically, ISAs require students to pay a percentage of their income after completing the program, but the CFPB found these agreements to be illegal and inadequately disclosed to borrowers. CFPB Director Rohit Chopra stated, 'Prehired lured student borrowers into debt with false promises of job placements and claims that students wouldn't have to pay until they got a job.' Chopra added, 'Today's action with our state partners ensures that borrowers harmed by Prehired can receive redress and have their illegal loans canceled.' The CFPB said that Prehired falsely advertised that borrowers would not need to repay until securing a job with a salary over $60,000, while in reality, graduates were required to repay loans regardless of employment status. According to the court order issued Monday, Prehired must refund $4.2 million to borrowers who made ISA payments between May 2019 and March 2023, and cancel all outstanding ISAs valued at approximately $27 million. Prehired is also permanently barred from offering ISAs in the future. Borrowers who believe they qualify for relief should email info@PreHiredClaims.com to ensure the CFPB has their information. Prehired did not immediately respond to requests for comment regarding the announcement. The CFPB's initial complaint also revealed that Prehired filed more than 280 lawsuits in 2022 against former students who defaulted on their loans, seeking $25,000 from each. Prehired filed for bankruptcy in 2022, and while these lawsuits have since been dropped, the company stated in bankruptcy filings that it believed the lawsuits were in the best interest of both the defaulted members and the company, by reducing the amount owed from $30,000 to $25,000 and allowing members to participate virtually. Additionally, Prehired faced investigations and legal actions in 2022 from the Delaware Justice Department and Washington's Attorney General, who accused the company of deceptive practices.

I måndags tillkännagav Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB), tillsammans med 11 delstater, ett federalt domstolsbeslut som kräver att Prehired ska tillhandahålla över 30 miljoner dollar i skuldlättnad till studielåntagare som ingått inkomstdelningsavtal (ISA) med företaget. CFPB och delstaterna stämde Prehired i juli och hävdade att företaget hade vilselett studenter om villkoren för de ISA som erbjöds till studenter i deras 12 veckors onlineutbildningsprogram. ISA innebär vanligtvis att studenter betalar en procentandel av sin inkomst efter avslutat program, men CFPB fann dessa avtal olagliga och bristfälligt redovisade för låntagarna. CFPB:s direktör Rohit Chopra sa: 'Prehired lockade studielåntagare till skulder med falska löften om jobberbjudanden och påståenden om att studenter inte behövde betala förrän de fått ett jobb.' Chopra tillade: 'Dagens åtgärd med våra delstatliga partners säkerställer att låntagare som skadats av Prehired kan få kompensation och att deras olagliga lån annulleras.' CFPB meddelade att Prehired felaktigt marknadsfört att låntagare inte behövde börja återbetala förrän de säkrat ett jobb med en lön över 60 000 dollar, medan studenter i verkligheten var tvungna att återbetala oavsett anställningsstatus. Enligt domstolsbeslutet från i måndags måste Prehired återbetala 4,2 miljoner dollar till låntagare som gjort ISA-betalningar mellan maj 2019 och mars 2023 och annullera alla utestående ISA värda cirka 27 miljoner dollar. Prehired är dessutom permanent förbjudet att erbjuda ISA i framtiden. Låntagare som tror att de är berättigade till kompensation bör mejla info@PreHiredClaims.com för att säkerställa att CFPB har deras uppgifter. Prehired har inte svarat på förfrågningar om kommentarer om tillkännagivandet. CFPB:s ursprungliga anmälan visade också att Prehired lämnade in över 280 stämningar under 2022 mot tidigare studenter som hade misslyckats med återbetalning, där man krävde 25 000 dollar per person. Prehired ansökte om konkurs 2022, och även om dessa stämningar nu har dragits tillbaka, uppgav företaget i konkursansökan att de trodde att stämningarna låg i både de betalningsförsumliga medlemmarnas och bolagets intresse, eftersom det minskade skuldbeloppet från 30 000 till 25 000 dollar och gjorde det möjligt för medlemmar att delta virtuellt. Dessutom utsattes Prehired 2022 för utredningar och rättsliga åtgärder från både Delaware Justice Department och Washingtons Justitieminister, som anklagade företaget för vilseledande affärsmetoder.

article_content: The Chief of Army Staff, Lt. Gen. Taoreed Lagbaja, has described the passing of Major General (retired) Aderonke Kale as a great loss to the Nigerian Army and the wider military community. Major General Kale was the first female officer in both the Nigerian Army and West Africa to be promoted to the rank of Major General, and was the first woman to command a military hospital in Nigeria. She died on November 8, 2023. In a statement on Saturday, Brigadier General Onyema Nwachukwu, Director of Army Public Relations, noted that Kale served the military with diligence and unwavering loyalty. The statement read: 'The Nigerian Army has received, with heavy heart but in absolute submission to the will of Almighty God, the news of the passing of Major General Aderonke Kale (retired). This outstanding veteran showed unmatched commitment, diligence, and loyalty as she rose to become the first female Major General in the Nigerian Army.' The Chief of Army Staff sent his condolences on behalf of all officers, soldiers, and civilian staff to the family, friends, and relations of the late senior officer, calling her death a profound loss. Kale's legacy of selfless service to Nigeria and humanity is indelible. She was renowned for reshaping perceptions of women in the military and advancing gender mainstreaming in the Nigerian armed forces. Born into a family of professionals—her father a pharmacist and her mother a teacher—Kale completed her primary education in Lagos and Zaria, and attended St. Anne’s School, Ibadan and Abeokuta Grammar School for her secondary education. She studied medicine at University College, which became University of Ibadan, and specialized in psychiatry at the University of London. After graduating, she worked briefly in Britain before returning to Nigeria in 1971, joining the Nigerian Army in 1972. Kale’s expertise as a psychiatrist was recognized in 1973 when she qualified as a consultant psychiatrist and later, in 1982, became chief consultant. From 1980 to 1985, she served as Commanding Officer of the Military Hospital in Ibadan, becoming the first woman to head a military hospital in Nigeria. She repeated this achievement at Military Hospital Enugu (1985–1987) and Military Hospital Benin (1989–1990). Her experience led to her elevation as Deputy Commandant of the Nigerian Army Medical Corps and School from 1991 to 1994. In 1994, she was promoted to Major General—the first female to achieve this rank in the Nigerian Army and West Africa—and soon after became the Commandant of the Nigerian Army Medical Corps, overseeing the health care of the entire Army. Kale's contributions to the military and the nation remain enduring.

article_content: England triumphed over Scotland 3-1 at Celtic Park in Glasgow during an international friendly, marking their first meeting in Scotland in 15 years. The game drew about 50,000 attendees, including former First Minister Alex Salmond, who was present shortly after resigning as SNP leader following the Scottish Referendum loss. Wayne Rooney scored twice for England, and Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain added a goal, while Andrew Robertson provided Scotland’s only score. Despite strong hopes from the home crowd, Scotland was unable to prevail against their traditional rivals. The historic fixture brought approximately 5,000 England fans to Glasgow. Policing was heightened to avoid crowd trouble—while the atmosphere was lively and included anti-IRA chants from a section of England supporters, there were no reports of significant disorder, a change from previous matches that saw violence. Prior to kick-off, fans and players observed a minute’s applause in tribute to Nathan McSeveney, a Scotland supporter who died during a previous match at the stadium. The event also featured a UNICEF appeal for Ebola victims, with the UK government promising to match donations up to £5 million. Supporters were divided about whether the Scotland-England fixture should become an annual event. Some enjoy the excitement it generates, while others prefer the rivalry remains occasional. Both teams entered the match in good form, with recent successes in their Euro 2016 qualifiers. After the game, England manager Roy Hodgson expressed an apology for any offensive chanting, noting he was unaware of the specifics at the time. Thanks to effective police presence, no major football-related incidents were reported. Although Scotland’s hopes for a home win were dashed, fans are already looking ahead to future opportunities.

Braxton Rayner, a two-year-old from Dalby, Queensland, appears to be a typical, adventurous toddler, but he is battling a rare and inoperable brain tumour. In his short life, Braxton has already undergone two brain surgeries, suffered from meningitis, experienced multiple seizures, and had eight MRI scans. Recently, his parents, Kirsten Kay and Clinton Rayner, received the devastating news that Braxton’s tumour has started to grow again.

This week, Braxton is scheduled for a third surgery in an attempt to obtain a biopsy, which is necessary for doctors to learn more about the tumour and to determine whether it is malignant. Previous attempts to obtain a biopsy through the top of Braxton's head were unsuccessful as the tumour could not be seen. The only alternative is to operate from the back of his head, but this option poses a high risk of blindness or loss of movement, since the tumour is located at the top of his spinal cord.

Braxton’s parents explained that doctors cannot provide the appropriate chemotherapy without a biopsy. His mother, Kirsten, described the anguish of facing these difficult decisions, saying, “My son is always on the go, he loves being outside. We can’t take that away from him—it’s a very hard and difficult decision for us.”

Braxton’s treatments have involved frequent trips between their home in rural Dalby and Brisbane Children’s Hospital. Despite all the procedures and trauma he has endured in the past 11 months, Braxton’s parents say he has demonstrated remarkable courage and resilience. Kirsten shared, “He’s been through more than most adults would endure, and he’s so brave. As soon as he wakes up from surgery, he’s running around and smiling. You wouldn’t know he had a serious condition.”

Braxton’s symptoms began in October 2013, when he started walking into walls and falling over. Three weeks later, he stopped walking altogether. Initially, doctors thought it was an ear infection, but after further examination and an MRI, Braxton was diagnosed with a brain tumour and was immediately transferred to Brisbane for surgery.

The ongoing medical care and frequent travel have caused financial strain for the family. Kirsten and Clinton had just built a new home before Braxton’s birth, and they said they would be willing to sell it if necessary to continue supporting his care. The Braxton Fight Foundation was created to help raise funds for the two-year-old’s medical treatment. More information can be found on the Braxton’s Fight Facebook page.

Braxton Rayner, en tvåårig pojke från Dalby i Queensland, verkar vara ett vanligt, äventyrligt litet barn, men han kämpar mot en sällsynt och icke-opererbar hjärntumör. Under sitt korta liv har Braxton redan gått igenom två hjärnoperationer, haft hjärnhinneinflammation, drabbats av flera anfall och gjort åtta magnetkameraundersökningar. Nyligen fick hans föräldrar, Kirsten Kay och Clinton Rayner, det förkrossande beskedet att Braxtons tumör har börjat växa igen.

Den här veckan väntar en tredje operation i hopp om att ta en biopsi, vilket är nödvändigt för att läkarna ska kunna förstå mer om tumören och avgöra om den är elakartad. Tidigare försök att ta en biopsi genom toppen av Braxtons huvud har misslyckats eftersom tumören inte gick att se. Enda alternativet är att operera bakifrån hans huvud, men det innebär stor risk för blindhet eller förlamning eftersom tumören sitter vid övre delen av ryggmärgen.

Braxtons föräldrar har berättat att läkarna inte kan ge rätt cellgiftsbehandling utan en biopsi. Hans mamma, Kirsten, beskrev hur svårt det är att ta sådana beslut och sa: "Min son är alltid aktiv och älskar att vara utomhus. Vi kan inte ta ifrån honom det—det är ett otroligt svårt beslut för oss."

Braxtons behandlingar har inneburit många resor mellan hemmet i Dalby och Brisbane Children’s Hospital. Trots alla ingrepp och den stress han gått igenom de senaste elva månaderna, säger hans föräldrar att Braxton har visat ett enastående mod och uthållighet. Kirsten berättade: "Han har varit med om mer än de flesta vuxna, och han är så modig. Så fort han vaknar efter en operation springer han runt och ler. Man skulle aldrig tro att han har en allvarlig sjukdom."

Braxtons symtom började i oktober 2013, då han började gå in i väggar och ramla. Tre veckor senare slutade han gå helt. Först trodde läkarna att det var en öroninflammation, men efter vidare undersökningar och en MRI konstaterades att Braxton hade en hjärntumör och han skickades direkt till Brisbane för operation.

Den löpande vården och de täta resorna har inneburit ekonomiska påfrestningar för familjen. Kirsten och Clinton hade precis byggt ett nytt hem innan Braxton föddes, och de säger att de är beredda att sälja huset om det behövs för att fortsätta ge honom den vård han behöver. Braxton Fight Foundation har skapats för att samla in pengar till tvååringens vård. Mer information finns på Braxtons Fights Facebook-sida.

article_content: Deepening ideological divides, challenges with housing affordability, and the rise of remote work have prompted many Americans to move to states that better align with their needs. Texas has emerged as one of the top choices. Recently released Census data show that Texas is the second most popular destination for newcomers, just behind Florida. Between 2021 and 2022, over 668,300 people relocated to the Lone Star State, while about 494,000 people left Texas during the same period. Texas has long been known for its reasonable cost of living, making it attractive to newcomers. According to RentCafe, Texas’s overall living costs are about 8% lower than the national average. The median home sale price in Texas was $347,800 in September, more than $64,000 less than the US median, according to Redfin. Texas receives the most new residents from California, a state struggling with high housing costs and increasing political polarization. Census data indicates that over 102,000 Californians moved to Texas between 2021 and 2022—the nation’s most popular relocation route. Florida and New York followed as top sources. Rogelio Saenz, a demography professor at the University of Texas at San Antonio, told USA Today that the main factor is housing affordability. Saenz explained, “The steep housing prices and cost of living in California represent major reasons for the movement.” Redfin data shows California’s median home price was $787,000 in September, one of the highest in the country, and according to RentCafe, California’s cost of living is 42% higher than the national average. Many Californians say they enjoy a better quality of life in Texas. Hailey Eustace, an Austin resident, highlighted the city’s growing tech scene and friendlier culture: “I’m friends with people from San Francisco who’ve moved to Texas and now have more work-life balance. As you get older, you realize the value in that.” While high home prices drive people from California to Texas, political differences are another consideration. Jackie Burse, a Conservative from Orange County, moved to San Antonio in 2021 and told Insider that California’s liberal climate influenced her decision. “We should have the freedom to speak our opinions or live our lives the way we want, regardless of political party. I think this is a value Texans also share,” she said. Movement is not one-sided; many Texans are also relocating elsewhere. Between 2021 and 2022, about 494,000 people left Texas. California was the top destination for these movers, with over 42,200 Texans heading west, followed by Florida and Oklahoma. Soaring costs—especially in Austin—are pushing some residents to leave. Insider previously reported that median home prices in Austin more than doubled between 2011 and 2021, thanks in part to increased demand from remote workers and tech companies, making Austin one of the least affordable cities in the country. Home prices for less expensive properties in Austin have declined, but overall prices remain high, with a median of $548,900, according to Redfin. Nicole Nabulsi Nosek, board chair of Texans for Reasonable Solutions, told Insider, “People have come around to the fact that they’re either leaving, or they know that their own kids won’t be able to buy a home if things don’t change.” Some Californians who moved to Texas during the pandemic have found the climate difficult. Austin-based real estate agent Danielle Fountain said she’s seen clients leave the state because of the heat. “When 2022 hit, we saw people who spent a year in Austin realize the weather here wasn’t what they wanted compared to California,” Fountain told Insider in August. Have you moved to or from Texas since 2021 and have a story to share? Contact reporter Alcynna Lloyd at alloyd@insider.com.

article_content: Douye Diri, the Governor of Bayelsa State and winner of the recent governorship election, has attributed his victory to the collective will of the people, united for progress and a better future. Diri emphasized that he would continue to serve all residents of the state, regardless of political affiliation. He made these remarks shortly after Prof. Kuta Farouq, the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) Returning Officer, declared him the winner of the governorship election held last Saturday. Diri received a total of 175,196 votes, defeating his closest rival, Timipre Sylva of the All Progressives Congress, who garnered 110,108 votes. Governor Diri expressed his gratitude to everyone who voted and trusted him with the leadership of the state. He also thanked the leadership of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) at all levels, as well as his campaign team and supporters who worked hard to promote their message of unity and progress. Diri called on residents to celebrate the election victory with moderation, stating that it is not the exclusive achievement of any one political party. He noted that the participation of those who voted for other candidates helped strengthen democratic practice in Bayelsa State. Additionally, Diri expressed appreciation to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for providing a conducive environment for a free, fair, and credible election. He reaffirmed his commitment to being a governor for all people in Bayelsa State.

Han gjorde dessa kommentarer strax efter att Prof. Kuta Farouq, valansvarig för den oberoende nationella valkommissionen (INEC), utropade honom till vinnare av guvernörsvalet som hölls i lördags. Diri fick totalt 175 196 röster och besegrade sin närmaste rival, Timipre Sylva från All Progressives Congress, som fick 110 108 röster. Guvernör Diri uttryckte sin tacksamhet till alla som röstade och gav honom förtroendet att leda delstaten. Han tackade också ledarskapet på alla nivåer inom Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), sitt kampanjteam och sina supportrar som arbetat hårt för att sprida budskapet om enighet och framsteg. Diri uppmanade invånarna att fira valvinsten med måtta och underströk att detta inte är en exklusiv seger för något politiskt parti. Han noterade att deltagandet från de som röstade på andra kandidater har stärkt den demokratiska processen i Bayelsa State. Dessutom uttryckte Diri uppskattning till president Bola Ahmed Tinubu för att ha skapat en gynnsam miljö för ett fritt, rättvist och trovärdigt val. Han bekräftade sitt engagemang för att vara en guvernör för alla människor i Bayelsa State.

article_content: As Web3 companies consider relocating from the United States due to regulatory uncertainty, the United Kingdom is being urged to simplify its cryptocurrency regulations to attract these firms. The conservative think tank Policy Exchange has released a report outlining ten recommendations for improving UK Web3 regulation. Key suggestions include reducing liability for token holders in decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) and encouraging the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) to explore alternative Know Your Customer (KYC) methods, such as digital identities and blockchain analytics tools. These recommendations are intended to position the UK as a leader in Web3 innovation and to encourage blockchain-based businesses seeking a supportive regulatory environment. Streamlining crypto regulations and adopting progressive approaches would help emerging Web3 companies navigate existing legal frameworks and contribute to the UK's digital economy. By creating a clearer, more straightforward regulatory landscape, the UK can foster innovation, growth, and competitiveness within the global fintech industry. The Policy Exchange report also advises against weakening self-hosted wallets or classifying proof-of-stake (PoS) services as financial services, underscoring the need to preserve decentralization, user autonomy, security, and compliance. Despite recent stringent actions by UK authorities like His Majesty’s Treasury and the FCA, Policy Exchange’s proposals aim to make the UK more attractive for Web3 businesses. Embracing these changes would signal the UK's commitment to supporting innovation in blockchain and cryptocurrency, all while ensuring robust and transparent regulations. With ongoing regulatory uncertainty in various countries, including the United States, Web3 companies are increasingly seeking clearer legal jurisdictions. Simplifying and streamlining its crypto regulation could allow the UK to establish itself as a global hub for Web3 innovation. Featured Image Credit: Photo by Jonathan Borba, Pexels.

Den konservativa tankesmedjan Policy Exchange har släppt en rapport med tio rekommendationer för att förbättra den brittiska Web3-regleringen. Nyckelförslag inkluderar att minska ansvaret för tokeninnehavare i decentraliserade autonoma organisationer (DAO:s) och att uppmuntra Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) att utforska alternativa metoder för kundkännedom (KYC), såsom digitala identiteter och blockchain-analysverktyg. Dessa rekommendationer syftar till att positionera Storbritannien som en ledare inom Web3-innovation och att locka blockchain-baserade företag som söker ett stödjande regelverk. Genom att skapa ett tydligare och enklare regelverk kan Storbritannien främja innovation, tillväxt och konkurrenskraft inom den globala fintech-branschen. article_content: YouTube is introducing new AI-powered features, similar to ChatGPT, to enhance user engagement on its platform. The company is currently testing a conversational AI tool and AI-generated comment summaries, aiming to offer users more relevant and insightful content. The conversational AI tool allows users to ask questions about the videos they are watching through an 'Ask' button beneath select videos. The tool provides responses without interrupting video playback, enabling users to explore video content more easily. It can also suggest related content and quiz viewers on educational videos, with answers generated by large language models. This feature is currently limited to YouTube Premium members on Android devices in the United States, but YouTube plans to expand its availability soon. In addition, YouTube is experimenting with AI-generated comment summaries that organize comments into thematic groups. This helps both creators and viewers quickly understand the main topics in a video's comment section. The summaries exclude unpublished comments, those held for review, and comments with blocked words. Creators retain the ability to delete specific comments within these topics. This feature is being tested in English on a small number of videos with large comment sections, and Premium subscribers can opt in via the YouTube Experiments page. As YouTube continues to develop AI-driven tools, users can expect further updates aimed at making the platform more useful and relevant. Currently, these tools are available to a limited audience, but YouTube plans to broaden access based on user feedback and engagement. Elsewhere in economic news, India is making efforts to bring Tesla into the country by fast-tracking approval processes, while luxury sales are rising during Diwali, and technology-sector salary growth is slowing amid global demand changes.

article_content: Queen Elizabeth II made her first public appearance since arriving at Sandringham Estate for her annual Christmas holiday. Accompanied by the Duke of Edinburgh, she attended a Sunday service at the village church of St Mary Magdalene. Greeted by cheering locals, the Queen appeared upbeat in a raspberry pink coat and hat. The Duke of Edinburgh looked well, despite earlier health issues this year. Though Sandringham House is a short walk from the church, the 87-year-old Queen and her husband traveled by Range Rover. St Mary Magdalene Church has long been a key part of royal Christmas traditions. This year, senior members of the Royal Family—including Prince George, Prince Harry, the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge, Prince Charles, and the Duchess of Cornwall—are expected at the estate. Prince Charles and the Duchess of Cornwall will arrive Christmas Eve, just in time for afternoon tea and present opening. Prince George's attendance marks his first Christmas at Sandringham and a rare gathering of four generations of royals. On Christmas Eve, the family will decorate the estate’s Norwegian spruce Christmas tree, with the Duke of Edinburgh placing the star on top. Christmas Day includes the church service, a turkey lunch, the Queen’s broadcast, and family time. Boxing Day will feature the royal shoot, a tradition dating to the 19th century. The Queen will stay at Sandringham until February, continuing a cherished holiday tradition at the Norfolk estate.

article_content:
Olivia Pooley, aged 11 months, developed a rare medical condition called hair tourniquet syndrome when a strand of hair tightly wrapped around her toe and cut off circulation, resulting in an infection. Her parents, Daniel and Christine, discovered the problem after noticing her swollen, red foot while getting her ready for bed. She was immediately taken to Colchester General Hospital, where surgeons had to cut into her skin to remove the hair, as it had become deeply embedded.

During the process, Olivia was mistakenly given 4mg of morphine—a dosage meant for a much older child—by hospital staff. The error went unnoticed for about 45 minutes, during which Olivia’s breathing became dangerously slow. Medical professionals responded quickly by administering reversal medication intravenously. Her father, Daniel, described the situation as terrifying and expressed frustration about poor communication from hospital staff.

Olivia spent a day in the children’s ward and ultimately recovered, though she was left with some scarring on her foot. Her family reports she also contracted gastroenteritis during her stay and has since filed a formal complaint regarding the incident.

Hair tourniquet syndrome, while rare, most commonly affects infants due to increased maternal hair loss after pregnancy. Its symptoms can be hard to detect because fine hairs are often invisible, but the resulting constriction can cause severe infection, and in extreme cases, loss of the digit. The condition can affect toes, fingers, ears, or other body parts. Hair removal generally requires careful examination and precise cutting. Colchester Hospital officials have apologized to the family and begun a formal investigation.

article_content: A global anti-terror finance authority should be alert to India’s use of its policies to curb critical voices. The recent enforcement action against NewsClick, including the arrests of founder Prabir Purkayastha and HR head Amit Chakravarty, exemplifies a larger trend where independent journalism faces increasing pressure in India. Over the past decade, Indian authorities have repeatedly invoked stringent anti-terror and financial laws—including the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA), Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), and Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA)—to target media outlets and non-governmental organizations, frequently invoking obligations to the Financial Action Task Force (FATF). Since becoming a FATF member in 2010, India has implemented these regulations to align with global standards, but critics say they are often wielded to suppress dissent. The Enforcement Directorate, empowered by the PMLA, can seize assets and arrest individuals on minimal grounds, often without court approval. Such powers have been used not only against media like NewsClick but also organizations including Amnesty International, whose operations in India were halted after authorities froze their funds and suspended their licenses without clear legal justification. Since 2010, Indian authorities have revoked more than 20,600 NGO licenses, with about 6,000 cancellations occurring since 2022 alone. Human rights advocates and international bodies have raised concerns about these vague and sweeping measures, noting their adverse impact on organizations with little risk of financial wrongdoing. Despite specific guidance from entities like FATF and the United Nations—calling for more precise, risk-based regulations and protection for civil society—government actions often ignore these recommendations. Although some legal amendments have been made, substantial reform has not occurred, despite suggestions during international reviews. The upcoming FATF evaluation presents an important chance for affected organizations to highlight these ongoing issues. There is mounting international expectation for the FATF to ensure its standards are not used by India as cover for undermining the rights to free expression and association. Under det senaste decenniet har indiska myndigheter återkommande tagit till stränga anti-terrorlagar och finanslagar—som UAPA, PMLA och FCRA—för att slå mot medier och ideella organisationer, ofta med hänvisning till landets åtaganden inför Financial Action Task Force (FATF). Efter att Indien blev medlem i FATF 2010 har reglerna införts för att passa in på globala standarder, men kritiker menar att de används för att stävja oliktänkande. Enforcement Directorate, stärkt genom PMLA, kan frysa tillgångar och gripa individer på svaga grunder, ibland utan domstolsbeslut.
