article_content: LUCKNOW, India — Officials attempting to rescue 41 workers trapped in a collapsed tunnel in northern India for eight days are considering alternative rescue strategies after technical problems halted their drilling. On Saturday, a new drilling machine arrived at the accident site in Uttarakhand state to replace the damaged one, which had broken down while clearing debris and rock. The original drill was creating a passage for wide pipes to allow the workers to crawl out to safety. Disaster management official Devendra Patwal reported that teams have drilled 24 meters (79 feet) so far, aiming for a total of 60 meters (197 feet) to reach the workers. Officials are now considering new approaches. Government spokesperson Deepa Gaur said the new machine might be used to drill from the top of the hill, under which the workers are trapped, though this could take an additional four or five days. Earlier, operations stopped when a loud cracking sound was heard in the tunnel, raising safety concerns. Tarun Kumar Baidya, director at the National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited (NHIDCL), said parts of the machine were found damaged. The workers have been trapped since November 12, when a landslide caused a section of the 4.5-kilometer-long (2.8-mile) tunnel to collapse about 200 meters (650 feet) from the entrance. The area is prone to landslides. The site, located in Uttarakhand—a mountainous state known for Hindu temples—draws many pilgrims and tourists, leading to frequent infrastructure projects. The tunnel is part of the Chardham all-weather road, a federal project connecting several Hindu pilgrimage destinations. Around 200 disaster relief personnel are on site, using drilling equipment and excavators, working to push 80-centimeter (2.6-foot) wide steel pipes through the debris. NHIDCL director Anshu Manish Khalkho said that after drilling was halted, experts worried the machine’s intense vibrations could cause more debris to fall. The current machine can drill up to 5 meters (16 feet) per hour and uses a 99-centimeter (3.2-foot) diameter pipe for debris removal. Khalkho explained that while drilling down from above could also lead to more debris, a specialized method for unstable soil might limit this risk. Drilling from above would require a 103-meter (338-foot) shaft to reach the workers—almost double the distance compared to horizontal drilling. Authorities are also considering drilling from the sides and tunnel ends, according to official Khulbe. Vijay Singh, a control room official, said the supply pipe delivering nuts, roasted chickpeas, popcorn, and other essentials to the trapped workers has been extended further. Oxygen is being supplied through another pipe. According to Patwal, two doctors at the site are monitoring the workers’ physical and mental health, providing vitamins and anxiety treatments. As the operation enters its eighth day, the families of those underground are increasingly worried, frustrated, and angry. “I am losing my patience,” said Maharaj Singh Negi, whose brother Gabbar Singh is among the trapped workers. “Officials have not even updated us about future plans.”

article_content: Starting Thursday, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is requiring broadcasters and pay TV providers to ensure that television commercials are no louder than the programs they accompany. The FCC's new rule mandates that ads must maintain the same average volume as the shows, under the Commercial Advertisement Loudness Mitigation (CALM) Act, passed by Congress in 2010. This change addresses a long-standing viewer complaint: excessively loud commercials, which have been among the top issues reported to the FCC since 2002. Between January 2008 and now, the commission has received around 1,000 complaints and about 5,000 inquiries about this problem. The FCC had not previously regulated commercial loudness due to difficulties in defining and measuring 'loudness,' a subjective issue. Instead, they advised viewers to mute or lower the volume. The CALM Act had broad bipartisan support, passing the Senate unanimously and the House by a voice vote. Lawmakers and industry representatives, including Rep. Anna Eshoo (D-California) and Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse (D-Rhode Island), will hold an event in Washington to mark the law’s full implementation. The FCC has granted two temporary waivers: one for the South Georgia Governmental Services Authority, citing financial hardship, and another for WPFO in Waterville, Maine, due to facility relocation. Non-commercial stations are exempt, but political advertisements must comply. The FCC will enforce the rule based on consumer complaints, which can be submitted online at http://www.fcc.gov/complaints.

Förändringen svarar mot en långvarig tittarfrustration: att reklampauser varit för högljudda, något som varit bland de vanligaste klagomålen till FCC sedan 2002. Mellan januari 2008 och nu har kommissionen tagit emot ungefär 1 000 klagomål och cirka 5 000 förfrågningar om detta problem. FCC har tidigare inte reglerat reklamens volym på grund av svårigheter att definiera och mäta ”ljudstyrka”, som är subjektiv. Istället har de rekommenderat tittare att stänga av ljudet eller sänka volymen. CALM Act fick brett stöd från båda partierna och gick igenom utan invändningar i senaten och med acklamation i representanthuset. Lagstiftare och branschrepresentanter, däribland Rep. Anna Eshoo (D-Kalifornien) och Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse (D-Rhode Island), kommer att hålla ett evenemang i Washington för att uppmärksamma den fulla implementeringen av lagen. FCC har gett två tillfälliga undantag: ett till South Georgia Governmental Services Authority på grund av ekonomiska svårigheter, och ett till WPFO i Waterville, Maine, på grund av omlokalisering. Icke-kommersiella kanaler är undantagna, men politisk reklam måste följa reglerna. FCC kommer att tillämpa reglerna utifrån tittarklagomål, som kan lämnas in online på http://www.fcc.gov/complaints.

article_content: Spain claimed a 2-0 win over Bolivia in an international friendly, with Fernando Torres both scoring and missing a golden chance. Early in the match, Torres latched onto an accurate pass from Andres Iniesta to face only Bolivia's goalkeeper, Romel Quinonez. Trying to chip the keeper with the outside of his foot, Torres missed the target completely, disappointing the fans. Despite this, Torres—whose club form at Chelsea has drawn criticism since his high-profile transfer from Liverpool—redeemed himself not long after the break. After Javi Martinez was fouled in the penalty area, Torres calmly scored the resulting penalty, bringing his international tally to 37 goals in 107 appearances for Spain. Andres Iniesta sealed the win in the 84th minute, weaving through defenders before slotting home a low shot in off the post. This match served as one of Spain’s final warm-ups before the World Cup, with several Real Madrid and Atletico Madrid players missing due to recent club duties. Following the game, Iniesta expressed his satisfaction in an interview with broadcaster Cuatro, emphasizing how important it is for the team to approach the tournament with confidence and highlighting the excitement ahead after a long season. Bolivia, who did not qualify for the World Cup, managed to resist Spain until the penalty. Spain’s squad included Reina, Moreno, Azpilicueta, Pique (Albiol), Xavi (Busquets), Martinez, Cazorla (Silva), Iturraspe, Pedro (Deulofeu), Mata (Iniesta), and Torres (Fabregas), while Bolivia’s lineup featured Quinonez, Bejarano, Raldes, Melean, Eguino, Gutierrez, Chumacero, Mojica, Arce, and Moreno. The match, overseen by Albanian referee Lorenc Jemini, was witnessed by a crowd of 35,000.

article_content: The Ministry of Rural Development has requested ₹1.1 lakh crore for the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) for the next financial year, nearly double the ₹60,000 crore allocated for the current year, according to an official source. This increase is being driven by continued strong demand for work, rising wages, and inflation, which are expected to raise expenditure for MGNREGS in FY25. A senior finance ministry official stated that the budget estimate for FY25 is under consideration and the appropriate allocation will be made. Due to upcoming elections in April-May, an interim budget for FY25 will be presented in February and, after a new government is formed, the final budget is expected in July. The interim budget allows government spending to continue until the new government takes office. Officials have noted that the revised estimate for MGNREGS in FY24 could reach ₹88,000 crore, nearly matching the FY23 outlay of ₹90,000 crore. The larger demand reflects more people seeking employment this year than first projected, contradicting initial expectations of reduced demand. However, a former economic affairs secretary pointed out that ministries often overstate budget requests in pre-budget discussions to secure higher funds, and the finance ministry must consider the broader fiscal picture when deciding final allocations. Earlier this month, the finance ministry released ₹10,000 crore in emergency funds to address unexpected costs in MGNREGS. This is part of a possible additional ₹28,000 crore to be included in the first round of supplementary grant requests for FY24 in the upcoming parliamentary session. So far, the central government has released ₹66,302 crore for MGNREGS this fiscal, surpassing the initial allocation due to the urgent funding needs.

Denna ökning drivs av fortsatt hög efterfrågan på arbete, stigande löner och inflation, vilket förväntas öka utgifterna för MGNREGS under räkenskapsåret 2025. En hög tjänsteman på finansdepartementet uppgav att budgetbedömningen för 2025 granskas och att ett lämpligt belopp kommer att tilldelas. På grund av kommande val i april-maj kommer en interimistisk budget för 2025 att presenteras i februari, och efter att en ny regering bildats väntas den slutliga budgeten i juli. Den interimistiska budgeten möjliggör fortsatt statliga utgifter tills den nya regeringen har tillträtt. Tjänstemän har noterat att den reviderade uppskattningen för MGNREGS under 2024 kan nå 88 000 crore rupier, nästan lika mycket som budgetåret 2023, som låg på 90 000 crore rupier. Den ökade efterfrågan återspeglar att fler söker arbete i år än vad som ursprungligen förutspåddes, vilket motsäger tidigare förväntningar om minskad efterfrågan. En tidigare ekonomisekreterare påpekade dock att ministerier ofta överskattar sina budgetanslag i förhandsdiskussioner för att säkra högre medel, men att finansdepartementet måste ta hänsyn till det övergripande budgetläget när de beslutar om slutliga anslag. Tidigare denna månad släppte finansdepartementet 10 000 crore rupier i akuta medel för att hantera oväntade kostnader för MGNREGS. Detta är en del av möjliga ytterligare 28 000 crore rupier som kan inkluderas i den första omgången av extraanslagsbegäran för 2024 i den kommande riksdagssessionen. Hittills har centralregeringen släppt 66 302 crore rupier till MGNREGS denna budgetperiod, vilket överstiger den ursprungliga tilldelningen på grund av akuta finansieringsbehov.

article_content: In rural Pennsylvania, the search for lost gold has generated both intrigue and dispute. Early one morning, Eric McCarthy and his client Don Reichel set out to collect elk antlers, but soon became witnesses to a larger mystery. Not far from them, the FBI was undertaking an operation to find rumored Civil War-era gold in Dents Run, a secluded valley northeast of Pittsburgh. The FBI's excavation more than five years ago has since led to ongoing legal battles and persistent doubts about whether treasure was unearthed. Recently, two witnesses—McCarthy and Reichel—have come forward, casting doubt on the FBI’s official statements and suggesting possible secretive activity. The FBI maintains that its 2018 dig turned up nothing, but Dennis Parada, a treasure seeker who spent years researching the site, remains unconvinced. He refers to the FBI’s own geophysical scans, which pointed to a substantial object buried underground. Parada and his group, Finders Keepers, suspect the FBI may have conducted unauthorized work overnight, possibly explaining reports of a heavy armored truck leaving the area. McCarthy, who has no direct ties to the search group, recalls hearing large machinery before sunrise and later seeing armored trucks—one appearing heavily loaded. Reichel also remembers the sounds and the convoy of trucks. These reports align with earlier accounts from local residents who noted construction noise and FBI presence at unusual times. Warren Getler, an advisor familiar with the case, interprets the eye-witness stories as evidence of a covert removal of gold. The FBI, however, firmly denies any unauthorized digging, stating its only nighttime activity was routine patrols, and insists no gold or evidence was found. Although the legend of the lost gold is not well-supported by history, geophysical analysis arranged by the FBI revealed a large, dense mass underground where treasure was rumored to be buried. The agency received a court-approved warrant to dig but later declared the effort fruitless. Parada, arguing for greater transparency, has since filed lawsuits to access the FBI’s records, with only partial results as many operational details remain secret. Parada continues his quest, recently engaging a geophysical company that identified new underground anomalies nearby. He is now discussing possible new excavations with Pennsylvania state officials. As the search persists, the story of Dents Run captivates both believers and skeptics, with questions still swirling about what, if anything, was found during the FBI’s expedition in Pennsylvania’s storied gold region.

article_content: An auction in France featuring items that belonged to Senegal’s first president, Léopold Sédar Senghor, has been postponed as the Senegalese government attempts to purchase them directly. Senghor’s possessions, including military medals and jewelry, were scheduled to be auctioned in the city of Caen. Senegal’s current president, Macky Sall, has instructed the culture minister and the country’s embassy in Paris to initiate talks with the auctioneers. Senghor governed Senegal for 20 years following its independence from France in 1960. Renowned as a poet, he co-founded the anti-colonialist Négritude movement—which celebrated African culture—alongside Martinican poet Aimé Cesairé during their student years in Paris in the 1930s. Politically, Senghor was a socialist but maintained strong ties with France. He retired to France with his French wife, Colette, near Caen, where he passed away in 2001. The items up for auction were submitted by an unnamed private seller. According to auctioneer Solène Laine, negotiations with Senegalese authorities will continue for several weeks. If no agreement is reached, her firm states the auction will be held in December instead.

Senegals nuvarande president, Macky Sall, har gett kulturministern och landets ambassad i Paris i uppdrag att inleda samtal med auktionsförrättarna. Senghor ledde Senegal i 20 år efter självständigheten från Frankrike 1960. Han var en känd poet och medgrundare av den antikolonialistiska Négritude-rörelsen – som hyllade afrikansk kultur – tillsammans med den martinikanske poeten Aimé Cesairé under deras studietid i Paris på 1930-talet. Politiskt var Senghor socialist men behöll starka band till Frankrike. Han gick i pension i Frankrike med sin franska fru, Colette, nära Caen där han avled 2001. Föremålen som skulle auktioneras har lämnats in av en anonym privat säljare. Enligt auktionsförrättaren Solène Laine kommer förhandlingarna med de senegalesiska myndigheterna att fortsätta i flera veckor. Om ingen överenskommelse nås kommer auktionen enligt hennes företag att hållas i december istället.

article_content: President Barack Obama and Vice President Joe Biden visited Shake Shack in Washington, D.C.'s Dupont Circle on Friday for lunch, enjoying burgers and fries together. Four construction workers from a nearby project in the gentrifying NoMa neighborhood joined them. Their lunch coincided with First Lady Michelle Obama’s continuing campaign to promote healthy eating and fight childhood obesity. Despite her efforts, President Obama and Biden opted for classic fast food. During the meal, President Obama emphasized the importance of improving the nation’s infrastructure, a message he has recently been promoting. He pointed out he picked Shake Shack not just for its well-loved burgers, but also because it pays employees more than $10 an hour. Notably, the road outside the restaurant was under repair. The outing also happened to fall in National Burger Month.

article_content: Frank Warren, promoter for Tyson Fury, has ruled out the highly anticipated all-British heavyweight clash between Fury and Anthony Joshua taking place in 2024. The potential showdown has been discussed for years and is widely regarded as one of the biggest matches British boxing could offer. Fury recently edged past Francis Ngannou in a closely contested bout in Saudi Arabia, being knocked down in the third round by Ngannou—who was making his professional boxing debut. Many fans felt Fury’s performance was underwhelming throughout the 10-round contest. Fury had been expected to easily defeat Ngannou and then move on to an undisputed title fight against Oleksandr Usyk on December 23. However, after a challenging victory over Ngannou, with some fans believing Ngannou was unjustly denied by the judges, Anthony Joshua’s promoter Eddie Hearn called for the Usyk fight to be dropped in favor of a Fury versus Joshua fight. Hearn told Matchroom’s YouTube channel: "Forget Fury vs Usyk, no one is interested. Just give us Fury against AJ. Joshua will knock Tyson Fury out inside six rounds. Make the fight, otherwise we'll never get it." Despite Hearn’s push, Warren remains adamant that Fury will honor his commitment to face Usyk next. Warren, a Hall of Fame boxing promoter, claims Joshua previously turned down a fight offer and is currently not in title contention. Warren explained to Mail Sport: "No. He (Joshua) didn’t want to fight him last December. We made the offer. So you know where he is now. He’s at the back of that long queue." Warren continued, "They weren’t interested in fighting for a world title after losing twice to Usyk. He didn’t want to fight for a world title, otherwise he would have taken that opportunity when it was offered to him." Joshua has recorded two wins in 2023 as he looks to rebuild after consecutive defeats to Usyk. The former two-time world champion appears to be positioning himself for a potential future bout against Fury, but Warren has pointed out that possible rematches with Usyk or Ngannou mean Joshua is unlikely to be considered as an opponent in the near future.

article_content: The Red Sea International Film Festival in Saudi Arabia will open its third edition, taking place from November 30 to December 9, with the Saudi film HWJN. HWJN is a fantasy romance blending Arabian folklore with modern themes, set in Jeddah, the festival’s location. This is a shift from the festival’s previous two editions, which opened with English-language films Cyrano (2021) and What’s Love Got To Do With It? (2022). HWJN represents the most ambitious project to date from a collaboration between Image Nation Abu Dhabi, VOX Studios, and MBC Studios — a partnership first announced at Cannes in 2019. Antoine Khalife, Director of Arab Programs & Film Classics at RSIFF, highlighted the event as a major milestone, happening just six years after Saudi Arabia ended its 35-year ban on cinemas. He stated that the festival’s choice not only celebrates Saudi cinema but the talents of the entire Arab world, underlining the Kingdom’s recent progress. Mohammed Al-Turki, CEO of the Red Sea Film Foundation, said the selection of HWJN is a testament to the rapid evolution of Saudi cinema. He shared his excitement about opening the edition with a highly anticipated Saudi film. HWJN is included in the festival’s Arab Spectacular lineup. Around 50 films have been announced so far, including international titles like Anna Kendrick’s directorial debut Woman of the Hour and the family drama Mother Couch, starring Ewan McGregor and Ellen Burstyn. The finalization of the program has been delayed due to the Israel-Hamas conflict and the recent end of the SAG-AFTRA strikes. Actor Baraa Alem plays HWJN, a good-hearted jinn living among humans in contemporary Jeddah. After discovering his royal heritage, HWJN sets out on a quest to reclaim his birthright and defend the balance between the spirit and human worlds, encountering ancient dangers along the way. He also forms an unexpected romantic relationship with Sawsan, a young medical student played by Nour Alkhadra. The movie is adapted from the popular Young Adult fantasy novel by Saudi author Ibraheem Abbas. The novel gained attention upon its 2013 release for blending Western sci-fi ideas with Arabic culture and folklore. Director Yasir Al Yasiri, based in Dubai and originally from Iraq, directed and produced the film through his company Axx Productions. His previous works include Shabab Sheyab (2018), the thriller 122 (2019), and the Starzplay fantasy series Kaboos. Al Yasiri described HWJN as an epic combining romance, adventure, and culture that resonates with audiences in Saudi Arabia and beyond. He emphasized the significance of premiering the film in Jeddah, the story’s setting, and expressed pride in the achievement. The screenplay was written by Yasir Al Yasiri, Ibraheem Abbas, Sarah Taibah, and Hussam Alhulwah. Majid Al Ansari and Saad Al Albutaily are executive producers. The book was originally published by Yatakhayaloon, co-founded by Yasser Bahjatt and Ibraheem Abbas.

Detta är en förändring från festivalens två tidigare upplagor, som öppnade med de engelskspråkiga filmerna Cyrano (2021) och What’s Love Got To Do With It? (2022). HWJN representerar det mest ambitiösa projektet hittills från samarbetet mellan Image Nation Abu Dhabi, VOX Studios och MBC Studios — ett partnerskap som först presenterades i Cannes 2019. Antoine Khalife, chef för Arab Programs & Film Classics på RSIFF, beskrev evenemanget som en betydande milstolpe, endast sex år efter att Saudiarabien hävde sitt 35-åriga biografförbud. Skådespelaren Baraa Alem spelar HWJN, en godhjärtad jinn som lever bland människor i dagens Jeddah. När han upptäcker sitt kungliga ursprung ger han sig ut på en resa för att återta sin rättmätiga plats och skydda balansen mellan ande- och människovärlden mot gamla hot. Han inleder även en oväntad romantisk relation med Sawsan, en medicinstudent spelad av Nour Alkhadra. Filmen är baserad på den populära ungdomsromanen av den saudiska författaren Ibraheem Abbas. Romanen väckte uppmärksamhet vid släppet 2013 tack vare sin unika blandning av västerländska sci-fi-element med arabisk kultur och folktro. Regissören Yasir Al Yasiri, som är Dubai-baserad med irakiskt ursprung, har regisserat och producerat filmen genom sitt bolag Axx Productions. Hans tidigare verk omfattar Shabab Sheyab (2018), thrillern 122 (2019) och fantasyserien Kaboos på Starzplay. Al Yasiri beskrev HWJN som ett episkt verk som förenar romantik, äventyr och kultur och som ligger nära hjärtat hos publiken i Saudiarabien och internationellt. Han betonade vikten av premiären i Jeddah, där berättelsen utspelas, och uttryckte stolthet över produktionen. Manuset skrevs av Yasir Al Yasiri, Ibraheem Abbas, Sarah Taibah och Hussam Alhulwah. Majid Al Ansari och Saad Al Albutaily är exekutiva producenter. Boken gavs ursprungligen ut av Yatakhayaloon, grundad av Yasser Bahjatt och Ibraheem Abbas.

article_content: Lionel Messi won the men’s Ballon d’Or for an unprecedented eighth time in 2023, after leading Argentina to a World Cup victory in Qatar last year—a feat that fulfilled his lifelong ambition and secured the major trophy that had previously eluded him. Despite a relatively ordinary season at Paris Saint-Germain by his standards, Messi’s World Cup performance was the decisive factor in his award win, with Manchester City’s Erling Haaland and former PSG teammate Kylian Mbappé finishing as runners-up. Messi expressed gratitude to his Argentina coach, teammates, and staff, attributing his win to their collective efforts. Through a translator, he stated: “Tonight I’m enjoying myself. It’s a pleasure that will never leave me, and I hope to be able to enjoy it for many years to come. Becoming world champion was the title we were missing. I’d like to thank everyone who helped make Argentina the world champion team.” He also dedicated the trophy to the late Diego Maradona and the Argentine people. Aitana Bonmatí claimed the women’s Ballon d’Or after leading Spain to the Women’s World Cup title in August and helping Barcelona win both the Women’s Champions League and Spanish league. Bonmatí finished ahead of Sam Kerr and Salma Paralluelo, following in the footsteps of her teammate Alexia Putellas, who won the two previous awards. Messi’s Ballon d’Or victory came a year after he missed the 2022 shortlist and despite moving to Inter Miami in Major League Soccer (MLS). He has since earned his first silverware in the United States by inspiring Inter Miami to win the Leagues Cup. This achievement marked the first time an MLS-based player has won the Ballon d’Or, with Messi receiving the trophy from David Beckham, part-owner of Inter Miami. Erling Haaland led Manchester City to a treble—winning the Champions League, English Premier League, and FA Cup—and scored 52 goals last season, while Mbappé registered a hat-trick in the World Cup final, though France lost to Argentina on penalties. Statistically, Messi contributed to 10 goals (seven scored, three assisted) during the 2022 World Cup, including two goals in the final against France. Although PSG secured their 11th French league title, they exited the Champions League in the round of 16. No one else has won more than five Ballon d’Ors: Cristiano Ronaldo holds five, while Michel Platini, Johan Cruyff, and Marco van Basten have three each. For the first time, last year’s Ballon d’Or awards considered achievements from the previous football season instead of the calendar year. The original Ballon d’Or was created by France Football magazine in 1956, with the women’s trophy launched in 2018; both were canceled in 2020 due to the pandemic. Jude Bellingham was named best under-21 player, Erling Haaland received the Gerd Müller award for best striker, and Emiliano Martinez was recognized as best goalkeeper (Lev Yashin award). Martinez faced criticism for his World Cup celebrations, including mocking gestures and actions targeting Kylian Mbappé. The Socrates humanitarian award went to Vinícius Júnior of Real Madrid, who was honored for his foundation’s work with underprivileged children and his stance against racism.

Messis Ballon d'Or-seger kom ett år efter att han missade 2022 års lista och trots att han flyttat till Inter Miami i Major League Soccer (MLS). Han har redan vunnit sin första titel i USA genom att inspirera Inter Miami till seger i Leagues Cup. Ingen annan har vunnit fler än fem Ballon d'Or: Cristiano Ronaldo har fem, medan Michel Platini, Johan Cruyff och Marco van Basten har tre var. För första gången tog förra årets Ballon d'Or-utdelning hänsyn till prestationer under föregående säsong istället för kalenderåret. Ballon d'Or instiftades av tidningen France Football 1956, och damernas pris lanserades 2018; båda ställdes in 2020 på grund av pandemin. Jude Bellingham utsågs till bästa U21-spelare, Erling Haaland fick Gerd Müller-priset för bästa anfallare, och Emiliano Martinez fick Lev Yashin-priset för bästa målvakt. Martinez fick kritik för sina firanden under VM, inklusive hånfulla gester riktade mot Kylian Mbappé. Socrates Humanitarian Award gick till Vinícius Júnior i Real Madrid, som uppmärksammades för sitt arbete med stiftelsen för utsatta barn och sin kamp mot rasism.

article_content: Emergency services and Australian military personnel in Queensland, Australia, increased their search on Friday for dozens of missing people following the state’s worst flooding in decades. According to Queensland Police Commissioner Bob Atkinson, one of the 15 bodies found was located 80 kilometers from where the person was swept away, and he warned that some bodies may never be recovered. In Brisbane, the state capital, floodwaters that left widespread destruction have started to recede, but authorities caution that cleanup could take months. More than 20,000 homes were flooded as relentless rainfall caused the typically calm Brisbane River to rise above 4 meters at high tide on Thursday. Premier Anna Bligh, visibly moved, described the catastrophe as Queensland’s worst natural disaster. Search operations are most concentrated west of Brisbane, especially near Toowoomba, which was nearly submerged after a sudden surge on Monday. Australian Defence Minister Stephen Smith said more fatalities and discoveries were likely and urged people to prepare for difficult news. Residents were cautioned to avoid floodwaters due to contamination risks from affected sewage plants. Sightseers were told to stay away from the river to avoid disrupting emergency response. About 200 people—including personnel from the Australian Defence Force, Emergency Services, and police—continued searching for 55 individuals still unaccounted for. Prime Minister Julia Gillard, at Amberley Air Force Base, announced the increase of ADF deployment to 1,200—its highest for a natural disaster since Cyclone Tracy in 1974. Aerial footage revealed only rooftops and treetops emerging from brown floodwaters, with some high-rises appearing as islands. The Brisbane River peaked Thursday at 4.6 meters, approximately a meter below forecasts and lower than the record set in 1974. Authorities had anticipated a peak of 5.2 meters. Bligh confirmed that 11,900 Brisbane homes were completely flooded and 14,700 partially flooded. She added that 2,500 businesses were fully inundated and another 2,500 partially so. Many may never be habitable again. Queensland police arrested 10 individuals on 18 counts of looting—nine in Brisbane and one in Ipswich. Convicted offenders face up to 10 years in prison. Around 600 Defence Force members were already assisting; more are expected. Bligh stated that Brisbane’s Central Business District is mostly operational and should be fully functional by next week as power is restored to several office buildings. Brisbane’s flooding follows previous floods across Queensland, including Rockhampton after Christmas, which triggered a large recovery operation. In total, 70 towns and cities across the state have been affected. Evacuated homeowners began returning on Thursday to assess the damage, using inflatable boats and kayaks. Mark Grant from West End returned by kayak to retrieve belongings, noting that his family evacuated when water reached their garage, only to find later that floodwater had risen even higher than expected. He learned too late that his home’s elevation was less than believed. Elsewhere, Jody Jackson returned to her property, finding sodden mattresses and furniture. She and her husband initially sheltered in a nearby hostel but ultimately moved to the RNA Showgrounds evacuation center, alongside more than 1,000 others. The number of evacuees is expected to drop as people arrange other housing. Jackson said their hostel wasn’t as badly damaged as feared, but many in the community are facing greater losses. In other parts of the city, floodwaters reached rooftops, submerging houses and creating financial and logistical challenges for homeowners awaiting receding waters. Reported by CNN’s John Raedler.
translated_content: Räddningstjänsten och den australiska militären i Queensland intensifierade på fredagen sökandet efter dussintals saknade personer efter delstatens värsta översvämning på årtionden. Enligt Queenslands polischef Bob Atkinson hittades en av de 15 omkomna personerna 80 kilometer från platsen där personen sveptes bort, och han varnade för att vissa kroppar kanske aldrig återfinns. I Brisbane, delstatens huvudstad, har översvämningsvattnet som lämnat omfattande förstörelse efter sig börjat dra sig tillbaka, men myndigheterna varnar för att uppröjningen kan ta månader. Över 20 000 hem svämmades över när långvarigt regn fick den annars lugna Brisbane River att stiga till över 4 meter vid högvatten på torsdagen. Delstatspremiärminister Anna Bligh, synbart känslosam, beskrev katastrofen som Queenslands värsta naturkatastrof. Sökinsatserna koncentreras väster om Brisbane, särskilt nära Toowoomba, som nästan dränktes efter en plötslig vattenvåg i måndags. Försvarsminister Stephen Smith sade att fler dödsfall och fynd troligen väntar och uppmanade folk att förbereda sig på svåra nyheter. Invånare varnades för att gå ut i översvämningsvattnet på grund av risk för föroreningar från översvämmade reningsverk. Nyfikna uppmanades att hålla sig borta från floden för att inte störa räddningsarbetet. Ungefär 200 personer – inklusive personal från Australiens försvarsmakt, räddningstjänsten och polisen – fortsatte sökandet efter 55 saknade. Premiärminister Julia Gillard, vid Amberley flygbas, meddelade att antalet insatta försvarsanställda höjs till 1 200 – den största insatsen sedan naturkatastrofen Cyclone Tracy 1974. Flygbilder visade hustak och trädtoppar som stack upp ur det bruna vattnet, och höghus som såg ut som öar. Brisbane River nådde sin topp på torsdagen vid 4,6 meter, omkring en meter under prognoser och lägre än rekordet från 1974. Myndigheter hade förväntat en topp på 5,2 meter. Bligh bekräftade att 11 900 bostäder i Brisbane var helt översvämmade och 14 700 delvis drabbade. Hon uppgav att 2 500 företag svämmats över helt och ytterligare 2 500 delvis. Många kommer kanske aldrig att kunna återvända till sina hem. Queensland-polisen grep tio personer misstänkta för plundring i 18 fall – nio i Brisbane och en i Ipswich. Vid fällande dom riskerar de upp till tio års fängelse. Omkring 600 försvarsanställda hjälper redan till och fler förväntas komma. Bligh sade att Brisbanes centrala affärsdistrikt är i stort sett i drift och bör vara helt fungerande nästa vecka när elen är återställd i flera kontorsbyggnader. Brisbanes översvämning kom efter tidigare översvämningar i Queensland, bland annat i Rockhampton efter jul, vilket ledde till en omfattande återuppbyggnadsinsats. Hittills har 70 orter och samhällen drabbats i delstaten. Evakuerade husägare började återvända på torsdagen för att bedöma skadorna, många med gummibåt eller kajak. Mark Grant från West End tog sig tillbaka med kajak för att rädda tillhörigheter och noterade att familjen evakuerade när vattnet nådde garaget – men vattnet steg senare högre än de trott. Först i efterhand insåg han att huset låg lägre än de fått veta. På andra håll återvände Jody Jackson till sitt hem där blöta madrasser och möbler låg staplade i uppfarten. Hon och hennes man bodde först i ett närliggande vandrarhem, men flyttade till slut till evakueringscentret vid RNA Showgrounds med över 1 000 andra. Antalet boende där beräknas minska när fler hittar annat boende. Jackson sade att vandrarhemmet var i bättre skick än väntat, men att många drabbats hårdare. På andra håll i staden steg vattnet till hustakshöjd, dränkte bostäder och skapade både ekonomiska och praktiska problem för husägare som väntar på att översvämningen drar sig tillbaka. Rapportering av John Raedler, CNN.

article_content: A senior Pentagon official has initiated an emergency review of the U.S. military's use of the anti-malarial drug mefloquine (Lariam) due to concerns about its severe psychiatric side effects. The review was ordered in the aftermath of the tragic incident in which Staff Sgt Robert Bales allegedly killed 17 Afghan civilians, including nine children, raising questions about whether he might have been prescribed the drug despite guidance against its use in soldiers with prior brain injuries. Mefloquine has been associated with numerous cases of suicides, homicides, paranoia, hallucinations, and psychotic behavior among military personnel over the past decade. The drug, developed by Army researchers near the end of the Vietnam War, became popular because it is effective in areas where mosquitoes have developed resistance to previous treatments and requires only a once-weekly dose. Despite mounting evidence of its psychiatric and neurological risks, the military continued prescribing mefloquine for years. In 2009, policy changes nearly banned the drug, recommending it only when other options like doxycycline were unsuitable. Usage was further restricted for those with traumatic brain injuries, yet concerns persisted about proper screening and documentation. Medical experts and soldiers have raised alarms about mefloquine's potential toxicity and its role in mental health issues. Dr. Remington Nevin, an epidemiologist and Army major, has criticized the drug for its possible neurotoxic effects and its ability to mimic symptoms of combat-related stress disorders, complicating diagnoses. The Pentagon's review was reportedly prompted by an urgent task order from Assistant Secretary Jonathan Woodson, though officials maintain this action was planned before the Bales case. Meanwhile, prescriptions for mefloquine have significantly decreased in recent years as other anti-malarial medications have been more widely adopted. Several high-profile cases, such as that of Staff Sgt Georg-Andreas Pogany, have highlighted the link between mefloquine toxicity and abnormal behavior or breakdowns in service members. Advocacy from affected veterans and medical professionals has led to calls for stronger safeguards or discontinuation of the drug's use in the military. Recent data shows substantial reductions in mefloquine prescriptions and spending. While the Department of Defense insists the review is routine, critics argue that further action is necessary to protect the health of military personnel. Lawmakers, including Sen. Dianne Feinstein, have also urged greater oversight of anti-malarial drug protocols.

Granskningen beordrades efter den tragiska händelsen där Staff Sgt Robert Bales påstås ha dödat 17 afghanska civila, inklusive nio barn, vilket väcker frågor om att han kan ha fått läkemedlet trots rekommendationer om att inte ge det till soldater med hjärnskador. Trots växande bevis på psykiatriska och neurologiska risker fortsatte militären att ordinera meflokin under många år. Pentagons granskning ska ha påbörjats efter en akut order från biträdande försvarsminister Jonathan Woodson, även om tjänstemän hävdar att åtgärden planerades innan Bales-fallet. Påtryckningar från drabbade veteraner och medicinska experter har lett till krav på striktare säkerhetsåtgärder eller att läkemedlet tas bort helt i militären. Medan försvarsdepartementet menar att granskningen är en rutinåtgärd hävdar kritiker att mer måste göras för att skydda militär personal. Lagstiftare som senator Dianne Feinstein har också krävt skärpt kontroll av protokoll för antimalariamedel.

article_content: Instead of spending money on a new outfit, why not tap into your creativity to craft pieces that reflect your personal style? Simple DIY projects can transform everyday items into custom couture, making any day feel like your own fashion show. 'It's really the best form of self-expression one can have,' says Kirsten Nunez, founder of the DIY blog Studs and Pearls. 'You're making something that's fully yours. DIY has inspired people to value the artistic side of fashion, rather than just its price tag.' If the idea of remaking a thrift store find or designing an outfit from scratch sounds daunting, don't worry—the flourishing world of DIY fashion blogs is here to help. These bloggers share countless photo-illustrated, step-by-step tutorials, offering endless inspiration and the assurance that comes from wearing something you made. DIY blogger Jessica Quirk loves when people ask, 'You made that?' For her, making clothes is second nature. 'Why buy it if you can make it?' she says. Quirk started sewing at age 10 and now showcases her self-made outfits on her blog, What I Wore, which has become part of an online community devoted to DIY fashion. Quirk’s daily looks often resemble runway trends or vintage designs but are usually a mix of DIY, thrifted finds, and affordable pieces from stores like Target. ‘You don’t need to spend a lot to look great,’ she says. ‘What looks expensive can be a project that cost just $4.’ Jenni Radosevich, who runs I Spy DIY and writes a column for InStyle Magazine, shares a similar passion. ‘I like making what I can’t find,’ she says. Her tutorials show readers how to turn everyday items—like plain shoes or household objects—into fashionable pieces inspired by designer trends. Readers contribute their own ideas and creations, turning DIY into a collaborative, community-driven experience. Radosevich adds, ‘DIY is about finding ways to create and share with others. It’s always been around, but now people are blogging about it—sparking a real conversation about fashion.’ Erica Domesek, author and creator of 'P.S. -- I made this ...', also wants to demystify DIY. Her mantra: 'Re-imagine, reuse, and reinvent.' Domesek started her blog and book to help others overcome creative intimidation. Whether copying a high-priced necklace with friends or showing how to turn old clothes into something new, her goal is to inspire and educate. Blogger Carly Cais of Chic Steals curates easy, engaging tutorials sourced from across the web, alongside her own projects. Cais started with a column in 2008 and has since built a blog that encourages making fashion from items you already have or translating designer looks into accessible home projects. Whether you’re gathering inspiration or diving into your first project, DIY fashion is approachable and rewarding. Domesek suggests starting small—try creating jewelry using simple items and online tutorials. Soon, you’ll feel the pride of answering, ‘Yes, I made this,’ and enjoy pieces crafted just for you. Quirk sums it up: 'You wear your creations with pride—they’re not just clothes, they’re a badge of honor.'
translated_content: Istället för att lägga pengar på nya kläder, varför inte använda din kreativitet för att skapa plagg som speglar din personliga stil? 'Det är verkligen det bästa sättet att uttrycka sig själv,' säger Kirsten Nunez, grundare av DIY-bloggen Studs and Pearls. 'Du gör något som är helt och hållet ditt. DIY har inspirerat folk att se det konstnärliga i mode snarare än prislappen.' Om tanken på att göra om ett second hand-fynd eller designa ett plagg från grunden känns skrämmande, oroa dig inte – den växande världen av DIY-modebloggar finns där för att hjälpa till. Dessa bloggare delar fotofyllda steg-för-steg-guider, erbjuder oändlig inspiration och tryggheten som kommer med att bära något du skapat själv. DIY-bloggaren Jessica Quirk älskar när folk frågar: 'Har du gjort den själv?' För henne är det helt naturligt att sy egna kläder. 'Varför köpa det om du kan göra det själv?' säger hon. Quirk började sy som tioåring och visar nu upp sina egengjorda outfits på sin blogg What I Wore, som blivit en del av ett online-community för DIY-mode. Quirks vardagsstilar påminner ofta om trender från modeshower eller vintage-design, men är oftast en blandning av DIY, fyndade plagg och prisvärda saker från exempelvis Target. 'Du behöver inte spendera mycket för att se bra ut,' säger hon. 'Det som ser dyrt ut kan vara ett projekt som bara kostat 40 kronor.' Jenni Radosevich, som driver I Spy DIY och skriver för InStyle Magazine, delar samma passion. 'Jag gillar att skapa det jag inte hittar i butikerna,' säger hon. Hennes guider visar hur man förvandlar vanliga skor eller hushållsprylar till trendiga, designersinspirerade plagg. Läsare bidrar med egna idéer och kreationer, vilket gör DIY till en gemensam och inspirerande upplevelse. Radosevich tillägger: 'DIY handlar om att hitta sätt att skapa och dela med andra. Det har alltid funnits, men nu bloggar fler om det – vilket gör modet till en riktig dialog.' Erica Domesek, författare och skapare av 'P.S. -- I made this ...', vill också göra DIY lättförståeligt. Hennes mantra är: 'Återuppfinn, återanvänd och omvandla.' Domesek startade sin blogg och bok för att hjälpa andra att våga vara kreativa. Oavsett om hon återskapar ett dyrt halsband med vänner eller visar hur man gör om gamla kläder till något nytt, är hennes mål att inspirera och utbilda. Bloggaren Carly Cais på Chic Steals samlar lätta och roliga guider från nätet och delar även egna projekt. article_content: Eric Cantona, the former Manchester United footballer, was arrested in London following an altercation with a photographer outside The Queens pub in Primrose Hill. Cantona was seen drinking beer with an unidentified woman before the incident occurred. According to witnesses, Cantona’s companion went inside the pub and later left through a different door. Police were called around 12:55pm after a photographer was reportedly punched. Cantona, 47 and currently residing in Paris with his wife, actress Rachida Brakni, was detained by police officers from Camden Borough. He was held at a North London police station for over six hours before accepting a caution for common assault. The victim did not require medical attention. Cantona, known for his successful football career with Manchester United and his post-retirement ventures into acting and modeling, has faced controversy in the past. In 1995, he was convicted of assault for a kung-fu kick directed at a Crystal Palace fan, receiving a two-week jail sentence that was later reduced to 120 hours of community service. He was also banned from football for eight months. Since retiring from football in 1997, Cantona has worked as an actor, appeared in advertisements for brands such as Kronenbourg 1664, and is recognized for his philosophical remarks. His brother and agent, Jean-Marie Cantona, declined to comment on the latest incident. Cantona has two children with his former wife, Isabelle Ferrer. Passers-by reported seeing Cantona outside the pub before the altercation, but staff at the establishment declined to comment. The Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) previously banned a Kronenbourg advertisement featuring Cantona for misleading consumers about the beer’s origins.

article_content: Storm Babet tore through Scotland before moving into Scandinavia, bringing heavy flooding, widespread disruptions, and tragic losses. Scottish emergency responders, particularly in Angus, raced to save families trapped by floodwaters. Two people died: a 57-year-old woman swept into a river, and a 56-year-old van driver killed by a falling tree. Eastern Scotland endured record rainfall—up to 22 centimeters—which led the UK Met Office to issue a rare red warning. Hundreds of homes in towns like Brechin flooded, and some neighborhoods were only reachable by boat. Officials went door-to-door, urging around 350 households in Angus to evacuate. The storm also disrupted travel and infrastructure. In England, strong winds forced a Boeing 737-800 from Corfu to skid off Leeds Bradford Airport’s runway. Flooding and wind caused rail and road closures across central and northern England and Wales. The Tyne River mouth was blocked to ships due to massive swells. Cork, in southern Ireland, was also hit hard, experiencing its worst flooding in thirty years. In Midleton, a care home was evacuated, and the main street was submerged under four feet of water. As Babet continued eastward, Sweden and Denmark faced warnings for harsh wind and rain from SMHI and DMI. Copenhagen Airport canceled 77 flights, while multiple ferries between Denmark, Germany, Sweden, and Poland were halted. Scotland’s First Minister Humza Yousaf and other local officials highlighted the extreme danger in affected areas, noting that many residents were stranded, with some rescue attempts delayed by powerful currents. Experts warned that as climate change advances, storms like Babet are becoming increasingly severe and frequent.

The newly elected Slovak government has decided to recall hundreds of police officers and soldiers who were deployed to reinforce the border with Hungary, just one day after initially announcing the deployment. The coalition government, formed only last week, announced on Monday a 'massive' deployment of police and armed forces at the border to prevent a rising number of migrants from entering Slovakia from the neighboring country. Prime Minister Robert Fico defended the move by expressing concerns about individuals potentially linked to terrorist groups entering Slovakia through its 655-kilometre border with Hungary. Fico reported that 46,000 undocumented migrants have entered Slovakia since the start of the year. However, just one day later, the government reversed the decision. Interior Minister Matus Sutaj Estok explained that the deployment was a 'one-off action aimed to clearly show that Slovakia is not a safe haven for migrants, especially for smugglers.'

The measure faced criticism. Former Foreign Minister Miroslav Wlachovsky described it as a 'grandiose spectacle of public relations policy' on social media, while opposition leader Michal Simecka argued that the display at the border was a waste of the country’s finances and human resources. Slovakia’s current coalition government includes Fico's left-wing, populist, and anti-refugee party Smer-SD, which has aligned with the far-right, pro-Russian SNS and Hlas-SD, a breakaway party from Smer.

On October 5, Slovakia’s previous government reinstated random checks at the border with Hungary, following similar moves by Austria, Czechia, and Poland to curb migration by reinstating border controls with Slovakia. Then-Prime Minister Ludovit Odor criticized these new checks, suggesting that a Europe-wide solution to migration challenges would be preferable.

Crystal Spencer, 33, passed away in Detroit, Michigan after battling necrotizing fasciitis, often called flesh-eating bacteria, for almost a month. The infection began on June 30, when she visited Botsford Hospital in Farmington Hills for severe pain due to a boil on her thigh. She was later moved to Huron Valley-Sinai Hospital, where doctors performed major surgery to remove infected tissue. After a brief period of improvement, Crystal's condition deteriorated and she was readmitted, ultimately dying on July 29.

Jeff Spencer, her husband, asserts that Crystal contracted the infection while at Botsford Hospital and intends to take legal action against the facility. An autopsy has been requested to determine the exact cause of death. Hospital officials, including Dr. Gerald Blackburn and spokesperson Margo Gorchow, deny that the infection originated in their hospital. They state necrotizing fasciitis typically arises from bacteria entering an open wound, and note Crystal's heightened risk due to diabetes, obesity, and smoking, as well as not following return visit instructions after her release.

Crystal's family had hoped for her recovery, but her condition quickly worsened. Her husband noted her chance of survival was limited, at around 20–30 percent, given the infection's aggressive nature and her diabetes.

Similar instances have been reported elsewhere, such as Aimee Copeland in Georgia, who survived after multiple amputations. Necrotizing fasciitis is a rare but serious condition requiring immediate treatment, often involving strong antibiotics and surgery. Common symptoms include red bumps, rapidly spreading bruises, fever, and nausea. Sometimes, amputation and reconstructive surgery are needed for recovery.

In honor of Latinx Heritage Month, Tiny Desk is featuring an 'El Tiny' takeover, presenting a vibrant lineup of artists representing the diverse spectrum of Latinidad. Kicking off the session, Alex Cuba takes the stage with the simplest of musical elements: a rhythmic guitar, the gentle rasp of an agüiro, and a small vocal ensemble. His first song, 'Ciudad Hembra (La Habana)', is a heartfelt tribute to his hometown, unfolding with a slow, deliberate intensity.

Alex Cuba's unique charm shines as he weaves vivid imagery into his arrangements, conjuring not only nostalgia for Cuba but also evoking any setting where an acoustic guitar and emotive vocals captivate the audience. The song 'De Camino' is a clear example, driven by bass, drums, and congas. It's an intimate love song brimming with joyful energy—Cuba's guitar and subtle percussion grounding the listener in the spirit of the Caribbean.

'Chekere', named after the Afro-Cuban percussion instrument crafted from a bead-covered gourd, starts softly before building into a dynamic, percussion-rich crescendo. The performance then seamlessly transitions into 'Sarah', a tender love song dedicated to Alex Cuba's wife.

The relationship between a mother and daughter is at the heart of the documentary film 'Table for Two.' Writer-director Kim Bo-ram began the project in the winter of 2018, initially seeking to examine the rising prevalence of eating disorders in South Korea. After gathering data and conducting numerous interviews, Kim chose to focus on one family.

By 2019, she had interviewed 15 women and advanced the project when the school where Park Sang-ok, a vice-principal, worked requested a screening of Kim's earlier film. During a Q&A session afterward, Kim mentioned her work on a new documentary about eating disorders. Afterward, Park Sang-ok approached Kim, sharing that her daughter, Chae-young, had suffered from an eating disorder for over ten years. This exchange became the starting point of the film's personal story.

Chae-young was first diagnosed with anorexia as a teenager. Hospitalized for treatment, she soon began to eat again, but chose to induce vomiting, developing bulimia as a means to maintain control. The documentary introduces Chae-young a decade after her hospitalization, as she prepares for a job in Australia. As she says goodbye to her mother, Sang-ok's plea for her to 'stay healthy' carries complex emotional weight given their history.

When the COVID-19 pandemic brought Chae-young back to South Korea, she and her mother reconnected, sharing conversations over food—a subject that had once been a source of tension. Kim's focus for the film shifted from a broad look at eating disorders to the nuanced mother-daughter relationship. The filming continued until February 2021.

Kim reflects on how food, a central aspect of maternal care, is deeply intertwined with the family’s struggles. As a single mother, Sang-ok worked hard to support her daughter, sometimes at the expense of time together. Kim notes that trauma and complex family histories—compounded by South Korea’s sociopolitical climate and patriarchy—shape the characters’ experiences, even if these contexts are not overtly explained in the film. Kim references 'The Body Keeps the Score' by Bessel van der Kolk to support the connection between trauma and eating disorders.

The documentary also reveals that Sang-ok's mother, too, experienced bulimia. Kim emphasizes that its roots are both familial and societal; for example, in 1980s Korea, social norms created immense pressure for women, especially those without sons. Kim believes the inheritance is less about genetics and more about the intergenerational transmission of trauma.

Before working on the film, Kim viewed eating disorders as issues related to dieting or social pressures about appearance. However, her perspective changed as she came to appreciate the complex interplay of family, society, and culture. Both mother and daughter had to confront long-standing questions and uncertainties in their family, ultimately teaching Kim about resilience and human dignity.

While the belief that 'thin is beautiful' plays a role, Kim cautions that eating disorders are influenced by deeper dynamics—including media influence, junk food availability, and a competitive social climate. She hopes 'Table for Two' encourages less judgment and more understanding for those suffering from eating disorders, recognizing that personal stories are shaped by deeper social roots and family histories.

The movie is currently featured in the Women’s Voices section of the London Korean Film Festival, where audiences and the filmmakers continue to engage in meaningful discussions.
translated_content:
Relationen mellan mor och dotter står i centrum för dokumentärfilmen "Table for Two". Manusförfattaren och regissören Kim Bo-ram påbörjade projektet vintern 2018, med avsikt att belysa den ökande förekomsten av ätstörningar i Sydkorea. Efter att ha samlat in data och genomfört flera intervjuer valde Kim att fokusera på en familj.

År 2019 hade hon intervjuat 15 kvinnor och arbetet hade gått framåt när skolan där Park Sang-ok, en biträdande rektor, arbetade bad om att få visa Kims tidigare film. Under en efterföljande frågestund nämnde Kim att hon arbetade med en ny dokumentär om ätstörningar. Efter evenemanget närmade sig Park Sang-ok Kim och berättade att hennes dotter, Chae-young, hade kämpat med en ätstörning i över tio år. Denna dialog blev startpunkten för filmens personliga berättelse.

Chae-young diagnostiserades först med anorexi som tonåring. Hon lades in för vård och började snart äta igen, men valde då att själv framkalla kräkningar och utvecklade bulimi som ett sätt att behålla kontrollen. Dokumentären introducerar Chae-young ett decennium efter sjukhusinläggningen, då hon förbereder sig för arbete i Australien. När hon tar farväl säger modern Sang-ok åt henne att vara rädd om sig, vilket får en komplex innebörd med tanke på deras gemensamma historia.

När covid-19-pandemin förde Chae-young tillbaka till Sydkorea återknöt hon och modern, och samtal kring mat blev möjliga – ett ämne som tidigare varit laddat. Kims fokus för filmen gick från att skildra ätstörningar generellt till att berätta om den nyanserade relationen mellan mor och dotter. Filmandet pågick till februari 2021.

Kim reflekterar över hur maten, som en viktig symbol för moderskap, är djupt sammanvävd med familjens svårigheter. Som ensamstående kämpade Sang-ok hårt för att försörja sin dotter, ibland på bekostnad av deras tid tillsammans. Kim påpekar att trauma och komplicerade familjehistorier – förstärkta av Sydkoreas samhällsklimat och patriarkat – präglar personerna, även om detta inte förklaras öppet i filmen. Kim hänvisar till "The Body Keeps the Score" av Bessel van der Kolk för att visa kopplingen mellan trauma och ätstörningar.

Filmen avslöjar att även Sang-oks mor haft bulimi. Kim understryker att orsakerna är både familjära och samhälleliga; till exempel skapade normerna på 1980-talet enorm press på kvinnor – särskilt de utan söner. Kim menar att det är mer fråga om ett arv av trauma än om genetik.

Innan arbetet med filmen såg Kim på ätstörningar som frågor kring dieter eller skönhetsideal. Men mötet med familjen förändrade hennes synsätt och gav insikt i samspelet mellan familj, samhälle och kultur. Mor och dotter tvingades konfrontera långvariga frågor i familjen, och de lärde Kim mer om mänsklig värdighet och styrka.

Trots att tron om att "smal är vackert" spelar in, betonar Kim att ätstörningar orsakas av djupare mekanismer, såsom mediepåverkan, tillgång på skräpmat och ett konkurrenskraftigt samhälle. Hon hoppas att "Table for Two" ska leda till större förståelse och mindre dömande mot personer med ätstörningar, och öka medvetenheten om hur sådana problem har djupa rötter i samhälle och familjehistoria.

Filmen visas nu i Women’s Voices-sektionen på London Korean Film Festival, där publik och filmmakare fortfarande möts för meningsfulla samtal.

article_content: With Father's Day approaching—a time to celebrate the vital role dads play in families—concerns are mounting over how they're often depicted in popular culture. Television and advertising frequently show fathers as clumsy or foolish, perpetuating stereotypes that don't reflect their actual contributions. Well-known TV dads like Homer Simpson, Daddy Pig from Peppa Pig, and Fred Flintstone are usually portrayed as inept or laughable. According to a recent Netmums survey, 93% of parents believe these depictions do not match real-life fatherhood, and nine out of ten dads say they’re working harder than previous generations to support their families. Such portrayals aren’t limited to cartoons—many TV shows and adverts regularly feature fathers as out of touch or marginal, while mothers are shown as the family’s capable organizers. This can diminish the perceived value of fathers, even though many are making significant efforts at home. Academic research shows children do better with involved dads, but this is rarely acknowledged on screen. Increasingly, parents and advocates are calling for more balanced, respectful representations. While comic stereotypes aren't intended to offend, many fathers feel media images don’t reflect their true role. This is despite statistics noting a record number of stay-at-home dads and the dedication displayed by parents today. As awareness grows about the need for strong, positive male role models, especially during Father's Day, there’s a push to honor what fathers genuinely do—rather than mock them.

Tv och reklam skildrar ofta pappor som klumpiga eller lite okunniga, stereotyper som inte återspeglar deras verkliga betydelse. Kända tv-pappor som Homer Simpson, Daddy Pig från Peppa Pig och Fred Flintstone beskrivs ofta som lite tafatta eller löjeväckande. Enligt en färsk Netmums-undersökning tycker 93 % av föräldrarna att dessa framställningar inte stämmer överens med verkligheten, och nio av tio pappor säger att de anstränger sig hårdare än sina egna pappor för att stötta sina familjer. Sådana porträtt begränsas inte till animerade serier – i många tv-program och annonser visas pappor ofta som ointresserade eller i bakgrunden, medan mammor lyfts fram som de som har koll och styr upp. Detta riskerar att förringa pappors verkliga insats, trots att många är väldigt engagerade hemma. Forskning visar att barn lyckas bättre med engagerade pappor, men det syns inte mycket i media. Allt fler föräldrar och debattörer efterlyser nu mer balanserade och respektfulla bilder av pappor. Trots att komiska stereotyper inte alltid är illa menade känner många pappor att mediebilden inte gör dem rättvisa – trots statistik om rekordmånga hemmavarande pappor och stort engagemang i dagens familjer. Med ökad medvetenhet om vikten av positiva manliga förebilder, särskilt vid Fars dag, ropar allt fler efter att uppmärksamma och hylla pappor för det de faktiskt gör – istället för att bara skämta om dem.

WASHINGTON: After Hamas militants took hostages in their deadly October 7 attack on southern Israel, the government of Qatar contacted the White House with a request: establish a small team of advisers to help secure the captives’ release. This effort, launched in the days immediately following the abductions, eventually resulted in a prisoner swap deal brokered by Qatar and Egypt, and agreed upon by Israel, Hamas, and the United States.

The secretive operation involved intense diplomatic engagement from US President Joe Biden, who held a series of urgent conversations with Qatar’s Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in the weeks prior to the deal. The negotiations required hours of meticulous work by senior US officials including Secretary of State Antony Blinken, CIA Director Bill Burns, National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan and his deputy Jon Finer, and US Middle East envoy Brett McGurk.

According to officials involved, shortly after October 7, Qatar—an experienced mediator in the region—approached the White House with sensitive information about the hostages and the likelihood of their release. The Qatari officials requested the formation of a discreet “cell” to collaborate directly with Israeli counterparts. Sullivan tasked McGurk and another National Security Council official, Josh Geltzer, with establishing the team. McGurk, a seasoned Middle East diplomat, engaged in daily discussions with Qatar’s Prime Minister, Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani, and reported back to Sullivan, with Biden receiving daily briefings.

President Biden became personally acquainted with the hostages’ suffering during an emotional October 13 meeting with the families of Americans who were missing or being held. Days later, on October 18, he traveled to Tel Aviv for talks with Netanyahu. According to officials, securing the hostages’ release and providing humanitarian aid were central topics. On October 23, these efforts facilitated the release of two American hostages, Natalie and Judith Raanan. Their return demonstrated the possibility of freeing more hostages, bolstering Biden’s confidence in the process mediated by Qatar.

Subsequently, the pace accelerated to free additional captives. CIA Director Burns began direct communications with the Mossad chief. On October 24, as Israel prepared for a potential ground offensive in Gaza, US officials learned Hamas had agreed to a preliminary deal to release women and children in exchange for a pause in military action. Israel hesitated, citing insufficient guarantees and no evidence confirming the hostages’ conditions. Hamas maintained they could not verify the captives’ identities until after a pause was enacted, a position viewed skeptically by US and Israeli negotiators. Israel’s invasion plans were modified to allow flexibility for a potential pause.

Over the following weeks, Biden was closely engaged in shifting negotiations, demanding that Hamas provide clear information about the hostages. Communications were lengthy and indirect, as messages passed through Doha or Cairo into Gaza and back. Biden made an unreported call to the Qatari prime minister as plans for the phased releases crystallized. The developing deal proposed that women and children would be released first, alongside Palestinian prisoners. Hamas committed to freeing 50 hostages in the initial phase, yet did not specify identities.

Three days later, Biden called the Qatari emir, insisting on a list of the 50 hostages with their ages, genders, and nationalities. Promptly after this call, Hamas provided the needed details. In a November 14 call, Biden encouraged Netanyahu to accept the agreement. Netanyahu acquiesced, and McGurk reiterated the importance of the deal in person. As talks stalled due to communication outages in Gaza, Biden again contacted the Qatari emir, who pledged to pressure Hamas to conclude negotiations.

On November 18, McGurk met the Qatari prime minister in Doha, with Burns dialing in after calls with Mossad. The group identified remaining obstacles, and in Cairo the following morning, McGurk consulted with Egypt’s intelligence chief. Final messages from Hamas leaders indicated acceptance of almost all agreements formulated in Doha. After a flurry of contact among negotiators, the deal was finalized.

WASHINGTON: Efter att Hamas-militanter tagit gisslan under sitt dödliga angrepp på södra Israel den 7 oktober, kontaktade Qatars regering Vita huset med en begäran: bilda ett litet rådgivarteam för att arbeta för att få gisslan frigiven. Detta initiativ, som sattes igång direkt efter kidnappningarna, ledde till slut till ett fångutbyte förhandlat av Qatar och Egypten och godkänt av Israel, Hamas och USA.

Den hemliga operationen involverade intensiva diplomatiska insatser från USA:s president Joe Biden, som förde flera akuta samtal med Qatars emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani och Israels premiärminister Benjamin Netanyahu veckorna före avtalet. Förhandlingarna krävde många timmars noggrant arbete från höga amerikanska tjänstemän, inklusive utrikesminister Antony Blinken, CIA-chefen Bill Burns, nationella säkerhetsrådgivaren Jake Sullivan och hans biträdande Jon Finer, samt Mellanösternsändebudet Brett McGurk.

Enligt involverade tjänstemän kontaktade Qatar strax efter 7 oktober Vita huset med känslig information om gisslan och deras möjliga frigivning. Qatars representanter bad om att bilda en diskret "cell" för att samarbeta direkt med israeliska myndigheter. Sullivan gav McGurk och nationella säkerhetsrådets tjänsteman Josh Geltzer uppdraget att skapa teamet. McGurk, en erfaren diplomat i Mellanöstern, hade dagliga samtal med Qatars premiärminister Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani och rapporterade till Sullivan, medan Biden fick dagliga lägesrapporter.

President Biden fick personligen inblick i gisslans situation under ett känslosamt möte den 13 oktober med familjer till saknade eller tillfångatagna amerikaner. Några dagar senare, den 18 oktober, reste han till Tel Aviv för samtal med Netanyahu. Enligt tjänstemän var gisslan och humanitärt bistånd centrala frågor. Den 23 oktober ledde dessa ansträngningar till att de två amerikanska gisslan, Natalie och Judith Raanan, släpptes. Deras återkomst visade att en frigivning var möjlig och ökade Bidens förtroende för processen med Qatars medling.

Därefter ökade ansträngningarna för att frigöra fler gisslan. CIA-chefen Burns började föra direkta samtal med Mossads chef. Den 24 oktober, när Israel förberedde en möjlig markoffensiv i Gaza, fick amerikanska tjänstemän information om att Hamas hade gått med på en första överenskommelse om att släppa kvinnor och barn mot ett tillfälligt stopp av militära åtgärder. Israel tvekade på grund av bristande garantier och avsaknad av bevis om gisslans tillstånd. Hamas hävdade att de inte kunde fastställa identiteter förrän en paus inleddes, vilket betraktades med skepsis från amerikanska och israeliska förhandlare. Israels invasionsplan förändrades för att ge utrymme till en möjlig paus om en överenskommelse nåddes.

Under de kommande veckorna var Biden aktivt involverad i förhandlingarna och krävde tydlig information från Hamas om gisslan. Kommunikationsvägarna var långa och indirekta, där meddelanden sändes via Doha eller Kairo till Gaza och tillbaka. Biden genomförde ett tidigare okänt samtal med Qatars premiärminister när planeringen av etappvisa frigivningar tog sig form. Planen var att kvinnor och barn skulle släppas först, tillsammans med palestinska fångar. Hamas lovade att släppa 50 personer i första omgången, men specificerade inte vilka.

Tre dagar senare ringde Biden emiren av Qatar och krävde en lista med namn, ålder, kön och nationalitet på de 50 gisslan. Kort efter det samtalet lämnade Hamas uppgifterna. I ett samtal den 14 november uppmanade Biden Netanyahu att acceptera uppgörelsen, vilket han gjorde. McGurk underströk avtalets betydelse vid ett möte i Israel. När kommunikationen bröts i Gaza kontaktade Biden åter Qatars emir, som då lovade att sätta press på Hamas för att få till en avslutning.

Den 18 november träffade McGurk Qatars premiärminister i Doha, där Burns deltog via länk efter samtal med Mossad. Gruppen identifierade de sista hindren, och dagen efter mötte McGurk chefen för egyptisk underrättelsetjänst i Kairo. Slutligen indikerade Hamas-ledare att de accepterat nästan alla avtal som utarbetats i Doha. Efter intensiva kontakter mellan förhandlarna kunde avtalet slutligen slutföras.

article_content: Jio Financial Services, recently carved out from Reliance Industries, is in the early stages of discussions with merchant bankers regarding its maiden bond issuance, according to four bankers who spoke to Reuters. The company may look to raise between Rs 5,000 crore ($600.6 million) and Rs 10,000 crore through the bond issue, which could take place in the last quarter of the current financial year. Currently, Jio Financial is in the process of securing its credit rating and obtaining necessary regulatory approvals. The bankers requested anonymity as they are not authorised to speak with the media, and Jio Financial did not immediately respond to Reuters’ request for comment. Listed in August, Jio Financial intends to become a comprehensive financial services provider, with offerings such as auto and home loans, entering competition with established players like Bajaj Finance. Venkatakrishnan Srinivasan, founder and managing partner at Rockfort Fincap, noted, 'Jio Financial has strong promoter backing, so it is expected to automatically receive a AAA credit rating.' He added that, as a non-banking financial company (NBFC), Jio Financial's bond pricing would likely be 10-20 basis points higher than Reliance Industries, depending on factors like tenor and balance sheet size at the time of issuance. Earlier this month, Reliance Industries raised 200 billion rupees through a record 10-year bond issue, paying 40 basis points above the government’s borrowing cost—the largest such issuance by an Indian non-financial firm. In anticipation of the bond sale, some bankers have recommended that Jio Financial first issue short-term commercial papers and establish bank borrowing lines to help determine pricing. They also recommended bonds with maturities not exceeding five years. 'Since the company is new, documentation and compliance will take time, but we may see the issue before the end of March,' a merchant banker at a private bank commented.
translated_content: Jio Financial Services, som nyligen separerats från Reliance Industries, befinner sig i de tidiga stadierna av diskussioner med investeringsbanker om sin första obligationsutgivning, enligt fyra bankirer som talat med Reuters. Företaget kan komma att vilja ta in mellan 5 000 crore rupier (600,6 miljoner dollar) och 10 000 crore rupier genom emissionen, som kan ske under det sista kvartalet av det nuvarande räkenskapsåret. Jio Financial håller för närvarande på att säkra sitt kreditbetyg och erhålla nödvändiga myndighetsgodkännanden. Bankirerna bad om anonymitet då de inte är auktoriserade att tala med media, och Jio Financial svarade inte omedelbart på Reuters förfrågan om kommentar. Bolaget, som börsnoterades i augusti, siktar på att bli en heltäckande finansiell aktör med erbjudanden som bil- och bolån, och ska konkurrera med etablerade företag som Bajaj Finance. Venkatakrishnan Srinivasan, grundare och managing partner på Rockfort Fincap, noterade: "Jio Financial har starkt stöd från sin ägare, så bolaget förväntas automatiskt få ett AAA-kreditbetyg." Han tillade att eftersom företaget är ett NBFC (icke-bankfinansiellt företag), kommer obligationsprissättningen troligen ligga 10–20 punkter högre än Reliance Industries, beroende på löptid och balansräkning vid emissionstillfället. Tidigare denna månad tog Reliance Industries in 200 miljarder rupier genom en rekordstor 10-årsobligation, där bolaget betalade 40 punkter mer än statens lånekostnad—den största obligationsemissionen hittills för ett icke-finansiellt indiskt företag. Inför obligationsförsäljningen har vissa bankirer rekommenderat att Jio Financial först ger ut kortfristiga kommersiella papper och etablerar kreditlinjer hos banker för att fastställa prissättningen. De rekommenderade också obligationer med en löptid på maximalt fem år. "Eftersom företaget är nytt kommer dokumentation och regelefterlevnad ta tid, men vi kan se emissionen före slutet av mars," kommenterade en merchant banker på en privat bank.

article_content: This year, the pitching section of the Taiwan Creative Content Fest (TCCF) expanded to include international submissions, moving beyond its earlier exclusive focus on Taiwanese projects. This new direction attracted 539 entries from 20 different regions, such as Taiwan, Japan, Korea, Indonesia, Singapore, Iran, France, and the United States. After thorough assessment by four panels, 43 projects were chosen for the final pitching rounds across Feature Films, Series, Animation, and Documentary categories. Noteworthy filmmakers selected include Japan’s Koji Fukada, Indonesia’s Edwin, the Philippines’ Sheron Deyoc, and Anshul Chauhan, an Indian-origin director now based in Japan. Additionally, ten Taiwanese intellectual properties (IPs) with strong adaptation potential, from companies like Kadokawa Taiwan, Mirror Fiction, and Naver Webtoon, are included among the contenders. All selected projects are eligible for awards totaling over $150,000. The top honor, the TCCF Award: Best Project, carries a $30,000 prize, while other awards come from international partners like Series Mania, Warner Bros Discovery, the Udine Far East Film Festival, and the Motion Picture Association. Among the IPs, three will receive the TCCF Award: Best Story along with $3,000 each, with further support available from Taiwanese broadcasters Sanlih and Gala Television. The pitching and IP showcase are central features of TCCF, which is organized by the Taiwan Creative Content Agency (TAICCA). The agency’s mission is to promote local content and build international connections. This year’s event is scheduled from November 7-10 at the Songshan Cultural and Creative Park in Taipei. Project highlights include Koji Fukada’s 'Nagi Note' in tribute to French filmmaker Eric Rohmer, Edwin’s 'Sleep No More' penned by renowned Indonesian author Eka Kurniawan, Sheron Deyoc’s 'Mother Maybe' produced in collaboration with partners from the Philippines and Singapore, and Anshul Chauhan’s 'Tides', a joint production between Japan and Taiwan. Taiwanese director Lingo Hsieh debuts her first English-language feature, 'The Shadows', produced by Japan’s Takashige Ichise. In the series lineup, Malaysian director Edmund Yeo is adapting 'The Last Children Of Tokyo' as a co-production with Taiwan’s Betula Films, Flash Forward Entertainment, and Japan’s NHK. Other notable Taiwanese series are 'So May We Start' by Teng I-Hang and 'I Wish You Happiness' by Chen Weiling, acclaimed for 'On Children'. In animation, French director Denis Do presents 'Sorya', which follows a young woman seeking new beginnings in the city. Documentary entries include 'Island Of The Winds', focusing on Taiwan’s Losheng Sanatorium and a Cannes Docs-in-Progress winner, along with 'Palimpsest: Traces Of A Name' by Mary Stephen. Qualifying projects can also apply for support from TAICCA’s funding schemes—Creative Content Development Program (CCDP) and Taiwan International Co-funding Program (TICP)—offering up to $300,000 in additional backing. Participants also gain access to pitching workshops and investor meetings before and during the festival. Since launching in 2020, TCCF has combined established industry events into a single program, featuring content pitching, a creative marketplace, and innovations in audiovisual technology.
